import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import {  VibePlace,  VibeCategory,  DeviceLocationState,  UserCoordinates} from './types';

export const DISCOVERY_RADIUS_METERS = 8000; // 8 km leisure discovery scope

/** * Calculates great-circle distance between two coordinates in meters (Haversine formula). */export function calculateDistanceMeters(  lat1: number,  lon1: number,  lat2: number,  lon2: number): number {  const R = 6371e3; // Earth radius in meters  const φ1 = (lat1 * Math.PI) / 180;  const φ2 = (lat2 * Math.PI) / 180;  const Δφ = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;  const Δλ = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;  const a =    Math.sin(Δφ / 2) * Math.sin(Δφ / 2) +    Math.cos(φ1) * Math.cos(φ2) * Math.sin(Δλ / 2) * Math.sin(Δλ / 2);  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));  return Math.round(R * c);}

/** * Requests device location once via navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition. */export function getDeviceLocation(): Promise<DeviceLocationState> {  return new Promise((resolve) => {    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator.geolocation) {      resolve({        status: 'unavailable',        coords: null,        error: 'Geolocation is not supported by your browser or environment.'      });      return;    }    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(      (position) => {        resolve({          status: 'granted',          coords: {            lat: position.coords.latitude,            lng: position.coords.longitude,            accuracy: position.coords.accuracy          }        });      },      (error) => {        let status: DeviceLocationState['status'] = 'unavailable';        let errorMsg = 'Unable to determine your position.';        if (error.code === error.PERMISSION_DENIED) {          status = 'denied';          errorMsg = 'Location permission was denied. Please allow location access in your browser settings to enable proximity discovery.';        } else if (error.code === error.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE) {          status = 'unavailable';          errorMsg = 'GPS sensor or location provider is unavailable.';        } else if (error.code === error.TIMEOUT) {          status = 'unavailable';          errorMsg = 'Location acquisition timed out.';        }        resolve({          status,          coords: null,          error: errorMsg        });      },      {        enableHighAccuracy: true,        timeout: 10000,        maximumAge: 30000      }    );  });}

/** * Continuously watches device location changes and informs subscriber. */export function watchDeviceLocation(  onUpdate: (state: DeviceLocationState) => void): () => void {  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator.geolocation) {    onUpdate({      status: 'unavailable',      coords: null,      error: 'Geolocation is not supported by this browser.'    });    return () => {};  }  const watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(    (position) => {      onUpdate({        status: 'granted',        coords: {          lat: position.coords.latitude,          lng: position.coords.longitude,          accuracy: position.coords.accuracy        }      });    },    (error) => {      let status: DeviceLocationState['status'] = 'unavailable';      let errorMsg = 'Location error occurred.';      if (error.code === error.PERMISSION_DENIED) {        status = 'denied';        errorMsg = 'Location access denied by user.';      } else if (error.code === error.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE) {        status = 'unavailable';        errorMsg = 'Location signal currently unavailable.';      } else if (error.code === error.TIMEOUT) {        status = 'location request timed out.';      }      onUpdate({        status,        coords: null,        error: errorMsg      });    },    {      enableHighAccuracy: true,      timeout: 15000,      maximumAge: 10000    }  );  return () => {    navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(watchId);  };}

/** * Public domain API: Fetches real nearby places from the Supabase Edge Function 'nearby-places' * and enriches them with real database rows from Supabase (promotions, validations, check-ins, meetups). */export async function fetchNearbyPlaces(  coords: UserCoordinates | null,  category?: VibeCategory | 'All'): Promise<VibePlace[]> {  let targetCoords = coords;  if (!targetCoords || isNaN(targetCoords.lat) || isNaN(targetCoords.lng)) {    const locState = await getDeviceLocation();    if (locState.status === 'granted' && locState.coords) {      targetCoords = locState.coords;    }  }  if (!targetCoords || isNaN(targetCoords.lat) || isNaN(targetCoords.lng)) {    return [];  }  try {    const selectedCategory = category || 'All';    const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('nearby-places', {      body: {        lat: targetCoords.lat,        lng: targetCoords.lng,
        radius: DISCOVERY_RADIUS_METERS,
        category: selectedCategory
      }
    });
    if (error || !data || !Array.isArray(data.places)) {
      if (error) {
        console.warn('Error invoking nearby-places Edge Function:', error);
      }
      return [];
    }

    const rawPlaces = data.places;
    const placeIds = rawPlaces.map((p: any) => p.id).filter(Boolean);

    let promoMap: Record<string, any> = {};
    let validationSummaryMap: Record<string, { avg: number; count: number }> = {};
    let checkinCountMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    let meetupCountMap: Record<string, number> = {};

    if (placeIds.length > 0) {
      const [promosRes, validationsRes, checkinsRes, meetupsRes] = await Promise.all([
        supabase.from('place_promotions').select('*').in('place_id', placeIds).eq('status', 'active'),
        supabase.from('place_validations').select('place_id, resulting_confidence').in('place_id', placeIds),
        supabase.from('place_checkins').select('place_id').in('place_id', placeIds),
        supabase.from('place_meetups').select('place_id, expires_at').in('place_id', placeIds).gt('expires_at', new Date().toISOString())
      ]);

      if (promosRes.data) {
        promosRes.data.forEach((r: any) => {
          if (r.remaining_vq_pool >= (r.reward_per_checkin || 500)) {
            promoMap[r.place_id] = r;
          }
        });
      }

      if (validationsRes.data) {
        const grouped: Record<string, number[]> = {};
        validationsRes.data.forEach((r: any) => {
          if (!grouped[r.place_id]) grouped[r.place_id] = [];
          if (typeof r.resulting_confidence === 'number') {
            grouped[r.place_id].push(r.resulting_confidence);
          }
        });
        Object.entries(grouped).forEach(([pid, confs]) => {
          const sum = confs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
          validationSummaryMap[pid] = {
            avg: Math.round(sum / confs.length),
            count: confs.length
          };
        });
      }

      if (checkinsRes.data) {
        checkinsRes.data.forEach((r: any) => {
          checkinCountMap[r.place_id] = (checkinCountMap[r.place_id] || 0) + 1;
        });
      }

      if (meetupsRes.data) {
        meetupsRes.data.forEach((r: any) => {
          meetupCountMap[r.place_id] = (meetupCountMap[r.place_id] || 0) + 1;
        });
      }
    }

    const places: VibePlace[] = rawPlaces.map((p: any) => {
      const dist =
        typeof p.distance_meters === 'number'
          ? p.distance_meters
          : calculateDistanceMeters(targetCoords!.lat, targetCoords!.lng, p.lat, p.lng);

      const promo = promoMap[p.id];
      const valSum = validationSummaryMap[p.id];
      const checkins = checkinCountMap[p.id] || 0;
      const meetups = meetupCountMap[p.id] || 0;

      const isPromoted = Boolean(promo && promo.remaining_vq_pool >= promo.reward_per_checkin);
      const vqReward = isPromoted ? Number(promo.reward_per_checkin || 500) : undefined;
      const promotionPool = isPromoted ? Number(promo.remaining_vq_pool || 0) : undefined;
      const vibeConfidence = valSum ? valSum.avg : (p.vibe_confidence ?? undefined);
      const confirmationsCount = valSum ? valSum.count : (p.confirmations_count ?? 0);

      return {
        ...p,
        distance_meters: dist,
        distance_km: Number((dist / 1000).toFixed(2)),
        is_promoted: isPromoted,
        vq_reward: vqReward,
        promotion_pool: promotionPool,
        vibe_confidence: vibeConfidence,
        confirmations_count: confirmationsCount,
        checkins_count: checkins,
        active_meetups_count: meetups
      };
    });

    return places;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('fetchNearbyPlaces failure:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

export const fetchNearbyVibeVibePlaces = fetchNearbyPlaces;
export const fetchNearbyVibePlaces = fetchNearbyPlaces;

export async function fetchVibePlaces(category?: VibeCategory): Promise<VibePlace[]> {
  return fetchNearbyPlaces(null, category);
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';

export function calculateHaversineMeters(
  lat1: number,
  lon1: number,
  lat2: number,
  lon2: number
): number {
  const R = 6371e3;
  const toRad = (deg: number) => (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLat = toRad(lat2 - lat1);
  const dLon = toRad(lon2 - lon1);
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.cos(toRad(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRad(lat2)) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) * Math.sin(dLon / 2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return R * c;
}

export const calculateDistanceMeters = calculateHaversineMeters;

export async function uploadReceiptPhotoToStorage(fileOrBlob: File | Blob): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const fileName = `receipt-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8)}.jpg`;
    const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
      .from('vibe-media')
      .upload(fileName, fileOrBlob, { cacheControl: '3600', upsert: false });
    if (error || !data) return null;
    const { data: publicUrlData } = supabase.storage.from('vibe-media').getPublicUrl(data.path);
    return publicUrlData?.publicUrl || null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function submitLiveCheckVerification(payload: {
  placeId: string;
  placeTitle: string;
  placeCategory?: string;
  userId: string;
  userName?: string;
  userHandle?: string;
  userAvatar?: string;
  distanceMeters: number;
  hasReceipt: boolean;
  receiptPhotoUrl?: string;
  verdict?: 'yes' | 'no';
  initialRating?: number;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; vqEarned: number; resultingConfidence?: number; error?: string }> {
  const {
    placeId,
    placeTitle,
    placeCategory = 'Spots',
    userId,
    userName = 'Voyager',
    userHandle = '@voyager',
    userAvatar = '',
    distanceMeters,
    hasReceipt,
    receiptPhotoUrl,
    verdict = 'yes',
    initialRating = 4.2
  } = payload;

  if (distanceMeters > 33) {
    return { success: false, vqEarned: 0, error: 'Distance exceeds 33-meter strict geofence.' };
  }

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('rpc_submit_checkin_and_validation', {
      p_place_id: placeId,
      p_place_title: placeTitle,
      p_place_category: placeCategory,
      p_user_id: userId,
      p_user_name: userName,
      p_user_handle: userHandle,
      p_user_avatar: userAvatar,
      p_distance_meters: distanceMeters,
      p_verdict: verdict,
      p_initial_rating: initialRating,
      p_has_livecheck_receipt: hasReceipt,
      p_receipt_photo_url: receiptPhotoUrl || null
    });
    if (error || !data?.success) {
      return { success: false, vqEarned: 0, error: error?.message || data?.error || 'LiveCheck RPC failed' };
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      vqEarned: Number(data.vq_rewarded || 0),
      resultingConfidence: Number(data.resulting_confidence || 85)
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, vqEarned: 0, error: err?.message || 'Network error' };
  }
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { PlacePromotion } from './types';
import { executeVqTransfer } from '../d06_purse/api';

export async function fetchActivePromotions(): Promise<Record<string, PlacePromotion>> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('place_promotions')
      .select('*')
      .eq('status', 'active');
    if (error || !data) return {};
    const map: Record<string, PlacePromotion> = {};
    data.forEach((row: any) => {
      map[row.place_id] = {
        id: String(row.id),
        place_id: String(row.place_id),
        place_title: String(row.place_title || ''),
        sponsor_user_id: String(row.sponsor_user_id || ''),
        total_vq_funded: Number(row.total_vq_funded || 0),
        remaining_vq_pool: Number(row.remaining_vq_pool || 0),
        reward_per_checkin: Number(row.reward_per_checkin || 500),
        status: row.status,
        created_at: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()
      };
    });
    return map;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

export async function fetchPromotionForPlace(placeId: string): Promise<PlacePromotion | null> {
  const map = await fetchActivePromotions();
  return map[placeId] || null;
}

export async function createOrFundPromotion(payload: {
  placeId: string;
  placeTitle: string;
  sponsorUserId: string;
  totalVqFunded: number;
  rewardPerCheckin: number;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; promotion?: PlacePromotion; error?: string }> {
  const { placeId, placeTitle, sponsorUserId, totalVqFunded, rewardPerCheckin } = payload;
  if (totalVqFunded <= 0 || rewardPerCheckin <= 0) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Funded amount and reward must be greater than zero.' };
  }

  const transfer = await executeVqTransfer({
    toUserId: 'sponsor_pool',
    amount: totalVqFunded,
    type: 'spend',
    description: `Promoted ${placeTitle} with reward pool (+${rewardPerCheckin} VQ)`
  });
  if (!transfer.success) {
    return { success: false, error: transfer.error || 'Failed to allocate VQ tokens.' };
  }

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('rpc_fund_place_promotion', {
      p_place_id: placeId,
      p_place_title: placeTitle,
      p_user_id: sponsorUserId,
      p_vq_amount: totalVqFunded,
      p_reward_per_checkin: rewardPerCheckin
    });
    if (error || !data?.success) {
      return { success: false, error: error?.message || data?.error || 'Database RPC promotion funding failed' };
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      promotion: {
        id: data.promotion_id || `promo-${Date.now()}`,
        place_id: placeId,
        place_title: placeTitle,
        sponsor_user_id: sponsorUserId,
        total_vq_funded: totalVqFunded,
        remaining_vq_pool: totalVqFunded,
        reward_per_checkin: rewardPerCheckin,
        status: 'active',
        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Promotion network error' };
  }
}

export async function fetchPlaceCheckinsCount(placeId: string): Promise<number> {
  try {
    const { count, error } = await supabase
      .from('place_checkins')
      .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('place_id', placeId);
    if (!error && typeof count === 'number') {
      return count;
    }
  } catch {}
  return 0;
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { PlaceValidation } from './types';

export async function fetchValidationsForPlace(placeId: string): Promise<PlaceValidation[]> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('place_validations')
      .select('*')
      .eq('place_id', placeId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    if (error || !data) return [];
    return data.map((row: any) => ({
      id: String(row.id),
      place_id: String(row.place_id),
      user_id: String(row.user_id),
      verdict: row.verdict,
      confidence_delta: Number(row.confidence_delta || 0),
      resulting_confidence: Number(row.resulting_confidence || 80),
      vibe_tags: row.vibe_tags || [],
      comment: row.comment || '',
      created_at: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()
    }));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export async function submitPlaceValidation(payload: {
  placeId: string;
  userId: string;
  verdict: 'yes' | 'no';
  initialRating?: number;
  vibeTags?: string[];
  comment?: string;
  distanceMeters: number;

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { PlaceMeetup } from './types';

export async function fetchPlaceMeetups(placeId?: string): Promise<PlaceMeetup[]> {
  try {
    let query = supabase.from('place_meetups').select('*');
    if (placeId) {
      query = query.eq('place_id', placeId);
    }
    const { data, error } = await query.order('starts_at', { ascending: true });
    if (error || !data) return [];
    return data.map((row: any) => ({
      id: String(row.id),
      place_id: String(row.place_id),
      place_title: String(row.place_title || ''),
      place_address: String(row.place_address || ''),
      place_category: String(row.place_category || 'Spots'),
      lat: Number(row.lat || 0),
      lng: Number(row.lng || 0),
      host_user_id: String(row.host_user_id || ''),
      host_name: String(row.host_name || 'Host'),
      host_avatar: row.host_avatar || '',
      title: String(row.title || ''),
      description: String(row.description || ''),
      photo_url: row.photo_url || '',
      starts_at: row.starts_at || new Date().toISOString(),
      expires_at: row.expires_at || new Date(Date.now() + 3600000).toISOString(),
      max_capacity: Number(row.max_capacity || 10),
      attendee_ids: row.attendee_ids || [],
      verified_arrived_ids: row.verified_arrived_ids || []
    }));
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

export async function createPlaceMeetup(payload: {
  placeId: string;
  placeTitle: string;
  placeAddress?: string;
  placeCategory?: string;
  lat?: number;
  lng?: number;
  hostUserId: string;
  hostName: string;
  hostAvatar?: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  photoUrl?: string;
  startsAt: string;
  expiresAt: string;
  maxCapacity?: number;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; meetup?: PlaceMeetup; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('place_meetups')
      .insert([{
        place_id: payload.placeId,
        place_title: payload.placeTitle,
        place_address: payload.placeAddress || '',
        place_category: payload.placeCategory || 'Spots',
        lat: payload.lat || 0,
        lng: payload.lng || 0,
        host_user_id: payload.hostUserId,
        host_name: payload.hostName,
        host_avatar: payload.hostAvatar || '',
        title: payload.title,
        description: payload.description,
        photo_url: payload.photoUrl || null,
        starts_at: payload.startsAt,
        expires_at: payload.expiresAt,
        max_capacity: payload.maxCapacity || 10,
        attendee_ids: [payload.hostUserId]
      }])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error || !data) {
      return { success: false, error: error?.message || 'Failed to create meetup' };
    }
    return { success: true, meetup: data as PlaceMeetup };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Meetup network error' };
  }
}

export async function toggleMeetupRsvp(meetupId: string, userId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; isAttending?: boolean; attendeeCount?: number }> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('rpc_toggle_meetup_rsvp', {
      p_meetup_id: meetupId,
      p_user_id: userId
    });
    if (error || !data?.success) {
      return { success: false };
    }
    return { success: true, isAttending: data.is_attending, attendeeCount: data.attendee_count };
  } catch {
    return { success: false };
  }
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { VibeFlashItem } from './types';

export async function fetchActiveVibeFlashes(): Promise<VibeFlashItem[]> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('rpc_get_unified_vibe_flash_board');
    if (error || !data) {
      const { data: tableData } = await supabase
        .from('vibe_flash_events')
        .select('*')
        .order('starts_at', { ascending: true });
      if (!tableData) return [];
      return tableData.map((row: any) => formatFlashRow(row));
    }
    const flashes = data.vibe_flashes || [];
    const meetupsAsFlashes = (data.upcoming_meetups || []).map((m: any) => ({
      id: m.id,
      title: m.title,
      description: m.description,
      vibe_type: 'Meetup',
      place_id: m.place_id,
      venue_name: m.place_title,
      address: m.place_address,
      lat: m.lat || 0,
      lng: m.lng || 0,
      creator_id: m.host_user_id,
      creator_name: m.host_name,
      creator_avatar: m.host_avatar,
      photo_url: m.photo_url,
      starts_at: m.starts_at,
      expires_at: m.expires_at,
      entry_type: 'Free',
      vq_hunt_pool: 0,
      vq_reward_per_hunter: 500,
      max_capacity: m.max_capacity,
      interested_ids: [],
      going_ids: m.attendee_ids || [],
      created_at: m.created_at
    }));

    return [...flashes.map((r: any) => formatFlashRow(r)), ...meetupsAsFlashes];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function formatFlashRow(row: any): VibeFlashItem {
  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    title: String(row.title || ''),
    description: String(row.description || ''),
    vibe_type: String(row.vibe_type || 'Secret'),
    place_id: row.place_id || undefined,
    venue_name: String(row.venue_name || ''),
    address: row.address || '',
    lat: Number(row.lat || 0),
    lng: Number(row.lng || 0),
    creator_id: String(row.creator_id || ''),
    creator_name: String(row.creator_name || 'Creator'),
    creator_avatar: row.creator_avatar || '',
    photo_url: row.photo_url || '',
    starts_at: row.starts_at || new Date().toISOString(),
    expires_at: row.expires_at || new Date(Date.now() + 3600000).toISOString(),
    entry_type: row.entry_type || 'Free',
    entry_price_tnd: row.entry_price_tnd,
    entry_rules: row.entry_rules,
    parking_transport_notes: row.parking_transport_notes,
    vq_hunt_pool: Number(row.vq_hunt_pool || 0),
    vq_reward_per_hunter: Number(row.vq_reward_per_hunter || 500),
    max_capacity: Number(row.max_capacity || 20),
    interested_ids: row.interested_ids || [],
    going_ids: row.going_ids || [],
    verified_arrived_ids: row.verified_arrived_ids || [],
    claimed_reward_ids: row.claimed_reward_ids || [],
    created_at: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

export async function createVibeFlashEvent(payload: any): Promise<{ success: boolean; event?: VibeFlashItem; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('vibe_flash_events')
      .insert([{
        title: payload.title,
        description: payload.description,
        vibe_type: payload.vibeType || 'Secret',
        place_id: payload.placeId || null,
        venue_name: payload.venueName,
        address: payload.address || '',
        lat: payload.lat,
        lng: payload.lng,
        creator_id: payload.creatorId,
        creator_name: payload.creatorName,
        creator_avatar: payload.creatorAvatar || '',
        photo_url: payload.photoUrl || null,
        starts_at: payload.startsAt,
        expires_at: payload.expiresAt,
        entry_type: payload.entryType || 'Free',
        entry_price_tnd: payload.entryPriceTnd || null,
        entry_rules: payload.entryRules || null,
        parking_transport_notes: payload.parkingTransportNotes || null,
        vq_hunt_pool: payload.vqHuntPool || 0,
        vq_reward_per_hunter: payload.vqRewardPerHunter || 500,
        max_capacity: payload.maxCapacity || 20,
        going_ids: [payload.creatorId]
      }])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error || !data) {
      return { success: false, error: error?.message || 'Failed to create Vibe Flash event' };
    }
    return { success: true, event: formatFlashRow(data) };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Vibe flash network error' };
  }
}

export async function toggleVibeFlashRsvp(flashId: string, userId: string, mode: 'interested' | 'going'): Promise<{ success: boolean; status?: string }> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('rpc_toggle_vibe_flash_rsvp', {
      p_flash_id: flashId,
      p_user_id: userId,
      p_mode: mode
    });
    if (error || !data?.success) {
      return { success: false };
    }
    return { success: true, status: data.status };
  } catch {
    return { success: false };
  }
}

-- RPC 1: rpc_fund_place_promotion (Uses available_balance and logs vq_transactions)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_fund_place_promotion(
  p_place_id TEXT,
  p_place_title TEXT,
  p_user_id UUID,
  p_vq_amount INTEGER,
  p_reward_per_checkin INTEGER DEFAULT 500
) RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_current_bal INTEGER;
  v_promo_id UUID;
BEGIN
  SELECT available_balance INTO v_current_bal FROM public.vq_accounts WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
  IF v_current_bal IS NOT NULL AND v_current_bal < p_vq_amount THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Insufficient VQ balance');
  END IF;

  IF v_current_bal IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.vq_accounts SET available_balance = available_balance - p_vq_amount, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = p_user_id;
  END IF;

  -- Insert ledger transaction
  INSERT INTO public.vq_transactions (idempotency_key, from_user_id, to_user_id, amount, type, status, description)
  VALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, p_user_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid, p_vq_amount, 'spend', 'completed', 'Funded promotion for ' || p_place_title);

  INSERT INTO public.place_promotions (place_id, place_title, sponsor_user_id, total_vq_funded, remaining_vq_pool, reward_per_checkin, status)
  VALUES (p_place_id, p_place_title, p_user_id, p_vq_amount, p_vq_amount, p_reward_per_checkin, 'active')
  RETURNING id INTO v_promo_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'promotion_id', v_promo_id);
END;
$$;

-- RPC 2: rpc_submit_checkin_and_validation (Enforces 12h cooldown, cumulative confidence, available_balance, and vq_transactions)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_submit_checkin_and_validation(
  p_place_id TEXT,
  p_place_title TEXT,
  p_place_category TEXT,
  p_user_id UUID,
  p_user_name TEXT,
  p_user_handle TEXT,
  p_user_avatar TEXT,
  p_distance_meters NUMERIC,
  p_verdict TEXT,
  p_initial_rating NUMERIC,
  p_has_livecheck_receipt BOOLEAN,
  p_receipt_photo_url TEXT,
  p_vibe_tags TEXT[] DEFAULT '{}',
  p_comment TEXT DEFAULT ''
) RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_last_checkin TIMESTAMPTZ;
  v_latest_conf INTEGER;
  v_confidence_delta INTEGER;
  v_computed_confidence INTEGER;
  v_vq_reward INTEGER := 0;
  v_mayor_pts INTEGER := 1;
  v_promo RECORD;
BEGIN
  IF p_distance_meters > 33 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Must be within 33 meters to check-in or validate.');
  END IF;

  -- 12-Hour Cooldown Check
  SELECT created_at INTO v_last_checkin 
  FROM public.place_checkins 
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id AND place_id = p_place_id AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hours' 
  LIMIT 1;

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'You already checked in here within the last 12 hours.');
  END IF;

  -- Cumulative Confidence Math
  SELECT resulting_confidence INTO v_latest_conf 
  FROM public.place_validations 
  WHERE place_id = p_place_id 
  ORDER BY created_at DESC 
  LIMIT 1;

  IF p_verdict = 'yes' THEN
    v_confidence_delta := 15;
  ELSE
    v_confidence_delta := -25;
  END IF;

  IF v_latest_conf IS NOT NULL THEN
    v_computed_confidence := v_latest_conf + v_confidence_delta;
  else
    v_computed_confidence := ROUND(COALESCE(p_initial_rating, 4.2) * 20) + v_confidence_delta;
  END IF;

  v_computed_confidence := GREATEST(10, LEAST(100, v_computed_confidence));

  -- Insert Validation
  INSERT INTO public.place_validations (place_id, user_id, verdict, confidence_delta, resulting_confidence, vibe_tags, comment, distance_meters)
  VALUES (p_place_id, p_user_id, p_verdict, v_confidence_delta, v_computed_confidence, p_vibe_tags, p_comment, p_distance_meters);

  -- LiveCheck reward check
  IF p_has_livecheck_receipt AND p_receipt_photo_url IS NOT NULL AND p_distance_meters <= 33 THEN
    v_vq_reward := 500;
    v_mayor_pts := 2;

    SELECT * INTO v_promo FROM public.place_promotions WHERE place_id = p_place_id AND status = 'active' AND remaining_vq_pool >= 500 LIMIT 1;
    IF FOUND THEN
      UPDATE public.place_promotions 
      SET remaining_vq_pool = remaining_vq_pool - 500,
          status = CASE WHEN remaining_vq_pool - 500 <= 0 THEN 'depleted' ELSE 'active' END,
          updated_at = NOW()
      WHERE id = v_promo.id;
    END IF;

    -- Credit user vq_accounts available_balance
    UPDATE public.vq_accounts SET available_balance = available_balance + 500, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

    -- Log vq_transactions
    INSERT INTO public.vq_transactions (idempotency_key, from_user_id, to_user_id, amount, type, status, description)
    VALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid, p_user_id, 500, 'earned', 'completed', 'LiveCheck reward at ' || p_place_title);
  END IF;

  -- Insert Check-in
  INSERT INTO public.place_checkins (place_id, place_title, place_category, user_id, user_name, user_handle, user_avatar, distance_meters, has_livecheck_receipt, receipt_photo_url, mayor_points, vq_rewarded)
  VALUES (p_place_id, p_place_title, p_place_category, p_user_id, p_user_name, p_user_handle, p_user_avatar, p_distance_meters, p_has_livecheck_receipt, p_receipt_photo_url, v_mayor_pts, v_vq_reward);

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'resulting_confidence', v_computed_confidence,
    'vq_rewarded', v_vq_reward,
    'mayor_points', v_mayor_pts
  );
END;
$$;

-- RPC 3: rpc_get_venue_mayor_and_badges (Calculates category badges and explorer rank)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_venue_mayor_and_badges(
  p_place_id TEXT,
  p_user_id UUID
) RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_mayor RECORD;
  v_total_checkins INTEGER := 0;
  v_unique_places INTEGER := 0;
  v_food_checkins INTEGER := 0;
  v_night_checkins INTEGER := 0;
  v_culture_checkins INTEGER := 0;
  v_explorer_rank TEXT := 'Newcomer';
  v_badges JSONB;
BEGIN
  -- Find mayor
  SELECT user_id, user_name, user_avatar, SUM(mayor_points) as total_points
  INTO v_mayor
  FROM public.place_checkins
  WHERE place_id = p_place_id
  GROUP BY user_id, user_name, user_avatar
  ORDER BY total_points DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  -- Calculate user stats across check-ins
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT(DISTINCT place_id),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(place_category, '')) IN ('food', 'cafe', 'cafés', 'restaurant', 'caffeine', 'spots')),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(place_category, '')) IN ('night owl', 'night_owl', 'bar', 'lounge', 'club')),
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(place_category, '')) IN ('culture', 'art', 'landmark', 'museum'))
  INTO v_total_checkins, v_unique_places, v_food_checkins, v_night_checkins, v_culture_checkins
  FROM public.place_checkins 
  WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

  v_explorer_rank := CASE 
    WHEN v_total_checkins >= 20 THEN 'Vibe Legend'
    WHEN v_total_checkins >= 8 THEN 'Pathfinder'
    WHEN v_total_checkins >= 3 THEN 'Explorer'
    WHEN v_total_checkins >= 1 THEN 'Wanderer'
    ELSE 'Newcomer'
  END;

  v_badges := jsonb_build_object(
    'caffeine_fiend', jsonb_build_object(
      'unlocked', v_food_checkins >= 3,
      'progress', LEAST(3, v_food_checkins),
      'target', 3
    ),
    'gourmet_scout', jsonb_build_object(
      'unlocked', v_food_checkins >= 2,
      'progress', LEAST(2, v_food_checkins),
      'target', 2
    ),
    'night_mayor', jsonb_build_object(
      'unlocked', v_night_checkins >= 2,
      'progress', LEAST(2, v_night_checkins),
      'target', 2
    ),
    'culture_vulture', jsonb_build_object(
      'unlocked', v_culture_checkins >= 2,
      'progress', LEAST(2, v_culture_checkins),
      'target', 2
    ),
    'vibe_vanguard', jsonb_build_object(
      'unlocked', v_unique_places >= 5,
      'progress', LEAST(5, v_unique_places),
      'target', 5
    )
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'mayor', CASE WHEN v_mayor.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'user_id', v_mayor.user_id,
      'name', v_mayor.user_name,
      'avatar', v_mayor.user_avatar,
      'points', v_mayor.total_points
    ) ELSE NULL END,
    'user_checkins_count', v_total_checkins,
    'explorer_rank', v_explorer_rank,
    'badges', v_badges
  );
END;
$$;

-- RPC 4: rpc_toggle_meetup_rsvp & rpc_toggle_vibe_flash_rsvp (Fixes COALESCE(array_length(...), 0))
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_toggle_meetup_rsvp(
  p_meetup_id UUID,
  p_user_id UUID
) RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_meetup RECORD;
  v_attendees UUID[];
  v_is_attending BOOLEAN;
  v_len INTEGER;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_meetup FROM public.place_meetups WHERE id = p_meetup_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Meetup not found');
  END IF;

  v_attendees := v_meetup.attendee_ids;
  IF p_user_id = ANY(v_attendees) THEN
    v_attendees := array_remove(v_attendees, p_user_id);
    v_is_attending := false;
  ELSE
    v_len := COALESCE(array_length(v_attendees, 1), 0);
    IF v_len >= v_meetup.max_capacity THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Meetup is at full capacity');
    END IF;
    v_attendees := array_append(v_attendees, p_user_id);
    v_is_attending := true;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.place_meetups SET attendee_ids = v_attendees WHERE id = p_meetup_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'is_attending', v_is_attending, 'attendee_count', COALESCE(array_length(v_attendees, 1), 0));
END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_toggle_vibe_flash_rsvp(
  p_flash_id UUID,
  p_user_id UUID,
  p_mode TEXT
) RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_flash RECORD;
  v_interested UUID[];
  v_going UUID[];
  v_status_result TEXT;
  v_going_len INTEGER;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_flash FROM public.vibe_flash_events WHERE id = p_flash_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Vibe flash event not found');
  END IF;

  v_interested := v_flash.interested_ids;
  v_going := v_flash.going_ids;

  IF p_mode = 'going' THEN
    IF p_user_id = ANY(v_going) THEN
      v_going := array_remove(v_going, p_user_id);
      v_status_result := 'none';
    ELSE
      v_going_len := COALESCE(array_length(v_going, 1), 0);
      IF v_going_len >= v_flash.max_capacity THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Vibe flash event is at full capacity');
      END IF;
      v_going := array_append(v_going, p_user_id);
      v_interested := array_remove(v_interested, p_user_id);
      v_status_result := 'going';
    END IF;
  ELSIF p_mode = 'interested' THEN
    IF p_user_id = ANY(v_interested) THEN
      v_interested := array_remove(v_interested, p_user_id);
      v_status_result := 'none';
    ELSE
      v_interested := array_append(v_interested, p_user_id);
      v_going := array_remove(v_going, p_user_id);
      v_status_result := 'desired';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.vibe_flash_events 
  SET interested_ids = v_interested, going_ids = v_going 
  WHERE id = p_flash_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true, 
    'status', v_status_result, 
    'going_count', COALESCE(array_length(v_going, 1), 0), 
    'interested_count', COALESCE(array_length(v_interested, 1), 0)
  );
END;
$$;

-- RPC 5: rpc_get_unified_vibe_flash_board
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_get_unified_vibe_flash_board()
RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_flashes JSONB;
  v_meetups JSONB;
BEGIN
  SELECT json_agg(to_jsonb(f)) INTO v_flashes
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM public.vibe_flash_events 
    WHERE expires_at > NOW() 
    ORDER BY starts_at ASC
  ) f;

  SELECT json_agg(to_jsonb(m)) INTO v_meetups
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM public.place_meetups 
    WHERE starts_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '60 minutes' 
      AND expires_at > NOW() 
    ORDER BY starts_at ASC
  ) m;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'vibe_flashes', COALESCE(v_flashes, '[]'::jsonb),
    'upcoming_meetups', COALESCE(v_meetups, '[]'::jsonb)
  );
END;
$$;

-- RPC 6: rpc_claim_vibe_flash_hunt (33m verification, vq_hunt_pool deduction, vq_accounts credit, and vq_transactions log)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_claim_vibe_flash_hunt(
  p_flash_id UUID,
  p_user_id UUID,
  p_distance_meters NUMERIC,
  p_livecheck_photo_url TEXT
) RETURNS JSONB
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_flash RECORD;
  v_reward INTEGER;
  v_claimed UUID[];
  v_arrived UUID[];
BEGIN
  IF p_distance_meters > 33 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Must be within 33 meters to claim Vibe Flash hunt reward.');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_flash FROM public.vibe_flash_events WHERE id = p_flash_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Vibe Flash event not found.');
  END IF;

  v_arrived := v_flash.verified_arrived_ids;
  IF NOT (p_user_id = ANY(v_arrived)) THEN
    v_arrived := array_append(v_arrived, p_user_id);
  END IF;

  v_reward := v_flash.vq_reward_per_hunter;
  v_claimed := v_flash.claimed_reward_ids;

  IF p_livecheck_photo_url IS NOT NULL AND v_flash.vq_hunt_pool >= v_reward AND NOT (p_user_id = ANY(v_claimed)) THEN
    v_claimed := array_append(v_claimed, p_user_id);

    UPDATE public.vibe_flash_events
    SET vq_hunt_pool = vq_hunt_pool - v_reward,
        verified_arrived_ids = v_arrived,
        claimed_reward_ids = v_claimed
    WHERE id = p_flash_id;

    -- Credit user vq_accounts available_balance
    UPDATE public.vq_accounts 
    SET available_balance = available_balance + v_reward, updated_at = NOW() 
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id;

    -- Log transaction
    INSERT INTO public.vq_transactions (idempotency_key, from_user_id, to_user_id, amount, type, status, description)
    VALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid, p_user_id, v_reward, 'earned', 'completed', 'Vibe Flash Hunt reward for ' || v_flash.title);

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'vq_awarded', v_reward);
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.vibe_flash_events
    SET verified_arrived_ids = v_arrived
    WHERE id = p_flash_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'vq_awarded', 0, 'message', 'Arrived verified, but reward already claimed or pool depleted.');
  END IF;
END;
$$;

# VQgemni — Master Plan.md

**Document role:** Single living implementation-sequencing, operational-policy and acceptance-control plan for the **complete production-ready VQgemni application**. This is not an MVP, prototype, partial launch plan, replacement Requirements document, replacement Structure document, or physical schema specification. **This Product Owner-approved `Master Plan.md` is the controlling implementation and production-execution authority below any later direct Product Owner instruction.**

> **For agentic workers:** Implement this plan only after explicit Product Owner authorization. Use bounded, source-verified vertical slices. A step is not complete until its acceptance contract is satisfied; a green build, created table, route, or screen is not completion evidence.

**Goal:** Restore and complete the existing `funmarket/VQgemini` application as a production-ready, fully domain-owned product with 28 approved logical domains, preserving the current populated UI and its features. First perform S00 content/test-account/media preservation and verified cutover, then S01–S18 engineering rehabilitation and acceptance.

**Architecture source and execution hierarchy:** Latest explicit Product Owner decisions remain highest authority. This Product Owner-approved `Master Plan.md` is the consolidated living implementation/operations authority and may contain newer directed decisions, implementation clarifications, Admin/governance controls and production-readiness requirements that are absent from older design documents. `Requirements.md` remains the full product-behavior source, `structure.md` the architecture/module ownership source, and `Database.md` the conceptual persistence/invariant source. A newer approved Master Plan clarification is not a defect merely because an older file did not mention it. Historical Gemini/old VibeQuest remain behavior/failure references only.

**Modular Monolith runtime (directed; additive):** The existing `funmarket/VQgemini` React/Vite application remains one frontend, one Supabase project (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Auth, Storage and Edge Functions as needed), and one deployment. The 28 numbered domains under `src/domains/dXX_*` are internal modules, not separate services; each is the sole authorized writer of its canonical tables. Domain public commands and queries are exported through `index.ts` only. UI, features, screens, hooks, other domains and Admin use those public APIs (or non-writing thin application orchestration); nobody writes another domain's tables. Admin is orchestration, not D29 or a second writer. S00 must satisfy its existing full preservation, genuine test identity, D13 media migration and visual/data parity acceptance **before structural transfer**. Transfer existing working code gradually from `features/`, `screens/`, `components/`, `services/` and `hooks/`, one real feature at a time; retain previous functionality until verified backend, RLS/authorization, functional and visual parity plus authorized cutover. Boundary tests must enforce public-only imports and no cross-domain writes; no mocks, shadow writers or service extraction. The domain directories currently exist, and some contain `index.ts`; inspect their actual contents at execution time rather than treating them as empty or completed.

**Live-source rule:** Current repository HEAD and governing-document identities are intentionally verified at execution time rather than frozen into this living plan. Historical checkpoint values, if retained elsewhere as evidence, never override current source.

**Plan status:** `PRODUCT OWNER APPROVED — CONTRIBUTING IMPLEMENTATION / PRODUCTION-EXECUTION PLAN`.

## Proposed Share camera, VibeCheck, VibeFlash and social-feed correction — 2026-11-06

**Status: Product Owner-requested scope, revised against the supplied 2026-11-06 Share screenshot; documentation-only and pending independent acceptance.** This section records the Share repair and its dependency gates. It does **not** certify a feature as implemented, approve a schema migration or override an unresolved Product Owner decision. The prior plan and scope remain intact. This document is for **funmarket/VQULTIMATE**; references to **funmarket/VQgemini** in the inherited source paragraphs are legacy identifiers to reconcile, not permission to switch repositories.

### A. Why the Share slice is needed and where it fits

The Share page must offer a professionally designed, mobile-first, genuinely working camera/publishing experience while preserving the five-tab shell and the concept of Share Good Vibes. It is a source of canonical posts and engagement visible in Vibe/Gossip and, when authorized by visibility and audience rules, in the later Home social feeds. The Share camera fix is an explicit bounded slice following D12's minimal canonical publishing contract; coordinate its D13 media and D18 timed-challenge dependencies before enabling individual features. This **does not** authorize skipping D12 tests, the existing PR acceptance gates, or moving the Home feed ahead of the last Social System Mechanics task. The Share UI design/camera slice may be prepared and independently verified before D03/D17/D14 completion; any feature depending on their authorization remains gated until verified.

### B. Fresh reference/implementation reconciliation and authority

- Current UI source observed: `src/components/ShareTab.tsx`, `src/domains/d04_share/api.ts`, `src/components/CreateFlashModal.tsx`; closed, unmerged PR #7 as a historical failed candidate only. A clean D12 successor must start from fresh VQULTIMATE `main` and its verified schema; it must not inherit PR #7 code or CI as acceptance proof. Reference: `funmarket/VQgemini@fe96aa780cfe35c88329e4456c9ab2b2c685fefa` — `src/components/share/LiveCameraFeatures.tsx`, `LiveCameraModule.tsx`, `VibePhotoCapture.tsx`, `src/native/vibeCheckService.ts`, `vibeFlashService.ts`, and its fuller `structure.md`/`Database.md`. Reference source remains interaction/failure evidence, not code, schema or operational authority.
- Verified present defects: ShareTab currently synthesizes fallback canvas capture on camera failure, initializes a stock photo as media fallback, ignores a Boolean publication result and can show success after an error. `d04_share/api.ts` writes `vibe_posts` rather than canonical `social_posts`, and derives a public URL for the currently private Supabase `media` bucket. Camera/text Share, Gossip and Home are not yet one verified publication flow.
- The reference's UI labels advertise **5-minute VibeCheck / 3-minute Vibe Flash**, and legacy internal implementations contain other conflicting countdowns. Its longer, Product Owner-approved `structure.md` and `Database.md` describe **D18 VibeCheck 180 seconds** and **VibeFlash 33 seconds**. Resolve document precedence explicitly during requirements restoration; never select an arbitrary timer from old component code, and never silently change an approved limit.
- `social_posts`, `social_post_comments`, `social_post_reactions`, `vibe_checks` and `vibe_flashes` exist in the examined Supabase schema. Read-only inspection on 2026-11-06 confirmed restrictive ownership-oriented social posting policies, but both challenge tables have `PUBLIC ALL USING true WITH CHECK true` and effective `anon`/`authenticated` write grants. They must **not** be treated as authorized real challenge persistence until separately approved and tested access controls close the exposure. Schema presence never proves functionality.

### C. Canonical domain and component ownership (no new business domain)

| Boundary | Owns | Does not own |
|---|---|---|
| D01/D02 | authenticated account and profile identity | camera proof, media or posts |
| D03 | directed ECHO follows; Orbit outbound / Echo inbound audience relationships | publication, challenges or DMs |
| D04 geo-presence | optional consented location evidence, accuracy/freshness, proximity | camera upload or published post |
| D12 social-content | canonical Gossip/Share publication, text/media references, comments/reactions and visibility | hardware capture, storage bytes, challenge deadlines |
| D13 global-media | real captured bytes, ownership, private delivery, attachment authorization, variants, retention/retirement | independent social posts or matches |
| D17 matching | Pull invitations, confirmed Vibes and Drift proposals | ECHO follow state or challenge response |
| D18 challenges | VibeCheck recipient/invite/response/reveal, VibeFlash collective timing and eligibility, deadlines/expiry | final D12 publication, D03 follows or unilateral D17 confirmation |
| D14/D23/D20 | authorized conversations; notification delivery; verified eligible VQ ledger award respectively | fabricated message delivery, alerts or rewards |

The current `src/domains/d04_share` is a **legacy adapter, not authorization to reassign D04's canonical geo-presence ownership**. Share page feature/presentation modules compose calls to the public APIs of the above owners. Cross-owner orchestration is an application use case, never direct writes into a foreign canonical table. Vibe Flash is **not** automatically equivalent to D11 Flash Events or a confirmed D17 Vibe. A Share-specific aesthetic Echo is **not** a D03 follow or permission to DM.

### D. Separate user journeys and truth requirements

1. **Share composer / caption / photos:** clear message entry, optional genuine image, draft persistence only as nonauthoritative UI state, submit once with authenticated actor, selected audience, optional coarse area and explicit publish feedback. A genuine D12 record must be read back; same ID and content appear in Gossip and only eligible Home queries after refresh. No fake posts, usernames, location or engagement; no fake localStorage authority.
2. **Live Vibe Shot:** camera-only acquisition (no gallery-import substitute for live proof), explicit permission, real video track readiness, rear/front capture when both supported, PIP or two-photo preview, retake, optional caption and explicit publication. Device with one camera or denied permission gets truthful capabilities/errors and a supported fallback workflow **without generating simulated proof**. No unseen or unconsented capture; stop tracks on close, unmount, logout, lens switch and error. A capture is not a publication until D13 upload and D12 commit succeed.
3. **VibeCheck:** real named eligible recipient, bounded prompt, invitation, accept/refuse, genuine photo response, authoritative server deadline, targeted alert via D23 and visibility-restricted reveal/reactions. Only two valid reciprocal responses under D18 can invoke D17's idempotent mutual confirmation. A unilateral response, follower, expired/declined invite or Flash does not unlock D14 DMs. Do not show reward success without D20 ledger acceptance.
4. **Vibe Flash:** distinct spontaneous, time-limited collective camera response and participant-visible Mosaic, based on server time and D18 audience rules. Expiry/deny/retry and post-publication consent are explicit. No client-only timer authority or automatically generated social post/match.
5. **Vibe Snap:** a new fourth Share action, **genuine 10-second in-app camera video** with capture permission, recording progress, stop at the 10-second limit, preview, retake, discard and optional caption/approved audience. It is a video *snippet*, **not live broadcast, livestream infrastructure or a historical Paltalk room**. D13 owns video bytes, access and lifecycle; D12 owns the resulting post. Recording/uploading never implies publication, and unsupported camera/codec/mic capabilities must be explained truthfully.

# VQgemni — Master Plan.md

**Document role:** Single living implementation-sequencing, operational-policy and acceptance-control plan for the **complete production-ready VQgemni application**. This is not an MVP, prototype, partial launch plan, replacement Requirements document, replacement Structure document, or physical schema specification. **This Product Owner-approved `Master Plan.md` is the controlling implementation and production-execution authority below any later direct Product Owner instruction.**

> **For agentic workers:** Implement this plan only after explicit Product Owner authorization. Use bounded, source-verified vertical slices. A step is not complete until its acceptance contract is satisfied; a green build, created table, route, or screen is not completion evidence.

**Goal:** Restore and complete the existing `funmarket/VQgemini` application as a production-ready, fully domain-owned product with 28 approved logical domains, preserving the current populated UI and its features. First perform S00 content/test-account/media preservation and verified cutover, then S01–S18 engineering rehabilitation and acceptance.

**Architecture source and execution hierarchy:** Latest explicit Product Owner decisions remain highest authority. This Product Owner-approved `Master Plan.md` is the consolidated living implementation/operations authority and may contain newer directed decisions, implementation clarifications, Admin/governance controls and production-readiness requirements that are absent from older design documents. `Requirements.md` remains the full product-behavior source, `structure.md` the architecture/module ownership source, and `Database.md` the conceptual persistence/invariant source. A newer approved Master Plan clarification is not a defect merely because an older file did not mention it. Historical Gemini/old VibeQuest remain behavior/failure references only.

**Modular Monolith runtime (directed; additive):** The existing `funmarket/VQgemini` React/Vite application remains one frontend, one Supabase project (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Auth, Storage and Edge Functions as needed), and one deployment. The 28 numbered domains under `src/domains/dXX_*` are internal modules, not separate services; each is the sole authorized writer of its canonical tables. Domain public commands and queries are exported through `index.ts` only. UI, features, screens, hooks, other domains and Admin use those public APIs (or non-writing thin application orchestration); nobody writes another domain's tables. Admin is orchestration, not D29 or a second writer. S00 must satisfy its existing full preservation, genuine test identity, D13 media migration and visual/data parity acceptance **before structural transfer**. Transfer existing working code gradually from `features/`, `screens/`, `components/`, `services/` and `hooks/`, one real feature at a time; retain previous functionality until verified backend, RLS/authorization, functional and visual parity plus authorized cutover. Boundary tests must enforce public-only imports and no cross-domain writes; no mocks, shadow writers or service extraction. The domain directories currently exist, and some contain `index.ts`; inspect their actual contents at execution time rather than treating them as empty or completed.

**Live-source rule:** Current repository HEAD and governing-document identities are intentionally verified at execution time rather than frozen into this living plan. Historical checkpoint values, if retained elsewhere as evidence, never override current source.

**Plan status:** `PRODUCT OWNER APPROVED — CONTROLLING IMPLEMENTATION / PRODUCTION-EXECUTION PLAN`. This Master Plan is the controlling implementation, sequencing, operational-policy and acceptance authority below any later explicit Product Owner instruction. It does not itself authorize arbitrary repository, infrastructure, database or production mutation; each implementation task still requires its applicable bounded authorization and live-source verification.

---

## Current implementation direction — existing-app rehabilitation (2026-11-03)

**DIRECTED / SUPERSEDING:** VQgemni is the **existing** `funmarket/VQgemini` React/Vite application, not an empty repository. Repair and complete its engineering while preserving all approved experiences, the five-tab product, current visual appearance and populated content. The target remains 28 canonical logical domains and the existing S01–S18 functional scope. Earlier claims that application code/client/UI do not exist or must be rebuilt from scratch are superseded. The current selected infrastructure is GitHub `funmarket/VQgemini`, Vercel project `vqgemni`, Supabase project `avdfessrhbsqwlfmbdau`; verify the actual live environment/hosting state before every task, without treating connection as proof of readiness.

**Mandatory dependency:** S00 (defined below) precedes S01 and every structural refactor that could delete, detach or mutate existing content. S00 preserves and inventories every existing post, authored sample, Place, Trail, Guardian/Legend, account/profile, image/media asset, relation and screen; creates genuine Supabase Auth **test accounts** plus D01/D02 profiles; associates sample posts, Trails and Guardians with appropriately authorized test principals; migrates licensed media into Supabase Storage under D13 ownership; and verifies all content and visual parity before replacing the embedded React datasets. These are genuine database test fixtures, **not** invented real-user activity, check-ins, payments, Handshakes, rewards or verified location evidence. The app stays populated throughout development.

**Data authority:** React owns presentation, styling and transient interface state only. Domain-owned backend / authorized RLS interfaces own durable identity, posts, media attachments, Places, Trails, Guardians, relationships and transactional facts. Do not expose service role keys, bypass canonical writers, or treat localStorage/samples as source of truth. Preserve static design tokens and ordinary UI icons; **business datasets and their images** belong in Supabase-authorized persistence/media.

**Lifecycle:** Temporary test users and content remain in development/staging until a verified production-ready, legitimately populated release baseline is established. Cleanup is a **separately authorized** dependency-aware operation that cannot orphan posts, steal authorship, delete genuine user records or leave the launch application unintentionally empty. No content imports, Auth operations, Storage uploads or database changes are authorized merely by this document.

## 0. Global constraints and execution states

### 0.1 Non-negotiable constraints

1. The target is the **entire production application**; dependency ordering never reduces scope.
2. All **D01–D28** are complete-initial-product domains. Logical domains do not imply 28 services, schemas, tables or deployments.
3. One canonical writer owns each business fact. Cross-domain journeys use typed commands/events/read projections, not direct foreign-domain writes.
4. One canonical product/backend serves browser and Telegram Mini App. Host APIs are adapters, not separate business systems.
5. Five equal root destinations remain **Home / Explore / Share / Vibe / Purse**.
6. Guest-first public discovery; protected writes require verified identity and authorization.
7. No historical mock, browser-local authority, fabricated user, fake GPS, fake booking, fake notification, fake payment, client-minted VQ or optimistic failure-success is permitted in production.
8. VQ is the only in-app reward unit; it is distinct from recognition and fiat money.
9. Ticketing is independent of Events and Guardian reservations. Activities and Events remain distinct.
10. D13 owns media assets; consuming domains own attachment meaning/authorization. D04 owns geographic evidence; D05 owns Places; D06 owns Trails; D23 owns notification delivery, not originating actions.
11. PostgreSQL + PostGIS is the intended authoritative persistence/spatial platform. Physical schema is implemented incrementally from approved invariants, with versioned migrations and compatibility gates.
12. Security, observability, accessibility, localization, mobile acceptance and operations are built throughout, not appended at the end.
13. Staging appears early and remains continuously production-shaped, but staging availability is never production launch acceptance.
14. Genuine Supabase-authenticated development test users and imported, clearly attributed sample business records must populate the app during S00–S18 development. They never count as proof of real external events, payments, Handshakes, check-ins or production-user activity; no browser-local fake authority is allowed.
15. Any implementation task must re-read current branch/head and governing documents before mutation; this plan does not authorize stale-state execution.
16. Implementation workers must read the current Product Owner-approved `Master Plan.md` before executing any slice. Authority order is: latest explicit Product Owner decision → approved Master Plan → Requirements → structure → Database → historical/reference evidence.
17. Master Plan enhancements do **not** require automatic back-edits to older design documents. A blocking contradiction exists only when execution would remove approved functionality, duplicate a canonical writer, violate the 28-domain model, breach privacy/security, recreate prohibited legacy authority, split Web/Telegram into separate products, introduce a 29th business domain, or violate a newer explicit Product Owner decision.
18. The Master Plan may add implementation/operational detail only when directed, source-backed, ownership-consistent, security/privacy-required or a production-readiness engineering choice. `Master Plan controls` is never permission for an agent to silently invent product policy.
19. **Modular-monolith ownership and non-destructive migration (ADDITIVE):** One React/Vite frontend, one Supabase project and one deployment. D01–D28 stay internal numbered modules and sole writers of their canonical tables, exposing only public `index.ts` APIs. All UI, features, other domains and Admin call the owning public API; no foreign-table direct mutations, shadow writers, D29, mock persistence or extracted services. Complete S00 preservation acceptance before any structural transfer. Migrate one existing feature at a time without deleting its old path until the replacement is backend-authoritative, security/visual/functionally verified, and approved for cutover; enforce public-API-only and sole-writer boundaries with automated tests.

### 0.2 Status vocabulary

Every slice/domain/journey uses only: `PLANNED`, `READY`, `IN PROGRESS`, `IMPLEMENTED`, `VERIFIED`, `STAGING ACCEPTED`, `PRODUCTION ACCEPTED`, `BLOCKED`.

`IMPLEMENTED` means code/persistence exists. `VERIFIED` adds the required automated evidence. `STAGING ACCEPTED` adds integrated production-shaped runtime evidence. `PRODUCTION ACCEPTED` requires the final release gates. No domain is called complete because a subset of these states is green.

### 1.3 Decision supersession for this plan

The following explicit Product Owner decisions are incorporated into the current governing-document set and remain controlling where older historical wording is retained for context. The synchronized Requirements, Structure and Database documents contain their applicable post-baseline delta notices; the Master Plan remains the controlling implementation authority.

1. **Master Plan authority — DIRECTED FINAL**: the Product Owner-approved `Master Plan.md` controls implementation sequencing, operational policy, acceptance contracts, Admin/governance controls and production readiness below any later direct Product Owner instruction. Older Requirements/Structure/Database remain mandatory design sources but do not require back-edits merely because the approved Master Plan contains a newer directed clarification or operational enhancement.
2. **Handshake — DIRECTED FINAL**: qualifying approved agreement acceptance creates exactly one idempotent D22 Handshake; service-flow provider acceptance is the trigger. No Handshake cancellation state. Server-authoritative lifetime is exactly 24 hours: `ACTIVE → EXPIRED`. Cancellation of the underlying engagement does not revoke/reset/delete the Handshake or its timer. New review creation is allowed only while the Handshake is active and otherwise eligible; after expiry it is denied. D22 owns eligibility proof, not review content.
3. **Marketplace VQ — DIRECTED FINAL**: optional Marketplace VQ transfer is peer-to-peer, buyer-to-seller via D20, at participant risk. No default escrow, platform guarantee, commission, delivery proof or automatic refund. D26 owns listing/negotiation/deal state; D20 alone posts VQ.
4. **Marketplace review — DIRECTED FINAL**: an eligible D26 mutual agreement may create one D22 Handshake and a 24-hour review-eligibility window. D26 owns Marketplace product/deal-item review content because the reviewed object is a D26 listing/deal fact; D19 remains the established owner for Guardian/provider reputation review where applicable. D22 never owns review text/rating content and never proves delivery/payment.
5. **Official app products — DIRECTED BOUNDARY**: no official products are invented now. Future Product Owner-authorized official VQgemni products appear through Vibe Guide and remain distinct from ordinary D26 peer listings.
6. **Place confidence — DIRECTED FINAL OWNERSHIP**: D05 confidence is computed under a versioned, auditable Admin-managed policy. D05 owns observations and confidence result; Admin Control Room changes policy through an authorized contract and audit, not direct SQL or a second writer.
7. **User enforcement — DIRECTED FINAL**: ordinary confirmed violations use Strike 1 first formal warning → Strike 2 final formal warning → Strike 3 account sanction. Reports are allegations/case inputs, never automatic strikes. Duplicate reports about one incident do not multiply strikes. Standard suspension/ban choices are 3 days, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months or Permanent. Severe safety/security violations may bypass graduated warnings with evidence, reason, actor, case and audit; temporary protective restriction may be used while evidence is reviewed. Eligible sanctions support appeal without automatic suspension removal.
8. **Admin Control Room — DIRECTED FINAL**: a real permission-scoped Control Room begins with S02 authorization/shell and grows with owner-domain panels through S15, where it reaches integrated operational completeness. Admin is orchestration over D01–D28, never a 29th writer or direct-SQL console.
9. Existing latest Geo decisions remain binding: real device location; D04 evidence/consent; PostgreSQL/PostGIS authoritative proximity; MapLibre rendering; Overpass external POI adapter; replaceable providers; external device navigation; 5 m check-in rule with uncertainty; 23 km applicable discovery scope; 2-hour Find Hub temporary-position retention; no fake geo fallback.

## S00 — Mandatory existing-content preservation, test-account attribution and Supabase media migration

**Status: PLANNED; no implementation or acceptance claimed.** S00 MUST reach its verified content/data and visual preservation gates before S01 starts. No old source arrays, assets, sample accounts or demo records may be removed beforehand.

1. **Inventory and recoverability:** Inspect current GitHub HEAD, Vercel serving revision, Supabase schema/Auth/Storage, React templates/assets, localStorage and existing backend data; record every sample/real user and profile, post, Place, Guardian/Legend/offer, Trail/stops/remix, community, image/video/audio, relationship, feed card, event and related record. For each record capture original source/path/key/ID, user-facing placement, media source/rights, dependencies, timestamp, intended owner and status (existing real, imported demo, external suggestion, fake workflow). Capture screenshots at responsive widths for Home/Explore/Share/Vibe/Purse, count visible content, and obtain recoverable, verified source/data/media backups. Historical attached 215-feature CSV is a provisional coverage index (210 REVIEW OPEN, 5 blocked ownership), **not** 215 accepted functional services.
2. **Authentic test identities:** Create approved restricted **actual Supabase Auth test accounts**, linked canonical D01 IDs and durable D02 profiles, handles and valid account roles; test profiles/avatars are persistent, never JavaScript-user objects. Keep credentials and service keys out of React and repositories, identify test cohorts/provenance and enforce actual authorization/RLS. S00 introduces only the minimal safe identity/media/data migration capabilities necessary for preservation; S02 later extends full authentication, provider linking and Web/Telegram support using those same canonical identities.
3. **Domain-correct record import and attribution:** Associate old *sample* posts with authorized test-author D01 IDs under D12; preserve captions, ordering, relationships and eligible import dates. Attribute D06 Trails/ordered stops/versions/remix lineage to test authors; D07 Guardian/Legend qualifications and offers to test principals; D08 Tours/reservations remain separate; D05 Places retain their canonical Place facts and permitted images; D09 Business operator records and D16 communities retain proper ownership. Preserve legitimate existing records, never overwrite real users or attach their historical posts to someone else. Imported test provenance must be recoverable, idempotent, duplicate-safe and clearly marked in the controlled dataset. Do not convert fake operational events into genuine check-ins, accepted bookings, rewards, votes, ratings, location proofs, wallet transfers, Handshakes or permissions.
4. **Supabase Storage and D13:** Inventory all displayed images/media, verify ownership/rights, copy permitted bytes into access-controlled Supabase Storage, record D13 asset identity/metadata/retention, and attach through each consuming domain's authorization. Preserve original photo selection, crop/aspect/order and access scope; enforce approved 24-hour ephemeral vs durable Place/Business media treatment. Never assume a third-party URL is licensed for rehosting; provider map tiles/POI results do not become canonical Place/media records by import.
5. **Verified visual/data cutover:** Once the equivalent records and media are confirmed, replace React hardcoded **business data reads** with authorized domain/backend/Supabase queries; retain purely presentational constants. Verify source-to-target counts/IDs, legitimate test authors, foreign references, media hashes/access, Trail lineage, Guardian content, Place cards, links, and screenshot/interaction parity. Test rerun idempotency, denial, missing media, failed import recovery and rollback in an isolated scope. Do not delete original business-data source or cut over a module before its persistent replacement is validated.
6. **S00 acceptance:** Document exact source commit, import manifest, backups/restoration, test Auth identities (without exposing secrets), profile/owner mappings, SQL migration/checksums where used, RLS/auth tests, asset proofs, rendered before/after comparison, failure tests, staging/host checks and Product Owner acceptance. The app remains fully populated and looks and behaves as before, with authoritative data now outside React. If any S00 category cannot be migrated safely, preserve it and mark S00 blocked rather than invent a shortcut.

**S00 implementation/acceptance evidence:** source mapping IN_PROGRESS; backup PENDING; test users/profiles COMPLETED (24 canonical Supabase Auth test accounts mapped 1:1 to profiles with handle, display name, and avatar persistence; legacy `s00_test_identity_links` retired via `p03_retire_s00_identity_links.sql` and direct profile RLS); canonical domain records IN_PROGRESS (D12 posts attributed to canonical @handle, D06 trails and D07 guardians integrated with Supabase persistence); media import IN_PROGRESS; source cutover IN_PROGRESS; visual and functional parity VERIFIED; Product Owner acceptance PENDING.

## 3. Full-system dependency graph

This is dependency ordering, **not product-scope phasing**.

```text
S00 Content, real test identities, domain-owned Supabase data/media and baseline acceptance
  └─> S01 Engineering/release substrate
  └─> S02 Identity + shell + Web/Telegram host authority + real Admin shell/RBAC
       ├─> S03 Media + camera/mic/permission capability
       ├─> S04 Profiles + Social Graph + Business/operator authority core
       ├─> S05 Messaging engine + Notifications + D21 report/case core + realtime
       └─> S06 VQ ledger + reward/admin VQ panels

S04 + S05 ─> S07 Geo/Find Hub
S03 + S06 + S07 ─> S08 Places/Validate/check-in/confidence + Places Admin
S03 + S07 + S08 ─> S09 Trails/navigation/remix
S04 + S03 + S05 + S06 + S09 ─> S10 Guardians/Tours/Reservations/Handshake/Recognition/Entitlements + Guardian Admin
S04 + S03 + S05 ─> S11 Social Content/Communities/Live Rooms + moderation panels
S04 + S03 + S05 + S11 ─> S12 Matching/Pulls/Vibes/VibeCheck/VibeFlash + safety operations
S03 + S05 + S08 + S04(D09 authority) ─> S13 Activities/Events/Ticketing + operations panels
S05 + S06 + S10 ─> S14 Purse/Marketplace/Payments boundary + Marketplace operations/reviews
S02 + S04(D09) + S05(D21) + S06 + S08 + S10 + S11 + S12 + S13 + S14 ─> S15 Admin/Trust & Safety integrated completeness + Business completion + Ads
S07 + S08 + S09 + S11 + S12 + S13 + S14 + S15 ─> S16 Home/Share/Vibe destination integration
S02–S16 ─> S17 Full client parity/accessibility/phone/Web/Telegram integration
S01–S17 ─> S18 Full production-readiness, release and post-deploy acceptance
```

### 3.1 Safe parallelism

- After S02 contracts are stable, **S04 Profiles/Social Graph** and **S03 Media/Device Capture** may proceed in parallel because they own different canonical state.
- D14 transport plumbing and D23 delivery plumbing within S05 may be split between agents only after shared contract/event envelope definitions are frozen.
- S06 D20 can progress in parallel with parts of S05 after D01 authorization contracts exist.
- S11 Communities/Social Content and S13 Activities/Events can overlap after D13/D14 contracts are stable, provided they do not edit the same media/message ownership internals.
- The real Admin Control Room begins in S02 with scoped authorization and its permanent shell. Panels are added to that same product surface in S05/S06/S08/S10/S11/S12/S13/S14; S15 is the integration/completeness gate, not the start of Admin. Separate agents may add panels only after owner-domain command contracts and shared Admin navigation/permission conventions are frozen.
- Database migrations touching a shared invariant, core identity keys, outbox, or cross-domain reference are serialized through one owner/reviewer. Two agents must not concurrently invent competing schemas for the same canonical record.
