## 4. Complete production implementation sequence

### 4.0 Modular Monolith implementation and cutover requirements (ADDITIVE)

Each S01–S18 slice preserves all of its original detailed functional, security, data, Admin, production and acceptance contracts. After S00 acceptance, source-verified changes move one real feature into the correctly owning numbered domain folder, expose its public commands/queries exclusively through `index.ts`, wire other domains, UI and Admin only through that API, and pass boundary tests (no private imports, no foreign table writes) as additional evidence. Preserve working legacy code in `features/`, `screens/`, `components/`, `services/` and `hooks/` until the complete authorized replacement has been verified for backend truth, cross-account state, RLS, visual and behavioral parity and rollback/cutover safety. No feature deletion or mock shortcut merely to satisfy the new architecture.


### S01 — Engineering substrate, permanent CI contract and production-shaped staging path

**Objective:** Refactor and harden the existing application's engineering substrate after S00 acceptance, without sacrificing the functioning visual product or populated content.

**Requirements covered:** cross-cutting `NF-*`, `LEG-ARCH-*`, architecture/release constraints.

**Domains affected:** all indirectly; no business domain becomes implemented by this step.

**Canonical owner:** platform/application composition only; no new business writer.

**Dependencies:** S00 accepted; current governing documents and the exact live code and environment verified.

**Intended implementation outcome:** progressively organize existing React/Vite source into the approved domain-owned modular structure, retain the populated shell, and establish/harden actual API/Worker, contracts, tests, migrations, configuration, CI, readiness and staging as needed. Reuse verified components rather than replace them blindly.

**Logical modules/files:** `apps/client`, `apps/api`, `apps/worker`, `packages/contracts`, `packages/testing`, `database/migrations`, `.github/workflows`, `docs/architecture`, `docs/operations` as implementation work later authorizes.

**Database work:** establish migration ledger/tooling, PostGIS extension gate, transaction/test harness, rollback/expand-contract conventions; no speculative all-domain schema.

**API/contracts:** versioned error envelope, request/correlation/causation IDs, contract compatibility rules, health/readiness contracts.

**Frontend:** preserve and regression-test the current five-tab UI, populated S00 test-backed content, navigation, appearance and real feature entry points while extracting monolithic responsibilities; no empty-shell replacement.

**Worker/realtime:** process boot, outbox/inbox framework and durable scheduler interfaces; no fake jobs.

**Security/privacy:** secret-loading boundaries, secure defaults, dependency scanning, no secrets in client bundle, environment separation.

**Tests:** workspace/build/type/lint; architecture-boundary tests; migration up/down/compatibility harness; health/readiness integration; configuration validation.

**Staging acceptance:** API/Web/Worker deploy from exact artifact; persistent staging database connects; migration ledger is queryable; health and dependency-aware readiness distinguish liveness from readiness; exact serving revision observable.

**Documentation reconciliation:** implementation runbook records actual commands only after verified.

**Exit criteria:** CI contract enforced; staging path exists; exact build/deploy identities are observable; no fake business state; no domain declared complete.

**Blockers:** inability to create a production-shaped staging environment when implementation is authorized.

**Not authorized by this step:** launch, production data writes, removal of verified S00 content, wholesale screen recreation, fabricated feature completion or import of obsolete historical backend schemas as authority.

### S02 — D01 Identity, authorization, application shell and Web/Telegram host authority

**Objective:** Harden the existing canonical identity/session and present phone-first product shell for browser and Telegram, **reusing S00 real Supabase Auth test principals and D01/D02 profiles** without creating duplicate identities or destroying the populated UI.

**Requirements covered:** `APP-*`, `ID-001`, identity portions of `NF-001/NF-004`, account-category decisions.

**Domains:** D01 lead; D02/D09/D25 consumed only for category/entitlement projections as they become available.

**Dependencies:** S01.

**Implementation outcome:** credential registration/sign-in/recovery, Google sign-in where supported, secure sessions, Telegram launch verification and canonical account linking, logout/revocation, Vibe/Pro/Business category representation without privilege escalation, guest session/read context, intended-action restoration after sign-in, plus the **permanent Admin Control Room shell** and scoped Admin authorization framework. Admin roles/capabilities bind to canonical D01 identities and call owner-domain commands; the shell is not a business writer and is not throwaway UI.

**Logical modules:** `apps/client/src/app`, `platform/web`, `platform/telegram`, `shell`, `apps/api/src/modules/identity`, auth middleware, `packages/contracts` identity/session schemas.

**Database:** canonical users, credentials/provider links, sessions/revocation/recovery artifacts and audit-relevant fields with uniqueness constraints.

**API:** register/sign-in/link/recover/session/revoke/current-user; explicit unauthorized/expired/conflict responses.

**Frontend:** five equal tabs, top notification location, profile/settings entry, guest/protected-route behavior, EN/FR/AR/RTL boot, safe areas/back navigation; permanent phone-usable Admin Control Room shell with responsive primary navigation for Dashboard, Users, Reports & Cases, Places, Guardians, Content, Communities, Activities & Events, Marketplace, VQ, Commerce, Advertising, Operations and Settings, using sub-navigation rather than another bottom-tab system.

**Workers:** expiry/cleanup only where durable session/recovery state requires it.

**Security:** password/provider verification, Telegram signature validation, CSRF/session protections as applicable, brute-force/rate controls, session fixation/replay defenses, object-level auth foundation, Admin route denial by default, least-privilege capability checks and audited privileged-session/revocation foundations. No universal god-mode permission is assumed.

**Tests:** credential/provider/linking uniqueness, Telegram linking attacks, revoked session, guest-to-auth intended action, Web/Telegram canonical user equivalence, authorization middleware, unauthorized Admin-route denial, scoped Admin-capability checks and support/VQ/moderation role separation at the authorization boundary.

**Staging acceptance:** real browser and Telegram test identities, including approved S00 principals when eligible, resolve to the same backend authority without duplicate user/wallet/profile state; an authorized staging Admin can enter the permanent Control Room shell while ordinary users and under-scoped staff are denied privileged routes.

**Exit criteria:** authenticated writes have a trustworthy D01 principal; guest public browsing works; no host-specific business identity.

**Not authorized:** separate Telegram DB/user system, mock guest promotion, account-category privilege shortcuts.

### S03 — D13 Global Media and shared camera/microphone/permission capability

**Objective:** Extend and harden the **S00 Supabase Storage/D13 media baseline** into secure durable/ephemeral production media lifecycle and reusable device capture for every dependent feature; preserve imported attachments and thumbnails.

**Requirements:** `MEDIA-001`, capture portions of Share/Guardian/challenge/profile requirements and `NF-004` permission behavior.

**Domains:** D13 lead; consuming domains retain attachment meaning.

**Dependencies:** S01–S02.

**Outcome:** preserve and extend S00 uploaded assets and references; permission coordinator; camera/mic adapters; upload initiation/finalization; validation; processing/variants; private/authorized delivery; expiry/retirement intent; durable deletion retries; 24h ephemeral retention where approved; Web/Telegram capability parity.

**Logical modules:** client `platform/permissions`, `platform/devices/camera`, `microphone`, `capture-session`; API D13; Worker media processing/deletion; storage adapter.

**Database:** asset metadata, ownership/access context, processing state, retention/expiry/retirement state, attachment references without universal business ownership.

#### S15 Admin navigation and Dashboard

#### S15 D21 report/case and enforcement lifecycle

Canonical lifecycle: `REPORT SUBMITTED → TRIAGE → CASE OPENED/MERGED → EVIDENCE REVIEW → DECISION → NO VIOLATION | WARNING/STRIKE/RESTRICTION/SUSPENSION/CONTENT ACTION → USER NOTIFICATION → APPEAL IF ELIGIBLE → RESOLVED/CLOSED`. Operational case states support `new`, `triaged`, `assigned`, `investigating`, `awaiting information`, `actioned`, `appeal pending`, `resolved`, `closed`. Severity supports **Critical / High / Normal / Support**. Reportable source references cover users/profiles, Guardians/Legends, Businesses, Places/contributions/validation/check-in abuse, posts/comments/messages/media, Communities/live rooms, Activities, Events, tickets, Marketplace listings/deals and other supported interactions. Reports are allegations/case input, **never automatic punishment**. Duplicate reports for the same incident may merge and must not create duplicate strikes. Deliberate repeated false/coordinated reporting can itself become a D21 case; genuine mistaken reports are not automatically punished.

**Directed normal strike model:** `NO ACTIVE STRIKE → confirmed violation = Strike 1 / first formal warning → another distinct confirmed violation = Strike 2 / final formal warning → third distinct confirmed violation = Strike 3 / sanction`. Each strike is a case-backed historical record with user, policy category, severity, evidence/source refs, moderator/Admin actor, reason, issue time, strike number, affected capability/sanction, expiry if any, appeal and final disposition. Do not implement a naked mutable integer counter. An overturned decision invalidates/reverses its current strike effect and derived active strike sequence as appropriate while preserving audit/history; it does not erase the historical case.

**Standard third-strike/other suspension durations:** **3 days, 1 week (7 days), 1 month, 3 months, Permanent**. Selection is explicit/reasoned/audited/communicated. Temporary suspension uses durable server-authoritative expiry and restores the permitted access automatically at expiry; Permanent never auto-expires.

**Severe-violation bypass:** qualified Critical/High safety/security cases may bypass the two-warning progression and apply immediate scoped protective restriction, suspension or Permanent ban when warranted. Evidence/source, severity, actor, reason, case and audit are required. Where safe, temporary protective restriction may preserve users while investigation continues and must be represented as protective—not a final guilt decision. Severe classification/report volume alone never auto-permanently-bans an account without the required qualified decision/evidence path.

**Scoped restrictions:** D21 owns restriction/sanction fact; affected domains enforce it. Examples include posting/commenting/messaging, Community participation/creation, Guardian availability, Activity/Event creation, Marketplace buy/sell, VQ transfer, Place contributions/Validate and advertising operations. A messaging restriction must not silently destroy unrelated account data; a Marketplace-selling restriction does not imply account deletion.

#### S15 Appeals and transparency

Eligible enforcement supports `sanction → appeal → review → uphold/reduce/modify/revoke → reason → notification`. Appeal submission does not automatically remove the sanction. Duplicate appeals follow explicit idempotency/case rules. Higher-impact/Permanent appeals support review by another qualified Admin/moderator where staffing permits. User Account Status shows safe truthful action/category, strike/warning number, duration/start/end, affected capabilities and appeal path while protecting reporter identity and sensitive evidence.

#### S15 Support and operational correction

Support cases cover non-misconduct account access, entitlement, reservation, VQ posting, duplicate/failed transaction, media, ticketing, notification, Place contribution, Guardian eligibility and Marketplace application-state issues. Support staff route corrections through owner-domain commands and do not gain VQ/moderation powers by default. Admin may correct legitimate D20 errors with compensating entries, never rewrite history; may correct application state through the owning domain; and may not guarantee/refund off-platform cash or physical Marketplace goods. Future official VQgemni products may later gain separate support/refund policy only after Product Owner authorization.

#### S15 Business, Ads, entitlements and account lifecycle

Complete D09 Business/operator review, Place claims, Business→Place relationships, Event-publishing authority, complaints/operator revocation; D24 campaign/placement/schedule/privacy-compliant targeting/frequency/measured-impression reporting/moderation for Home/Explore/Share without mutating advertised objects; D25 entitlement status/expiry/access/reconciliation support without treating payment as Guardian qualification/Business ownership/trust. Account operations provide suspend/restrict/session revoke/start closure/process deletion request; no casual `hard delete everything` button. Deletion/anonymization follows approved privacy/retention rules while legitimate ledger/audit/security retention remains separate.

#### S15 Media and notification operations

Authorized moderators/operators may inspect D13 media **only** when linked to a legitimate report/support/processing purpose, quarantine or retire prohibited assets through D13, and retry failed processing/deletion where safe. There is no unrestricted private-media browser. D23 operations may inspect template/configuration where authorized, delivery health/failures and source-backed retry/resend; D23 never invents the originating action or notification-triggering business fact.

#### S15 role/capability model

Implement scoped permission groupings such as **Super Admin, Trust & Safety/Moderator, Support, VQ Operator, Places Moderator, Guardian/Business Operations, Marketplace Moderator, Ads Operator, Operations Viewer** as capability bundles, not new domains. Support cannot grant VQ merely by role; VQ Operator cannot permanently ban without sanction capability; Ads Operator cannot inspect moderation evidence or ban users; Operations Viewer is read-only. No universal god-mode path is assumed.

#### S15 audit and system-health visibility

Every privileged action records actor, role/capability, target, source case/report when relevant, action, reason, relevant previous/new state, timestamp, correlation/causation ID, owning-domain command and result/failure. Audit is durable, not only generic logs. Operations view is read-only for API/Worker/DB/storage/realtime/outbox/scheduler/jobs/media cleanup/provider failures/serving revision/deployment state where available; it is not a general infrastructure control panel.

**Database:** D09 organization/operator authority; D21 reports/cases/assignments/evidence references/decisions/strikes/restrictions/suspensions/appeals/history; D24 campaigns/placements/impressions; privileged audit records/owner-command provenance; support-case records where implemented as operational case type. Canonical business facts remain in owner domains.

**Security/privacy:** least privilege, object/evidence scope, purpose binding, Admin session security, actor/reason requirement, reporter protection, private-message/media/location access controls, no direct SQL, no VQ-as-privilege and future stronger-grant approval seam without invented threshold.

**Staging:** representative roles execute allowed owner-domain operations and are denied forbidden ones; report→case→strike/sanction→notification→appeal path; severe protective restriction; temporary expiry; Marketplace/Guardian/Place/content operations; Dashboard metrics sourced from real staging facts; system-health view read-only.

**Exit criteria:** the final Control Room can operate the complete application through canonical owner commands, D21 enforcement/appeals are deterministic/audited, every privileged path is role-scoped, and Admin remains orchestration rather than a second writer.

### S16 — Full Home / Share / Vibe destination integration

**Objective:** Integrate previously implemented canonical features into the three dense product destinations without creating page-level monoliths or duplicate state.

**Requirements:** `HOME-*`, `SHARE-*`, `PAR-HOME-*`, `PAR-SHARE-*`, `LEG-HOME-*`, `LEG-SHARE-*` plus cross-screen requirements.

**Domains:** composition reads/commands across D02–D05, D10–D12, D16–D20, D23; no new writer.

**Dependencies:** S07–S13 plus S15 for advertising/Admin-governed destination configuration. S14 is consumed where Purse/Marketplace cross-links are surfaced.

**Outcome:** Home geographic context/check-ins/Secrets/network/local/For You/activity/event/streak/heritage/gems/Vibe Guide/live feed; Share emotion rail/camera/PIP/filters/nearby stream/Join Vibe/Aesthetic Echoes/challenges/Circles/Support the Pulse; Vibe Gossip/Drift/Pulls/Vibes/Orbit/Echo/matching and deep links. Every control routes to canonical state or truthful unavailable state.

**Frontend:** feature composition only; independent feature stores/adapters; phone-first sheets/modals, back behavior, loading/empty/error/offline/permission states.

**Tests:** page-level contract/component/E2E journeys, no duplicated writes, cross-screen consistency after source mutations, long translations/RTL, keyboard/safe-area behavior.

**Staging:** real phone browser/Telegram walkthrough of all destination controls with seeded **clearly marked staging fixtures only where a user cannot practically create prerequisite data**, never fake production state.

**Exit criteria:** dense destinations are product-complete compositions, not orchestration monoliths.

### S17 — Full client parity, phone-first, localization, accessibility, offline/deep-link and cross-domain acceptance

**Objective:** Close every approved user-facing journey across all five destinations, Profile and Admin on browser and Telegram using the production domain implementations.

**Requirements:** all `APP-*`, `PAR-XD-001`, `PAR-QA-*`, `PAR-HIDDEN-001`, `LEG-HIDDEN-001`, all legacy/parity interaction families not already accepted in their owner slice.

**Domains:** all through composition; no new writer.

**Dependencies:** S02–S15.

**Outcome:** all canonical deep links; loading/empty/denied/offline/unavailable/pending/success states; Web/Telegram host parity; EN/FR/AR and RTL; accessibility; device settings/help; safe area/keyboard/modal/scroll behavior; actual scannable Traveler Code; offline Trail capability truth; no consumer developer/teleporter/mock panels.

**Phone matrix:** 320, 360, 375, 390, 393, 412, 430 px for relevant screens, plus Telegram WebView and supported browser families.

**Tests:** visual/component/E2E at width matrix; RTL/long translations; keyboard; back/deep-link restore; permission denial; offline; cross-host canonical state; accessibility automation plus manual screen-reader/focus checks where necessary.

**Staging:** full scripted and exploratory Product Owner QA on real phones/Telegram/browser with source-to-destination journeys.

**Exit criteria:** no approved interaction is a placeholder or fake; all cross-domain projections converge on canonical state.

### S18 — Full production readiness, performance evidence, recovery rehearsal and controlled release

**Objective:** Prove the entire application is production-ready as one system, then release only under explicit Product Owner authorization.

**Requirements:** `NF-*`, `LEG-ARCH-*`, `PAR-QA-*`, production acceptance requirements across all domains.

**Domains:** D01–D28.

**Dependencies:** S01–S17 all `STAGING ACCEPTED` for launch scope.

**Data gates:** exact migration set/checksums; PostGIS/spatial indexes; constraints; ledger/ticket/Handshake integrity; retention/cleanup; backup; restore rehearsal; expand/contract compatibility; current serving version vs proposed version compatibility.

**Security gates:** auth/session/Telegram linking; object/admin authorization; CSRF/injection; uploads/media; secrets; rate/abuse; idempotency/replay; location privacy/spoof risk; dependency/security scan; retention/deletion; threat-model review and targeted penetration testing appropriate to risk.

**Operations gates:** structured logs, correlation/causation IDs, metrics, traces, alerting, API/Worker/job health, provider/storage/database monitoring, runbooks, incident recovery, rollback and on-call ownership.

**Performance:** instrument first; benchmark representative phone/network/Telegram conditions; record baseline; set/tighten explicit production thresholds before acceptance. Do not fabricate Product Owner SLA numbers.

**Client gates:** all target widths, browsers, Telegram, EN/FR/AR, RTL, accessibility, location/camera/mic flows, offline states.

**Release gates:** exact release artifact/digest; migration compatibility; staging smoke; approved migration sequence; rollback; production deploy; post-deploy readiness and representative authorized smoke journeys; confirm desired revision actually serves.

**Exit criteria:** every D01–D28 and required cross-domain journey is `PRODUCTION ACCEPTED`; no fake business outcome; no unresolved launch-blocking requirement; Product Owner explicitly authorizes release.

**Not authorized by this plan creation:** performing any of these release actions now.

## 7. Cross-domain journey implementation matrix

| Journey | Canonical sequence / owners | Build order | Acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|---|

## 8. Environment and release strategy

### Local/test

- Reproducible developer environment and isolated PostgreSQL/PostGIS test database.
- Explicit test object storage/realtime adapters; no production secrets or user data.
- Unit/contract/component tests run quickly; integration suites use disposable isolated state.
- S00-approved existing sample content is imported into legitimate test-authored Supabase development records, never presented as genuine production-user or real-world activity; isolated automated fixtures remain clearly synthetic.

### Staging — brought up in S01 and evolved continuously

- Persistent production-shaped API, client, Worker, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, object storage and required realtime/provider configuration.
- Web and Telegram staging clients point to the same canonical backend authority.
- Every slice reaches staging after exact-SHA CI and migration compatibility checks.
- Test/staging identities/content are clearly marked; no fake business outcome is used to claim a feature works.
- Staging records exact artifact/deployment revision, installed migration ledger, health/readiness, provider errors and worker state.

### Production

- Created/changed only under explicit release authorization after S18 gates.
- Exact release artifact, database compatibility, migration order, rollback and mixed-version safety established before rollout.
- Post-deploy checks prove the desired revision serves, the database is compatible and representative authorized journeys function.
- Staging acceptance never substitutes for production acceptance.

---

## 9. Permanent CI and testing strategy

CI begins in S01 and grows with the product; checks run against the exact candidate SHA.

1. Formatting/lint/types/build.
2. Architecture/import-boundary tests enforcing single-writer/module rules.
3. Contract/schema compatibility checks.
4. Unit tests for domain invariants and state machines.
5. Real PostgreSQL/PostGIS integration tests for persistence, constraints, transactions and spatial queries.
6. Migration forward/backward/expand-contract checks against representative prior schema state.
7. API integration/auth/object-authorization tests.
8. Worker/outbox/idempotency/retry/timer tests with controllable server clock.
9. Realtime/message/notification tests including reconnect/dedup/failure.
10. Frontend component/interaction tests, including denied/loading/empty/error/offline states.
11. Cross-domain E2E journeys from §7.
12. Web + Telegram host-adapter tests.
13. Security/dependency scanning and secret-leak checks.
14. Phone-width/RTL/accessibility visual and interaction suites where automatable; manual evidence where not.
15. Performance instrumentation and benchmark suites in staging; production thresholds set from measured evidence before release.

**Critical concurrency/idempotency suites:** D08 capacity, D20 double spend/grants, D22 duplicate Handshake/review, D28 redemption, check-in/reward duplication, outbox retries, provider callbacks, mixed-version deployment windows.

## 9.1 Admin / Trust & Safety acceptance matrix

These tests are mandatory in addition to slice-local tests; they become real integration/E2E evidence as the owning domains become available.

| Area | Required tests |
|---|---|
| Reports | report creates D21 case input; duplicate same-incident reports merge/associate appropriately; report does not automatically create strike; reporter cannot fabricate sanction; blocked/private source is authorization-checked; deliberate report abuse can form its own case without punishing honest mistakes |
| Strikes | first distinct confirmed ordinary violation → Strike 1; second → Strike 2; third → sanction; duplicate incident cannot double-strike; overturned violation invalidates current strike effect/derived active sequence while preserving immutable case/audit history |
| Standard suspensions | 3 days; 7 days; 1 month; 3 months; Permanent; temporary expiry restores permitted access at server-authoritative due time; Permanent never auto-expires |
| Severe bypass | authorized severe case can apply protective restriction/suspension without two warnings; actor/reason/evidence/severity/case/audit required; under-scoped moderator cannot impose stronger sanction |
| Scoped restrictions | messaging-only restriction blocks messaging and not unrelated reads; Marketplace-selling restriction blocks D26 selling without deleting account data; each consuming domain checks applicable D21 restriction |
| Appeals | eligible submit; duplicate/idempotent behavior; uphold/reduce/modify/revoke; reason/audit/notification; appeal itself does not auto-remove sanction; higher-impact appeal supports qualified separate reviewer where staffing permits |
| Admin permissions | Support cannot grant VQ; VQ Operator cannot permanently ban without sanction capability; Ads Operator cannot access moderation evidence/ban; Operations Viewer cannot mutate; unauthorized Admin route denied |
| VQ | Admin correction creates D20 compensating posting; historical journal unchanged; grant batch preview/count/total; per-recipient idempotent retry; no silent balance edit |
| Place policy | D05 confidence draft/preview/activate/history/rollback authorization; historical observations unchanged; under-scoped Admin denied |
| Guardian/Handshake | Admin can inspect operational state but cannot fabricate accepted engagement, Handshake, review, completion or +75 reward |
| Marketplace | Admin can remove listing/sanction through owner commands and inspect legitimate transfer context; cannot claim cash/delivery guarantee; D26 product review requires active D22 eligibility |
| Privacy | Admin without purpose/capability cannot inspect protected DM/report evidence, unrelated private media or precise Find Hub location; permitted evidence access is audited |
| Audit | every privileged mutation includes actor/capability/target/reason/case where relevant/correlation/owner command/result; failed attempts remain observable as appropriate |

## 11. Observability and operations strategy

Established in S01 and extended with every slice:

- structured application/worker logs with request, correlation and causation IDs;
- explicit domain/source event IDs without logging secrets/private payloads unnecessarily;
- API error rates/latency, DB pool/query health, Worker queue/job age/failures, outbox lag;
- provider-specific metrics for Overpass/geocoding/maps/navigation handoff visibility where observable, storage/media failures, realtime disconnects;
- business-integrity indicators where safe: duplicate-prevention conflicts, failed VQ postings, expired Handshakes, ticket redemption conflicts, media deletion backlog, open/critical moderation cases, appeal backlog, sanction-expiry failures and Admin-action failures;
- traces across API→domain→DB/outbox→worker for high-value journeys;
- dependency-aware readiness separate from liveness;
- alerts tied to actionable failure modes and runbooks;
- backup schedules, restore verification, retention/cleanup visibility;
- incident response, rollback and mixed-version compatibility runbooks;
- audit logs for admin/moderation/rules/grants/security-sensitive actions.

No metric, dashboard or seeded record may pretend a feature succeeded.

Production release is blocked until every applicable item is evidenced on the exact release candidate.

### Security/privacy

- Authentication, Telegram linking, authorization/Admin least-privilege matrix, D21 sanction enforcement/appeals, purpose-scoped moderation evidence, privacy/blocking, upload/media, geo/location, abuse/rate controls, replay/idempotency and secrets pass.

### Operations

- Health/readiness, logs, metrics, traces, alerts and worker/provider monitoring operational.
- Runbooks cover deploy, migration, rollback, provider outage, DB/storage/realtime failure and incident response.

### Client

- Browser + Telegram on representative real phones.
- 320/360/375/390/393/412/430 px relevant screens.
- EN/FR/AR, RTL, long strings, safe areas, keyboard, scrolling, modal/sheet/back behavior.
- Accessibility focus, semantics, text scaling, non-color states, reduced motion and alternatives to sound/haptics.
- Real permission denial/revocation/unavailable flows for location/camera/mic.

### Release

1. Freeze exact release SHA/artifacts.
2. Verify exact-SHA CI and security gates.
3. Verify installed staging migration reality and representative journeys.
4. Compare production current schema/serving versions for compatibility.
5. Execute only explicitly approved migration/deployment sequence.
6. Re-query installed migration/schema state.
7. Probe dependency-aware readiness and representative authorized journeys.
8. Confirm desired API/Worker/Web/Telegram revisions actually serve.
9. Monitor launch health and preserve rollback capability.
10. Record Product Owner production acceptance.

Only then can the application be `PRODUCTION ACCEPTED`.

## 14. Remaining genuine Product Owner decisions

No current unresolved choice blocks the overall Master Plan, dependency graph or unrelated slices. The following are **slice-local Product Owner gates** and must close before the affected behavior can reach the stated staging/production acceptance:

1. **Secret bounty-claim proximity** — exact qualifying proximity/rule must be decided before the Secret claim path is accepted. Do **not** adopt a historical 50 m value by inference.
2. **Validate approach-notification radius** — exact automated approach-alert radius must be decided before that automatic alert behavior is accepted. Do **not** silently promote the historical 200 m reference to policy; the directed 5 m check-in radius remains a separate rule.
3. **VibeFlash scheduling/automation** — exact scheduling/trigger/automation policy must be decided before automated VibeFlash scheduling is accepted. Do not infer random legacy client timers. The 33-second response window remains directed and unaffected.

These gates do not block other implementation work or acceptance that does not depend on them.

Other future/non-blocking decisions:

4. **Future official VQgemni products** — none are authorized now; if later authorized, they enter Vibe Guide under a separate official-product support/responsibility policy and remain distinct from ordinary D26 peer listings.
5. **Future stronger Admin-grant approval** — no two-person/amount threshold is directed now. Current implementation uses scoped authority, explicit recipients/amount/reason, preview, audit and idempotent D20 postings while preserving an approval-workflow seam.

**Measured engineering acceptance, not a Product Owner policy gate:** numeric production performance thresholds are established from instrumented staging baselines before production acceptance. Future paid/self-hosted map/POI/geocoding provider migration remains an operational/cost choice inside the already directed replaceable-provider architecture.

Ordinary engineering selections—libraries, physical column types, cache TTLs, indexes, queue implementation, deployment packaging—are resolved during the owning slice from approved architecture and evidence; they are not inflated into Product Owner questions.

## 15. Living-plan authority, update and change-control discipline

### 15.1 Approved authority hierarchy

Implementation agents use:

`latest explicit Product Owner decision → approved Master Plan.md → Requirements.md → structure.md → Database.md → historical/reference evidence`.

`Master Plan.md` is the consolidated living implementation and production-control authority. It incorporates approved product/architecture/database design plus newer Product Owner decisions and implementation, Admin/governance, security and production-readiness completion. **Absence of a Master Plan detail from an older governing document does not by itself constitute a contradiction.** A newer explicit Product Owner decision or approved Master Plan operational clarification controls execution unless a later Product Owner decision supersedes it.

This rule does **not** authorize agents to invent product policy. New plan detail must be directed, source-backed, ownership-consistent, a necessary security/privacy/operational control or an engineering choice within settled boundaries. Genuine new product choices remain `PROPOSED` until Product Owner decides.

### 15.2 No automatic backward-document loop

Do not stop implementation merely because Requirements/Structure/Database omit a newer approved Master Plan detail. Back-edit those older files only under separate explicit authorization. Treat a real contradiction as blocking only when the plan would remove approved behavior, violate current Product Owner direction, duplicate ownership, break the 28-domain model, introduce a 29th domain, split Web/Telegram authority, recreate prohibited legacy/mock authority or violate privacy/security.

### 15.3 Living-plan updates

After each accepted implementation slice:

1. Re-read the current approved Master Plan, exact repository base/head and sources relevant to that slice.
2. Update only the slice status/evidence fields, dependency facts and future instructions actually changed by implementation or a newer decision.
3. Record real commit/PR/CI/migration/deployment/staging/runtime evidence; never fabricate pending evidence.
4. Preserve accepted history; do not rewrite completed evidence as if later decisions had always existed.
5. Correct source-answerable defects inside this same Master Plan when within authorization.
6. When Product Owner makes a newer decision, record it, identify the superseded Master Plan rule, update affected **future** slices and preserve unrelated accepted work.
7. Keep exactly one `Master Plan.md`; no V2/fixed/final-final competing plan.
8. Implementation workers must inspect this plan before starting a task; its current approved restart point and evidence ledger govern continuation.

# Post-Baseline Product & Policy Updates — Master Plan Controlled

> **Authority notice:** This document remains the full product-behavior requirements baseline. The Product Owner-approved `Master Plan.md` and any later explicit Product Owner decisions supersede conflicting, incomplete, OPEN or UNSPECIFIED wording in this older baseline. Absence of a newer Master Plan rule from this file does not invalidate it. Latest explicit Product Owner direction remains highest authority; the approved `Master Plan.md` is the controlling implementation/production-execution authority beneath it.

## Architecture Note — Modular Monolith (ADDITIVE; original requirements unchanged)

The existing `funmarket/VQgemini` React/Vite application remains one frontend, one Supabase project (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Auth, Storage and Edge Functions as needed), and one deployment. The 28 numbered domains under `src/domains/dXX_*` are internal modules, not separate services; each is the sole authorized writer of its canonical tables. Domain public commands and queries are exported through `index.ts` only. UI, features, screens, hooks, other domains and Admin use those public APIs (or non-writing thin application orchestration); nobody writes another domain's tables. Admin is orchestration, not D29 or a second writer. S00 must satisfy its existing full preservation, genuine test identity, D13 media migration and visual/data parity acceptance **before structural transfer**. Transfer existing working code gradually from `features/`, `screens/`, `components/`, `services/` and `hooks/`, one real feature at a time; retain previous functionality until verified backend, RLS/authorization, functional and visual parity plus authorized cutover. Boundary tests must enforce public-only imports and no cross-domain writes; no mocks, shadow writers or service extraction. The domain directories currently exist, and some contain `index.ts`; inspect their actual contents at execution time rather than treating them as empty or completed.

All existing product behavior, timings, distances, eligibility, media/retention, five-destination UX, Admin, safety, security, and anti-mock requirements remain binding and unchanged.

## Requirements Delta M — Existing-app rehabilitation, S00 real test accounts and Supabase data/media — DIRECTED 2026-11-03

1. **Preserve and rehabilitate the existing VQgemni app.** The existing `funmarket/VQgemini` React/Vite product is the implementation starting point, not an empty replacement app. Preserve its currently presented five-section UI, navigation, color/themes, imagery, posts, Places, Trails, Guardians/Legends, community/social features and meaningful interactions while correcting monolithic code and domain ownership. No removal of a feature merely because its current code is defective, mocked, embedded or unfinished.
2. **S00 MUST precede S01 and structural refactoring.** Inventory existing real and sample records, sources and all images/assets; create recoverable pre-change snapshots and visible before-state screenshots; make real, authenticated, restricted **Supabase Auth test users** and linked canonical D01/D02 profiles; attribute the currently displayed sample posts, Trails and Guardian/Legend offers to these controlled test principals with explicit imported/test provenance; populate D05 Places and remaining legitimate sample records under their canonical domains; migrate permitted image/media bytes into authorized **Supabase Storage** with D13 asset references. Compare before/after counts, relations and presentation before removing any hardcoded business-data source.
3. **No embedded authoritative content.** React/TSX templates may contain UI presentation logic, styles, icons, empty/loading states and static design decoration, but no canonical sample users, posts, Places, Guardian records, Trails, ratings, authored image collections, simulated network identities or fake transactional state. Once verified, records are loaded via authorized domain/API or secured Supabase data-access paths, not hardcoded arrays, invented URLs, random GPS, localStorage truth or silent fallback. Sample content remains visible and functional throughout development as **genuine database data**.
4. **Accurate authorship and media handling.** Every imported sample post/Trail/Guardian requires a valid linked test-user identity and correct D12/D06/D07/D08 attribution. Preserve captions, timestamps as source context, ordered stops/remix lineage, Guardian qualifications/offers, valid relationships and image composition. Test fixture/import provenance is identifiable; do not represent a test account as a genuine person or its sample posts as historic user-authored actions. D13 owns bytes and media lifecycle; consuming domains own attachment permissions. Verify image rights, uploads, authorized delivery and applicable ephemeral/durable retention.
5. **Truthful operational state.** Never turn demo text/cards into verified check-ins, consents, GPS presence, accepted reservations, Handshakes, VQ ledger postings, payments, notifications, reviews or social approvals. These require genuine domain-owned transactions/evidence and appropriate test-only lifecycle. Test accounts and development fixtures may participate in actual authorized staging workflows, but fake success is not an implementation.
6. **Retain content throughout development, controlled eventual cleanup.** S00 fixtures remain for S01–S18 testing and visual population. Cleanup only after complete production acceptance, a legitimately populated launch-content plan and separate explicit authorization, without orphaning retained posts, deleting real users, impersonating new authors or leaving unintended blank screens. Do not silently seed into real public production as genuine community activity.
7. **Acceptance gate.** Before S01: evidence of full inventory and restoration, valid Supabase Auth/profile/author mappings, RLS/permission coverage, idempotent imports, nonmissing media, ownership/referential integrity, controlled failures and full visual/interaction parity across existing routes and mobile widths. Preserve original content if a safe migration cannot be verified; never destructively refactor to reach an appearance of progress.

**Authority:** This delta is a newer explicit Product Owner decision. It supersedes earlier empty-repository assumptions, historical prohibitions on using **any** sample fixtures during development and proposals to start feature refactoring before preserving the current app. It does **not** relax actual production truth, privacy or the distinct accepted feature/domain policies elsewhere in this document.

## Requirements Delta A — Handshake — DIRECTED

- A qualifying source agreement acceptance creates exactly one idempotent **D22 Handshake**.
- For Guardian/Legend/Tour-style service flow, the qualifying trigger is real provider acceptance of the request/agreement. Opening Hire or merely submitting a request does **not** create a Handshake.
- D22 Handshake state is **ACTIVE** then **EXPIRED**. There is **no Handshake cancellation state**.
- Expiry occurs exactly **24 hours after issuance**, using server-authoritative time.
- Later booking/deal cancellation does not revoke, reset, delete or extend that Handshake.
- Review creation is allowed only while the Handshake is ACTIVE and the reviewer/subject remain otherwise eligible; after 24 hours, new review creation from that Handshake is denied.
- D22 owns Handshake identity, issuance/expiry/idempotency and review-eligibility proof; D22 does **not** own review content.
- These rules supersede older OPEN/UNSPECIFIED Handshake cancellation/review wording in the original baseline below.

## Requirements Delta B — Marketplace VQ — DIRECTED

- Marketplace VQ is a **peer-to-peer** transfer between buyer/user and seller/provider through D20.
- Ordinary Marketplace does **not** use default escrow, does **not** charge a platform Marketplace commission under current policy, and does **not** make the platform guarantor of delivery, quality, authenticity, physical handover or off-platform payment.
- A VQ transfer must not be represented as proof that goods/services were delivered or that external/cash payment occurred.
- Ordinary Marketplace transactions remain at buyer/seller risk.
- Admin may investigate fraud, remove listings through D26/D21, sanction accounts through D21 and correct legitimate VQ/application errors through the owning domains. Admin does not guarantee off-platform cash or physical goods and does not create automatic refunds.

## Requirements Delta C — Marketplace Review — DIRECTED

- A qualifying D26 mutual agreement may create one idempotent D22 Handshake.
- While that Handshake is ACTIVE, it provides the applicable **24-hour review eligibility** window.
- **D26 owns Marketplace product/deal-item review content.** D22 owns only the review-eligibility proof.
- **D19 continues to own established Guardian/provider reputation review content** where that separate provider-review journey applies.
- Marketplace review eligibility/content does not prove physical delivery, authenticity, quality, external payment or successful physical handover.

## Requirements Delta D — D05 Confidence — DIRECTED

- D05 Place confidence policy/formula is **Admin-configurable, versioned and auditable**.
- Each active policy has a known version and effective time.
- Admin Control Room changes policy through authorized **D05 commands**; D05 remains the sole canonical confidence writer.
- No permanently hard-coded immutable confidence formula is product policy.
- Changing the active formula/policy does not rewrite historical validation observations. Current confidence may be recomputed under the active versioned policy while retaining provenance.

## Requirements Delta E — Full Admin Control Room — DIRECTED

The Admin Control Room is an explicit full-product operational requirement and a privileged orchestration surface over D01–D28, not a new business domain or direct database editor. Its applicable product navigation covers:

- Dashboard
- Users
- Reports & Cases
- Places
- Guardians
- Content
- Communities
- Activities & Events
- Marketplace
- VQ
- Commerce
- Advertising
- Operations
- Settings

Its operational responsibilities include, where applicable: reports, case management, moderation, sanctions, appeals, support, VQ rules/grants/corrections, D05 confidence policy, Guardian/Business operations, Marketplace disputes, Advertising, Ticketing support, Notifications, Media operations, system-health visibility and privileged audit. Every mutation must invoke the appropriate canonical D01–D28 owner; Admin does not become a duplicate writer.

## Requirements Delta F — User Warning / Strike System — DIRECTED

Normal confirmed-violation enforcement is:

```text
Strike 1 = first formal warning
Strike 2 = final formal warning
Strike 3 = sanction
```

- A user report is an allegation/case input, **not** a strike.
- A strike requires a confirmed violation decision by an authorized moderator/Admin.
- Duplicate reports concerning the same incident do not automatically create multiple strikes; they may be merged into one case.
- Standard suspension/ban choices are **3 days, 1 week, 1 month, 3 months, Permanent**.
- Temporary sanctions use server-authoritative due time and expire automatically; Permanent does not auto-expire.

## Requirements Delta G — Severe Violation Bypass — DIRECTED

Severe safety/security violations may bypass the normal two-warning progression. Serious threats, harassment, stalking, exploitation, fraud/scams, malicious impersonation, severe privacy abuse, dangerous conduct, security abuse or ban evasion may justify immediate protective restriction, suspension or permanent ban according to the reviewed case. Such action requires evidence/source, severity, authorized actor, reason, linked case and audit. Where safe and appropriate, a temporary protective restriction may be used during investigation rather than treating every serious report as an automatic final guilt decision.

## Requirements Delta H — Appeals / Enforcement Transparency — DIRECTED

- Eligible sanctions support an appeal path. Appeal does not automatically remove the sanction.
- Review may uphold, reduce, modify or revoke the action, with reason and audit recorded.
- User Account Status should expose, where safe: action taken, general policy/reason category, warning/strike number, restriction/suspension duration, start/end time, affected capabilities and appeal path.
- Reporter identity and sensitive evidence remain protected where privacy/safety policy requires it.

## Requirements Delta I — Scoped Restrictions — DIRECTED

D21 sanctions may be capability-specific instead of account-wide, including appropriate restrictions on messaging, posting/commenting, Community participation, Guardian activity, Event/Activity creation, Marketplace buying/selling, VQ transfers, Place contributions, Validate participation and Advertising operations. **D21 owns the sanction/restriction fact; affected domains enforce it** through their write-authorization checks.

## Requirements Delta J — Support / Issue Resolution — DIRECTED

Admin/support operations must also handle non-misconduct application issues such as account access, entitlement problems, failed VQ postings, stuck reservation state, failed media processing, ticketing problems, notification failures, Place contribution issues, Guardian eligibility issues and Marketplace application-state issues. Support/case tooling may reference those canonical records, but corrections must be executed through the owning domains; support visibility does not grant unrestricted moderator or VQ authority.

## Requirements Delta K — Geo/Maps — DIRECTED

Preserve the latest directed Geo architecture and behavior:

- genuine device location through shared Web/Telegram capability adapters;
- D04 geographic consent/evidence authority;
- PostgreSQL + PostGIS for authoritative VQgemni-owned spatial operations;
- MapLibre for in-app interactive map rendering;
- OSM Overpass as the current replaceable low-cost external POI discovery adapter;
- replaceable tile/style/geocoding/provider boundaries;
- Google Maps/Waze/supported device navigation handoff for applicable Place/Trail directions;
- **5 m** maximum Place check-in distance, with evidence freshness/measurement uncertainty sufficient to support the 5 m conclusion or a truthful cannot-verify/insufficient-accuracy result;
- **23 km** applicable Secrets / Find Hub / nearby-feed discovery scope, distinct from individual Find Hub geofence radius;
- Find Hub temporary-position retention capped at **2 hours**;
- no fabricated coordinates, Places, users, movement, distances or provider-success fallback.

## Requirements Delta L — Remaining Genuine Product Policy Gates

Only these currently remain Product Owner decisions before their affected behavior can reach acceptance:

1. **Secret bounty-claim proximity** — do not infer the historical 50 m value.
2. **Validate approach-notification radius** — do not infer the historical 200 m value; this is separate from the directed 5 m check-in eligibility rule.
3. **VibeFlash scheduling/automation** — exact automated scheduling/trigger policy remains to be decided; do not infer random legacy timers.

These gates are slice-local and do not reopen unrelated accepted decisions.

## 1. Non-negotiable scope and source-truth contract

**Preserve the existing VQgemni product and its currently populated presentation. Rebuild the engineering without replacing the app.** The supplied `vibequest-fixed-v2 (2).zip` is the primary reference for historical features, functional interactions, screens, flows, labels and visual character. The attached `VIBEQUEST_LEGACY_SAFE_BEHAVIOR_EXTRACTION_EXPLORE_SHARE_HOME_GENERAL_PURSE_2026-10-30.md` and historical `funmarket/VibeQuest` (`phase-0-foundation`) provide complementary evidence and warnings. Never copy the old scripts, services, localStorage authority, database tables, schema, fake workflows, folder topology or deployments. The existing application's target **28 locked logical domains** and one authoritative owner per business invariant govern engineering; 28 domains do not imply 28 microservices or databases.

**Precedence:** Latest explicit Product Owner decision > approved `Master Plan.md` > approved `Requirements.md` > approved `structure.md` > approved `Database.md` > historical/reference/think-tank material. A source-visible button is evidence of intended interaction, not that any old server completed it. A directed requirement is a product target and does not need to be implemented in Gemini to be authoritative.

**No superficial completion:** Every meaningful interaction must define actors, trigger, eligibility, states, UI feedback, canonical side effect, permissions, failure/retry, cross-page implications and acceptance tests. The original inventory of 215 items is a source-coverage aid, not a target number of new features. A rigorous source-to-control-to-requirement semantic audit is an independent acceptance gate. The ZIP-wide mechanical inventory covers 212 first-party TS/TSX files, but that catalog does **not** prove that all controls are reachable, correctly implemented or completely mapped; this requirements baseline does not claim implementation or runtime verification.

**Decision classification:** `DIRECTED` / `LOCKED` / `REVISED` for owner policy; `HISTORICAL` for ZIP/narration behavior; `PROPOSED SAFEGUARD` for necessary operational protection; `UNSPECIFIED` where an exact policy is genuinely absent. This document has Product Owner approval as a governing requirements source. Repository mutation, implementation, database changes, deployment and release still require their applicable authorization and live-source verification.

## 2. Product identity, shell and platform — APP

**APP-001** VQgemni is a mobile-first local exploration, cultural Trails, Guardian, community, social and local commerce product. Preserve Midnight Obsidian, neon/cybernetic smiles, visual radar, expressive camera composition, cultural photography and inviting community feel. Redesign technical implementation independently, preserving the visual language and meaningful original journeys.

**APP-002** Five **equal-sized** bottom destinations: **Home / Explore / Share / Vibe / Purse**; Share retains heart imagery but is **not** elevated, floating or oversized. Global bell in the top bar; settings under user/profile menu. Use accessible modals/sheets and consistent back navigation/deep links.

**APP-003** One responsive frontend codebase serves browser and Telegram Mini App with the same canonical backend, identity and data. Detect and validate Telegram host/launch context on the server where identity is involved; adapt viewport, safe areas, colors, native BackButton, haptics and text sizing. Browser mode operates normally without Telegram. No separate Telegram business ledger or backend.

**APP-004** Support **English, French and Arabic**, Arabic RTL, device/host typography and accessibility settings, and eligible user overrides. Guest-first read-only discovery of public Places, Trails, Guardians, Events, Activities and Gossip; sign-in only for protected actions. Restore intended task after sign-in where feasible.

**APP-005** Every interactive page and entry method supports real loading, empty, permission-denied, offline, unavailable, pending, failure, expired, cancelled and completed states as applicable. Browser-local state may improve UI responsiveness but never becomes proof of a booking, identity, chat, check-in, payment or VQ effect.

**APP-006** The current five-tab shell preserves Home to Explore trails, map, Find Hub, event and Place links; Explore to Profile, Guardian, Tour, Share; Share to Home/Vibe/Communities; Vibe to DMs/Home/Purse; Purse to authentic Marketplace and VQ history. A tap must navigate to the actual canonical authorized object, not a placeholder alert.

## 3. Authentication, profile, social and privacy — ID/PRO

**ID-001** D01 owns authenticated users, sessions, browser/Telegram account linking and credential recovery. Preserve browser sign-in/registration with member credentials and the source-visible **Google account sign-in** option; any external-provider sign-in must create or link the same canonical D01 identity through genuine provider/server verification rather than a simulated local profile. Handle uniqueness, rate limits, session revocation and proper credential storage. Never substitute guest mock profiles after authentication failure. Different users may not be merged through untrusted Telegram browser values.

**PRO-001** D02 owns photo-first, Tinder-inspired user presentation: prominent real photo/gallery, display name, concise bio, interests, languages, area preferences, cultural identity, authentic badges, public Trails and contextual follow/message actions. This describes **presentation**, not an automatically introduced dating/swipe mechanism. Tap compact preview → expanded card → full profile. The profile exposes the member's eligible published D06 Trails as a permission-aware read projection, including discovery/grouping by their real city/location context; D02 does not own or duplicate those Trail records. Respect optional fields and privacy.

**PRO-002** Cultural Passport presents legitimately saved Trails, visited Places, heritage stamps, milestones and recognition, not client-edited balances. Profile settings include EN/FR/AR, appearance, text/accessibility, notification and privacy preferences and separate adult-only Polar Romance opt-in. Profile editing also retains custom interest tags, an optional preferred contact channel with user-entered Telegram/X contact handles, and the source-visible opt-in **Cozy Diary Mode** completion-assist: while a member explicitly enables that mode it may require the profile's otherwise-optional biography, broad location and configured contact handles before that profile edit can be saved, but it does not create a global account-eligibility requirement or make those fields public by default. Contact fields obey explicit visibility/privacy controls. The source-visible Profile menu also preserves real entry points for Sync/Device Settings, Security/Identity Verification status where an approved identity flow applies, and Help/Support; each must open its applicable canonical settings/help state or an honest unavailable state rather than a placeholder alert, and the Identity Verification label does not create a new mandatory government-document requirement. Public cards never reveal exact real-time coordinates, secret content, credentials or private contacts.

## 3A. GEO, MAPS AND LOCATION — shared real-location product guarantees

**GEO-001** Browser/Web and Telegram Mini App obtain genuine device location through host-appropriate capabilities feeding one shared application location boundary. The product distinguishes not requested, requesting, granted, denied, blocked/unavailable, interrupted where detectable, revoked where detectable, stale and inaccurate states. Operating-system/device permission is not consent to expose location socially, and manual city/district/area selection remains a browsing/discovery context rather than verified physical presence.

**GEO-002** D04 is the canonical authority for location consent/evidence, accuracy, freshness, temporary presence, proximity assertions and geofence transitions. Consuming features receive only the precision they are permitted to use; public/social surfaces expose coarse city/district/area or permitted approximate distance rather than exact live coordinates. Temporary Find Hub position pings retain the directed 2-hour maximum retention; no permanent movement history is created by ordinary location use.

**GEO-003** Interactive in-app maps use real canonical or explicitly external discovery coordinates and keep eligible pins, cards/lists and selected objects synchronized. Map rendering never becomes authority for Place, Trail, Tour, Business, Event, Activity, person or challenge state. Missing/denied/stale location, provider failure, offline state and partial results are shown truthfully; the product must never synthesize Places, routes, distances, contacts, movement or arrivals to preserve a happy path.

**GEO-004** At the current low-cost stage, Explore/Radar may discover real external OpenStreetMap POIs through an Overpass-backed discovery capability using the existing approved Explore categories. External results remain discovery candidates and are clearly distinct from canonical D05 Places where necessary; if a candidate becomes an accepted VibeQuest Place, D05 becomes the canonical owner. Provider failure yields cached valid results where permitted, retry, partial/empty/unavailable or error states rather than invented fallback POIs, ratings, reviews, crowd counts or Business ownership.

**GEO-005** Protected proximity outcomes are server-authoritative. Client Haversine or other local distance calculations may present provisional distance from already-authorized coordinates but cannot authorize check-in, Place validation, VQ, geofence transitions, Trail completion, Find Hub disclosure or another protected geographic action. VibeCheck and VibeFlash retain their existing rule that participation has no geographic/proximity gate.

**GEO-006** The directed discovery/search scope for **Secrets, Find Hub and applicable nearby-feed discovery is 23 km**. This discovery radius does not become a Secret bounty-claim radius, Place check-in radius, Validate alert radius, matching rule or individual Find Hub geofence radius; each such boundary keeps its separately approved policy.

**GEO-007** Place and Trail navigation hand canonical VQgemni coordinates/ordered stops to a supported external device navigation application where appropriate; opening navigation is not itself a Place check-in, Trail completion or VQ event. In-app map viewing is separate from turn-by-turn navigation. If an offline map/tile/routing capability is not permitted or available, the product must state that limitation while still allowing legitimately cached Trail text, itinerary and permitted media.

**SOC-001** D03 owns follow/unfollow/block. Orbit displays accounts followed; Echo displays followers; blocking revokes prohibited discovery/messages and affected shares. Following alone is not a confirmed Vibe match. D17 owns matching invitations and connection confirmation.

**SOC-002** Ordinary one-to-one personal DMs require a confirmed D17 **Vibe** (mutually accepted connection), subject to blocks, recipient privacy and active access. Orbit, Echo, unilateral or reciprocal follows alone, Gossip participation, compatible Drift scores, pending Pulls and shared Community membership do **not** independently authorize ordinary personal DMs. D14 still supports separately authorized Guardian consultation, Community rooms, Marketplace deal threads and Event discussion under their respective scoped participation contracts. Never infer a relationship or DM authorization from Gemini's fabricated compatibility scores.

## 4. HOME — living neighborhood dashboard

**HOME-001** Geographic context bar shows consented/selected city and district; tapping area/search deep-links Explore with appropriate map center/query. Manual location works when GPS is denied; do not substitute an invented fixed city.

**HOME-002** Horizontal Vibe Check-Ins carousel: own status/prompt, eligible network members' genuine check-ins, person photo, Place, relative time and descriptor; tapping opens a Place drawer/full detail. Enforce privacy and social changes; no fake check-ins.

**HOME-003** Flash Event alert banner: title, genuine countdown and **Hunt Now** / **Spawn Flash**. Hunt opens Explore Secrets Board at selected item; create opens legitimate form. No secret bounty can be claimed through the banner without the distinct qualifying evidence.

**HOME-004** Three feeds: **My Network / Local Vibes / For You**. My Network shows own/followed/permitted connections' Gossip and Share content. Local Vibes shows eligible public live/ephemeral moments within the directed **23 km** nearby-feed discovery scope using authorized coarse geographic context; it never requires public exact coordinates. For You recommends authentic Places, Trails, posts and interests informed by user preferences and Drift, without made-up scores. Initial up-to-five cards with Expand/Collapse. Same canonical post appears in permitted Home/Gossip projections; likes/comments/replies and notification effects remain consistent.

**HOME-005** Live Activities panel separates Live/Upcoming, host, meeting point, participation, authentic Resonance boost, inline creation, expanded details/feedback and route navigation. Community-led activity shows linked Circle badge and room. D10 owns activity lifecycle; D19 separately owns reputation; D20 separately evaluates configured reward events. Never manufacture ratings.

**HOME-006** Live Events panel separates Live Now/Upcoming, official organizer identity, flyer, venue, schedule, real RSVP and optional Ticketing. Publishing official Events follows D09/D11 organizer eligibility, not a simulated toggle. Eligible reminders link back to Event; exact lead time is an approved preference/rule, not an arbitrary historical 45-minute default. Up to three compact Activities/Events initially, with expansion.

**HOME-007** Daily Streak Quest shows genuine streak and Verify Signal Presence action, eligibility, once-per-day state and progress. D20 applies active starting rule **+25 VQ daily** where qualified, not legacy +20. Expired, denied, duplicate and failed awards show truthful outcomes.

**HOME-008** Explore Local Circuits opens Explore's Trails/Radar hub with area context. Heritage coordinates support **Plot** (map pin/route) and **Calibrate Coordinate** (real qualified place assertion, Passport stamp, eligible D20 reward). Local Gems expand to practical information, **Save**, **Navigate**, **Launch Interactive Signal Scanner**. Saved items and place detail remain canonical.

**HOME-009** VIBE Guide opens Community Handbook and genuine quiz/progress. Approved Admin-configured rewards only. Live Feed Monitor shows recent authorized activity from canonical events, never simulated people/check-ins. Distinct desktop **F** shortcut may toggle appropriate scanner where focus/accessibility makes sense; do not intercept text typing.

**HOME-010** **Find Hub** is a real product feature, not a decorative Home button. See section 5 for complete journey.

## 5. FIND HUB — consented friends, proximity and geofences

**HUB-001** Find Hub opens from Home/other approved navigation as a full modal with close/back, contact list and appropriate selection. Where Find Hub discovery/search is distance-scoped, the directed discovery scope is **23 km**; this does not set an individual geofence radius. A contact is an actual eligible relationship; the system must never populate it with mock people or auto-fabricated GPS positions.

**HUB-002** Each selected contact card presents permitted avatar/name, current authorized sharing/availability, approximate position/distance when consented, last updated and a clear **Lock-On** location-monitoring toggle. Unavailable/stale/revoked sharing is explicit. Lock-On requires relevant consent and cannot silently start background tracking.

**HUB-003** User and contact must each have relevant opt-in/location-sharing permissions where the workflow requires it. Server enforces visibility, session, following/connection, blocking, consent expiration and revocation. Denied GPS, inaccurate evidence or offline host must not be replaced with a default coordinate.

**HUB-004** Per eligible contact, support **Geofence Alert Boundaries**: list existing boundary labels, radius and enabled status; **Add New Geofence**, enter a label, choose a meaningful approved target (including current map area, a designated Place, or source-visible custom coordinates where explicitly entered and valid), inspect radius, **Save Geofence Rule**, toggle enabled/disabled and delete. Historical default **200 m** is a design reference, not a global imposed threshold for all Geo functions. Validate coordinate ranges, radius, location target, owner and consent; invalid custom coordinates must not silently fall back to an invented/default location.

**HUB-005** For a correctly configured and consented geofence, detect real **enter/exit** transitions and notify the subscribing member, with deduplication, freshness and boundary jitter protection. A stale or unknown contact position cannot trigger a fake arrival. Revocation, blocking, deletion, disable or permission withdrawal stops future use immediately.

**HUB-006** D04 owns authentic geofence boundary enter/exit transition evidence and deduplication; D23 owns delivery to the subscribing member and inbox read/dismiss/unread state. Provide Find Hub **Alerts** history, unread counts, read/clear controls and real alerts. The historical mock-shift/test buttons that move contacts randomly must not exist as operative production features. Admin/test fixtures may exist only in isolated test environments, not as fabricated public location proof.

**HUB-007** For location safety, share only the approved precision and permitted area/distance data. Do not expose permanent accurate trajectories, host-secret locations or persistent peer GPS history. Temporary live position pings are discarded within the directed **2-hour** policy; persistent user-authored geofence configuration is separate and must have user deletion controls.

**HUB-008** Accept only after testing create/edit/toggle/delete boundary; contact consent and withdrawal; enter/exit using genuine permitted test events; delayed/missing/inaccurate location; multi-device state; no repeated alerts on jitter; block behavior; no seeded contacts or fake movement; Web/Telegram parity and D04/D03/D23 ownership.

## 6. EXPLORE — map, radar, Places and Secrets

**EXP-001** Search Places, streets, districts and cities with suggestions that identify real results; choosing an item pans/zooms the interactive map and fetches eligible nearby canonical Places plus real external discovery candidates where applicable. The current low-cost external POI discovery may use Overpass/OpenStreetMap behind the approved provider boundary; provider results never become canonical D05 Places merely by appearing in Explore. List/map filters remain synchronized. Seven categories: **All, Food, Cafés, Culture, Art, Venues, Hidden**.

**EXP-002** Radar Pulse animates a genuine discovery search, with area/map result indication, appropriate activity signals and cultural rarity presentation when grounded. Historical **10-km** range, **Common/Rare/Legendary** and visual heatmap are experience references; live people, rarity and venue scores must not be fabricated. Map pins and cards reference real Places.

**EXP-003** Place card/dossier includes photos, name, category, vibe descriptor, permitted real distance, address, practical details, authorized external website/contact links where available, community confidence, navigation, save, contributions and linked real Trails/Events. External links open the actual Place resource with safe browser handling rather than a fabricated destination. **Navigate** hands the canonical D05 coordinate to a supported external device-navigation application; the handoff does not mutate Place state or claim arrival. Correct and report Place facts through D05, with review/moderation where applicable; editing a Place record is distinct from submitting a report.

**EXP-004** Verified venue check-in uses a server-authoritative maximum distance of **5 m** from the canonical D05 Place location. D04 must have sufficiently fresh and precise evidence to support the conclusion that the member is within that 5 m boundary. The existing device-reported accuracy requirement **better than 50 m** is a separate coarse eligibility condition and is **not sufficient proof** of the 5 m distance; if measurement uncertainty is too large to establish the 5 m condition, return a truthful insufficient-accuracy/cannot-verify state. Do not invent another exact GPS-accuracy threshold, and do not adopt the historical 200-m Validate-popup alert radius as the check-in threshold. A previous check-in is a canonical D05 record, never a browser flag.

**EXP-005** Secrets Board: **Live Secrets Board**, live countdowns, Place/map context, event dossier/story, host, admission/transport guidance, audience **Interested/Going**, **Spawn Flash/Create Secret** and genuine eligible **Claim Secret Bounty**. Secret discovery/search uses the directed **23 km** scope with controlled approximate location/clue release; this does **not** define the separate bounty-claim proximity rule. Author may select lifetime (historical 30m/1h/2h/up to 8h). Accurate expiry removes from active listings; claims require authorized verification and D20 rule, not old GPS teleporter. Historical 50-m bounty radius remains only an experience reference pending its own final claim policy.

## 7. WAZE-STYLE VALIDATE POPUP — full workflow

## 18. VQ — canonical reward catalog and full Admin control

| Source event | Starting credit | Initial limit |
|---|---:|---|

Validation votes, community joins, radar use, guide quizzes, social Pulls, Secret hunts, VibeFlash or gratitude receive VQ only if an explicit supported Admin activity rule exists and all source eligibility is satisfied; historical amounts are not silently copied.

**VQ-003** Gossip creator tipping provides **10 / 20 / 50 VQ** presets with eligible recipient and amount confirmation. Member transfers and authorized Marketplace VQ movement use actual double-entry-like balanced ledger effects, account eligibility, blocking/fraud rules, available-balance checks and idempotency. Failed/partial transactions never create success receipts. No crypto/fiat conversion is implied.

**ADM-VQ-001** A separate, phone-usable **Admin Control Panel → VQ Rules** presents current rule catalog with stable event key, name, description, amount, active state, eligibility, frequency cap, VQ amount cap, cooldown, effective version/time, audit actor and history. Rule catalog and editor must display **the same active authoritative values**. Only supported originating business events may become executable reward rules; typing a name does not fabricate a backend trigger.

**ADM-VQ-002** Authorized Admin may create/configure **supported** rules and edit amount, enable/disable, participant eligibility, source verification, frequency limit, amount-per-period cap, cooldown and effective activation. Distinguish '**three awards/day**' from '**max 150 VQ/day**'; historical Grok contradictory cap screenshots do not set policy. Backend validates allowed combinations and persists effective versions. Draft/preview is non-effective until successful authorized save/publish. A changed value applies prospectively per version policy without retroactively editing ledger entries.

**ADM-VQ-003** **Manual grant** is an authorized, auditable grant command with explicit recipient selection and independent idempotent **per-recipient ledger attribution** (never one shared balance edit). It supports one individual; **targeted grants** to eligible Pro Guardians and Local Legends; **selected-group grants**; and **all-eligible-user/bulk** distributions. Admin selects recipients/criteria, custom amount, attribution label/reason and confirms. Show recipient count, exclusions, per-user and total VQ and review of high-impact action. **Preview never posts credits.** Privileged grant execution uses canonical D20 writer, per-recipient idempotency and truthful completed/failed/pending counts, preserving safe retry without double credit. Elevated approvals where configured; never grant Admin privileges because of VQ ownership.

**ADM-VQ-004** Admin dashboard exposes genuine rule status, source-event awards, grant totals, outstanding distribution outcomes, tips/transfers, corrections and ledger reconciliation. Filter/details/refresh must reflect real records, not synthetic daily-active-user charts. A failed API write does not update authoritative visual success or claim credits were issued.

**ADM-VQ-005** All edits, activations, bulk grants and correction requests require permission-scoped authorization, actor/reason timestamp, rule version/old-new values and audit history. Corrections use compensating postings rather than erasing balance history. Genuine risk protections include suspicious repetitive event activity, duplicate source event/replayed request, race conditions, insufficient balance, double spending, unauthorized rule edits and accidental platform-wide grants.

**ADM-VQ-006** D20 receives qualified source outcomes from D05 Place checks, D06 Trail completion, D22 Handshake, D18 VibeCheck, relevant streak/event owners and explicitly approved optional categories. VQ posting remains independent of notification delivery or UI completion. The source domain retains ownership of its underlying fact; a validation No vote cannot independently create a venue check-in award.

**ADM-VQ-007** Admin VQ acceptance tests: real catalog/edit/enable/disable; new values affect future events; caps/cooldowns/daily limits verified; unauthorized role denied; invalid source key rejected; double event not double credited; user grant and Pro/Legend/group/global grant each preview and genuinely post correct recipients; safe retry of partial distribution; correction/audit intact; tips, transfers, insufficient funds, concurrent debits, Marketplace posting and reconciliation verified; cross-device Purse/Admin state consistent; no local fallback reports fabricated success.

## 19. Remaining domains — complete initial scope, real lifecycles

**BIZ-001 / D09:** Business/organization onboarding, authority and operator management, public profile, legitimate Place links, and verified business event eligibility. Paid entitlements do not themselves establish ownership or trust.

**ACT-001 / D10:** User-created Activities support create/edit/publish, join/leave, host, date/place, authentic participation, context-specific chat and permitted resonance/reviews. D10 owns status, D23 delivery, D19 standing, D20 conditional reward.

**MEDIA-001 / D13:** Durable avatars/Place and Trail photos in controlled persistent object storage; ephemerals (VibeCheck/VibeFlash, social Moments) obey **24-hour** expiry. Live room audio via WebRTC is never routinely recorded. Upload permissions, processing, deletion and attachment authorization must be enforced. Live-only requirement applies to dedicated live-capture modes, not every permitted profile or Place upload.

**ROOM-001 / D15 and COM-001 / D16:** Communities/Circles create/browse/join/request/leave, public/private membership, owner/moderator roles, room chat, bulletins, polls, optional soundboard, legitimate attendance and moderation; no fake joined membership after failed insertion.
