# PART 11 — SEPARATE DRIFT DATABASE STRUCTURES

**Do not implement Drift messaging inside generic social-post tables or permanently retained direct-message tables.**

Drift needs its own logically isolated persistence system.

Stay within the existing approved VQULTIMATE Supabase project and D01–D28 single-writer architecture unless separately authorized to create an entirely new database service.

Inspect existing objects first.

Proposed dedicated objects:

| Proposed resource | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `drift_rooms` | Independent wavelength room definitions |
| `drift_room_presence` | Active participants and heartbeat status |
| `drift_aliases` | Temporary anonymous identity records |
| `drift_messages` | Ephemeral group-chat messages |
| `drift_message_reactions` | Reactions tied to unexpired messages |
| `drift_private_threads` | Private anonymous conversations |
| `drift_private_messages` | Ephemeral private message records |
| `drift_bottles` | Anonymous bottle messages and pickup status |
| `drift_reveal_requests` | Bilateral reveal consent |
| `drift_room_moderators` | Authorized room-management assignments |
| `drift_moderation_actions` | Restricted moderation event records |
| `drift_media` | Dedicated private media bucket |

These are target logical resources. Inspect the existing schema to prevent duplication and finalize physical names before preparing migrations.

Keep ownership explicit:

- **D15:** Room lifecycle, participation, presence, and group-chat records.
- **D14:** Private anonymous conversations and private-message records.
- **D17:** Anonymous discovery, bottle pickup, reveal consent, confirmed-Vibe creation.
- **D13:** Storage, attachment lifecycle, cleanup.
- **D01:** Authenticated identity and platform administrator authorization.
- **D23:** Notifications.

Do not create shadow owners or direct cross-domain writes.

## 11.1 Required database behavior

- Appropriate uniqueness constraints.
- Efficient room/message indexes.
- Expiration indexes.
- Atomic pickup and reveal operations.

## 7. HANDSHAKE — KEEP THE EXACT REFERENCE UI, IMPLEMENT SIMPLE MUTUAL ACCEPTANCE NOW

**Important Product Owner decision:**

Keep the Handshake button, labels, badges, visual behavior and placement matching the reference.

Do not remove, replace or redesign Handshake.

For this phase, implement the **simple mutual-acceptance workflow** described by the reference's intended protocol.

The more advanced full Handshake contract will be implemented separately later.

### Required simple workflow

**Step 1 — Initiation**

An authenticated user presses the appropriate Handshake/Hire/Meet action on a Guardian or Local Legend profile.

The application creates a genuine Handshake request for the correct recipient.

The request is pending.

**Step 2 — Provider decision**

The actual intended Guardian/Local Legend can view the pending request and choose to accept or decline.

Only the intended recipient may act on that request.

**Step 3 — Acceptance**

On acceptance, the backend verifies both participants and the pending request.

Mutual acceptance is persisted.

The UI updates to show genuine accepted Handshake status.

**Step 4 — Decline**

If declined, the request does not produce a completed Handshake proof.

The user receives truthful status feedback.

**Step 5 — Approved effects**

Only an actual completed Handshake may enable the corresponding supported Handshake-gated interactions, such as eligible Guardian reviews.

### Strict rules

- A button click alone is not a completed Handshake.
- Do not create active proof before provider acceptance.
- Do not create a fake Handshake badge.
- Do not fabricate the provider's consent.
- Do not duplicate the same active agreement.
- Do not store the agreement solely in browser memory.
- Do not create a second writer outside D22.
- Do not automatically unlock D17 Confirmed Vibes.
- Do not automatically unlock permanent D14 direct messaging.
- Do not implement speculative reward logic.

### Reference implementation warning

The historical reference contains localStorage-based Handshake state and operations that can mark or display proof before genuine mutual backend confirmation.

**Do not copy those implementation defects.**

Preserve the interface and intended mutual acceptance behavior while using real backend persistence and proper domain ownership.

### Future contract boundary

Do not implement the complete future Handshake protocol prematurely.

Respect any current governing lifecycle rules that already apply, but do not invent additional expiry states, payment logic, reward rules, geolocation requirements or verification mechanics.

If the current D22 database contract cannot represent initiation and mutual acceptance correctly, document the exact missing capability and provide SQL for review.

Do not silently change the contract.

# 3. CONFIRMED ISSUES TO RECHECK AND REPAIR

The previous source inspection identified the following issues.

Reconfirm each against the current working tree before editing.

### A. Oversized social post cards

Current `HomeSocialFeed.tsx` used:

`aspect-[4/5]`

The reference uses:

`aspect-[4/3]`

The current implementation also separates the image, header and action controls differently from the reference.

This produces excessive card height.

Repair the layout to match the reference screenshot.

### B. Comment false-success

The examined `addCommentToPost()` implementation:

- Creates a local comment.
- Saves it to localStorage.
- Attempts a Supabase insert.
- Returns the local comment even when the backend insert fails.

This can display a successful comment that does not exist in the authoritative database.

**This behavior must be eliminated.**

### C. Non-authoritative comment retrieval

The examined `fetchCommentsForPost()` implementation combines Supabase comments with locally persisted comments.

This can conceal backend errors and display comments that were never accepted by the server.

Do not treat localStorage as authoritative comment persistence.

### D. Reaction false-success

The Home feed optimistically toggles liked state without properly reconciling the result of `addReactionToPost()`.

The inspected API does not establish a complete unlike operation.

Repair this according to the approved canonical reaction contract.

### E. My Network filtering defect

The examined code returns every post when the relationship-ID set is empty.

This can expose unrelated posts under My Network.

Correct this without confusing D03 follows with D17 Confirmed Vibes.

### F. Local Vibes filtering defect

The examined code effectively displays all posts under Local Vibes.

Implement only the authorized location-based filtering supported by the current application contracts.

Do not fabricate locations or location consent.

### G. For You ranking

The examined code uses reactions/comments as a simplified inclusion test.

Inspect the approved requirements and current supported ranking signals.

Do not invent a personalization algorithm or fake relevance score.

### H. Share feedback

The inspected share code may report that a link is ready even after clipboard failure.

Ensure user feedback accurately reflects what was completed.

🗄️ Part 2: The Supabase SQL Editor Prompt

text
Act as a Senior Database Architect specializing in PostgreSQL and Supabase. Write a highly optimized, bulletproof, migration-ready SQL script to set up a double-entry off-chain ledger system for "VQ Rewards".

### 1. Database Schema Design:
- Create `vq_accounts` table:
  - `user_id` uuid primary key (references existing `auth.users(id)` or `profiles(id)` via ON DELETE CASCADE).
  - `available_balance` numeric(18,4) not null default 0. Add a check constraint preventing values less than 0.
  - `locked_balance` numeric(18,4) not null default 0. Add a check constraint preventing values less than 0.
  - `updated_at` timestamptz default now().
- Create `vq_transactions` table:
  - `id` uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid().
  - `idempotency_key` text unique not null.
  - `from_user_id` uuid references profiles(id) or auth.users(id) nullable (null represents system mints/purchases).
  - `to_user_id` uuid references profiles(id) or auth.users(id) nullable (null represents system burns/spends).
  - `amount` numeric(18,4) not null check (amount > 0).
  - `type` text not null check (type in ('purchase','reward','tip','transfer','spend','stake','unstake','redemption')).
  - `status` text not null default 'completed' check (status in ('pending','completed','failed')).
  - `description` text layout.
  - `metadata` jsonb default '{}'::jsonb.
  - `created_at` timestamptz default now().

### 2. Security & RLS Policies:
- Enable Row Level Security (RLS) on both `vq_accounts` and `vq_transactions`.
- Create Select policies: Users can only read rows where `auth.uid() = user_id` for balances, and where `auth.uid() = from_user_id` OR `auth.uid() = to_user_id` for transactions.
- Deny direct Insert/Update modifications to these tables from the client app. All state modifications must happen via the security-definer RPC function below.

### 3. Atomic Database Transfer Function (RPC):
Write a PostgreSQL function named `execute_vq_transfer` utilizing `SECURITY DEFINER` logic to execute atomic mutations safely:
- Input parameters: `p_idempotency_key text`, `p_to_user_id uuid`, `p_amount numeric`, `p_type text`, `p_description text`.
- Context parameters: Sender is evaluated dynamically inside the function using `auth.uid()`.
- Implementation Logic:
  1. Check if the provided `p_idempotency_key` already exists in `vq_transactions`. If it does, exit immediately without error to guarantee idempotency.
  2. Implement row-level locking via `SELECT FOR UPDATE` on the sender's balance row within `vq_accounts`.
  3. Assert that the sender has an `available_balance` greater than or equal to `p_amount`. Raise an explicit custom exception if funds are insufficient.
  4. Perform an atomic debit change on the sender's row.
  5. Perform an atomic credit update on the receiver's row (if the row doesn't exist yet, insert a default zeroed record first).
  6. Append a single ledger record entry inside `vq_transactions`.
  7. Wrap the entire operational block inside a native `BEGIN ... EXCEPTION ... END;` transaction context block.

Output only the clean, copy-pasteable pure SQL script ready for the Supabase SQL editor

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Navbar } from './components/Navbar';
import { BottomNav, TabType } from './components/BottomNav';
import { HomeTab } from './components/HomeTab';
import { ExploreTab } from './components/ExploreTab';
import { ShareTab } from './components/ShareTab';
import { VibeTab } from './components/VibeTab';
import { PurseTab } from './components/PurseTab';
import { NotificationModal } from './components/NotificationModal';
import { ProfileModal } from './components/ProfileModal';
import { PulseDmModal } from './components/PulseDmModal';
import { PlaceDetailModal } from './components/PlaceDetailModal';
import { AdminModal } from './components/AdminModal';
import { subscribeAuthProfile, UserProfile } from './domains/d01_auth';
import { VibePlace } from './domains/d03_vibe_orbit';
import { CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { UserProfileCard } from './components/UserProfileCard';
import { AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { useTheme } from './lib/theme';
import { useProfileSettings } from './features/profile/hooks/useProfileSettings';
import { fetchNotifications } from './domains/d08_notifications';

export default function App() {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<UserProfile | null>(null);
  const mainScrollRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<TabType>('home');
  const { locale: lang } = useProfileSettings();
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  const themeMode = theme === 'light' ? 'cream' : 'midnight';
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState(0);
  const [isNotificationsOpen, setIsNotificationsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isProfileOpen, setIsProfileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isMessagesOpen, setIsMessagesOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isAdminOpen, setIsAdminOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPlace, setSelectedPlace] = useState<VibePlace | null>(null);
  const [inspectedProfile, setInspectedProfile] = useState<UserProfile | null>(null);
  const [appToast, setAppToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => subscribeAuthProfile(setUser), []);
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    void fetchNotifications().then(items => {
      if (active) setUnreadCount(items.filter(item => !item.read).length);
    });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [user?.id]);

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setAppToast(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setAppToast(null), 3000);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // The reference shell scrolls each tab inside the viewport, not the document.
    if (mainScrollRef.current) mainScrollRef.current.scrollTop = 0;
  }, [activeTab]);

  const isRtl = lang === 'ar';

  return (
    <div
      dir={isRtl ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'}
      className={`h-[100dvh] flex flex-col ${
        themeMode === 'cream' ? 'bg-amber-100 text-neutral-900' : 'bg-neutral-950 text-white'
      } font-sans antialiased selection:bg-orange-500 selection:text-white overflow-hidden max-w-md mx-auto w-full box-border transition-colors duration-300 relative`}
    >
      {/* Toast Notification Banner */}
      {appToast && (
        <div className="fixed top-16 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-teal-500 text-neutral-950 font-bold text-xs shadow-2xl flex items-center space-x-2 animate-fadeIn border border-teal-300">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>{appToast}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Top Navbar */}
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto w-full box-border shrink-0">
        <Navbar
          user={user}
          onOpenNotifications={() => setIsNotificationsOpen(true)}
          onOpenProfile={() => setIsProfileOpen(true)}
          unreadCount={unreadCount}
        />
      </div>

      {/* Main Content Container */}
      <main ref={mainScrollRef} className="max-w-md mx-auto px-4 pt-4 w-full box-border flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden overscroll-contain pb-24">
        {activeTab === 'home' && (
          <HomeTab
            user={user}
            onNavigateTab={setActiveTab}
            onSelectPlace={(place) => setSelectedPlace(place)}
            onInspectUser={(profile) => setInspectedProfile(profile)}
          />
        )}
        {activeTab === 'explore' && (
          <ExploreTab
            user={user}
            onSelectPlace={(place) => setSelectedPlace(place)}
            onRequireAuth={() => setIsProfileOpen(true)}
          />
        )}
        {activeTab === 'share' && (
          <ShareTab
            user={user}
            onPostSuccess={() => setActiveTab('vibe')}
          />
        )}
        {activeTab === 'vibe' && <VibeTab user={user} onNavigateShare={() => setActiveTab('share')} />}
        {activeTab === 'purse' && <PurseTab user={user} />}
      </main>

      {/* Bottom Five-Tab Navigation */}
      <BottomNav activeTab={activeTab} onChangeTab={setActiveTab} scrollContainerRef={mainScrollRef} />

      {/* Modals */}
      {isNotificationsOpen && (
        <NotificationModal onClose={() => setIsNotificationsOpen(false)} />
      )}

      <AnimatePresence>
        {isProfileOpen && (
          <ProfileModal
            key="reference-profile-sidebar"
            user={user}
            onClose={() => setIsProfileOpen(false)}
            onUserSwitch={setUser}
            themeMode={themeMode}
            onToggleTheme={toggleTheme}
            onOpenAdmin={() => setIsAdminOpen(true)}
            onOpenNotifications={() => setIsNotificationsOpen(true)}
            onOpenMessages={() => setIsMessagesOpen(true)}
            onNavigateHome={() => setActiveTab('home')}
          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {isMessagesOpen && (
        <PulseDmModal user={user} onClose={() => setIsMessagesOpen(false)} />
      )}

      {isAdminOpen && (
        <AdminModal user={user} onClose={() => setIsAdminOpen(false)} />
      )}

      {selectedPlace && (
        <PlaceDetailModal
          place={selectedPlace}
          onClose={() => setSelectedPlace(null)}
          onCheckIn={(place) => {
            showToast(`Checked in at ${place.title}. Reward ledger unverified (backend pending).`);
          }}
          onViewMap={() => {
            setSelectedPlace(null);
            setActiveTab('explore');
          }}
          onRequireAuth={() => setIsProfileOpen(true)}
        />
      )}

      {inspectedProfile && (
        <UserProfileCard
          profile={inspectedProfile}
          currentUser={user}
          onClose={() => setInspectedProfile(null)}
          onRequireAuth={() => setIsProfileOpen(true)}
          onToast={showToast}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Compass, Camera, Flame, Wallet, Home as HomeIcon } from 'lucide-react';

export type TabType = 'home' | 'explore' | 'share' | 'vibe' | 'purse';

interface BottomNavProps {
  activeTab: TabType;
  onChangeTab: (tab: TabType) => void;
  scrollContainerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
}

export const BottomNav: React.FC<BottomNavProps> = ({ activeTab, onChangeTab, scrollContainerRef }) => {
  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(true);
  const lastScrollY = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      const currentScrollY = scrollContainerRef?.current?.scrollTop ?? window.scrollY;
      if (currentScrollY > lastScrollY.current + 15) {
        setIsVisible(false); // scrolling down past 15px threshold
      } else if (currentScrollY < lastScrollY.current - 10 || currentScrollY < 10) {
        setIsVisible(true); // scrolling up
      }
      lastScrollY.current = currentScrollY;
    };

    const target = scrollContainerRef?.current ?? window;
    target.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
    return () => target.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
  }, [scrollContainerRef]);

  useEffect(() => {
    lastScrollY.current = 0;
    setIsVisible(true);
  }, [activeTab]);

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'home' as TabType, label: 'Home', icon: HomeIcon },
    { id: 'explore' as TabType, label: 'Explore', icon: Compass },
    { id: 'share' as TabType, label: 'Share', icon: Camera },
    { id: 'vibe' as TabType, label: 'Vibe', icon: Flame },
    { id: 'purse' as TabType, label: 'Purse', icon: Wallet },
  ];

  return (
    <nav
      className={`fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 max-w-md mx-auto transition-all duration-300 transform ${
        isVisible ? 'translate-y-0 opacity-100' : 'translate-y-full opacity-0 pointer-events-none'
      } bg-neutral-950/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-neutral-800/80 px-2 py-2 box-border shadow-2xl`}
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-1">
        {tabs.map((tab) => {
          const Icon = tab.icon;
          const isActive = activeTab === tab.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={tab.id}
              onClick={() => onChangeTab(tab.id)}
              className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-2 px-1 rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 box-border ${
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-gradient-to-t from-orange-500/20 via-teal-500/10 to-transparent text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30 shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/10'
                  : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-200 hover:bg-neutral-900/50'
              }`}
            >
              <Icon className={`w-5 h-5 mb-1 transition-transform duration-300 ${isActive ? 'scale-110 text-orange-400' : 'text-neutral-400'}`} />
              <span className={`text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wide ${isActive ? 'text-white' : 'text-neutral-400'}`}>
                {tab.label}
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Footprints, X, Upload, MapPin, CheckCircle2, Image as ImageIcon, Flame } from 'lucide-react';
import { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';

interface CreateActivityModalProps {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreated: (newActivity: any) => void;
  onToast: (msg: string) => void;
}

export const CreateActivityModal: React.FC<CreateActivityModalProps> = ({ user, onClose, onCreated, onToast }) => {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('OUTDOORS');
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(user?.city || 'Sidi Bou Said');
  const [isLive, setIsLive] = useState(true);
  const [tagline, setTagline] = useState('Casual walk • LIVE');
  const [isVibeFlash, setIsVibeFlash] = useState(false);
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files) return;
    const newPhotos: string[] = [...photos];
    Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
      if (newPhotos.length >= 4) {
        onToast('Maximum 4 photos allowed per activity.');
        return;
      }
      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
        onToast('Only JPEG, PNG, and WebP images are supported.');
        return;
      }
      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        onToast('Image size must be under 5MB.');
        return;
      }
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (uploadEvent) => {
        if (uploadEvent.target?.result) {
          setPhotos(prev => [...prev, uploadEvent.target!.result as string].slice(0, 4));
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  };

  const removePhoto = (index: number) => {
    setPhotos(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim() || !location.trim()) {
      onToast('Please enter activity title and location.');
      return;
    }
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800));

    const activityItem = {
      id: `act-${Date.now()}`,
      title: title.trim(),
      category: isVibeFlash ? 'VIBEFLASH' : category.toUpperCase(),
      badge: isLive ? 'LIVE' : 'UPCOMING',
      location: location.trim(),
      author: user?.full_name || user?.username || 'District Explorer',
      tagline: isVibeFlash ? '⚡ VibeFlash Spontaneous Gathering' : (isLive ? 'Casual gathering • LIVE' : tagline),
      isLive,
      is_vibeflash: isVibeFlash,
      image: photos[0] || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507525428034-b723cf961d3e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80',
      gallery: photos
    };

    onCreated(activityItem);
    setIsSubmitting(false);
    onToast(isVibeFlash ? 'VibeFlash spontaneous gathering posted successfully!' : 'Activity successfully posted to district feed!');
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-teal-500/50 rounded-3xl p-6 space-y-5 shadow-2xl text-white max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-800 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-2xl bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-400 border border-teal-500/40">
              <Footprints className="w-5 h-5 text-teal-400" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-black text-lg tracking-wide">Create Activity & VibeFlash</h3>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer">

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Calendar, X, Upload, MapPin, CheckCircle2, Image as ImageIcon, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';

interface CreateEventModalProps {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreated: (newEvent: any) => void;
  onToast: (msg: string) => void;
}

export const CreateEventModal: React.FC<CreateEventModalProps> = ({ user, onClose, onCreated, onToast }) => {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('MUSIC');
  const [venue, setVenue] = useState('');
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(user?.city || 'Downtown Tunis');
  
  // Timing for ACME V8 automatic 60-min Flash Alert eligibility
  const defaultStarts = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
  const defaultEnds = new Date(Date.now() + 150 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
  
  const [startsAt, setStartsAt] = useState(defaultStarts);
  const [endsAt, setEndsAt] = useState(defaultEnds);
  const [isFlashPromoted, setIsFlashPromoted] = useState(false);
  
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const canPromoteFlash = Boolean(user?.role === 'admin' || user?.tier === 'pro' || user?.tier === 'business' || user?.accountType === 'pro');

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files) return;
    const newPhotos: string[] = [...photos];
    Array.from(files).forEach(file => {
      if (newPhotos.length >= 4) {
        onToast('Maximum 4 photos allowed per event.');
        return;
      }
      if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
        onToast('Only JPEG, PNG, and WebP images are supported.');
        return;
      }
      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        onToast('Image size must be under 5MB.');
        return;
      }
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = (uploadEvent) => {
        if (uploadEvent.target?.result) {
          setPhotos(prev => [...prev, uploadEvent.target!.result as string].slice(0, 4));
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  };

  const removePhoto = (index: number) => {
    setPhotos(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim() || !venue.trim()) {
      onToast('Please enter event title and venue.');
      return;
    }
    const startMs = new Date(startsAt).getTime();
    const endMs = new Date(endsAt).getTime();
    if (isNaN(startMs) || isNaN(endMs) || startMs >= endMs) {
      onToast('Event end time must be after start time.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800));

    const now = Date.now();
    const isLiveNow = startMs <= now && endMs > now;
    const isSoon = startMs - now <= 60 * 60 * 1000 && startMs > now;
    const timeStatusStr = isLiveNow ? 'LIVE NOW' : isSoon ? `Starts in ${Math.ceil((startMs - now)/60000)}m` : new Date(startMs).toLocaleString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });

    const eventItem = {
      id: `ev-${Date.now()}`,
      title: title.trim(),
      description: description.trim() || 'Community district gathering and cultural showcase.',
      category: category.toUpperCase(),
      badge: isLiveNow ? 'LIVE' : 'UPCOMING',
      venue: venue.trim(),
      host: user?.full_name || user?.username || 'District Host',
      location: location.trim(),
      timeStatus: timeStatusStr,
      isLive: isLiveNow || isSoon,
      starts_at: new Date(startMs).toISOString(),
      ends_at: new Date(endMs).toISOString(),
      is_flash_promoted: isFlashPromoted,
      image: photos[0] || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511192336575-5a79af67a629?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80',
      gallery: photos
    };

    onCreated(eventItem);
    setIsSubmitting(false);
    onToast(isFlashPromoted ? 'Event published & promoted as Flash Alert!' : 'Event successfully published to district feed!');
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-fuchsia-500/50 rounded-3xl p-6 space-y-5 shadow-2xl text-white max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-800 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-2xl bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/40">
              <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-400" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-black text-lg tracking-wide">Create Event & Flash Promotion</h3>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-neutral-300 mb-1">Event Title *</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Rooftop Synthwave Session"
              className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-neutral-300 mb-1">Category</label>
              <select
                value={category}
                onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500"
              >
                <option value="MUSIC">Music</option>
                <option value="ART & CULTURE">Art & Culture</option>
                <option value="ELECTRONIC">Electronic</option>
                <option value="ACOUSTIC">Acoustic</option>
                <option value="NIGHTLIFE">Nightlife</option>
                <option value="COMMUNITY">Community</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-neutral-300 mb-1">Venue Name *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={venue}
                onChange={(e) => setVenue(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. The Atlas Rooftop"
                className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-neutral-300 mb-1">Start Date & Time *</label>
              <input
                type="datetime-local"
                required
                value={startsAt}
                onChange={(e) => setStartsAt(e.target.value)}

                required
                value={endsAt}
                onChange={(e) => setEndsAt(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-3 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-neutral-300 mb-1">Location / District</label>
            <input

              value={location}
              onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)}

              className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500"
            />

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Zap, Clock, Shield, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { createFlashEvent } from '../domains/d11_events';
import { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';
import { VibePlace } from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit';

interface CreateFlashModalProps {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  canCreate: boolean;
  places: VibePlace[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreated: () => void;
  onToast: (msg: string) => void;
}

export const CreateFlashModal: React.FC<CreateFlashModalProps> = ({
  user,
  canCreate,
  places,
  onClose,
  onCreated,
  onToast
}) => {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [kind, setKind] = useState('secret_party');
  const [durationMins, setDurationMins] = useState('120');
  const [startsAtInput, setStartsAtInput] = useState(() => {
    const local = new Date(Date.now() - new Date().getTimezoneOffset() * 60 * 1000);
    return local.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
  });
  const [placeId, setPlaceId] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const isAdmin = canCreate;

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);

    if (!isAdmin) {
      setErrorMsg('Unauthorized: Only server-verified Pro, Business or App Admin accounts can create Flash Events.');
      return;
    }
    if (!title.trim() || !description.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Please enter a title and description for the Flash Event.');
      return;
    }

    const startDate = new Date(startsAtInput);
    if (!Number.isFinite(startDate.getTime()) || startDate.getTime() < Date.now() - 120000) {
      setErrorMsg('Choose a valid start time in the future.');
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    const startsAt = startDate.toISOString();
    const endsAt = new Date(startDate.getTime() + Number(durationMins) * 60 * 1000).toISOString();

    const res = await createFlashEvent({
      title: title.trim(),
      description: description.trim(),
      kind,
      place_id: placeId || null,
      starts_at: startsAt,
      ends_at: endsAt,
      created_by: user?.id
    });

    setLoading(false);
    if (res.success) {
      onToast('Flash Event saved. It becomes discoverable 60 minutes before its start.');
      onCreated();
      onClose();
    } else {
      setErrorMsg(res.error || 'Failed to spawn flash event. Check Supabase RLS / table schema.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl text-white space-y-5 relative">
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Close Create Flash Modal"
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white p-2 rounded-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 transition cursor-pointer"
        >
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
          <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/40">
            <Zap className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-black text-lg text-white">Create Flash Event</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400">D11 Events & Business Authority Protocol</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {!isAdmin && (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 text-xs flex items-center space-x-2">
            <Shield className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
            <span>Only verified Pro, Business or App Admin accounts can create Flash Events.</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-300">Event Title</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Secret Pop-up Gallery"
              className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-white text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-orange-500 transition"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-300">Description & Rules</label>
            <textarea
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="An exclusive underground installation..."
              rows={3}
              className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-white text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-orange-500 transition resize-none"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label htmlFor="flash-start" className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-300">Event Start Time</label>
            <input id="flash-start" type="datetime-local" value={startsAtInput}
              onChange={e => setStartsAtInput(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-white text-sm"
              required />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">Scheduled events appear 60 minutes before their start and stay visible until they end.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label htmlFor="flash-place" className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-300">Event Place (optional)</label>

/**
 * Create Meetup Modal Component
 * Allows creating pop-up venue gatherings with live/scheduled options, description, and 1 optional photo.
 */

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Users, Calendar, MapPin, Radio, CheckCircle2, Camera } from 'lucide-react';
import { VibePlace } from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit/types';
import { createPlaceMeetup } from '../domains/d12_meetups/api';
import { PlaceMeetup } from '../domains/d12_meetups/types';
import { useUser } from '../contexts/UserContext';

interface CreateMeetupModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  place: VibePlace;
  onCreated?: (meetup: PlaceMeetup) => void;
}

function compressImage(file: File): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        let width = img.width;
        let height = img.height;
        const maxDim = 900;
        if (width > maxDim || height > maxDim) {
          if (width > height) {
            height = Math.round((height * maxDim) / width);
            width = maxDim;
          } else {
            width = Math.round((width * maxDim) / height);
            height = maxDim;
          }
        }
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) {
          resolve(e.target?.result as string || '');
          return;
        }
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
        resolve(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.82));
      };
      img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load image'));
      img.src = e.target?.result as string;
    };
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read file'));
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

export const CreateMeetupModal: React.FC<CreateMeetupModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  place,
  onCreated
}) => {
  const { user } = useUser();
  const [isLiveCheckin, setIsLiveCheckin] = useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [scheduledDate, setScheduledDate] = useState(() => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setHours(d.getHours() + 2);
    d.setMinutes(0, 0, 0);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 16);
  });
  const [photoUrl, setPhotoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [createdMeetup, setCreatedMeetup] = useState<PlaceMeetup | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handlePhotoChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      const compressed = await compressImage(file);
      setPhotoUrl(compressed);
    } catch {
      setError('Failed to process meetup photo.');
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!title.trim()) {
      setError('Please provide a meetup title or topic.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);

    const hostUserId = user?.id || 'usr_anonymous';
    const hostName = user?.username || user?.full_name || 'Vibe Explorer';
    const hostAvatar = user?.avatar_url;

    try {
      const scheduledAt = isLiveCheckin
        ? new Date().toISOString()
        : new Date(scheduledDate).toISOString();

      const res = await createPlaceMeetup({
        placeId: place.id,
        placeTitle: place.title,
        placeAddress: place.address || '',
        placeCategory: (place as any).categoryLabel || place.category || 'Spots',
        hostUserId,
        hostName,
        hostAvatar,
        title: title.trim(),
        description: description.trim() || undefined,
        scheduledAt,
        isLiveCheckin,
        photo_url: photoUrl || undefined
      });

      if (res.success && res.meetup) {
        setCreatedMeetup(res.meetup);
        if (onCreated) {
          onCreated(res.meetup);
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
          setCreatedMeetup(null);
          onClose();
        }, 1400);
      } else {
        setError(res.error || 'Failed to create meetup');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err?.message || 'Error publishing meetup');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in"
    >
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-[#0d111a] border border-neutral-800 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden border-t-2 border-t-blue-500">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-5 border-b border-neutral-800">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 rounded-lg border border-blue-500/30">
              <Users className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white tracking-wide">
                Organize Spot Meetup
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 truncate max-w-[280px]">
                {place.title}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close create meetup modal"
            className="p-1.5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-neutral-800 transition"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {createdMeetup ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center space-y-3">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 mx-auto rounded-full bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-blue-500/40">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8" />
            </div>
            <h4 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">Meetup Published!</h4>
            <p className="text-sm text-neutral-300">
              Your meetup is now active in this spot's Meetup tab, your profile, and the community feeds.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4 max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto text-xs">
            {error && (
              <div className="p-3 text-xs bg-red-950/50 border border-red-500/40 text-red-200 rounded-xl">
                {error}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Mode selection: Live Now vs Scheduled */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 p-1 bg-neutral-900/80 rounded-xl border border-neutral-800">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsLiveCheckin(false)}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition ${
                  !isLiveCheckin
                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-md'
                    : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-200'
                }`}
              >
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Scheduled Meetup</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsLiveCheckin(true)}
                className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition ${
                  isLiveCheckin
                    ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md'
                    : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-200'
                }`}
              >
                <Radio className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-pulse" />
                <span>Live Now (I'm Here)</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Title */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-300">
                Meetup Title / Topic *
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={title}
                onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Afternoon Latte & Tech Chat, Casual Drinks..."
                maxLength={60}
                required
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Date/Time if not live */}
            {!isLiveCheckin && (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-300">
                  Date & Time
                </label>
                <input
                  type="datetime-local"
                  value={scheduledDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setScheduledDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Meetup Photo Upload */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="font-bold text-neutral-300 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Camera className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
                <span>Meetup Photo (Optional — 1 Photo)</span>
              </label>
              {photoUrl ? (
                <div className="relative w-full h-32 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-blue-500/40">
                  <img src={photoUrl} alt="Meetup preview" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setPhotoUrl(null)}
                    className="absolute top-2 right-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-black/80 text-white font-bold text-[10px] hover:bg-red-600 transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    ✕ Remove Photo
                  </button>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <label className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-24 border-2 border-dashed border-neutral-800 hover:border-blue-500/50 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950/60 cursor-pointer transition">
                  <Camera className="w-5 h-5 text-neutral-400 mb-1" />
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 font-semibold">Upload meetup photo</span>
                  <input type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={handlePhotoChange} className="hidden" />
                </label>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Description */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-300">

              <textarea
                value={description}
                onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Look for the yellow notebook by the outdoor patio. Everyone welcome!"
                rows={2}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 resize-none"

            {/* Location context reminder */}
            <div className="p-3 bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800/80 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-neutral-400">

function compressImage(file: File): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

    reader.onload = (e) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {

        const maxDim = 900;

          if (width > height) {
            height = Math.round((height * maxDim) / width);
            width = maxDim;
          } else {
            width = Math.round((width * maxDim) / height);
            height = maxDim;
          }
        }
        canvas.width = width;

        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

          resolve(e.target?.result as string || '');

        }

                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setPhotoUrl(null)}
                  className="absolute top-2 right-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-black/80 text-white font-bold text-[10px] hover:bg-red-600 transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  ✕ Remove Photo
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <label className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-28 border-2 border-dashed border-neutral-800 hover:border-fuchsia-500/50 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950/60 cursor-pointer transition">
                <Camera className="w-6 h-6 text-neutral-400 mb-1" />
                <span className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 font-semibold">Click to upload event photo</span>
                <span className="text-[9px] text-neutral-500">Compressed automatically (JPEG)</span>
                <input type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={handlePhotoChange} className="hidden" />
              </label>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="font-bold text-neutral-300 uppercase tracking-wider">Description & Secret Access</label>
            <textarea
              value={description}
              onChange={e => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Provide vibe details, directions, or secret password notes..."
              rows={3}
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-fuchsia-500 text-xs font-semibold resize-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="font-bold text-neutral-300 uppercase tracking-wider">Duration</label>
              <select
                value={durationMinutes}
                onChange={e => setDurationMinutes(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-fuchsia-500 text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value={60}>60 Minutes</option>
                <option value={120}>2 Hours (Default)</option>
                <option value={180}>3 Hours</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="font-bold text-neutral-300 uppercase tracking-wider">Max Capacity</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                value={maxCapacity}
                onChange={e => setMaxCapacity(Math.max(5, Number(e.target.value)))}
                min={5}
                max={100}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-fuchsia-500 text-xs font-semibold"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 rounded-xl font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider bg-fuchsia-600 hover:bg-fuchsia-500 text-white transition cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-fuchsia-600/30 disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 mt-2"
          >
            <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>{submitting ? 'Publishing Flash...' : '🚀 Publish Vibe Flash Now'}</span>
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

===== BEGIN FILE: src\components\CurateTrailModal.tsx =====
SIZE_BYTES: 28486

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { X, Plus, Trash2, Route, Clock, Sparkles, MapPin, Compass, ArrowUp, ArrowDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { CommunityTrail, TrailStop, TimeOfDay, createCommunityTrail, fetchCulturalTrails, photoLimit, requireTrailGallery, uploadTrailPhotos, validateTrailPhotos } from '../domains/d07_trails';
import { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';

interface CurateTrailModalProps {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  availableTrails: CommunityTrail[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreated: (trail: CommunityTrail) => void;
  onToast: (msg: string) => void;
  onRequireSignIn: () => void;
  initialTrail?: CommunityTrail | null;
  initialIsTour?: boolean;
}

export const CurateTrailModal: React.FC<CurateTrailModalProps> = ({
  user,
  availableTrails,
  onClose,
  onCreated,
  onToast,
  onRequireSignIn,
  initialTrail = null,
  initialIsTour = false
}) => {
  const [isTour, setIsTour] = useState(initialIsTour);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'overview' | 'stops' | 'tour'>(initialIsTour ? 'tour' : 'overview');
  const [sourceTrailId, setSourceTrailId] = useState(initialTrail?.id || '');
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(initialTrail?.title ? `${initialTrail.title.replace(/\s*\(Remix\)$/i, '')} (Remix)` : '');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(initialTrail?.category || 'FULL DAY CIRCUIT');
  const [city, setCity] = useState(initialTrail?.city || '');
  const [story, setStory] = useState(initialTrail?.story || '');
  const [vibeTagsInput, setVibeTagsInput] = useState(initialTrail?.vibeTags?.join(', ') || '');
  const [imageUrl, setImageUrl] = useState(initialTrail?.imageUrl || '');
  const [pricePerPerson, setPricePerPerson] = useState<number>(0);
  const [durationHours, setDurationHours] = useState<number>(initialTrail?.durationHours || 1);
  const [flow, setFlow] = useState<string[]>(initialTrail?.flowSequence || ['🌅', '🌆', '🌙']);

  const [stops, setStops] = useState<TrailStop[]>(
    initialTrail?.stops?.length ? initialTrail.stops.map(stop => ({...stop})) :
    [{ id: 'stop-1', name: '', address: '', vibeNote: '', timeOfDay: 'Morning', durationMinutes: 60 }]
  );

  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [publishError, setPublishError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [photoFiles, setPhotoFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [coverPhotoIndex, setCoverPhotoIndex] = useState(0);
  const previews = useMemo(() => photoFiles.map(file => URL.createObjectURL(file)), [photoFiles]);
  useEffect(() => () => previews.forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url)), [previews]);
  const maxPhotos = photoLimit(user?.accountType, user?.role === 'admin');
  const freePhotoSlots = Math.max(0, maxPhotos - (imageUrl ? 1 : 0));

  const selectPhotos = (incoming: FileList | null) => {
    if (!incoming?.length) return;
    const next = [...photoFiles, ...Array.from(incoming)];
    try {
      validateTrailPhotos(next, freePhotoSlots);
      setPhotoFiles(next);
    } catch (error) {
      onToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Invalid Trail photos.');
    }
  };
  const removePhoto = (index: number) => {
    setPhotoFiles(current => current.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
    setCoverPhotoIndex(0);
  };

  const applySourceTrail = (sourceId: string) => {
    setSourceTrailId(sourceId);
    const original = availableTrails.find(trail => trail.id === sourceId);
    if (!original) return;
    setTitle(original.title);
    setCategory(original.category);
    setCity(original.city);
    setStory(original.story);
    setVibeTagsInput(original.vibeTags.join(', '));
    setImageUrl(original.imageUrl);
    setDurationHours(original.durationHours);
    setStops((original.stops || []).map(stop => ({...stop})));
    setFlow(original.flowSequence);
  };

  const handleMoveStop = (index: number, direction: -1 | 1) => {
    setStops(current => {
      const nextIndex = index + direction;
      if (nextIndex < 0 || nextIndex >= current.length) return current;
      const reordered = [...current];
      [reordered[index], reordered[nextIndex]] = [reordered[nextIndex], reordered[index]];
      return reordered;
    });
  };

  const handleAddStop = () => {
    const newStop: TrailStop = {
      id: `stop-${Date.now()}`,
      name: '',
      address: '',
      vibeNote: '',
      timeOfDay: 'Afternoon',
      durationMinutes: 45
    };
    setStops(current => [...current, newStop]);
  };

  const handleRemoveStop = (idx: number) => {
    if (stops.length <= 1) return;
    setStops(current => current.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  };

  const handleUpdateStop = (idx: number, field: keyof TrailStop, val: TrailStop[keyof TrailStop]) => {
    setStops(current => current.map((stop, i) => i === idx ? { ...stop, [field]: val } : stop));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!user) { onRequireSignIn(); return; }
    if (!title.trim() || !city.trim()) {
      onToast('Please provide a Trail title and city.');
      setActiveTab('overview');
      return;
    }
    if (isTour && (!user || !['pro','business'].includes(user.accountType || ''))) { onToast('Only Pro and Business accounts can publish Tours.'); setActiveTab('tour'); return; }
    if (isTour && (!Number.isFinite(pricePerPerson) || pricePerPerson <= 0)) { onToast('Enter the actual Tour price.'); setActiveTab('tour'); return; }
    if (stops.some((s) => !s.name.trim())) {
      onToast('Please give a title/location to all itinerary stops.');
      setActiveTab('stops');
      return;
    }
    if (stops.some((s) => !s.address.trim())) {
      onToast('Enter a Google Maps address for each stop so visitors can navigate the route.');
      setActiveTab('stops');
      return;
    }

    setPublishError(null);
    setSubmitting(true);
    let published: CommunityTrail | undefined;
    try {
      // Fail before creating a Trail when the gallery migration is not installed.
      if (photoFiles.length) {
        validateTrailPhotos(photoFiles, freePhotoSlots);
        await requireTrailGallery();
      }
      const tags = vibeTagsInput
        .split(',')
        .map(t => t.trim().toLowerCase())
        .filter(Boolean);
      const result = await createCommunityTrail({
        title: title.trim(),
        story: story.trim(),
        category,
        city: city.trim(),
        vibeTags: tags,
        imageUrl,
        durationHours: Number(durationHours) || 0,
        isTour,
        forkedFromTrailId: sourceTrailId || undefined,
        pricePerPerson: isTour ? Number(pricePerPerson) : undefined,
        flowSequence: flow,
        authorName: user.full_name,
        authorHandle: `@${user.username}`,
        authorAvatarUrl: user.avatar_url,
        stops
      });
      if (!result.success || !result.trail) throw new Error(result.error || 'Failed to publish Trail.');
      published = result.trail;
      if (photoFiles.length) {
        await uploadTrailPhotos(published.id, photoFiles, coverPhotoIndex);
        published = (await fetchCulturalTrails()).find(t => t.id === published?.id) || published;
      }
      onCreated(published);
      onToast(isTour ? 'Commercial Vibe Tour published!' : 'Cultural Vibe Trail published!');
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      if (published) {
        // Never silently erase an already-published Trail because a photo failed.
        const safePublished = published;
        const refreshed = await fetchCulturalTrails().then(
          trails => trails.find(t => t.id === safePublished.id) || safePublished,
          () => safePublished,
        );
        onCreated(refreshed);
        onToast('Trail was published, but one or more photos failed: ' +
          (error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)));
        onClose();
      } else {
        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to publish Trail.';
        setPublishError(message);
        onToast(message);
      }
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="w-full sm:max-w-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl text-white max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-neutral-950/80">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Compass className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-black text-sm text-white">
                {isTour ? 'Curate Vibe Tour' : 'Curate Cultural Vibe Trail'}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">D07 Local Knowledge & Curation Engine</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-full bg-neutral-900 hover:bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Form Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-4 flex-1 text-xs">
          <div role="tablist" aria-label="Trail and Tour creator sections" className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 rounded-xl border border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-950 p-1">
            {([['overview', '1. Overview'], ['stops', '2. Stops'], ['tour', '3. Tour']] as const).map(([tab, label]) => (
              <button key={tab} type="button" role="tab" id={`studio-tab-${tab}`} aria-controls={`studio-panel-${tab}`}
                aria-selected={activeTab === tab} onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab)}
                className={`min-w-0 rounded-lg px-1.5 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold transition sm:text-xs ${activeTab === tab ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40' : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white border border-transparent'}`}>
                {label}{tab === 'stops' ? ` (${stops.length})` : ''}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div role="tabpanel" id="studio-panel-overview" aria-labelledby="studio-tab-overview" hidden={activeTab !== 'overview'} className="space-y-4">
          {/* Curation Type Selector */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 p-1 bg-neutral-950 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-800">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setIsTour(false)}
              className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                !isTour
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-neutral-950 shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/20'
                  : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <span>🧭 Free Vibe Trail</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                if (!user) { onRequireSignIn(); return; }
                if (!['pro', 'business'].includes(user.accountType || '')) {
                  onToast('Only Pro and Business accounts can create Tours.'); return;
                }
                setIsTour(true);
              }}
              className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                isTour
                  ? 'bg-amber-500 text-neutral-950 shadow-md shadow-amber-500/20'
                  : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <span>⬡ Vibe Tour</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <section className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-950/60 p-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <label htmlFor="trail-gallery-input" className="text-[11px] font-bold text-white">
                Add Trail Photos
              </label>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">
                {photoFiles.length + (imageUrl ? 1 : 0)} / {maxPhotos} photos
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">
              Add real JPG, PNG or WebP images (up to 5 MB each). The existing cover counts toward your limit.
              Select a cover for your uploaded gallery.
            </p>
            <input id="trail-gallery-input" type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
              multiple disabled={submitting || photoFiles.length >= freePhotoSlots}
              onChange={event => { selectPhotos(event.target.files); event.currentTarget.value = ''; }}
              className="block w-full text-xs text-neutral-300 file:mr-3 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:bg-emerald-500/20 file:px-3 file:py-2 file:font-bold file:text-emerald-300 disabled:opacity-50"
            />
            {photoFiles.length > 0 && (
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-3">
                {photoFiles.map((file, index) => (
                  <div key={`${previews[index] || file.name}-${index}`} className="min-w-0 space-y-1 rounded-lg border border-neutral-800 p-1.5">
                    {previews[index] ? (
                      <img src={previews[index]} alt={`Selected Trail photo ${index + 1}`}
                        className="aspect-video w-full rounded-md object-cover" />
                    ) : null}
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-neutral-300">
                      <input type="radio" checked={coverPhotoIndex === index}
                        onChange={() => setCoverPhotoIndex(index)}
                        name="trail-gallery-cover" /> Cover
                    </label>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => removePhoto(index)}
                      className="text-[10px] text-red-300 hover:text-red-200">Remove</button>
                    <p className="truncate text-[9px] text-neutral-500" title={file.name}>{file.name}</p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </section>

          {/* Title */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-300">Trail Title</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Golden Day in Tunis: Coastal Coffee to Late Night Beats"
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Category & City */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-300">Category Tag</label>
              <select
                value={category}
                onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
              >
                <option value="FULL DAY CIRCUIT">FULL DAY CIRCUIT</option>
                <option value="ANTIQUITY & COAST">ANTIQUITY & COAST</option>
                <option value="HERITAGE & ARCHITECTURE">HERITAGE & ARCHITECTURE</option>
                <option value="VIBRANT AESTHETICS">VIBRANT AESTHETICS</option>
                <option value="FOOD & SEA BREEZE">FOOD & SEA BREEZE</option>
                <option value="VIP GUIDED TOUR">VIP GUIDED TOUR</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-300">City / Location</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={city}
                onChange={(e) => setCity(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Tunis, Tunisia"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Story Narrative */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-300">Atmospheric Narrative & Story</label>
            <textarea
              rows={2}
              value={story}
              onChange={(e) => setStory(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="A complete sunup-to-late-night circuit through the soul of northern Tunis..."
              className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 resize-none"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Tags & Duration */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-300">Vibe Tags (comma-separated)</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={vibeTagsInput}
                onChange={(e) => setVibeTagsInput(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="tunis, culture, sunset"
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-300">Estimated Duration (~hours)</label>
              <input
                type="number"
                step="0.5"
                min="0.5"
                max="24"
                value={durationHours}
                onChange={(e) => setDurationHours(Number(e.target.value))}
                className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Time Flow Sequence Picker */}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-300">Time Flow Sequence</label>
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
              {['🌅 Morning', '☀️ Afternoon', '🌆 Sunset', '🌙 Night'].map((item) => {
                const emoji = item.split(' ')[0];
                const active = flow.includes(emoji);
                return (
                  <button
                    key={item}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (active) {
                        if (flow.length > 1) setFlow(flow.filter((e) => e !== emoji));
                      } else {
                        setFlow([...flow, emoji]);
                      }
                    }}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border font-bold text-[11px] transition cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-1 ${
                      active
                        ? 'bg-neutral-800 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/50'
                        : 'bg-neutral-950 text-neutral-500 border-neutral-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span>{item}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {isTour && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-amber-300">Reuse an Existing or Adopted Trail</label>
          <select value={sourceTrailId} onChange={event => applySourceTrail(event.target.value)} className="w-full bg-neutral-900 text-white border border-neutral-700 rounded-xl p-2">
            <option value="">Create a new itinerary</option>
            {availableTrails.filter(trail => !trail.isTour).map(trail =>
              <option key={trail.id} value={trail.id}>{trail.title} — @{trail.authorHandle.replace(/^@/, '')}</option>
            )}
          </select>
        </div>
      )}

          </div>
          <div role="tabpanel" id="studio-panel-stops" aria-labelledby="studio-tab-stops" hidden={activeTab !== 'stops'} className="space-y-3">
      {/* Itinerary Stops Builder */}
          <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-neutral-800">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="font-bold text-white text-xs flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                <Route className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                <span>Itinerary Stops ({stops.length} Stops)</span>
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleAddStop}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>Add Stop</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {stops.map((stop, idx) => (
                <div key={stop.id} className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-black">
                      {idx + 1}
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => handleMoveStop(idx, -1)} disabled={idx === 0}
                        aria-label={`Move stop ${idx + 1} up`} className="p-1 rounded-lg text-neutral-400 hover:text-white disabled:opacity-30">
                        <ArrowUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => handleMoveStop(idx, 1)} disabled={idx === stops.length - 1}
                        aria-label={`Move stop ${idx + 1} down`} className="p-1 rounded-lg text-neutral-400 hover:text-white disabled:opacity-30">
                        <ArrowDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                      <select
                        value={stop.timeOfDay}
