import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Wine, Waves, Clock, X, Sparkles, Globe } from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import {
  DriftBottle,
  DriftRoom,
  castDriftBottle,
  fetchFloatingBottles,
  pickupDriftBottle,
  CANONICAL_WAVELENGTH_ROOMS
} from '../../domains/d15_drift';

interface CastBottleModalProps {
  room: DriftRoom;
  currentUserId: string;
  currentHandle: string;
  aliasId?: string;
  onBottlePickedUp: (threadId: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const CastBottleModal: React.FC<CastBottleModalProps> = ({
  room,
  currentUserId,
  currentHandle,
  aliasId,
  onBottlePickedUp,
  onClose
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'cast' | 'floating'>('cast');
  const [bottleContent, setBottleContent] = useState('');
  const [floatingBottles, setFloatingBottles] = useState<DriftBottle[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Helper for origin room name
  const getOriginRoomName = (roomId: string) => {
    const found = CANONICAL_WAVELENGTH_ROOMS.find((r) => r.id === roomId);
    return found ? found.name : room.name;
  };

  // Helper for 12-hour remaining countdown
  const getTimeRemaining = (expiresAt: string) => {
    const diff = Math.max(0, new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now());
    const hrs = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60));
    const mins = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
    if (hrs === 0 && mins === 0) return 'Expiring soon';
    return `${hrs}h ${mins}m float left`;
  };

  // Global fetch & Realtime subscription across all 12 rooms
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    fetchFloatingBottles().then((bottles) => {
      if (isMounted) setFloatingBottles(bottles);
    });

    const channel = supabase
      .channel('drift_global_bottles_realtime')
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'drift_bottles' },
        () => {
          fetchFloatingBottles().then((bottles) => {
            if (isMounted) setFloatingBottles(bottles);
          });
        }
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleCast = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!bottleContent.trim()) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setStatusMessage(null);

    const res = await castDriftBottle({
      roomId: room.id,
      senderAliasId: aliasId,
      senderAliasHandle: currentHandle,
      senderUserId: currentUserId,
      content: bottleContent
    });

    setLoading(false);
    if (res.success && res.bottle) {
      setBottleContent('');
      setStatusMessage('✨ Bottle cast into the global current! Visible across all 12 rooms for 12 hours.');
      setFloatingBottles((prev) => [res.bottle!, ...prev.filter((b) => b.id !== res.bottle!.id)]);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setActiveTab('floating');
        setStatusMessage(null);
      }, 1300);
    } else {
      setStatusMessage(res.error || 'Failed to cast bottle.');
    }
  };

  const handlePickup = async (bottle: DriftBottle) => {
    if (bottle.sender_user_id === currentUserId) {
      setStatusMessage('You cannot pick up your own bottle.');
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    const res = await pickupDriftBottle(bottle.id, currentUserId, currentHandle);
    setLoading(false);

    if (res.success && res.threadId) {
      // Remove immediately from local state
      setFloatingBottles((prev) => prev.filter((b) => b.id !== bottle.id));
      onBottlePickedUp(res.threadId);
    } else {
      setStatusMessage(res.error || 'Bottle pickup failed.');
      // Re-sync floating bottles in case another voyager scooped it
      fetchFloatingBottles().then(setFloatingBottles);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-start justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 pt-3 sm:pt-6 animate-fadeIn overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-3xl p-5 space-y-4 shadow-2xl text-white max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col mt-1 sm:mt-3">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-800 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-pink-500/20 text-pink-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-pink-500/30">
              <Wine className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-white font-serif">Message in a Bottle</h3>
                <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-pink-900/60 text-pink-300 font-bold border border-pink-500/40">
                  12h Float
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-teal-400 flex items-center space-x-1 mt-0.5">
                <Globe className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-400" />
                <span>Global Currents • Visible Across All 12 Rooms</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer transition"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab switch: Cast vs Floating */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 bg-neutral-950 p-1 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-800 text-xs font-bold">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('cast')}
            className={`py-2 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'cast'
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-purple-600 text-white shadow'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Wine className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Cast a Drift</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('floating')}
            className={`py-2 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'floating'
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-500 to-cyan-600 text-neutral-950 shadow'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Waves className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Floating Bottles ({floatingBottles.length})</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {statusMessage && (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-teal-500/10 border border-teal-500/30 text-teal-300 text-xs leading-relaxed animate-fadeIn">
            {statusMessage}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* CAST TAB */}
        {activeTab === 'cast' ? (
          <form onSubmit={handleCast} className="space-y-4 flex-1">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                <span className="text-neutral-400">Anonymous message:</span>
                <span className={`text-[11px] font-mono ${bottleContent.length > 220 ? 'text-rose-400' : 'text-neutral-500'}`}>
                  {bottleContent.length} / 240
                </span>
              </div>
              <textarea
                value={bottleContent}
                onChange={(e) => setBottleContent(e.target.value)}
                maxLength={240}
                rows={4}
                placeholder="Cast an anonymous thought, secret riddle, or serendipitous question into the digital sea..."
                className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-2xl p-3.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-pink-500 resize-none leading-relaxed"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950/60 p-3 border border-neutral-800 text-[11px] text-neutral-400 space-y-1.5">
              <p className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-pink-300 font-bold">
                <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Global Ocean Physics</span>
              </p>
              <p className="leading-relaxed">
                Your bottle is cast from <span className="text-pink-300 font-semibold">{room.name}</span> and drifts across <span className="text-teal-300 font-semibold">all 12 wavelength rooms</span> simultaneously for <span className="text-amber-300 font-bold">12 hours</span>.
              </p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 leading-relaxed">
                The first voyager who picks it up initiates a 1:1 anonymous conversation with you, and the bottle immediately vanishes from all rooms.
              </p>
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading || !bottleContent.trim()}
              className="w-full py-3 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 via-purple-600 to-indigo-600 text-white font-black text-xs shadow-xl shadow-pink-500/20 hover:opacity-90 transition disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Wine className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>{loading ? 'Casting Bottle...' : 'Cast Into Global Ocean'}</span>
            </button>
          </form>
        ) : (
          /* FLOATING BOTTLES TAB */
          <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-3 min-h-[200px] max-h-[55vh] pr-1">
            {floatingBottles.length > 0 ? (
              floatingBottles.map((b) => (
                <div
                  key={b.id}
                  className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 p-4 space-y-3 hover:border-pink-500/40 transition"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <span className="font-bold text-pink-400">{b.sender_alias_handle}</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-300 border border-neutral-700">
                        {getOriginRoomName(b.room_id)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400/90 font-mono flex items-center space-x-1">

export const DriftActiveSoulsDrawer: React.FC<DriftActiveSoulsDrawerProps> = ({

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Pin, Globe, MapPin, X, ShieldAlert, Check, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { DriftRoom } from '../../domains/d15_drift';

interface DriftAdminPinModalProps {
  room: DriftRoom;
  currentPinnedAnnouncement?: string | null;
  initialMessageText?: string;
  isPlatformAdmin: boolean;
  onConfirmPin: (text: string, scope: 'room' | 'all') => Promise<void>;
  onConfirmUnpin: (scope: 'room' | 'all') => Promise<void>;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const DriftAdminPinModal: React.FC<DriftAdminPinModalProps> = ({
  room,
  currentPinnedAnnouncement,
  initialMessageText = '',
  isPlatformAdmin,
  onConfirmPin,
  onConfirmUnpin,
  onClose
}) => {
  const [announcementText, setAnnouncementText] = useState(
    initialMessageText || currentPinnedAnnouncement || ''
  );
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<'room' | 'all'>('room');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!isPlatformAdmin) {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
        <div className="w-full max-w-sm bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-3xl p-5 space-y-4 text-white text-center shadow-2xl">
          <ShieldAlert className="w-10 h-10 text-rose-400 mx-auto" />
          <h4 className="font-bold text-base text-rose-300">Unauthorized</h4>
          <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400">
            Pinning and broadcast announcements are restricted to authorized App Admins.
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
          >
            Close
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const handlePin = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!announcementText.trim()) {
      setErrorMsg('Announcement text cannot be empty.');
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      await onConfirmPin(announcementText.trim(), scope);
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err?.message || 'Failed to pin announcement.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUnpin = async (unpinScope: 'room' | 'all') => {
    setLoading(true);
    setErrorMsg(null);
    try {
      await onConfirmUnpin(unpinScope);
      onClose();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err?.message || 'Failed to unpin announcement.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-start justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 pt-4 sm:pt-8 animate-fadeIn overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-3xl p-5 space-y-4 shadow-2xl text-white max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col mt-1 sm:mt-2">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-800 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-amber-500/30">
              <Pin className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-white font-serif">Admin Announcement Pin</h3>
                <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-900/60 text-amber-300 font-bold border border-amber-500/40">
                  App Admin
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">
                Authoritative room or global banner announcement
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer transition"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {errorMsg && (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 text-rose-300 text-xs animate-fadeIn">
            {errorMsg}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handlePin} className="space-y-4">
          {/* Scope Selector: Specific Room vs All 12 Rooms */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-300">Announcement Scope</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setScope('room')}
                className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border text-left transition cursor-pointer flex flex-col space-y-1 ${
                  scope === 'room'
                    ? 'bg-amber-500/20 border-amber-400 text-white ring-1 ring-amber-400 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20'
                    : 'bg-neutral-950 border-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white hover:border-neutral-700'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-amber-300">
                  <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>This Room Only</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 truncate">
                  Pin in {room.name}
                </p>
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setScope('all')}
                className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border text-left transition cursor-pointer flex flex-col space-y-1 ${
                  scope === 'all'
                    ? 'bg-purple-500/20 border-purple-400 text-white ring-1 ring-purple-400 shadow-lg shadow-purple-500/20'

                >

                  <span>Unpin All 12</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';

  Plus,
  Smile,

  Send,

  Sparkles,
  X
} from 'lucide-react';
import { DriftMessage } from '../../domains/d15_drift';

interface DriftComposerProps {

  onSendMessage: (e: React.FormEvent) => void;
  replyingTo: DriftMessage | null;
  onCancelReply: () => void;

  onStopRecording: () => void;

  onRevealVibeHandle: () => void;
}

export const DriftComposer: React.FC<DriftComposerProps> = ({

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Search, Zap, Smile, Heart, Hand, Sparkles, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { DriftEmoji, fetchDriftEmojis } from '../../domains/d15_drift';

interface DriftEmojiPickerProps {
  onSelectEmoji: (emojiChar: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const DriftEmojiPicker: React.FC<DriftEmojiPickerProps> = ({
  onSelectEmoji,
  onClose
}) => {
  const [emojis, setEmojis] = useState<DriftEmoji[]>([]);
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<'animated' | 'vibes' | 'smiles' | 'gestures' | 'symbols'>('animated');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [hoveredEmoji, setHoveredEmoji] = useState<DriftEmoji | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDriftEmojis().then(setEmojis);
  }, []);

  const categories = [
    { id: 'animated', label: 'Animated', icon: Zap, color: 'text-amber-400' },
    { id: 'smiles', label: 'Smiles', icon: Smile, color: 'text-yellow-400' },
    { id: 'vibes', label: 'Vibes', icon: Heart, color: 'text-rose-400' },
    { id: 'gestures', label: 'Gestures', icon: Hand, color: 'text-teal-400' },
    { id: 'symbols', label: 'Symbols', icon: Sparkles, color: 'text-purple-400' },
  ] as const;

  const filteredEmojis = useMemo(() => {
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      return emojis.filter(e => e.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || e.character.includes(q));
    }
    return emojis.filter(e => e.category === activeCategory);
  }, [emojis, activeCategory, searchQuery]);

  const getAnimationClass = (animType?: string) => {
    switch (animType) {
      case 'flame':
        return 'animate-flame-flicker inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(249,115,22,0.8)]';
      case 'pulse':
        return 'animate-heart-pulse inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(244,63,94,0.7)]';
      case 'spin':
        return 'animate-star-spin inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(250,204,21,0.7)]';
      case 'bounce':
        return 'animate-emoji-bounce inline-block';
      case 'shake':
        return 'animate-emoji-shake inline-block';
      case 'glow':
        return 'animate-neon-glow inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(45,212,191,0.8)]';
      case 'float':
        return 'animate-emoji-float inline-block';
      default:
        return 'animate-heart-pulse inline-block';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-80 bg-neutral-900/95 border border-neutral-800 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-white animate-fadeIn select-none z-50">
      {/* Telegram-style top Search & Close */}
      <div className="p-3 border-b border-neutral-800/80 flex items-center space-x-2">
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-neutral-500" />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search Telegram emojis..."
            className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500"
          />
          {searchQuery && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
              className="absolute right-2.5 top-2 text-neutral-500 hover:text-white"
            >
              <X className="w-3 h-3" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
        >
          <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Telegram Category Tabs */}
      {!searchQuery && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-around px-2 py-1.5 border-b border-neutral-800/80 bg-neutral-950/50">
          {categories.map((cat) => {
            const Icon = cat.icon;
            const isActive = activeCategory === cat.id;
            return (
              <button
                key={cat.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveCategory(cat.id)}
                className={`p-2 rounded-xl transition flex flex-col items-center cursor-pointer ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-neutral-800 text-white shadow-inner scale-105'
                    : 'text-neutral-500 hover:text-neutral-300'
                }`}
                title={cat.label}
              >
                <Icon className={`w-4 h-4 ${isActive ? cat.color : ''}`} />
                {cat.id === 'animated' && (
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-pulse mt-0.5" />
                )}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Grid of Emojis */}
      <div className="p-3 overflow-y-auto max-h-56 grid grid-cols-6 gap-2">
        {filteredEmojis.map((emoji) => (
          <button
            key={emoji.id}
            onClick={() => onSelectEmoji(emoji.character)}
            onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredEmoji(emoji)}
            onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredEmoji(null)}
            className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl hover:bg-neutral-800/80 flex items-center justify-center text-xl transition transform hover:scale-125 cursor-pointer relative group"
          >
            <span
              className={emoji.is_animated ? getAnimationClass(emoji.animation_type) : ''}
            >
              {emoji.character}
            </span>

            {emoji.is_animated && (
              <span className="absolute top-1 right-1 w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400 opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-100" />
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Preview Bar (Telegram-style preview of hovered emoji) */}
      <div className="px-3 h-10 min-h-[40px] border-t border-neutral-800/80 bg-neutral-950/80 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
        {hoveredEmoji ? (
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 truncate">
            <span
              className={`text-lg flex-shrink-0 ${hoveredEmoji.is_animated ? getAnimationClass(hoveredEmoji.animation_type) : ''}`}
            >
              {hoveredEmoji.character}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-300 truncate max-w-[170px]">
              {hoveredEmoji.name}
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 tracking-wide uppercase font-semibold truncate">
            {activeCategory === 'animated' ? '⚡ Tap animated emoji to send' : 'Telegram Emoji Vault'}
          </span>
        )}

        <span className="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30 font-bold flex-shrink-0">
          Drift_emoji
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';

interface DriftFloatingBottleIndicatorProps {
  bottleCount: number;
  onClick: () => void;
}

// 4-point star SVG sparkle component
const StarSparkle: React.FC<{ size?: number; className?: string; style?: React.CSSProperties }> = ({
  size = 14,
  className = 'text-cyan-300',
  style
}) => (
  <svg
    width={size}
    height={size}
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="currentColor"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    className={`absolute pointer-events-none drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_currentColor] animate-pulse ${className}`}
    style={style}
  >
    <path d="M12 0L14.5 9.5L24 12L14.5 14.5L12 24L9.5 14.5L0 12L9.5 9.5Z" />
  </svg>
);

export const DriftFloatingBottleIndicator: React.FC<DriftFloatingBottleIndicatorProps> = ({
  bottleCount,
  onClick
}) => {
  if (bottleCount <= 0) return null;

  const prefersReducedMotion =
    typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
    window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  return (
    <div className="absolute right-4 bottom-20 z-30 pointer-events-auto">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onClick}
        aria-label="Open Message in a Bottle"
        className="relative group cursor-pointer focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-400/50 rounded-full transition-transform active:scale-95 p-1 bg-transparent border-0 shadow-none"
        style={
          prefersReducedMotion
            ? undefined
            : { animation: 'floatBottle 5s ease-in-out infinite' }
        }
      >
        {/* Flashing/pulsing ambient glow aura (no outer border/circle) */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-tr from-cyan-500/30 via-pink-500/20 to-purple-500/30 blur-xl animate-pulse pointer-events-none scale-125" />

        {/* Star Sparkles of different sizes and colors */}
        <StarSparkle size={18} className="text-cyan-300 -top-3 -left-3" style={{ animationDuration: '2.1s' }} />
        <StarSparkle size={12} className="text-pink-400 -bottom-2 -right-3" style={{ animationDuration: '1.6s' }} />
        <StarSparkle size={14} className="text-teal-300 top-2 -right-4" style={{ animationDuration: '2.8s' }} />
        <StarSparkle size={10} className="text-purple-300 bottom-1 -left-3" style={{ animationDuration: '2.4s' }} />

        {/* Bottle Image (pure bottle with flashing aura, zero outer circle) */}
        <div className="relative w-16 h-16 flex items-center justify-center drop-shadow-[0_10px_25px_rgba(0,220,235,0.5)]">
          <img
            src="/assets/aistudio/vibe_message_bottle_d7f0607e.png"
            alt="Message in a Bottle"
            className="w-full h-full object-contain filter drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(236,72,153,0.5)] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-300"
          />
          {bottleCount > 0 && (
            <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-pink-600 text-white font-black text-xs border border-pink-300 shadow-xl animate-bounce">
              {bottleCount}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* CSS Keyframes for floating motion */}
        {!prefersReducedMotion && (
          <style>{`
            @keyframes floatBottle {
              0%, 100% {
                transform: translateY(0px) rotate(0deg);
              }
              50% {
                transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(4deg);
              }
            }
          `}</style>
        )}
      </button>
    </div>
  );

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, RefreshCw, Shield, Check, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { generateRandomHandle, DriftRoom } from '../../domains/d15_drift';

interface DriftIdentityModalProps {
  room: DriftRoom;
  initialHandle?: string;
  initialColor?: string;
  initialGender?: 'M' | 'F';
  onConfirm: (handle: string, color: string, gender: 'M' | 'F') => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const DriftIdentityModal: React.FC<DriftIdentityModalProps> = ({
  room,
  initialHandle,
  initialColor,
  initialGender = 'M',
  onConfirm,
  onClose
}) => {
  const [generated, setGenerated] = useState(() => {
    if (initialHandle) {
      return { handle: initialHandle, color: initialColor || '#14b8a6' };
    }
    return generateRandomHandle();
  });
  const [customHandle, setCustomHandle] = useState(initialHandle || '');
  const [selectedColor, setSelectedColor] = useState(initialColor || generated.color);
  const [gender, setGender] = useState<'M' | 'F'>(initialGender);

  const colors = [
    '#06b6d4', '#14b8a6', '#f59e0b', '#ec4899', '#8b5cf6',
    '#10b981', '#f97316', '#3b82f6', '#eab308', '#a855f7'
  ];

  const handleReroll = () => {
    const next = generateRandomHandle();
    setGenerated(next);
    setSelectedColor(next.color);
    setCustomHandle('');
  };

  const currentHandle = customHandle.trim()
    ? (customHandle.trim().startsWith('@') ? customHandle.trim() : `@${customHandle.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '_')}`)
    : generated.handle;

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    onConfirm(currentHandle, selectedColor, gender);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-3xl p-6 space-y-5 shadow-2xl text-white relative">
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute top-5 right-5 p-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800/80 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
        >
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-teal-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
            <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Temporary Drift Identity</span>
          </div>
          <h3 className="font-black text-xl text-white font-serif">
            {room.name} Identity
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
            Choose your anonymous temporary handle and gender identity.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Alias Identity Card Preview (Circle border removed) */}
        <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3.5 min-w-0">
            {/* Mask Icon only without circle border */}
            <span className="text-3xl flex-shrink-0 select-none">🎭</span>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-widest font-bold">Your Drift Alias</p>
                <span
                  className={`text-[9px] font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded uppercase ${
                    gender === 'F'
                      ? 'text-pink-300 bg-pink-950/80 border border-pink-500/40'
                      : 'text-cyan-300 bg-cyan-950/80 border border-cyan-500/40'
                  }`}
                >
                  {gender === 'F' ? '♀ Female (F)' : '♂ Male (M)'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <h4 className="font-bold text-base text-white tracking-wide truncate" style={{ color: selectedColor }}>
                {currentHandle}
              </h4>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"

            className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 text-teal-400 hover:text-white hover:border-teal-500/50 transition cursor-pointer flex-shrink-0 ml-2"
            title="Generate random handle"
          >
            <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Form Controls */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          {/* Custom Handle Input */}

                  gender === 'M'

          >
            <Check className="w-4 h-4" />

import React from 'react';
import { Play, Pause, Smile } from 'lucide-react';
import { DriftMessage } from '../../domains/d15_drift';

interface DriftMessageItemProps {
  msg: DriftMessage;
  currentUserId: string;
  playingAudioId: string | null;
  onSelectSoulAction: (soul: { handle: string; userId?: string; color?: string }, message: DriftMessage) => void;
  onPlayVoice: (msgId: string, url: string) => void;
  onToggleReaction: (msgId: string, emoji: string) => void;
  onOpenEmojiReactionPicker: (msgId: string) => void;
  onReply: (msg: DriftMessage) => void;
}

export const DriftMessageItem: React.FC<DriftMessageItemProps> = ({
  msg,
  currentUserId,
  playingAudioId,
  onSelectSoulAction,
  onPlayVoice,
  onToggleReaction,
  onOpenEmojiReactionPicker,
  onReply
}) => {
  const avatarColor = msg.avatar_color || '#14b8a6';

  // Helper: Detect if message is 1-3 emojis only (Telegram large sticker/animated style)
  const isOnlyEmojis = (text: string) => {
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.length > 12) return false;
    const emojiRegex = /^(\p{Extended_Pictographic}|\p{Emoji_Presentation}|\u200D|\uFE0F|\s)+$/u;
    return emojiRegex.test(trimmed);
  };

  const getEmojiAnimationClass = (char: string) => {
    if (char.includes('🔥') || char.includes('❤️‍🔥')) return 'animate-flame-flicker inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(249,115,22,0.85)]';
    if (char.includes('❤️') || char.includes('💖') || char.includes('💕') || char.includes('💗')) return 'animate-heart-pulse inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(244,63,94,0.8)]';
    if (char.includes('✨') || char.includes('⭐') || char.includes('💎')) return 'animate-star-spin inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(250,204,21,0.8)]';
    if (char.includes('⚡') || char.includes('🔮') || char.includes('🧿')) return 'animate-neon-glow inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(45,212,191,0.9)]';
    if (char.includes('🚀') || char.includes('👻')) return 'animate-emoji-float inline-block';
    if (char.includes('🎉') || char.includes('😂') || char.includes('🤣') || char.includes('👾')) return 'animate-emoji-bounce inline-block';
    if (char.includes('🤯') || char.includes('😈') || char.includes('👋')) return 'animate-emoji-shake inline-block';
    return 'animate-heart-pulse inline-block';
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex space-x-3 items-start group">
      {/* Mask Icon (Circle removed per design mandate) */}
      <div
        onClick={() => {
          onSelectSoulAction({
            handle: msg.alias_handle,
            userId: msg.sender_user_id,
            color: avatarColor
          }, msg);
        }}
        className="text-2xl flex-shrink-0 cursor-pointer hover:scale-110 transition flex items-center justify-center pt-0.5 select-none"
        title={`Action for ${msg.alias_handle}`}
      >
        🎭
      </div>

      {/* Message Bubble & Meta */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-1">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <span
            onClick={() => {
              onSelectSoulAction({
                handle: msg.alias_handle,
                userId: msg.sender_user_id,
                color: avatarColor
              }, msg);
            }}
            className="font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer hover:underline"
            style={{ color: avatarColor }}
          >
            {msg.alias_handle}
          </span>

          {msg.gender && (
            <span
              className={`text-[9px] font-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center space-x-0.5 ${
                msg.gender === 'F'
                  ? 'text-pink-300 bg-pink-950/80 border border-pink-500/40 shadow-sm shadow-pink-500/20'
                  : 'text-cyan-300 bg-cyan-950/80 border border-cyan-500/40 shadow-sm shadow-cyan-500/20'
              }`}
              title={msg.gender === 'F' ? 'Female (F)' : 'Male (M)'}
            >
              <span>{msg.gender === 'F' ? '♀ F' : '♂ M'}</span>
            </span>
          )}

          <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">
            {new Date(msg.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Bubble Content */}
        <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/80 border border-neutral-800/80 p-3 space-y-2 backdrop-blur-md max-w-lg shadow-xl">
          {/* Reply preview */}
          {msg.reply_to_snippet && (
            <div className="border-l-2 border-teal-400 pl-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-neutral-400 bg-neutral-950/60 rounded">
              <span className="font-bold text-teal-300">{msg.reply_to_handle}: </span>
              <span className="italic">{msg.reply_to_snippet}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Text / Telegram Animated Emojis */}
          {msg.content && (
            isOnlyEmojis(msg.content) ? (
              <div className="py-1">
                <span className={`text-4xl leading-none select-none ${getEmojiAnimationClass(msg.content)}`}>
                  {msg.content}
                </span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-100 leading-relaxed break-words">
                {msg.content}
              </p>
            )
          )}

          {/* Photo */}
          {msg.media_type === 'photo' && msg.media_url && (
            <div className="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-white/10 max-h-72">
              <img
                src={msg.media_url}
                alt="Drift snapshot"
                className="w-full h-full object-cover"
              />
              <span className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-black/70 text-[9px] font-bold text-teal-300 border border-teal-400/40">
                HD
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Voice Note */}
          {msg.media_type === 'voice' && msg.media_url && (
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 bg-black/40 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-neutral-800">
              <button
                onClick={() => onPlayVoice(msg.id, msg.media_url!)}
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-pink-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow hover:scale-105 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                {playingAudioId === msg.id ? (
                  <Pause className="w-4 h-4" />
                ) : (
                  <Play className="w-4 h-4 ml-0.5" />
                )}
              </button>
              <div className="flex-1 flex items-center space-x-1 h-5">
                {[4, 8, 14, 18, 10, 6, 12, 16, 8, 4, 10, 14, 8, 12, 6, 10, 14, 8].map((h, i) => (
                  <div
                    key={i}
                    className={`w-1 rounded-full ${
                      playingAudioId === msg.id ? 'bg-teal-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-neutral-600'
                    }`}
                    style={{ height: `${h}px` }}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                0:{String(msg.voice_duration || 24).padStart(2, '0')}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Emoji Reactions row underneath */}
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 pt-1 flex-wrap gap-y-1">
            {(() => {
              const reactionKeys = new Set<string>();
              if (msg.reactions) {
                Object.entries(msg.reactions).forEach(([emo, count]) => {
                  if (count > 0) reactionKeys.add(emo);
                });
              }
              if (msg.my_reactions) {
                msg.my_reactions.forEach((emo) => reactionKeys.add(emo));
              }

              return Array.from(reactionKeys).map((emo) => {
                const count = msg.reactions?.[emo] || (msg.my_reactions?.includes(emo) ? 1 : 0);
                const isReacted = msg.my_reactions?.includes(emo);

                return (
                  <button
                    key={emo}
                    onClick={() => onToggleReaction(msg.id, emo)}
                    className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer hover:scale-105 ${
                      isReacted
                        ? 'bg-pink-500/20 border-pink-500/50 text-pink-300'
                        : 'bg-neutral-950 border-neutral-800 text-neutral-300 hover:border-neutral-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className={getEmojiAnimationClass(emo)}>{emo}</span>
                    <span>{count}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              });
            })()}

            {/* Telegram Emoji picker trigger for this message */}
            <button
              onClick={() => onOpenEmojiReactionPicker(msg.id)}
              className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] text-neutral-400 hover:text-amber-300 hover:bg-neutral-800 border border-neutral-800/60 hover:border-neutral-700 transition cursor-pointer flex items-center space-x-1"
              title="Choose Telegram Emoji reaction"
            >
              <Smile className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-400" />
              <span>+</span>
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={() => onReply(msg)}
              className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 hover:text-teal-400 hover:underline px-1 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Reply
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { MessageSquare, Clock, X, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { DriftPrivateThread, fetchUserPrivateThreads } from '../../domains/d15_drift';

interface DriftMessagesModalProps {
  currentUserId: string;
  currentHandle: string;
  onSelectThread: (thread: DriftPrivateThread) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const DriftMessagesModal: React.FC<DriftMessagesModalProps> = ({
  currentUserId,
  currentHandle,
  onSelectThread,
  onClose
}) => {
  const [threads, setThreads] = useState<DriftPrivateThread[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    fetchUserPrivateThreads(currentUserId).then((data: DriftPrivateThread[]) => {
      if (isMounted) {
        setThreads(data);
        setLoading(false);
      }
    });
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [currentUserId]);

  const getTimeRemaining = (expiresAt: string) => {
    const diff = Math.max(0, new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now());
    const hrs = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60));
    const mins = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
    return `${hrs}h ${mins}m left`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-start justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 pt-3 sm:pt-6 animate-fadeIn overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-3xl p-5 space-y-4 shadow-2xl text-white max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col mt-1 sm:mt-3">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-800 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-400 flex items-center justify-center border border-teal-500/30">
              <MessageSquare className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-white font-serif">Drift Messages</h3>
                <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-teal-900/60 text-teal-300 font-bold border border-teal-500/40">
                  {threads.length} Active
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">Your anonymous 1:1 wavelength threads</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close Drift Messages"
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content stream */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto flex-1 space-y-2.5 pr-1">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="py-16 text-center text-xs text-neutral-400">
              Scanning wavelength threads...
            </div>
          ) : threads.length > 0 ? (
            threads.map((thread) => {
              const partnerHandle = thread.user_1_id === currentUserId ? thread.alias_2_handle : thread.alias_1_handle;
              return (
                <div
                  key={thread.id}
                  onClick={() => onSelectThread(thread)}
                  className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800/80 hover:border-teal-500/50 p-4 flex items-center justify-between transition duration-300 cursor-pointer group shadow-md"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 min-w-0">
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-500/20 to-pink-500/20 border border-teal-400/30 flex items-center justify-center text-teal-300 text-base font-bold flex-shrink-0 shadow-inner">
                      🌊
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <span className="font-black text-sm text-white truncate group-hover:text-teal-300 transition">
                          {partnerHandle}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-pink-400 bg-pink-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-pink-500/30 flex-shrink-0 flex items-center space-x-1">
                          <Clock className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                          <span>{getTimeRemaining(thread.expires_at)}</span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 truncate">
                        Active private conversation thread. Tap to open.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-neutral-500 group-hover:text-white group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition flex-shrink-0 ml-2" />
                </div>
              );
            })
          ) : (
            <div className="py-20 text-center space-y-3">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-neutral-800 border border-neutral-700 flex items-center justify-center text-neutral-400 text-xl mx-auto shadow-inner">
                📭
              </div>

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import {
  DriftRoom,
  DriftAlias,
  DriftMessage,
  DriftPrivateThread,
  DriftBottle,
  updateDriftAlias,
  fetchPrivateThreadById,
  recordRoomPresence,
  createOrGetPrivateThread,
  fetchFloatingBottles
} from '../../domains/d15_drift';
import { DriftRoomHeader } from './DriftRoomHeader';
import { DriftMessageItem } from './DriftMessageItem';
import { DriftActiveSoulsDrawer } from './DriftActiveSoulsDrawer';
import { DriftComposer } from './DriftComposer';
import { DriftEmojiPicker } from './DriftEmojiPicker';
import { DriftUserActionModal } from './DriftUserActionModal';
import { DriftIdentityModal } from './DriftIdentityModal';
import { DriftAdminPinModal } from './DriftAdminPinModal';
import { CastBottleModal } from './CastBottleModal';
import { DriftMessagesModal } from './DriftMessagesModal';
import { PrivateDriftView } from './PrivateDriftView';
import { DriftFloatingBottleIndicator } from './DriftFloatingBottleIndicator';

import { useDriftRoomMessages } from './useDriftRoomMessages';
import { useDriftPresence } from './useDriftPresence';
import { useDriftVoiceRecorder } from './useDriftVoiceRecorder';
import { useDriftMediaUpload } from './useDriftMediaUpload';
import { useDriftModeration } from './useDriftModeration';

interface DriftRoomViewProps {
  room: DriftRoom;
  currentUserId: string;
  alias: DriftAlias;
  isPlatformAdmin?: boolean;
  onLeave: () => void;
  onConfirmedVibeEstablished?: () => void;
}

export const DriftRoomView: React.FC<DriftRoomViewProps> = ({
  room,
  currentUserId,
  alias,
  isPlatformAdmin = false,
  onLeave,
  onConfirmedVibeEstablished
}) => {
  const [currentAlias, setCurrentAlias] = useState<DriftAlias>(alias);
  const [identityModalOpen, setIdentityModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [soulsDrawerOpen, setSoulsDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [soulsSearchQuery, setSoulsSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [pinnedAnnouncement, setPinnedAnnouncement] = useState<string | null>(
    room.pinned_announcement || 'Welcome to ' + room.name + '! Keep it respectful, keep it anonymous, and enjoy the energy!'
  );
  const [pinnedBannerDismissed, setPinnedBannerDismissed] = useState(false);

  // Composer state
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');
  const [replyingTo, setReplyingTo] = useState<DriftMessage | null>(null);
  const [playingAudioId, setPlayingAudioId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Modals state
  const [selectedActionSoul, setSelectedActionSoul] = useState<{ handle: string; userId?: string; color?: string } | null>(null);
  const [selectedActionMessage, setSelectedActionMessage] = useState<DriftMessage | null>(null);
  const [bottleModalOpen, setBottleModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [messagesModalOpen, setMessagesModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activePrivateThread, setActivePrivateThread] = useState<DriftPrivateThread | null>(null);
  const [adminPinModalOpen, setAdminPinModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [adminPinInitialText, setAdminPinInitialText] = useState('');
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [floatingBottles, setFloatingBottles] = useState<DriftBottle[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    fetchFloatingBottles(room.id).then((bottles) => {
      if (isMounted) setFloatingBottles(bottles);
    });

    const channel = supabase
      .channel('drift_room_floating_bottles_' + room.id)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'drift_bottles' },
        () => {
          fetchFloatingBottles(room.id).then((bottles) => {
            if (isMounted) setFloatingBottles(bottles);
          });
        }
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [room.id]);

  // Telegram-style Emoji Picker State
  const [emojiPickerOpen, setEmojiPickerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [emojiPickerTarget, setEmojiPickerTarget] = useState<'composer' | { messageId: string }>('composer');

  // Suspense 3-Hour Countdown
  const [roomTimeLeft, setRoomTimeLeft] = useState('02:47:19');

  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const audioPlayerRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3000);
  };

  // Custom extracted hooks
  const { messages, setMessages, sendMessage, toggleReaction } = useDriftRoomMessages(room.id, currentAlias, currentUserId);
  const { activeSouls, setActiveSouls } = useDriftPresence(room.id, currentUserId, currentAlias);
  
  const handleMessageSent = (msg: DriftMessage) => {
    setMessages((prev) => {
      if (prev.some((m) => m.id === msg.id)) return prev;
      return [...prev, msg];
    });
  };

  const { isRecording, recordingSeconds, uploading: voiceUploading, startRecording, stopRecording } = useDriftVoiceRecorder(
    room.id,
    currentUserId,
    currentAlias,
    handleMessageSent,
    showToast
  );

  const { uploading: photoUploading, handleFileUpload } = useDriftMediaUpload(
    room.id,
    currentUserId,
    currentAlias,
    handleMessageSent,
    showToast
  );

  const uploading = voiceUploading || photoUploading;

  const { pinMessage, adminSetAnnouncement, adminUnpinAnnouncement, deleteMessage } = useDriftModeration(
    room.id,
    currentUserId,
    room.name,
    showToast
  );

  // 3-Hour session countdown & Announcement Realtime Sync
  useEffect(() => {
    const expiresTimestamp = new Date(currentAlias.expires_at || Date.now() + 3 * 3600 * 1000).getTime();
    const countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {
      const diff = Math.max(0, expiresTimestamp - Date.now());
      const hours = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60));
      const minutes = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
      const seconds = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
      setRoomTimeLeft(
        `${String(hours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}`
      );
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(countdownInterval);
    };
  }, [currentAlias]);

  useEffect(() => {
    supabase
      .from('drift_rooms')
      .select('pinned_announcement')
      .eq('id', room.id)
      .maybeSingle()
      .then(({ data }) => {
        if (data?.pinned_announcement !== undefined && data.pinned_announcement !== null) {
          setPinnedAnnouncement(data.pinned_announcement);
        }
      });

    const announcementChannel = supabase
      .channel(`drift_announcements_sync_${room.id}`)
      .on('broadcast', { event: 'pinned_announcement_updated' }, ({ payload }) => {
        if (payload?.roomId === 'all' || payload?.roomId === room.id) {
          setPinnedAnnouncement(payload.announcement || null);
          setPinnedBannerDismissed(false);
        }
      })
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      supabase.removeChannel(announcementChannel);
    };
  }, [room.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages]);

  // Handle send message
  const handleSendMessage = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!inputText.trim()) return;

    const content = inputText.trim();
    setInputText('');
    await sendMessage(content, replyingTo);
    setReplyingTo(null);
  };

  // Update Drift Identity (Handle, Color, Gender M/F)
  const handleUpdateIdentity = async (newHandle: string, newColor: string, newGender: 'M' | 'F') => {
    const res = await updateDriftAlias({
      roomId: room.id,
      userId: currentUserId,
      handle: newHandle,
      avatarColor: newColor,
      gender: newGender
    });
    const updated = res.alias || {
      id: currentAlias.id,
      room_id: room.id,
      user_id: currentUserId,
      handle: newHandle,
      avatar_color: newColor,
      gender: newGender,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString()
    };
    setCurrentAlias((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      handle: updated.handle,
      avatar_color: updated.avatar_color,
      gender: updated.gender
    }));
    await recordRoomPresence(room.id, currentUserId, currentAlias.id, updated.handle, updated.avatar_color, updated.gender);
    setActiveSouls((prev) =>
      prev.map((s) =>
        s.user_id === currentUserId
          ? { ...s, alias_handle: updated.handle, avatar_color: updated.avatar_color, gender: updated.gender }
          : s
      )
    );
    setIdentityModalOpen(false);
    showToast(`Identity set: ${updated.handle} (${updated.gender === 'F' ? '♀ Female' : '♂ Male'})`);
  };

  const handleEmojiSelect = (emojiChar: string) => {
    if (emojiPickerTarget === 'composer') {
      setInputText((prev) => `${prev}${emojiChar}`);
      setEmojiPickerOpen(false);
    } else if (typeof emojiPickerTarget === 'object' && emojiPickerTarget.messageId) {
      toggleReaction(emojiPickerTarget.messageId, emojiChar);
      setEmojiPickerOpen(false);
    }
  };

  // Play voice
  const handlePlayVoice = (msgId: string, url: string) => {
    if (playingAudioId === msgId) {
      audioPlayerRef.current?.pause();
      setPlayingAudioId(null);
    } else {
      if (audioPlayerRef.current) audioPlayerRef.current.pause();
      const audio = new Audio(url);
      audioPlayerRef.current = audio;
      setPlayingAudioId(msgId);
      audio.play();
      audio.onended = () => setPlayingAudioId(null);
    }
  };

  // Start 1:1 Private Drift
  const handleStartPrivateDrift = async (targetHandle: string, targetUserId?: string) => {
    if (!targetUserId || targetUserId === currentUserId) {
      showToast('Cannot start a private Drift with yourself.');
      return;
    }

    const res = await createOrGetPrivateThread({
      roomId: room.id,
      user1Id: currentUserId,
      alias1Handle: currentAlias.handle,
      user2Id: targetUserId,
      alias2Handle: targetHandle
    });

    if (res.success && res.thread) {
      setActivePrivateThread(res.thread);
      setSelectedActionSoul(null);
      setSelectedActionMessage(null);
    } else {
      showToast(res.error || 'Failed to initialize private Drift thread.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[#0a0a0f] text-white flex flex-col font-sans overflow-hidden select-none">
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div className="fixed top-16 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-teal-500 text-neutral-950 font-bold text-xs shadow-2xl flex items-center space-x-2 animate-fadeIn border border-teal-300">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>{toastMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODULAR ROOM HEADER */}
      <DriftRoomHeader
        room={room}
        activeSoulsCount={activeSouls.length}
        roomTimeLeft={roomTimeLeft}
        soulsDrawerOpen={soulsDrawerOpen}
        pinnedAnnouncement={pinnedAnnouncement}
        pinnedBannerDismissed={pinnedBannerDismissed}
        currentGender={currentAlias.gender}
        isPlatformAdmin={isPlatformAdmin}
        onLeave={onLeave}
        onToggleSoulsDrawer={() => setSoulsDrawerOpen(!soulsDrawerOpen)}
        onOpenBottleModal={() => setBottleModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenMessages={() => setMessagesModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenIdentityModal={() => setIdentityModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenAdminPinModal={() => {
          setAdminPinInitialText(pinnedAnnouncement || '');
          setAdminPinModalOpen(true);
        }}
        onDismissPinnedBanner={() => setPinnedBannerDismissed(true)}
        showToast={showToast}
      />

      {/* MAIN CHAT CONTAINER (Messages Stream + Active Souls Drawer) */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex overflow-hidden relative">
        {/* Messages Stream */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4">
          {messages.length > 0 ? (
            messages.map((msg) => (
              <DriftMessageItem
                key={msg.id}
                msg={msg}
                currentUserId={currentUserId}
                playingAudioId={playingAudioId}
                onSelectSoulAction={(soul, message) => {
                  setSelectedActionSoul(soul);
                  setSelectedActionMessage(message);
                }}
                onPlayVoice={handlePlayVoice}
                onToggleReaction={toggleReaction}
                onOpenEmojiReactionPicker={(msgId) => {
                  setEmojiPickerTarget({ messageId: msgId });
                  setEmojiPickerOpen(true);
                }}
                onReply={(m) => setReplyingTo(m)}
              />
            ))
          ) : (
            <div className="py-20 text-center space-y-3">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-teal-500/20 border border-teal-400/40 flex items-center justify-center text-teal-300 text-xl mx-auto shadow-lg">
                🌊
              </div>
              <h4 className="font-black text-sm text-white">Quiet Current in {room.name}</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 max-w-xs mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                Be the first soul to drop an anonymous message or voice thought into this wavelength!
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
          <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
        </div>

        {/* MODULAR ACTIVE SOULS DRAWER */}
        {soulsDrawerOpen && (
          <DriftActiveSoulsDrawer
            activeSouls={activeSouls}
            currentUserId={currentUserId}
            soulsSearchQuery={soulsSearchQuery}
            onChangeSearchQuery={setSoulsSearchQuery}
            onClose={() => setSoulsDrawerOpen(false)}
            onSelectSoul={(soul) => setSelectedActionSoul(soul)}
            onStartPrivateDrift={handleStartPrivateDrift}
            showToast={showToast}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* FLOATING MESSAGE IN A BOTTLE INDICATOR */}
      <div className="relative">
        <DriftFloatingBottleIndicator
          bottleCount={floatingBottles.length}
          onClick={() => setBottleModalOpen(true)}
        />
      </div>

      {/* MODULAR COMPOSER BAR & EXPANDED TOOLBAR */}
      <DriftComposer
        inputText={inputText}
        onChangeInputText={setInputText}
        onSendMessage={handleSendMessage}
        replyingTo={replyingTo}
        onCancelReply={() => setReplyingTo(null)}
        isRecording={isRecording}
        onStartRecording={startRecording}
        onStopRecording={stopRecording}
        uploading={uploading}
        onFileUpload={handleFileUpload}
        emojiPickerOpen={emojiPickerOpen && emojiPickerTarget === 'composer'}
        onToggleEmojiPicker={() => {
          setEmojiPickerTarget('composer');
          setEmojiPickerOpen((prev) => !prev);
        }}
        onOpenBottleModal={() => setBottleModalOpen(true)}
        onRevealVibeHandle={() => {
          const firstOther = activeSouls.find((s) => s.user_id !== currentUserId);
          if (firstOther) {
            handleStartPrivateDrift(firstOther.alias_handle, firstOther.user_id);
          } else {
            showToast('Open a Private Drift with a soul to exchange handles.');
          }
        }}
      />

      {/* TELEGRAM DRIFT EMOJI PICKER POPUP */}
      {emojiPickerOpen && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-20 right-3 sm:right-6 z-50 shadow-2xl">
          <DriftEmojiPicker
            onSelectEmoji={handleEmojiSelect}
            onClose={() => setEmojiPickerOpen(false)}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* USER ACTION MODAL (Tap on any soul) */}
      {selectedActionSoul && (
        <DriftUserActionModal
          targetHandle={selectedActionSoul.handle}
          targetUserId={selectedActionSoul.userId}
          targetColor={selectedActionSoul.color}
          selectedMessage={selectedActionMessage}
          isModerator={isPlatformAdmin}
          onSendPrivateDrift={handleStartPrivateDrift}
          onCastBottleToUser={() => setBottleModalOpen(true)}
          onPinMessage={(msg, scope) => pinMessage(msg, scope, setPinnedAnnouncement, setPinnedBannerDismissed)}
          onDeleteMessage={(msg) => deleteMessage(msg, setMessages)}
          onReport={(h) => showToast(`Report logged for ${h}. Moderators notified.`)}
          onClose={() => {
            setSelectedActionSoul(null);
            setSelectedActionMessage(null);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* CAST / PICK UP DRIFT BOTTLE MODAL */}
      {bottleModalOpen && (
        <CastBottleModal
          room={room}
          currentUserId={currentUserId}
          currentHandle={currentAlias.handle}
          aliasId={currentAlias.id}
          onBottlePickedUp={(threadId) => {
            setBottleModalOpen(false);
            fetchPrivateThreadById(threadId).then((thread) => {
              if (thread) setActivePrivateThread(thread);
            });
          }}
          onClose={() => setBottleModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}

      {/* DRIFT MESSAGES INBOX MODAL */}
      {messagesModalOpen && (
        <DriftMessagesModal
          currentUserId={currentUserId}
          currentHandle={currentAlias.handle}
          onSelectThread={(thread) => {
            setMessagesModalOpen(false);
            setActivePrivateThread(thread);
          }}
          onClose={() => setMessagesModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}

      {/* 1:1 PRIVATE DRIFT VIEW */}
      {activePrivateThread && (
        <PrivateDriftView
          thread={activePrivateThread}
          currentUserId={currentUserId}
          currentHandle={currentAlias.handle}
          onClose={() => setActivePrivateThread(null)}
          onConfirmedVibeEstablished={() => {
            if (onConfirmedVibeEstablished) onConfirmedVibeEstablished();
            showToast('✨ Double-match Confirmed! Unlocked in VIBES squad.');
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* IDENTITY EDIT MODAL (Choose Handle & Gender M/F) */}
      {identityModalOpen && (
        <DriftIdentityModal
          room={room}
          initialHandle={currentAlias.handle}
          initialColor={currentAlias.avatar_color}
          initialGender={currentAlias.gender || 'M'}
          onConfirm={handleUpdateIdentity}
          onClose={() => setIdentityModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}

      {/* APP ADMIN PIN & BROADCAST MODAL (Specific Room or All 12 Rooms) */}
      {adminPinModalOpen && (
        <DriftAdminPinModal
          room={room}
          currentPinnedAnnouncement={pinnedAnnouncement}
          initialMessageText={adminPinInitialText}
          isPlatformAdmin={isPlatformAdmin}
          onConfirmPin={(text, scope) => adminSetAnnouncement(text, scope, setPinnedAnnouncement, setPinnedBannerDismissed)}
          onConfirmUnpin={(scope) => adminUnpinAnnouncement(scope, setPinnedAnnouncement)}
          onClose={() => setAdminPinModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  ChevronLeft,
  Sparkles,
  Send,
  Camera,
  Mic,
  Image as ImageIcon,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Play,
  Pause,
  AlertCircle,
  X,
  Smile
} from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import {
  DriftPrivateThread,
  DriftPrivateMessage,
  fetchPrivateMessages,
  sendPrivateMessage,
  requestVibeReveal,
  fetchRevealRequest,
  uploadDriftMedia
} from '../../domains/d15_drift';
import { DriftEmojiPicker } from './DriftEmojiPicker';

interface PrivateDriftViewProps {
  thread: DriftPrivateThread;
  currentUserId: string;
  currentHandle: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirmedVibeEstablished?: () => void;
}

export const PrivateDriftView: React.FC<PrivateDriftViewProps> = ({
  thread,
  currentUserId,
  currentHandle,
  onClose,
  onConfirmedVibeEstablished
}) => {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<DriftPrivateMessage[]>([]);
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState('');
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [recordingDuration, setRecordingDuration] = useState(0);
  const [revealState, setRevealState] = useState<'idle' | 'pending' | 'accepted'>('idle');
  const [revealCelebration, setRevealCelebration] = useState(false);
  const [playingAudioId, setPlayingAudioId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [emojiPickerOpen, setEmojiPickerOpen] = useState(false);

  const isOnlyEmojis = (text: string) => {
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    if (!trimmed || trimmed.length > 12) return false;
    const emojiRegex = /^(\p{Extended_Pictographic}|\p{Emoji_Presentation}|\u200D|\uFE0F|\s)+$/u;
    return emojiRegex.test(trimmed);
  };

  const getEmojiAnimationClass = (char: string) => {
    if (char.includes('🔥') || char.includes('❤️‍🔥')) return 'animate-flame-flicker inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(249,115,22,0.85)]';
    if (char.includes('❤️') || char.includes('💖') || char.includes('💕') || char.includes('💗')) return 'animate-heart-pulse inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(244,63,94,0.8)]';
    if (char.includes('✨') || char.includes('⭐') || char.includes('💎')) return 'animate-star-spin inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(250,204,21,0.8)]';
    if (char.includes('⚡') || char.includes('🔮') || char.includes('🧿')) return 'animate-neon-glow inline-block drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(45,212,191,0.9)]';
    if (char.includes('🚀') || char.includes('👻')) return 'animate-emoji-float inline-block';
    if (char.includes('🎉') || char.includes('😂') || char.includes('🤣') || char.includes('👾')) return 'animate-emoji-bounce inline-block';
    if (char.includes('🤯') || char.includes('😈') || char.includes('👋')) return 'animate-emoji-shake inline-block';
    return 'animate-heart-pulse inline-block';
  };

  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const audioChunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);
  const recordingTimerRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const audioPlayerRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const partnerHandle = thread.user_1_id === currentUserId ? thread.alias_2_handle : thread.alias_1_handle;
  const partnerUserId = thread.user_1_id === currentUserId ? thread.user_2_id : thread.user_1_id;

  // Calculate 3-hour expiry remaining time
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState('02:59:59');

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateCountdown = () => {
      const expiresAt = new Date(thread.expires_at).getTime();
      const diff = Math.max(0, expiresAt - Date.now());
      const hours = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60));
      const minutes = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
      const seconds = Math.floor((diff % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
      setTimeLeft(
        `${String(hours).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, '0')}`
      );
    };

    updateCountdown();
    const timer = setInterval(updateCountdown, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [thread.expires_at]);

  // Load messages and reveal status
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPrivateMessages(thread.id).then(setMessages);
    fetchRevealRequest(thread.id).then((reqs) => {
      const myReq = reqs.find((r) => r.requester_user_id === currentUserId);
      if (myReq) {
        if (myReq.status === 'accepted') setRevealState('accepted');
        else setRevealState('pending');
      }
      const isBothAccepted = reqs.some(r => r.status === 'accepted');
      if (isBothAccepted) {
        setRevealState('accepted');
      }
    });

    // Realtime subscription on this thread
    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`drift_private_${thread.id}`)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'drift_private_messages', filter: `thread_id=eq.${thread.id}` },
        (payload) => {
          const newMsg = payload.new as DriftPrivateMessage;
          setMessages((prev) => {
            if (prev.some((m) => m.id === newMsg.id)) return prev;
            return [...prev, newMsg];
          });
        }
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [thread.id, currentUserId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages]);

  // Audio recording handlers
  const startRecording = async () => {
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
      audioChunksRef.current = [];

      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
        if (e.data.size > 0) audioChunksRef.current.push(e.data);
      };

      mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
        const audioBlob = new Blob(audioChunksRef.current, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());

        setUploading(true);
        const res = await uploadDriftMedia(audioBlob, 'voice');
        setUploading(false);

        if (res.success && res.url) {
          await sendPrivateMessage({
            threadId: thread.id,
            senderUserId: currentUserId,
            senderAliasHandle: currentHandle,
            content: null,
            mediaUrl: res.url,
            mediaType: 'voice',
            voiceDuration: recordingDuration || 5
          });
        }
      };

      mediaRecorder.start();
      setIsRecording(true);
      setRecordingDuration(0);

      recordingTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setRecordingDuration((prev) => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);
    } catch (err) {
      // Microphone permissions not granted or blocked in preview sandbox
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && isRecording) {
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
      setIsRecording(false);
      clearInterval(recordingTimerRef.current);
    }
  };

  const handleSendText = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!inputText.trim()) return;
    const text = inputText.trim();
    setInputText('');

    const res = await sendPrivateMessage({
      threadId: thread.id,
      senderUserId: currentUserId,
      senderAliasHandle: currentHandle,
      content: text
    });

    if (res.success && res.message) {
      setMessages((prev) => {
        if (prev.some((m) => m.id === res.message!.id)) return prev;
        return [...prev, res.message!];
      });
    }
  };

  const handleFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setUploading(true);
    const res = await uploadDriftMedia(file, 'photo');
    setUploading(false);

    if (res.success && res.url) {
      await sendPrivateMessage({
        threadId: thread.id,
        senderUserId: currentUserId,
        senderAliasHandle: currentHandle,
        content: null,
        mediaUrl: res.url,
        mediaType: 'photo'
      });
    }
  };

  const handleAudioPlay = (msgId: string, url: string) => {
    if (playingAudioId === msgId) {
      audioPlayerRef.current?.pause();
      setPlayingAudioId(null);
    } else {
      if (audioPlayerRef.current) audioPlayerRef.current.pause();
      const audio = new Audio(url);
      audioPlayerRef.current = audio;
      setPlayingAudioId(msgId);
      audio.play();
      audio.onended = () => setPlayingAudioId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRevealRequest = async () => {
    const res = await requestVibeReveal(thread.id, currentUserId, partnerUserId);
    if (res.success) {
      if (res.mutualAccepted) {
        setRevealState('accepted');
        setRevealCelebration(true);
        if (onConfirmedVibeEstablished) onConfirmedVibeEstablished();
      } else {
        setRevealState('pending');
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[#0a0a0f] text-white flex flex-col animate-fadeIn select-none">
      {/* Top Bar */}
      <div className="bg-neutral-900/90 border-b border-neutral-800 p-3 flex items-center justify-between backdrop-blur-md">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <span className="text-2xl select-none">🎭</span>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white">{partnerHandle}</span>
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">Private Drift • Anonymous 1:1</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          {/* 3-Hour Expiry badge */}
          <div className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-neutral-950 border border-pink-500/40 text-pink-400 font-mono text-[11px] flex items-center space-x-1">
            <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>{timeLeft}</span>
          </div>

          {/* Reveal Vibe Handle button */}
          <button
            onClick={handleRevealRequest}
            disabled={revealState === 'accepted'}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer ${
              revealState === 'accepted'
                ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300'
                : revealState === 'pending'
                ? 'bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-300'
                : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-yellow-500 text-neutral-950 hover:opacity-90 shadow'
            }`}
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>
              {revealState === 'accepted' ? 'Revealed' : revealState === 'pending' ? 'Pending Reveal' : '✨ Reveal'}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Ephemeral Warning Banner */}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { uploadDriftMedia, sendRoomMessage, DriftMessage, DriftAlias } from '../../domains/d15_drift';

export function useDriftMediaUpload(
  roomId: string,
  currentUserId: string,
  currentAlias: DriftAlias,
  onMessageSent: (msg: DriftMessage) => void,
  showToast: (msg: string) => void
) {
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  const handleFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setUploading(true);
    const res = await uploadDriftMedia(file, 'photo');
    setUploading(false);

    if (res.success && res.url) {
      const sendRes = await sendRoomMessage({
        roomId,
        aliasId: currentAlias.id,
        aliasHandle: currentAlias.handle,
        avatarColor: currentAlias.avatar_color,
        gender: currentAlias.gender,
        senderUserId: currentUserId,
        content: null,
        mediaUrl: res.url,
        mediaType: 'photo'
      });

      if (sendRes.success && sendRes.message) {
        onMessageSent(sendRes.message);
      }
    } else {
      showToast('Photo upload failed. Try again.');
    }
  };

  return { uploading, handleFileUpload };
}
