import { deleteRoomMessage, logModerationAction, updateRoomAnnouncement, DriftMessage } from '../../domains/d15_drift';

export function useDriftModeration(roomId: string, currentUserId: string, roomName: string, showToast: (msg: string) => void) {
  const pinMessage = async (
    msg: DriftMessage,
    scope: 'room' | 'all' = 'room',
    setPinnedAnnouncement: (text: string | null) => void,
    setPinnedBannerDismissed: (dismissed: boolean) => void
  ) => {
    if (!msg.content) return;
    const res = await updateRoomAnnouncement({
      roomId,
      announcement: msg.content,
      moderatorUserId: currentUserId,
      scope
    });
    if (res.success) {
      setPinnedAnnouncement(msg.content);
      setPinnedBannerDismissed(false);
      showToast(scope === 'all' ? 'Announcement pinned across all 12 rooms!' : `Announcement pinned to ${roomName}.`);
    } else {
      showToast(res.error || 'Failed to pin announcement.');
    }
  };

  const adminSetAnnouncement = async (
    text: string,
    scope: 'room' | 'all',
    setPinnedAnnouncement: (text: string | null) => void,
    setPinnedBannerDismissed: (dismissed: boolean) => void
  ) => {
    const res = await updateRoomAnnouncement({
      roomId,
      announcement: text,
      moderatorUserId: currentUserId,
      scope
    });
    if (res.success) {
      setPinnedAnnouncement(text);
      setPinnedBannerDismissed(false);
      showToast(scope === 'all' ? 'Announcement broadcast across all 12 rooms!' : `Announcement pinned to ${roomName}.`);
    } else {
      showToast(res.error || 'Failed to update announcement.');
    }
  };

  const adminUnpinAnnouncement = async (scope: 'room' | 'all', setPinnedAnnouncement: (text: string | null) => void) => {
    const res = await updateRoomAnnouncement({
      roomId,
      announcement: null,
      moderatorUserId: currentUserId,
      scope
    });
    if (res.success) {
      setPinnedAnnouncement(null);
      showToast(scope === 'all' ? 'Announcement unpinned from all 12 rooms.' : `Announcement unpinned from ${roomName}.`);
    } else {
      showToast(res.error || 'Failed to unpin announcement.');
    }
  };

  const deleteMessage = async (msg: DriftMessage, setMessages: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<DriftMessage[]>>) => {
    setMessages((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m.id !== msg.id));
    await deleteRoomMessage(msg.id);
    await logModerationAction({
      roomId,
      actionType: 'delete_message',
      targetId: msg.id,
      reason: 'Deleted by moderator',
      moderatorUserId: currentUserId
    });
    showToast('Message removed.');
  };

  return { pinMessage, adminSetAnnouncement, adminUnpinAnnouncement, deleteMessage };
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { DriftPresence, fetchRoomPresenceSouls, recordRoomPresence, leaveRoomPresence, DriftAlias } from '../../domains/d15_drift';

export function useDriftPresence(roomId: string, currentUserId: string, currentAlias: DriftAlias) {
  const [activeSouls, setActiveSouls] = useState<DriftPresence[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchRoomPresenceSouls(roomId).then((souls) => {
      const hasSelf = souls.some((s) => s.user_id === currentUserId);
      if (!hasSelf) {
        setActiveSouls([
          {
            id: 'self',
            room_id: roomId,
            user_id: currentUserId,
            alias_id: currentAlias.id,
            alias_handle: currentAlias.handle,
            avatar_color: currentAlias.avatar_color,
            gender: currentAlias.gender,
            last_heartbeat: new Date().toISOString(),
            joined_at: new Date().toISOString()
          },
          ...souls
        ]);
      } else {
        setActiveSouls(souls);
      }
    });

    recordRoomPresence(roomId, currentUserId, currentAlias.id, currentAlias.handle, currentAlias.avatar_color, currentAlias.gender);

    const heartbeatInterval = setInterval(() => {
      recordRoomPresence(roomId, currentUserId, currentAlias.id, currentAlias.handle, currentAlias.avatar_color, currentAlias.gender);
      fetchRoomPresenceSouls(roomId).then(setActiveSouls);
    }, 45000);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(heartbeatInterval);
      leaveRoomPresence(roomId, currentUserId);
    };
  }, [roomId, currentUserId, currentAlias]);

  return { activeSouls, setActiveSouls };
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { DriftMessage, fetchRoomMessages, sendRoomMessage, toggleMessageReaction, DriftAlias } from '../../domains/d15_drift';

export function useDriftRoomMessages(roomId: string, currentAlias: DriftAlias, currentUserId: string) {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<DriftMessage[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchRoomMessages(roomId).then(setMessages);

    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`drift_room_${roomId}`)
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'drift_messages', filter: `room_id=eq.${roomId}` },
        (payload) => {
          const newMsg = payload.new as DriftMessage;
          setMessages((prev) => {
            if (prev.some((m) => m.id === newMsg.id)) return prev;
            return [...prev, { ...newMsg, reactions: {} }];
          });
        }
      )
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: 'DELETE', schema: 'public', table: 'drift_messages', filter: `room_id=eq.${roomId}` },
        (payload) => {
          setMessages((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m.id !== payload.old.id));
        }
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [roomId]);

  const sendMessage = async (content: string, replyingTo?: DriftMessage | null) => {
    const res = await sendRoomMessage({
      roomId,
      aliasId: currentAlias.id,
      aliasHandle: currentAlias.handle,
      avatarColor: currentAlias.avatar_color,
      gender: currentAlias.gender,
      senderUserId: currentUserId,
      content,
      replyToId: replyingTo?.id,
      replyToHandle: replyingTo?.alias_handle,
      replyToSnippet: replyingTo?.content?.substring(0, 48)
    });

    if (res.success && res.message) {
      setMessages((prev) => {
        if (prev.some((m) => m.id === res.message!.id)) return prev;
        return [...prev, res.message!];
      });
    }
    return res;
  };

  const toggleReaction = async (messageId: string, emoji: string) => {
    const isNowReacted = await toggleMessageReaction(messageId, currentAlias.handle, emoji);
    setMessages((prev) =>
      prev.map((m) => {
        if (m.id !== messageId) return m;
        const currentCount = m.reactions?.[emoji] || 0;
        const newCount = isNowReacted ? currentCount + 1 : Math.max(0, currentCount - 1);
        const myReactions = m.my_reactions || [];
        const updatedMy = isNowReacted
          ? [...myReactions, emoji]
          : myReactions.filter((e) => e !== emoji);

        return {
          ...m,
          reactions: {
            ...m.reactions,
            [emoji]: newCount
          },
          my_reactions: updatedMy
        };
      })
    );
  };

  return { messages, setMessages, sendMessage, toggleReaction };
}

import { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { uploadDriftMedia, sendRoomMessage, DriftMessage, DriftAlias } from '../../domains/d15_drift';

export function useDriftVoiceRecorder(
  roomId: string,
  currentUserId: string,
  currentAlias: DriftAlias,
  onMessageSent: (msg: DriftMessage) => void,
  showToast: (msg: string) => void
) {
  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [recordingSeconds, setRecordingSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const audioChunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);
  const recordingIntervalRef = useRef<any>(null);

  const startRecording = async () => {
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
      audioChunksRef.current = [];

      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
        if (e.data.size > 0) audioChunksRef.current.push(e.data);
      };

      mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
        const audioBlob = new Blob(audioChunksRef.current, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());

        setUploading(true);
        const res = await uploadDriftMedia(audioBlob, 'voice');
        setUploading(false);

        if (res.success && res.url) {
          const sendRes = await sendRoomMessage({
            roomId,
            aliasId: currentAlias.id,
            aliasHandle: currentAlias.handle,
            avatarColor: currentAlias.avatar_color,
            gender: currentAlias.gender,
            senderUserId: currentUserId,
            content: null,
            mediaUrl: res.url,
            mediaType: 'voice',
            voiceDuration: recordingSeconds || 5
          });

          if (sendRes.success && sendRes.message) {
            onMessageSent(sendRes.message);
          }
        }
      };

      mediaRecorder.start();
      setIsRecording(true);
      setRecordingSeconds(0);

      recordingIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setRecordingSeconds((prev) => prev + 1);
      }, 1000);
    } catch (err) {
      showToast('Microphone permission denied. Enable microphone access in browser settings to record voice notes.');
    }
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && isRecording) {
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
      setIsRecording(false);
      clearInterval(recordingIntervalRef.current);
    }
  };

  return { isRecording, recordingSeconds, uploading, setUploading, startRecording, stopRecording };
}

  const [exploreToast, setExploreToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const categories: (VibeCategory | 'All')[] = ['All', 'Food', 'Art', 'Spots', 'Culture', 'Night Owl'];

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setExploreToast(msg);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setExploreToast(null);
    }, 3500);
  };

  const prevCoordsRef = useRef<{ lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);

  // 1. Acquire real device location via watchPosition / getCurrentPosition
  useEffect(() => {
    let unwatch: (() => void) | null = null;

    setLocationState({ status: 'requesting', coords: null });

    getDeviceLocation().then((initialState) => {
      setLocationState(initialState);
      if (initialState.coords) {
        prevCoordsRef.current = { lat: initialState.coords.lat, lng: initialState.coords.lng };
      }

      // Start continuous GPS watch (filtered by >= 20m movement)
      unwatch = watchDeviceLocation((updatedState) => {
        if (updatedState.coords) {
          const prev = prevCoordsRef.current;
          if (!prev || calculateDistanceMeters(prev.lat, prev.lng, updatedState.coords.lat, updatedState.coords.lng) >= 20) {
            prevCoordsRef.current = { lat: updatedState.coords.lat, lng: updatedState.coords.lng };
            setLocationState(updatedState);
          }
        }
      });
    });

    return () => {
      if (unwatch) unwatch();
    };
  }, []);

  const [activePromos, setActivePromos] = useState<any[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchActivePromotions().then(map => {
      setActivePromos(map ? Object.values(map) : []);
    });
  }, []);

  // 2. Query each real directory independently. A failing gallery must not hide Guardians.
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    if (places.length === 0) {
      setLoading(true);
    }

    Promise.allSettled([
      fetchNearbyPlaces(locationState.coords, selectedCategory),
      fetchCulturalTrails(),
      fetchVibeGuardians(),
      supabase.auth.getUser()
    ]).then(([placesResult, trailsResult, guardiansResult, authResult]) => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      if (placesResult.status === 'fulfilled') setPlaces(placesResult.value);
      if (trailsResult.status === 'fulfilled') {
        const trailsData = trailsResult.value;
        setTrails(trailsData);
        const authId = authResult.status === 'fulfilled' ? authResult.value.data.user?.id : undefined;
        const aliases = [user?.id, authId, authId ? 'usr_' + authId : null];
        setSavedTrailIds(new Set(trailsData.filter(t => t.savedBy?.some(id => aliases.includes(id))).map(t => t.id)));
      }
      if (guardiansResult.status === 'fulfilled') setGuardians(guardiansResult.value);

      const failures = [placesResult, trailsResult, guardiansResult, authResult]
        .filter((result): result is PromiseRejectedResult => result.status === 'rejected');
      if (failures.length > 0) {
        const first = failures[0].reason;
        showToast(first instanceof Error ? first.message : 'Some Explore data could not be loaded.');
      }
      setLoading(false);
    });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [locationState.coords?.lat, locationState.coords?.lng, selectedCategory, user?.id]);

  // 3. Initialize MapLibre GL dark-matter map (Neutral world center until device location arrives)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mapContainer.current) return;
    if (mapInstance.current) return;

    const maplibregl = (window as any).maplibregl;
    if (!maplibregl) {
      console.warn('MapLibre GL CDN not loaded yet');
      return;
    }

    try {
      // Use real coordinates if already available; otherwise neutral view (NO hardcoded Dubai)
      const hasCoords = !!locationState.coords;
      if (hasCoords) {
        hasInitiallyCenteredRef.current = true;
      }
      const initialCenter: [number, number] = locationState.coords
        ? [locationState.coords.lng, locationState.coords.lat]
        : [0, 20];
      const initialZoom = locationState.coords ? 13.5 : 2;

      const map = new maplibregl.Map({
        container: mapContainer.current,
        style: 'https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/gl/dark-matter-gl-style/style.json',
        center: initialCenter,
        zoom: initialZoom,
        pitch: locationState.coords ? 45 : 0,
        bearing: -17,
        // Render mandatory map credits below the map, away from the GPS readout.
        attributionControl: false
      });

      map.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl({ visualizePitch: true }), 'top-right');
      mapInstance.current = map;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('MapLibre init error:', err);
    }

    return () => {
      if (mapInstance.current) {
        try {
          mapInstance.current.remove();
        } catch {
          // Ignore AbortError / tile cancellation on unmount
        }
        mapInstance.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // 4. Center MapLibre ONCE on initial real device coordinates, then preserve user pan/zoom freedom
  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      !hasInitiallyCenteredRef.current &&
      locationState.status === 'granted' &&
      locationState.coords &&
      mapInstance.current
    ) {
      try {
        hasInitiallyCenteredRef.current = true;
        mapInstance.current.flyTo({
          center: [locationState.coords.lng, locationState.coords.lat],
          zoom: 13.5,
          pitch: 45,
          bearing: -17,
          essential: true
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Error initially centering map on user location:', err);
      }
    }
  }, [locationState.status, locationState.coords]);

  // 5. Update MapLibre markers: User location beacon + Cultural orbs colored by category
  useEffect(() => {
    const map = mapInstance.current;
    const maplibregl = (window as any).maplibregl;
    if (!map || !maplibregl) return;

    // Remove previous place markers
    markersRef.current.forEach((m) => {
      try {
        m.remove();
      } catch {}
    });
    markersRef.current = [];

    // Add or update User location beacon marker
    if (locationState.coords) {
      if (userMarkerRef.current) {
        userMarkerRef.current.setLngLat([locationState.coords.lng, locationState.coords.lat]);
      } else {
        const userEl = document.createElement('div');
        userEl.className = 'relative flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer';
        userEl.innerHTML = `
          <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/20 animate-ping absolute"></div>
          <div class="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400/40 ring-4 ring-cyan-500/40 absolute"></div>
          <div class="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-white shadow-lg shadow-cyan-400 z-10"></div>
        `;
        userMarkerRef.current = new maplibregl.Marker({ element: userEl })
          .setLngLat([locationState.coords.lng, locationState.coords.lat])
          .addTo(map);
      }
    }

    // Add cultural orb markers for places within 23 km
    places.forEach((place) => {
      if (!place.lng || !place.lat || isNaN(place.lng) || isNaN(place.lat)) return;

      const orbEl = document.createElement('div');
      orbEl.className = 'cursor-pointer group flex flex-col items-center select-none';

      // Category color mapping matching reference artwork (0DvcX_6bc6cde4.jpg)
      let orbGlow = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.4)';
      let orbBorder = 'border-cyan-400/60';
      let orbBg = 'from-cyan-500/30 via-neutral-950/90 to-cyan-950/80';
      let dotBg = 'bg-cyan-400';

      if (place.category === 'Food') {
        orbGlow = 'rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5)';
        orbBorder = 'border-amber-400/60';
        orbBg = 'from-amber-500/30 via-neutral-950/90 to-amber-950/80';
        dotBg = 'bg-amber-400';
      } else if (place.category === 'Art') {
        orbGlow = 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.5)';
        orbBorder = 'border-teal-400/60';
        orbBg = 'from-teal-500/30 via-neutral-950/90 to-teal-950/80';
        dotBg = 'bg-teal-400';
      } else if (place.category === 'Spots') {
        orbGlow = 'rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.5)';
        orbBorder = 'border-purple-400/60';
        orbBg = 'from-purple-500/30 via-neutral-950/90 to-purple-950/80';
        dotBg = 'bg-purple-400';
      } else if (place.category === 'Culture') {
        orbGlow = 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5)';
        orbBorder = 'border-blue-400/60';
        orbBg = 'from-blue-500/30 via-neutral-950/90 to-blue-950/80';
        dotBg = 'bg-blue-400';
      } else if (place.category === 'Night Owl') {
        orbGlow = 'rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.5)';
        orbBorder = 'border-pink-400/60';
        orbBg = 'from-pink-500/30 via-neutral-950/90 to-pink-950/80';
        dotBg = 'bg-pink-400';
      }

      const rewardBadge = place.is_promoted && place.vq_reward
        ? `<span class="text-amber-300 font-bold">+${place.vq_reward} PTS</span>`
        : `<span class="text-amber-400/90 font-medium text-[9px]">📍 Spot</span>`;

      orbEl.innerHTML = `
        <div class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br ${orbBg} backdrop-blur-md border ${orbBorder} text-[10px] font-bold text-white shadow-xl flex items-center space-x-1.5 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-110" style="box-shadow: 0 4px 14px ${orbGlow}">
          <span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${dotBg} animate-pulse"></span>
          <span class="truncate max-w-[110px]">${place.title}</span>
          ${rewardBadge}
        </div>
        <div class="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full ${dotBg} ring-4 ring-white/20 mt-1 shadow-lg transition-transform group-hover:scale-125"></div>
      `;

      orbEl.onclick = (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        onSelectPlace(place);
      };

      const marker = new maplibregl.Marker({ element: orbEl, anchor: 'bottom' })
        .setLngLat([place.lng, place.lat])
        .addTo(map);

      markersRef.current.push(marker);
    });

    return () => {
      markersRef.current.forEach((m) => {
        try {
          m.remove();
        } catch {}
      });
      markersRef.current = [];
    };
  }, [places, locationState.coords]);

  const handleSaveTrail = async (trailId: string) => {
    if (!user) { onRequireAuth?.(); return; }
    try {
      const saved = await toggleSavedTrail(trailId);
      setTrails(prev => prev.map(t => t.id === trailId ? saved : t));
      setSelectedTrail(prev => prev?.id === trailId ? saved : prev);
      setSavedTrailIds(prev => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        if (saved.savedBy?.includes(user.id)) next.add(trailId);
        else next.delete(trailId);
        return next;
      });
      showToast(saved.savedBy?.includes(user.id) ? 'Trail saved to your account.' : 'Trail removed from bookmarks.');
    } catch (error) {
      showToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not update Trail save.');
    }
  };
  const openAdoptEditor = (source: CommunityTrail) => {
    if (!user) { onRequireAuth?.(); return; }
    setSelectedTrail(null);
    setAdoptingTrail(source);
    setIsCurateOpen(true);
  };

  const handleRecenterUser = () => {
    if (locationState.coords && mapInstance.current) {
      try {
        mapInstance.current.flyTo({
          center: [locationState.coords.lng, locationState.coords.lat],
          zoom: 14,
          pitch: 45,
          bearing: -17,
          essential: true
        });
        showToast('Map centered on your current location.');
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Recenter error:', err);
      }
    } else {
      handleManualCalibrate();
    }
  };

  const handleManualCalibrate = () => {
    setLocationState({ status: 'requesting', coords: null });
    getDeviceLocation().then((res) => {
      setLocationState(res);
      if (res.status === 'granted' && res.coords) {
        if (mapInstance.current) {
          try {
            mapInstance.current.flyTo({
              center: [res.coords.lng, res.coords.lat],
              zoom: 14,
              pitch: 45,
              bearing: -17,
              essential: true
            });
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn('Map flyTo error:', err);
          }
        }
        showToast(`GPS Calibrated! Lat: ${res.coords.lat.toFixed(4)}, Lng: ${res.coords.lng.toFixed(4)}`);
      } else if (res.status === 'denied') {
        showToast('Location permission denied. Please allow GPS in browser settings.');
      } else {
        showToast('Unable to acquire GPS signal. Check device location services.');
      }
    });
  };

  const handleScrollTrails = (direction: 'left' | 'right') => {
    if (trailsScrollRef.current) {
      const scrollAmount = direction === 'left' ? -320 : 320;
      trailsScrollRef.current.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  };

  const handleScrollGuardians = (direction: 'left' | 'right') => {
    if (guardiansScrollRef.current) {
      const scrollAmount = direction === 'left' ? -280 : 280;
      guardiansScrollRef.current.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  };

  const handleLocateGuardian = (g: VibeGuardian) => {
    setSelectedGuardian(null);
    if (g.lng && g.lat && mapInstance.current) {
      try {
        mapInstance.current.flyTo({
          center: [g.lng, g.lat],
          zoom: 15.5,
          pitch: 50,
          essential: true
        });
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Map fly error:', err);
      }
    }
    showToast(g.lng !== undefined && g.lat !== undefined ? `Located registered Guardian ${g.name} on the map.` : 'This Guardian has not shared a mapped location.');
  };

  const handleWaypointCheckIn = (wp: TrailWaypoint, trail: CulturalTrail) => {
    showToast(`Opened waypoint "${wp.title || wp.name}" in Trail "${trail.title}". Reward verification is not yet available.`);
  };

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-6 pb-24 text-white transition-all duration-300 ${isFullScreen ? 'fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-neutral-950 p-4 overflow-y-auto' : ''}`}>
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {exploreToast && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-20 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 bg-neutral-900/95 border border-teal-500/50 text-teal-300 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center space-x-2 animate-fadeIn pointer-events-none">
          <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span>{exploreToast}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Header & Fullscreen Toggle */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-black tracking-tight flex items-center space-x-2">
            <Compass className="w-6 h-6 text-orange-400 animate-spin-slow" />
            <span className="bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-neutral-200 to-orange-300">
              Vibe Orbit
            </span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400">23km : trust your instincts</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <button
            onClick={handleRecenterUser}
            className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-800 transition text-cyan-400 flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer"
            title="Recenter on My Location"
          >
            <Navigation className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">My Location</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsFullScreen(!isFullScreen)}
            className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-800 transition text-teal-400 flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer"
          >
            {isFullScreen ? <Minimize2 className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
            <span>{isFullScreen ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand Orbit'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Vibe Flash Board (Top of Explore Tab) */}
      <VibeFlashBoard userCoords={locationState.coords ? { lat: locationState.coords.lat, lng: locationState.coords.lng } : undefined} onToast={showToast} />

      {/* Geolocation Status / Permission Warning Banner */}
      {locationState.status === 'denied' && (
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 text-xs flex items-center justify-between animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0 text-amber-400" />
            <span>Location permission was denied. Please allow browser location access to scan the 23 km discovery orbit around your device.</span>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleManualCalibrate}
            className="px-3 py-1 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-200 font-bold text-xs whitespace-nowrap ml-2 cursor-pointer"
          >
            Retry GPS
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {locationState.status === 'unavailable' && (
        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 text-xs flex items-center justify-between animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <Radio className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0 text-neutral-500" />
            <span>GPS sensor is unavailable or timed out. Re-calibrating radar...</span>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleManualCalibrate}
            className="px-3 py-1 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-200 font-bold text-xs whitespace-nowrap ml-2 cursor-pointer"
          >
            Retry GPS
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Category Chips */}
      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-none">
        {categories.map((cat) => (
          <button
            key={cat}
            onClick={() => {
              setSelectedCategory(cat);
              recordCategoryClick(cat);
            }}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer ${
              selectedCategory === cat
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/30 border border-orange-400/50'
                : 'bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-400 border border-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-800 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            {cat}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Vibe Orbit Radar Container / Map View */}
      <div className={`relative rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-900 shadow-2xl ${isFullScreen ? 'h-[70vh]' : 'h-[380px]'}`}>
        {/* MapLibre Container (Real device coordinates center) */}
        <div ref={mapContainer} className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full" />

        {/* Soft Organic Concentric Rings Visual Overlay (Matches Reference 0DvcX_6bc6cde4.jpg) */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
          {/* Outer ring */}
          <div className="absolute w-[320px] h-[320px] rounded-full border border-purple-500/20 animate-pulse" style={{ animationDuration: '6s' }} />
          {/* Middle ring */}
          <div className="absolute w-56 h-56 rounded-full border border-teal-500/25" />
          {/* Inner ring */}
          <div className="absolute w-36 h-36 rounded-full border border-orange-500/30 animate-pulse" style={{ animationDuration: '3s' }} />

          {/* Central Compass Rose Emblem */}
          <div className="absolute flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center pointer-events-none opacity-80">
            <span className="text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-amber-200/90 font-bold">
              ✦ VIBE ORBIT ✦
            </span>
            <span className="text-[7.5px] uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-neutral-400 font-medium mt-0.5">
              CULTURAL DISCOVERY RADAR
            </span>
            <span className="text-[7px] text-teal-400/80 font-mono mt-0.5">
              23 KM SCOPE
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Bottom Legend Overlay with Real Device Coordinates */}
        <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3 bg-neutral-950/85 backdrop-blur-xl border border-neutral-800 rounded-2xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${locationState.status === 'granted' ? 'bg-cyan-400 animate-pulse' : 'bg-neutral-500'}`} />
            <span className="font-bold text-white">
              {locationState.status === 'granted' && locationState.coords
                ? `GPS Active: ${locationState.coords.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${locationState.coords.lng.toFixed(4)}`
                : locationState.status === 'requesting'
                ? 'Acquiring GPS Signal...'
                : 'GPS Offline'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 font-medium">
            {places.length} Places in 23 km
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-x-1 px-2 -mt-4" aria-label="Map attribution">
        <span>MapLibre |</span>
        <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="underline hover:text-neutral-300">© OpenStreetMap contributors</a>
        <span>©</span>
        <a href="https://carto.com/attributions" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="underline hover:text-neutral-300">CARTO</a>
      </div>

      {/* Nearby Vibe Waypoints (23 km Discovery Scope) */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold flex items-center space-x-2">
            <Flame className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400" />
            <span>Nearby Vibe Waypoints (23 km Scope: {places.length})</span>
          </h3>
          {locationState.coords && (
            <span className="text-[11px] text-teal-400 font-mono">
              Radius: 23,000 m
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {places.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="space-y-3.5">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3.5">
              {places.slice(0, visibleWaypointsCount).map((place, idx) => {
                const tier = idx === 0 ? 'LEGENDARY' : idx === 1 ? 'LEGENDARY' : 'RARE';
                const rating = place.rating !== undefined ? place.rating.toFixed(1) : undefined;
                const googleReviewsCount = typeof place.reviews_count === 'number' ? place.reviews_count : undefined;
                const appCheckinsCount = typeof place.checkins_count === 'number' && place.checkins_count > 0 ? place.checkins_count : undefined;
                const dynamicMatch = computeAiVibeMatch(place, user);
                const matchScore = place.ai_match_score ?? dynamicMatch.score;
                const promo = activePromos.find(p => p.place_id === place.id && p.is_active && p.remaining_pool > 0);
                const isPromoted = Boolean(place.is_promoted || (promo && promo.remaining_pool > 0));
                const vqReward = promo ? promo.reward_per_checkin : place.vq_reward;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={place.id}
                    onClick={() => onSelectPlace(place)}
                    className="rounded-3xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 hover:border-cyan-500/40 transition cursor-pointer p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col space-y-4 group shadow-xl relative"
                  >
                    {/* TOP: Badges & Full-width Title */}
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 flex-wrap gap-1">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-teal-300 bg-teal-950/60 border border-teal-500/30 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                          {place.category || 'SPOTS'}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-300 bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-500/40 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                          {tier}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-purple-300 bg-purple-950/60 border border-purple-500/30 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded flex items-center space-x-1">
                          <span>✨</span>
                          <span>{matchScore}% MATCH</span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <h4 className="font-black text-lg sm:text-xl text-white tracking-tight leading-snug">
                        {place.title}
                      </h4>
                    </div>

                    {/* MIDDLE: Large Hero Photo spanning full card width */}
                    <div className="relative w-full h-48 sm:h-56 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 shadow-lg">
                      <img
                        src={place.image_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555396273-367ea4eb4db5?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80'}
                        alt={place.title}
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition duration-500"
                      />
                      {rating && (
                        <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 px-3 py-1 rounded-xl bg-neutral-950/90 text-amber-400 text-xs font-black flex items-center space-x-1.5 border border-neutral-800 shadow-md">
                          <span>★</span>
                          <span>{rating}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* BELOW PHOTO: Address */}
                    <div className="text-xs text-neutral-300 flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                      <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400 flex-shrink-0" />
                      <span>{place.address}</span>
                    </div>

                    {/* BOTTOM: Distance, visits & reward actions */}
                    <div className="pt-3 border-t border-neutral-800/80 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-teal-300">
                        {place.distance_km !== undefined ? `${place.distance_km} km` : 'Nearby'}
                        {googleReviewsCount !== undefined ? ` • ${googleReviewsCount} reviews` : ''}
                        {appCheckinsCount !== undefined ? ` • ${appCheckinsCount} check-ins` : ''}
                      </span>
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                        <span className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800/80 text-neutral-400 border border-neutral-700/60 text-xs font-bold flex items-center space-x-1 shadow">
                          <span className="text-[10px]">🔒</span>
                          <span>Locked</span>
                        </span>
                        {isPromoted && vqReward ? (
                          <span className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-teal-950/60 text-emerald-400 border border-teal-500/30 text-xs font-bold shadow flex items-center space-x-1">

                            <span>🚀</span>
                            <span>Promote Spot</span>
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {visibleWaypointsCount < places.length && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setVisibleWaypointsCount((prev) => Math.min(places.length, prev + 3))}
                className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 hover:bg-neutral-800 border border-neutral-700/60 text-teal-300 hover:text-white font-bold text-xs tracking-wider transition cursor-pointer shadow-lg flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"
              >
                <span>Load More</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">({places.length - visibleWaypointsCount} remaining)</span>
              </button>

          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800/80 p-6 text-center space-y-2">
            <Compass className="w-8 h-8 text-orange-400/60 mx-auto" />
            <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">No cultural waypoints within 23 km</h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 max-w-sm mx-auto">
              {locationState.coords
                ? `No certified places or secrets were returned in your 23 km discovery orbit (${locationState.coords.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${locationState.coords.lng.toFixed(4)}). Zero mock fallback is active.`
                : 'Awaiting device location coordinates to scan for nearby cultural waypoints.'}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Part 1 & Part 2: Community Curations - Cultural Vibes Trails */}
      <div className="space-y-4 pt-4 border-t border-neutral-800">
        {/* Section Header with Neon Green Typography */}
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#00e599] animate-pulse" />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#00e599] font-mono">

              Cultural Vibes Trails

          const displayedTrails = trailSubTab === 'tours'
            ? trails.filter((t) => t.isTour)
            : trails.filter((t) => !t.isTour);

                      {/* Time Flow Indicator */}
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-neutral-300">
                        <span className="text-neutral-400 text-[11px]">FLOW:</span>
                        <span className="text-white">
                          {trail.flowSequence && trail.flowSequence.length > 0

                      {/* Title & Story */}
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-white text-base group-hover:text-[#00e599] transition line-clamp-2 leading-snug">
                          {trail.title}
                        </h4>
                        <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed font-light">
                          &ldquo;{trail.story || trail.description}&rdquo;
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      {/* Vibe Tags */}
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 overflow-hidden flex-wrap gap-y-1 pt-1">
                        {(trail.vibeTags && trail.vibeTags.length > 0 ? trail.vibeTags : ['tunis', 'culture', 'sunset']).map((tag) => (
                          <span
                            key={tag}
                            className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-teal-300 bg-teal-950/40 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg border border-teal-500/30"
                          >
                            #{tag}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>

                      {/* Card Footer: Author + Hire + Explore now button */}
                      <div className="pt-3 border-t border-neutral-800/80 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <img
                            src={trail.authorAvatarUrl || trail.guardian_avatar || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'}

                            className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full object-cover border border-[#00e599]/40 flex-shrink-0"
                          />
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate">
                            {trail.authorName || trail.guardian_name}
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 flex-shrink-0">
                          {/* Hire Button */}
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              setHireTrail(trail);
                            }}
                            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-purple-500/50 hover:border-purple-400 bg-purple-950/40 text-purple-300 text-[11px] font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            <Handshake className="w-3 h-3 text-purple-400" />
                            <span>Hire</span>
                          </button>

                          {/* Explore Now Button (Solid Neon Green) */}
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              setSelectedTrail(trail);
                            }}
                            className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[#00e599] hover:bg-[#00c985] text-neutral-950 text-[11px] font-black transition cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/20 active:scale-95"
                          >
                            <span>Explore now</span>
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          );
        })()}
      </div>

      {/* Part 3: Vibe Guardians & Local Legends (matching exact reference images: image_a6756c21.png, image_27dd8064.png, image_52948d57.png) */}
      <div className="space-y-4 pt-4 border-t border-neutral-800">
        {/* Master Header Container with World Map Backdrop */}
        <div className="relative rounded-3xl overflow-hidden bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4">
          {/* Subtle World Map Backdrop Effect */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-15 pointer-events-none bg-[radial-gradient(#8b2cf5_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:16px_16px]" />

          <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center justify-between">

              {guardians.filter(isGuardianFresh).slice(0, 3).map((g, i) => {

              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
              <span>{guardians.filter(isGuardianFresh).length} Fresh Selfies</span>

          {/* Verification Badges Stack */}

            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-300 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center space-x-1">

              Vibe Guardians

            <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed font-light">

          <div className="relative z-10 flex items-center space-x-2 pt-1 flex-wrap gap-y-2">
            <button

              : guardianFilter === 'local' ? g.type === 'local'

          if (filtered.length === 0) {

                  New guardians sync when live in-app selfies are updated.

                const isPro = g.type === 'pro';

          onCreated={(newTrail) => {
            setTrails((prev) => [newTrail, ...prev]);
            setAdoptingTrail(null);
            showToast(`Curated trail "${newTrail.title}" is now active in directory!`);
          }}
          onToast={showToast}
          onRequireSignIn={() => onRequireAuth?.()}
        />
      )}

      {/* Live 7-Day In-App Selfie Verification Modal */}

          initialGuardianType={guardianRegistrationType}

            void fetchVibeGuardians().then(setGuardians).catch(error =>
              showToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Guardian directory refresh failed.')
            );
          }}
          availableTrails={trails.filter(trail => !trail.isTour).map(trail => ({id:trail.id,title:trail.title}))}
          onGuardianSaved={guardian => {
            setGuardians(prev => [guardian, ...prev.filter(g => g.id !== guardian.id)]);
          }}
          onToast={showToast}
        />
      )}

      {reservationTour && <TourReservationModal
        tour={reservationTour}
        onClose={()=>setReservationTour(null)}
        onRequireAuth={()=>onRequireAuth?.()}
        onToast={showToast}
      />}

      {/* Selected Trail -> real fresh Pro Guardian directory, without arbitrary selection */}
      <HireGuardianForTrailModal
        trail={hireTrail}
        guardians={guardians}
        isOpen={Boolean(hireTrail)}
        onClose={() => setHireTrail(null)}
        onSelectGuardian={(guardian) => {
          setSelectedHireTrailContext(hireTrail);
          setHireTrail(null);
          setSelectedHireGuardian(guardian);
        }}
      />

      {/* Hire & Vibe Handshake Proof Modal */}
      {selectedHireGuardian && (
        <HireHandshakeModal
          guardian={selectedHireGuardian}
          trail={selectedHireTrailContext}
          currentUser={user}
          onClose={() => { setSelectedHireGuardian(null); setSelectedHireTrailContext(null); }}
          onSuccess={(gId, newCount) => {
            setGuardians((prev) =>
              prev.map((g) => (g.id === gId ? { ...g, hiresCount: newCount } : g))
            );
          }}
          onToast={showToast}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { CalendarClock, Clock, MapPin, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { FlashEvent } from '../domains/d11_events';
import { VibePlace } from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit';

interface FlashEventDetailModalProps {
  event: FlashEvent;
  place?: VibePlace;
  onClose: () => void;
  onViewPlace: (place: VibePlace) => void;
  onRsvp: () => void;
  rsvpEnabled: boolean;
  rsvpJoined: boolean;
  rsvpLoading: boolean;
}

export const FlashEventDetailModal: React.FC<FlashEventDetailModalProps> = ({
  event, place, onClose, onViewPlace, onRsvp, rsvpEnabled, rsvpJoined, rsvpLoading
}) => {
  const start = Date.parse(event.starts_at || '');
  const end = Date.parse(event.ends_at);
  const startsIn = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((start - Date.now()) / 60000));
  const valid = Number.isFinite(start) && Number.isFinite(end) && end > Date.now();
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 p-4 backdrop-blur-md" role="presentation">
      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="flash-event-detail-title"
        className="w-full max-w-lg max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto space-y-4 rounded-3xl border border-fuchsia-500/65 bg-[#1c1923] p-5 text-white shadow-2xl">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <span className="text-xs font-black tracking-wider text-pink-400">FLASH EVENT DETAILS</span>
            <h2 id="flash-event-detail-title" className="mt-1 text-xl font-black">{event.title}</h2>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close event details"
            className="rounded-xl border border-neutral-700 p-2 hover:bg-neutral-700"><X className="h-5 w-5" /></button>
        </div>
        <div className="relative h-44 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-fuchsia-500/50 bg-gradient-to-br from-fuchsia-950 to-indigo-950">
          {place?.image_url && place.image_url.trim() !== '' ? <img alt={place.title} src={place.image_url} className="h-full w-full object-cover" /> :
            <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center text-xs font-semibold text-neutral-400">Event photo unavailable</div>}
        </div>
        <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-200">{event.description || 'Event details have not been provided.'}</p>
        <div className="space-y-2 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-700 bg-black/20 p-3 text-xs text-neutral-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><CalendarClock className="h-4 w-4 text-cyan-300" />
            Starts: {Number.isFinite(start) ? new Date(start).toLocaleString() : 'Unavailable'}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-300" />
            Ends: {Number.isFinite(end) ? new Date(end).toLocaleString() : 'Unavailable'}
          </div>
          {startsIn > 0 && valid && <div className="font-bold text-cyan-300">Starts in {startsIn} minutes</div>}
          {place && <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><MapPin className="h-4 w-4 text-pink-300" />
            {place.title}{place.address ? ` · ${place.address}` : ''}
          </div>}
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button type="button" disabled={!valid || !rsvpEnabled || rsvpLoading} onClick={onRsvp}
            className="flex-1 rounded-xl bg-white px-3 py-3 text-xs font-black text-black disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50">
            {!rsvpEnabled ? 'RSVP unavailable' : rsvpLoading ? 'Please wait' : rsvpJoined ? 'Cancel RSVP' : 'Save your spot'}
          </button>
          {place && <button type="button" onClick={() => { onClose(); onViewPlace(place); }}
            className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-cyan-400/50 px-3 py-3 text-xs font-black text-cyan-200">View place</button>}
        </div>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">RSVP records your intention to attend. It does not guarantee a seat or provide a reward.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

            <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-400 mx-auto" />
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">Webcam standby or initializing...</p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onRetryCamera}
              className="text-[11px] text-purple-400 underline font-mono cursor-pointer"
            >
              Retry Camera
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {countdown !== null && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center z-20">
            <span className="text-6xl font-black text-amber-400 animate-ping font-mono">
              {countdown}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="bg-purple-950/20 border border-purple-500/20 rounded-2xl p-3 text-left flex items-start gap-2.5 max-w-xs">
        <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400">
          Selfie timestamps expire after <strong>7 days</strong>. Guardians must take an updated in-app photo to maintain active status.
        </p>
      </div>

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onSnapSelfie}
        disabled={!cameraActive || countdown !== null}
        className="w-full max-w-xs py-3 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-indigo-600 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg hover:opacity-95 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
      >
        <Camera className="w-4 h-4" />
        Snap In-App Selfie
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};

===== BEGIN FILE: src\components\GuardianDetailModal.tsx =====
