import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  X, Shield, Award, MapPin, Clock, Calendar, MessageSquare,
  Handshake, Check, AlertCircle, Star, Send, Camera, Sparkles, ChevronRight
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { VibeGuardian, CulturalTrail, CommunityTrail } from '../domains/d07_trails';
import type { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';
import {
  initiateHandshake,
  acceptHandshake,
  declineHandshake,
  getHandshakeStatus,
  HandshakeStatus
} from '../domains/d22_handshake';
import {
  fetchGuardianReviews,
  submitGuardianReview,
  GuardianReview
} from '../domains/d19_reviews';
import { requestTourReservation } from '../domains/d08_tours';

interface GuardianDetailModalProps {
  guardian: VibeGuardian;
  currentUser: UserProfile | null;
  trails: CulturalTrail[];
  onClose: () => void;
  onSelectTrail?: (trail: CulturalTrail) => void;
  onLocateMap?: (guardian: VibeGuardian) => void;
  onRequireAuth?: () => void;
  onToast?: (message: string) => void;
  onReserveTour?: (tour: CommunityTrail) => void;
  onOpenMessage?: (guardian: VibeGuardian) => void;
}

export const GuardianDetailModal: React.FC<GuardianDetailModalProps> = ({
  guardian,
  currentUser,
  trails,
  onClose,
  onSelectTrail,
  onLocateMap,
  onRequireAuth,
  onToast,
  onReserveTour,
  onOpenMessage
}) => {
  const [handshakeStatus, setHandshakeStatus] = useState<HandshakeStatus>('none');
  const [activeHandshakeId, setActiveHandshakeId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [handshakeLoading, setHandshakeLoading] = useState(false);

  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState<GuardianReview[]>([]);
  const [reviewsLoading, setReviewsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [reviewRating, setReviewRating] = useState(5);
  const [reviewComment, setReviewComment] = useState('');
  const [submittingReview, setSubmittingReview] = useState(false);
  const [reviewError, setReviewError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // In-modal quick reservation state
  const [bookingTour, setBookingTour] = useState<CommunityTrail | null>(null);
  const [bookingDate, setBookingDate] = useState('');
  const [bookingTime, setBookingTime] = useState('10:00');
  const [bookingParty, setBookingParty] = useState(2);
  const [bookingSubmitting, setBookingSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [bookingSuccess, setBookingSuccess] = useState(false);

  const cleanHandle = guardian.handle.replace(/^@/, '');
  const isSelf = currentUser?.id === guardian.id || (currentUser?.username && currentUser.username === cleanHandle);

  // 1. Calculate Selfie Freshness (7-day window)
  const selfieAgeMs = Date.now() - new Date(guardian.selfieCapturedAt || Date.now()).getTime();
  const SEVEN_DAYS_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const isSelfieFresh = Number.isFinite(selfieAgeMs) && selfieAgeMs >= 0 && selfieAgeMs <= SEVEN_DAYS_MS;
  const daysLeft = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((SEVEN_DAYS_MS - selfieAgeMs) / (24 * 60 * 60 * 1000)));

  // 2. Load Handshake status
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    if (currentUser?.id && guardian.id) {
      void getHandshakeStatus(currentUser.id, guardian.id).then(res => {
        if (active) {
          setHandshakeStatus(res.status);
          if (res.handshake?.id) setActiveHandshakeId(res.handshake.id);
        }
      });
    }
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [currentUser?.id, guardian.id]);

  // 3. Load Handshake-gated reviews
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    setReviewsLoading(true);
    void fetchGuardianReviews(guardian.id).then(items => {
      if (active) {
        setReviews(items);
        setReviewsLoading(false);
      }
    });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [guardian.id]);

  // Handshake action
  const handleHandshakeAction = async () => {
    if (!currentUser) {
      onToast?.('Sign in to initiate a Handshake with this Guardian.');
      onRequireAuth?.();
      return;
    }
    if (isSelf) {
      onToast?.('You cannot Handshake with your own profile.');
      return;
    }
    if (handshakeStatus === 'accepted') {
      onToast?.('You already have a verified Handshake with this Guardian.');
      return;
    }
    if (handshakeStatus === 'pending_sent') {
      onToast?.('Handshake request already sent. Awaiting Guardian confirmation.');
      return;
    }

    setHandshakeLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await initiateHandshake(currentUser.id, guardian.id);
      if (res.success && res.handshake) {
        setHandshakeStatus('pending_sent');
        setActiveHandshakeId(res.handshake.id);
        onToast?.(`🤝 Handshake request sent to ${guardian.name}! Awaiting confirmation.`);
      } else {
        onToast?.(res.error || 'Could not initiate Handshake.');
      }
    } catch {
      onToast?.('Handshake request failed.');
    } finally {
      setHandshakeLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAcceptHandshake = async () => {
    if (!activeHandshakeId) return;
    setHandshakeLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await acceptHandshake(activeHandshakeId, guardian.id);
      if (res.success) {
        setHandshakeStatus('accepted');
        onToast?.('🤝 Handshake accepted and verified!');
      }
    } finally {
      setHandshakeLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeclineHandshake = async () => {
    if (!activeHandshakeId) return;
    setHandshakeLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await declineHandshake(activeHandshakeId, guardian.id);
      if (res.success) {
        setHandshakeStatus('declined');
        onToast?.('Handshake request declined.');
      }
    } finally {
      setHandshakeLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit Review
  const handleSubmitReview = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!currentUser) {
      onRequireAuth?.();
      return;
    }
    setReviewError(null);
    setSubmittingReview(true);
    try {
      const res = await submitGuardianReview({
        guardianId: guardian.id,
        reviewerId: currentUser.id,
        reviewerName: currentUser.full_name || currentUser.username || 'Explorer',
        reviewerAvatar: currentUser.avatar_url,
        rating: reviewRating,
        comment: reviewComment
      });

      if (res.success && res.review) {
        setReviews(prev => [res.review!, ...prev]);
        setReviewComment('');
        onToast?.('⭐ Verified review posted successfully!');
      } else {
        setReviewError(res.error || 'Could not submit review.');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setReviewError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Review submission failed.');
    } finally {
      setSubmittingReview(false);
    }
  };

  // Tours resolution
  const guardianTours = trails.filter(
    t => (t.isTour || (t.guardian_name || '').toLowerCase() === guardian.name.toLowerCase() ||
         (t.guardian_handle && t.guardian_handle.toLowerCase() === guardian.handle.toLowerCase()) ||
         guardian.curated_trail_ids?.includes(t.id) ||
         t.id === guardian.offeredTrailId)
  );

  // If no explicitly filtered tours exist, construct canonical display representation
  const displayTours: CommunityTrail[] = guardianTours.length > 0 ? guardianTours : [
    {
      id: guardian.offeredTrailId || `tour_${guardian.id}_default`,
      title: guardian.offeredTrailTitle || 'Epic Carthage Fortress & Byrsa Hill Heritage Expedition',
      story: guardian.bio || 'Private in-depth historical expedition exploring ancient Punic ruins, Roman baths, and legendary fortress ramparts.',
      description: guardian.bio || 'Private in-depth historical expedition exploring ancient Punic ruins, Roman baths, and legendary fortress ramparts.',
      city: guardian.city || 'Tunis / Carthage',
      category: 'Heritage Tour',
      vibeTags: ['History', 'Culture'],
      imageUrl: guardian.avatarUrl || guardian.avatar_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1548013146-72479768bada?q=80&w=600&auto=format&fit=crop',
      durationHours: 3.0,
      stopsCount: 4,
      flowSequence: ['Morning', 'Afternoon'],
      authorName: guardian.name,
      authorHandle: guardian.handle,
      authorAvatarUrl: guardian.avatarUrl || guardian.avatar_url || '',
      isTour: true,
      pricePerPerson: guardian.hourlyRate || 50,
      currency: guardian.currency || 'USD',
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      stops: [
        {
          id: 'stop_start',
          name: 'Byrsa Hill Acropolium Gates',
          address: 'Byrsa Hill Acropolium Gates, Carthage',
          vibeNote: 'Initial meeting point and fortress summit view.',
          timeOfDay: 'Morning',
          durationMinutes: 60
        }
      ]
    }
  ];

  const handleBookSlot = (tour: CommunityTrail) => {
    if (onReserveTour) {
      onReserveTour(tour);
      return;
    }
    setBookingTour(tour);
    setBookingSuccess(false);
  };

  const handleConfirmReservation = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!currentUser) {
      onRequireAuth?.();
      return;
    }
    if (!bookingTour) return;
    setBookingSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await requestTourReservation({
        tourId: bookingTour.id,
        date: bookingDate,
        time: bookingTime,
        partySize: bookingParty,
        note: 'Requested directly from Guardian Profile'
      });
      setBookingSuccess(true);
      onToast?.('Tour reservation requested! Guide will respond to confirm.');
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBookingTour(null);
        setBookingSuccess(false);
      }, 2000);
    } catch (err) {
      onToast?.(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Reservation request failed.');
    } finally {
      setBookingSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMessage = () => {
    if (!currentUser) {
      onRequireAuth?.();
      return;
    }
    if (onOpenMessage) {
      onOpenMessage(guardian);
    } else {
      onToast?.(`Opening direct conversation with ${guardian.name}...`);
    }
  };

  const isPro = guardian.type === 'pro';

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 animate-fadeIn select-none font-sans">
      <div className="w-full sm:max-w-lg bg-[#0d0b12] border border-zinc-800/90 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl text-white max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col">
        {/* Header Bar matching Screenshot 3 */}
        <div className="px-6 pt-5 pb-3 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-zinc-900 bg-[#0d0b12] shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <span className="text-[12px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-400 font-mono">
              GUARDIAN PROFILE
            </span>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 font-black text-[9px] uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm">
              <Shield className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-amber-400" />
              <span>{isPro ? 'PRO GUIDE' : 'LOCAL LEGEND'}</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close Guardian Modal"
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition border border-white/5"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Content Container */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto flex-1 divide-y divide-zinc-900">
          {/* Identity Block matching Screenshot 3 */}
          <div className="p-6">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
              {/* Square Selfie Box with APP SELFIE tag */}
              <div className="relative w-28 h-28 sm:w-32 sm:h-32 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 shrink-0 shadow-lg">
                <img
                  src={guardian.avatarUrl || guardian.avatar_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=400&q=80'}
                  alt={guardian.name}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                />
                <div className="absolute bottom-1.5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap bg-zinc-950/90 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-400 text-[9px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md flex items-center gap-1 shadow-md">
                  <Camera className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                  <span>APP SELFIE</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Identity details */}
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                  <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight truncate">
                    {guardian.name}
                  </h2>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 text-xs shrink-0" title="Verified Identity">
                    <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 fill-blue-500 text-blue-500" />
                  </span>
                </div>

                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 font-mono tracking-wide">
                  {guardian.handle}
                </p>

                <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                  <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500 shrink-0" />
                  <span className="truncate">{guardian.city || guardian.district || 'Tunis / Carthage, Tunisia'}</span>
                  <span className="text-zinc-600">•</span>
                  <span className="shrink-0">{guardian.age ? `${guardian.age} yrs old` : '32 yrs old'}</span>
                </p>

                {/* Rate and Handshake Action Row */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1 flex-wrap">
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span>💰</span>
                    <span>Rate: {guardian.type === 'local' ? 'Free' : `$${guardian.hourlyRate || 50} / hr`}</span>
                  </span>

                  {/* Mutual Acceptance Handshake Button */}
                  {handshakeStatus === 'pending_received' ? (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <button
                        onClick={handleAcceptHandshake}
                        disabled={handshakeLoading}
                        className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase transition cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Accept
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={handleDeclineHandshake}
                        disabled={handshakeLoading}
                        className="px-2 py-1 rounded-xl bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase transition cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Decline
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      onClick={handleHandshakeAction}
                      disabled={handshakeLoading || handshakeStatus === 'accepted'}
                      className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer ${
                        handshakeStatus === 'accepted'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/50 cursor-default'
                          : handshakeStatus === 'pending_sent'
                            ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40 animate-pulse cursor-default'
                            : 'bg-black hover:bg-zinc-900 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40 hover:border-amber-400'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Handshake className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                      <span>
                        {handshakeStatus === 'accepted'
                          ? 'HANDSHAKEN'
                          : handshakeStatus === 'pending_sent'
                            ? 'PENDING'
                            : 'HANDSHAKE'}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Freshness Status Pill */}
                <div className="pt-1">
                  <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border ${
                    isSelfieFresh
                      ? 'bg-emerald-950/30 border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300'
                      : 'bg-red-950/30 border-red-500/30 text-red-300'
                  }`}>
                    <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>{isSelfieFresh ? `In-App Selfie Fresh • ${daysLeft} days left` : 'In-App Selfie Expired'}</span>
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* About Section matching Screenshot 3 */}
          <div className="p-6 space-y-2">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400">
              ABOUT THE GUARDIAN
            </span>
            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800/80 p-4 text-xs text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed font-light">
              {guardian.bio || 'Strategic explorer and heritage guide. Leading authentic expeditions across historic Carthage and the Mediterranean coast.'}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Pre-made Bookable Tours Section matching Screenshot 3 & 2 */}
          <div className="p-6 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-300">
                <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-300">
                  PRE-MADE BOOKABLE TOURS
                </span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs text-emerald-400 font-medium">
                Direct Reservation
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Tour Cards */}
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {displayTours.map((tour) => (
                <div
                  key={tour.id}
                  className="rounded-2xl bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800/80 p-4 space-y-3 transition hover:border-zinc-700"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <h3 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-white leading-snug">
                      {tour.title}
                    </h3>
                    <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 text-xs font-bold shrink-0">
                      ${tour.pricePerPerson || 50} / hour
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed">
                    {tour.story || tour.description || 'Private in-depth historical expedition exploring ancient Punic ruins, Roman baths, and legendary fortress ramparts.'}
                  </p>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-xs pt-1 flex-wrap">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-purple-300 font-medium">
                      <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-400" />
                      <span>{tour.durationHours || 3.0} hours</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-emerald-300 font-medium">
                      <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                      <span className="truncate max-w-[200px]">{tour.stops?.[0]?.address || tour.city || 'Byrsa Hill Acropolium Gates, Carthage'}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Direct Book Button */}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleBookSlot(tour)}
                    className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-[#f5a623] hover:bg-[#e0961b] text-neutral-950 font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 active:scale-98 transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-neutral-950" />
                    <span>BOOK TOUR SLOT</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Quick in-modal reservation drawer if booking active */}
            {bookingTour && (
              <form onSubmit={handleConfirmReservation} className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-zinc-950 border border-amber-500/40 space-y-3 animate-in fade-in">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-1 border-b border-zinc-900">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-300">Reserve Slot: {bookingTour.title}</span>
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => setBookingTour(null)} className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-white text-xs">Cancel</button>
                </div>
                {bookingSuccess ? (
                  <p className="text-xs text-emerald-400 font-bold py-2">✓ Reservation request submitted! Awaiting guide confirmation.</p>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                      <div>
                        <label className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 block mb-1">Date</label>
                        <input
                          type="date"
                          required
                          value={bookingDate}
                          onChange={e => setBookingDate(e.target.value)}
                          className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-2 text-white text-xs outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <label className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400 block mb-1">Time</label>
                        <input
                          type="time"
                          required
                          value={bookingTime}
                          onChange={e => setBookingTime(e.target.value)}
                          className="w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg p-2 text-white text-xs outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      disabled={bookingSubmitting}
                      className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-black font-bold text-xs uppercase"
                    >
                      {bookingSubmitting ? 'Sending Request...' : 'Confirm Request'}
                    </button>
                  </>
                )}
              </form>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Handshake-Gated Reviews Section matching Screenshot 2 */}
          <div className="p-6 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-400">
                <Award className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-400">
                  HANDSHAKE-GATED REVIEWS ({reviews.length})
                </span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-zinc-500">
                Max 111 chars
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Reviews display */}
            {reviewsLoading ? (
              <div className="p-4 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 font-mono">
                Loading verified reviews...
              </div>
            ) : reviews.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="rounded-2xl bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-800/80 p-5 text-center text-xs text-zinc-400">
                No reviews yet. Complete a Handshake to share the first review!
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {reviews.map(rev => (
                  <div key={rev.id} className="rounded-xl bg-zinc-900/50 border border-zinc-800/80 p-3 space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-purple-900/50 border border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] text-purple-300 font-bold">
                          {rev.reviewer_name.slice(0, 1)}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-200">{rev.reviewer_name}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-amber-400 text-xs">
                        {Array.from({ length: rev.rating }).map((_, i) => (
                          <Star key={i} className="w-3 h-3 fill-amber-400" />
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-zinc-300 font-light leading-relaxed">
                      &ldquo;{rev.comment}&rdquo;
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Handshake Gating State */}
            {handshakeStatus === 'accepted' ? (
              <form onSubmit={handleSubmitReview} className="rounded-2xl bg-zinc-900/60 border border-zinc-800 p-3.5 space-y-2.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    Verified Handshake Review
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(star => (
                      <button
                        key={star}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setReviewRating(star)}
                        className={`text-sm cursor-pointer ${star <= reviewRating ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-zinc-600'}`}
                      >
                        ★
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <textarea
                  maxLength={111}
                  rows={2}
                  required
                  placeholder="Share your verified encounter experience (max 111 chars)..."
                  value={reviewComment}
                  onChange={e => setReviewComment(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-xl p-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-zinc-500 outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                />

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-zinc-500">
                    {reviewComment.length}/111
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={submittingReview || !reviewComment.trim()}
                    className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-300 text-neutral-950 font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Send className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>{submittingReview ? 'Posting...' : 'Post Review'}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                {reviewError && <p className="text-red-400 text-[11px]">{reviewError}</p>}
              </form>
            ) : (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-zinc-900/40 border border-zinc-800/80 text-center text-xs text-zinc-500 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <span>🔒</span>
                <span>Handshake required before reviews can be posted.</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

        {/* Fixed Sticky Bottom Action Bar matching Screenshot 2 */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-t border-zinc-900 bg-[#0d0b12] shrink-0">

interface HireHandshakeModalProps {
  guardian: VibeGuardian;
  trail?: CommunityTrail | null;
  currentUser: UserProfile | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (guardianId: string, newHiresCount: number) => void;
  onToast: (msg: string) => void;
}

export const HireHandshakeModal: React.FC<HireHandshakeModalProps> = ({
  guardian,
  trail,
  currentUser,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  onToast
}) => {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const handleConfirmHandshake = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const result = await hireGuardian(guardian.id, currentUser?.id);
    setLoading(false);

    if (result.success) {

      onSuccess(guardian.id, (guardian.hiresCount ?? 0) + 1);
      onClose();
    } else {
      onToast('Handshake issuance is not available yet. No Handshake or reward was created.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="w-full sm:max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl text-white flex flex-col">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-neutral-950/80">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-300">
              <Handshake className="w-4 h-4" />

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-full bg-neutral-900 hover:bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content */}

          {trail && <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300">Selected Trail: <strong>{trail.title}</strong></p>}

                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSave(act.id)}
                    className={`flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer border flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 shadow ${
                      isSaved
                        ? 'bg-purple-900/60 text-purple-200 border-purple-500'
                        : 'bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-300 border-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Bookmark className={`w-4 h-4 ${isSaved ? 'fill-purple-300' : ''}`} />
                    <span>{isSaved ? 'Saved' : 'Save'}</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      onToast(`Opening directions to ${act.location}...`);
                      onNavigateTab('explore');
                    }}
                    className="flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs bg-neutral-900 hover:bg-neutral-800 text-cyan-300 border border-neutral-700 transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 shadow"
                  >
                    <Navigation className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Directions</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800 p-6 text-center space-y-2">
            <Footprints className="w-7 h-7 text-teal-400 mx-auto" />
            <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-white">No {filter} activities right now</h4>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">Explore district waypoints or create a new gathering.</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {filtered.length > 3 && (
          <div className="text-center pt-1 pb-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowAll(v => !v)}
              className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 text-xs font-bold text-teal-400 hover:bg-neutral-800 transition cursor-pointer shadow-lg"
            >
              {showAll ? 'Show Less' : `View All (${filtered.length})`}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

        <CreateActivityModal
          user={user}
          onClose={() => setIsCreateOpen(false)}
          onCreated={handleCreatedActivity}
          onToast={onToast}
        />
      )}

interface HomeFlashDiscoveryPanelProps {

const shell = 'rounded-[30px] border border-fuchsia-500/55 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1b1920] via-[#19171e] to-[#17151c] p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-[0_10px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.45)] space-y-5 overflow-hidden';
const whiteAction = 'min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-[22px] bg-white px-3 py-3.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-neutral-950 shadow-xl hover:bg-neutral-200 active:scale-[0.98] transition';
const outlinedAction = 'min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-[22px] border border-neutral-500 bg-[#26232b] px-3 py-3.5 text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-neutral-200 hover:bg-neutral-700/50 active:scale-[0.98] transition';
const thumbnail = 'relative aspect-square min-w-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-fuchsia-500/50 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#302139] to-[#18151e]';

function Photo({ src, alt, className = '' }: { src?: string | null; alt: string; className?: string }) {
  if (!src || typeof src !== 'string' || !src.trim()) return null;
  return <img src={src.trim()} alt={alt} loading="lazy" className={`absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover ${className}`} />;
}

export const HomeFlashDiscoveryPanel: React.FC<HomeFlashDiscoveryPanelProps> = ({
  flashEvent, flashEvents, onSelectFlashEvent, secondsLeft, places, pulsesSummary, onCreateFlash, onNavigateTab, onSelectPlace, onNotify,
  onSuggestVibe, onRsvp, rsvpEnabled, suggestionEnabled, rsvpJoined, rsvpLoading
}) => {
  const [showAllFlashEvents, setShowAllFlashEvents] = useState(false);
  const [showFlashDetail, setShowFlashDetail] = useState(false);
  const hasActiveFlash = Boolean(flashEvent && secondsLeft > 0);
  const picturePlaces = places.filter(place => Boolean(place.image_url && place.image_url.trim() !== ''));
  const realCities = pulsesSummary.cities.filter(city => Boolean(city.imageUrl && city.imageUrl.trim() !== ''));
  const suggestions = [
    ...picturePlaces.map(place => ({ id: 'place:' + place.id, kind: 'place' as const, title: place.title, image: place.image_url, place })),
    ...realCities.map(city => ({ id: 'city:' + city.id, kind: 'city' as const, title: city.city, image: city.imageUrl, city }))
  ];
  const hero = suggestions[0];
  const more = suggestions.filter(item => item.id !== hero?.id).slice(0, 4);
  const eventPlace = hasActiveFlash ? places.find(place => place.id === flashEvent?.place_id) : undefined;
  const eventPhoto = eventPlace?.image_url && eventPlace.image_url.trim() !== '' ? eventPlace.image_url : '';
  const now = Date.now();
  const startsInSeconds = flashEvent?.starts_at ? Math.max(0, Math.ceil((Date.parse(flashEvent.starts_at) - now) / 1000)) : 0;
  const startsInMinutes = Math.ceil(startsInSeconds / 60);
  const timeLeft = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(secondsLeft / 60));
  const galleryEvents = flashEvents.filter(event => event.id !== flashEvent?.id);
  const galleryVisible = showAllFlashEvents ? galleryEvents : galleryEvents.slice(0, 3);

  const openSuggestion = (item: typeof suggestions[number]) => {
    if (item.kind === 'place') onSelectPlace(item.place);
    else if (item.city.placeData) onSelectPlace(item.city.placeData);
    else onNavigateTab('explore');
  };

  const hunt = () => setShowFlashDetail(true);

  const frameHeading = (title: string, detail: string) => (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">

        </span>
        <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black leading-tight tracking-tight text-white">{title}</h2>
      </div>
      <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full border border-pink-500/50 bg-pink-500/10 px-3 py-1.5 text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-black tracking-wide text-pink-400">{detail}</span>
    </div>

            <span className="block text-sm font-black text-pink-400">REWARDS</span>
            <span className="mt-2 block border-t border-neutral-600 pt-2 text-[9px] font-bold text-neutral-400">Not configured</span>
          </div>
        </div>

          })}
          {Array.from({ length: Math.max(0, 3 - galleryVisible.length) }, (_, i) => (
            <div key={'empty-flash-' + i} className={thumbnail} aria-hidden="true">
              <div className="flex h-full items-center justify-center"><Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-neutral-600" /></div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <p className="text-center text-xs text-neutral-400">Discover the drop. Catch the moment.</p>
        <p className="text-center text-[10px] font-black tracking-widest text-pink-400">VIBEQUEST · FLASH EVENTS</p>
        {showFlashDetail && (
          <FlashEventDetailModal
            event={flashEvent}
            place={eventPlace}
            onClose={() => setShowFlashDetail(false)}
            onViewPlace={onSelectPlace}
            onRsvp={onRsvp}
            rsvpEnabled={rsvpEnabled}
            rsvpJoined={rsvpJoined}
            rsvpLoading={rsvpLoading}
          />
        )}
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section className={shell} aria-label="Vibe Suggestions">
      {frameHeading('Vibe Suggestions', 'FOR YOU')}
      <div className="flex gap-2.5">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onNavigateTab('explore')} className={whiteAction}>EXPLORE NOW! ↗</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={onSuggestVibe} disabled={!suggestionEnabled} aria-label={!suggestionEnabled ? 'Suggestion submissions are not available yet' : 'Suggest Vibe'} className={outlinedAction + ' disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed'}>+ SUGGEST VIBE</button>
      </div>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-white">Curated for You</h3>
        <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-300">
          Places, events, and moments matching your vibe, location, and what's trending right now.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onNavigateTab('explore')} className="min-w-0 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-700 bg-[#29252d] p-2 text-center">
          <span className="block text-sm font-black text-amber-400"><MapPin className="mx-auto mb-1 h-4 w-4" /> PLACES</span>
          <span className="mt-2 block border-t border-neutral-600 pt-2 text-[9px] font-bold text-neutral-200">SPOTS NEAR YOU</span>
        </button>
        <div className="min-w-0 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-700 bg-[#29252d] p-2 text-center" aria-label="Events discovery not available yet">
          <span className="block text-sm font-black text-cyan-400"><CalendarDays className="mx-auto mb-1 h-4 w-4" /> EVENTS</span>

          <span className="block text-sm font-black text-pink-400"><Flame className="mx-auto mb-1 h-4 w-4" /> VIBES</span>
          <span className="mt-2 block border-t border-neutral-600 pt-2 text-[9px] font-bold text-neutral-200">TRENDING NOW</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="relative h-56 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-fuchsia-500/80 bg-gradient-to-br from-fuchsia-950 via-neutral-900 to-blue-950 shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(217,70,239,0.12)]">

        )}

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-white">MORE SUGGESTIONS</h3>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onNavigateTab('explore')} className="text-xs font-black text-cyan-400">SEE ALL ›</button>
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
        {Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => {
          const item = more[i];
          return item ? (
            <button type="button" key={item.id} className={thumbnail} onClick={() => openSuggestion(item)} aria-label={`View ${item.title}`}>
              <Photo src={item.image} alt={item.title} />
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div key={'empty-' + i} className={thumbnail} aria-label="Suggestion photo unavailable">

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Heart, MessageCircle, Share2, Sparkles, Send, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import { fetchVibePosts, VibePostItem, addReactionToPost, fetchCommentsForPost, addCommentToPost, VibeComment } from '../domains/d05_vibe';
import { fetchOrbitProfiles } from '../domains/d03_social_graph';
import { fetchConfirmedVibes } from '../domains/d17_matching';
import { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';
import { fetchAllMeetups, subscribeToMeetupUpdates } from '../domains/d12_meetups';
import { PlaceMeetup } from '../domains/d12_meetups/types';
import { MeetupCard } from './MeetupCard';
import { VibeFlashBoard } from './VibeFlashBoard';

interface HomeSocialFeedProps {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  onOpenComments: (postId: string) => void;
  onToast: (msg: string) => void;
  onInspectUser?: (profile: UserProfile) => void;
}

export const HomeSocialFeed: React.FC<HomeSocialFeedProps> = ({ user, onToast, onInspectUser }) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'network' | 'local' | 'for_you'>('network');
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState<VibePostItem[]>([]);
  const [meetups, setMeetups] = useState<PlaceMeetup[]>([]);
  const [networkUserIds, setNetworkUserIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [likedPosts, setLikedPosts] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [showAllSocial, setShowAllSocial] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setShowAllSocial(false);
  }, [activeTab]);

  // Inline comments state
  const [expandedPostId, setExpandedPostId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [postComments, setPostComments] = useState<Record<string, VibeComment[]>>({});
  const [commentInputs, setCommentInputs] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [commentLoading, setCommentLoading] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchVibePosts().then(setPosts);
    fetchAllMeetups().then(setMeetups);

    const unsub = subscribeToMeetupUpdates(() => {
      fetchAllMeetups().then(setMeetups);
    });

    if (user?.id) {
      Promise.all([
        fetchOrbitProfiles(user.id),
        fetchConfirmedVibes(user.id)
      ]).then(([orbit, vibes]) => {
        const ids = new Set<string>();
        orbit.forEach(p => ids.add(p.id));
        vibes.forEach(v => {
          ids.add(v.user_1_id);
          ids.add(v.user_2_id);
        });
        ids.add(user.id);
        setNetworkUserIds(ids);
      });
    }

    return () => unsub();
  }, [user]);

  const handleToggleLike = async (postId: string) => {
    const isLiked = likedPosts.has(postId);
    setLikedPosts(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (isLiked) next.delete(postId);
      else next.add(postId);
      return next;
    });
    const success = await addReactionToPost(postId);
    if (!success) {
      setLikedPosts(prev => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        if (isLiked) next.add(postId);
        else next.delete(postId);
        return next;
      });
      onToast('Failed to record reaction.');
    }
  };

  const handleToggleComments = async (postId: string) => {
    if (expandedPostId === postId) {
      setExpandedPostId(null);
      return;
    }
    setExpandedPostId(postId);
    if (!postComments[postId]) {
      const comms = await fetchCommentsForPost(postId);
      setPostComments(prev => ({ ...prev, [postId]: comms }));
    }
  };

  const handleSendComment = async (e: React.FormEvent, postId: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const content = commentInputs[postId]?.trim();
    if (!content) return;
    if (!user) {
      onToast('Please sign in to comment.');
      return;
    }

    setCommentLoading(prev => ({ ...prev, [postId]: true }));
    const result = await addCommentToPost(postId, content, {
      username: user.username,
      avatar_url: user.avatar_url || ''
    });

    if (result) {
      setPostComments(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        [postId]: [...(prev[postId] || []), result]
      }));
      setCommentInputs(prev => ({ ...prev, [postId]: '' }));
      setPosts(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === postId ? { ...p, comments_count: p.comments_count + 1 } : p));
      onToast('Comment posted successfully!');
    } else {
      onToast('Failed to post comment. Please try again.');
    }
    setCommentLoading(prev => ({ ...prev, [postId]: false }));
  };

  const handleShare = async (post: VibePostItem) => {
    const text = `VibeQuest Social Feed: @${post.username} — "${post.caption}"`;
    if (navigator.share) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({ title: 'VibeQuest', text, url: window.location.href });
        return;
      } catch {}
    }
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${text} - ${window.location.href}`);
      onToast('Post link copied to clipboard!');
    } catch {
      onToast('Share link ready!');
    }
  };

  const handleInspectAuthor = (userId: string, username: string, avatarUrl?: string, createdAt?: string) => {
    if (!onInspectUser) return;
    onInspectUser({
      id: userId,
      username: username,
      full_name: username,
      avatar_url: avatarUrl || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80',
      vq_balance: 500,
      reputation: 90,
      role: 'explorer',
      created_at: createdAt || new Date().toISOString()
    });
  };

  const filteredPosts = posts.filter(p => {
    if (activeTab === 'network') {
      if (networkUserIds.size === 0) return true;
      return networkUserIds.has(p.user_id);
    }
    if (activeTab === 'for_you') {
      return p.reactions_count > 0 || p.comments_count > 0;
    }
    return true; // local
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 pt-2">
      {/* Vibe Flash Board (Top of Home Feed) */}
      <VibeFlashBoard onToast={onToast} />

      {/* Social Feed Tabs matching reference image */}
      <div className="border-b border-neutral-800 pb-1 flex items-center space-x-6 text-sm">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('network')}
          className={`pb-2.5 font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition relative cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === 'network' ? 'text-amber-400 font-extrabold' : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <span>MY NETWORK</span>
          {activeTab === 'network' && (
            <span className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-0.5 bg-amber-400 rounded-full" />
          )}
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('local')}
          className={`pb-2.5 font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition relative cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === 'local' ? 'text-amber-400 font-extrabold' : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <span>LOCAL VIBES</span>
          {activeTab === 'local' && (
            <span className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-0.5 bg-amber-400 rounded-full" />
          )}
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('for_you')}
          className={`pb-2.5 font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition relative cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === 'for_you' ? 'text-amber-400 font-extrabold' : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <span>FOR YOU</span>
          {activeTab === 'for_you' && (
            <span className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-0.5 bg-amber-400 rounded-full" />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Feed Posts & Spot Meetups */}
      <div className="space-y-3.5">
        {/* Active Spot Meetups Cross-Feed Propagation */}
        {activeTab !== 'for_you' && meetups.length > 0 && (
          <div className="space-y-2.5 pb-1">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider px-1">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-blue-400 font-black">
                <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Active Spot Meetups ({meetups.length})</span>
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5">
              {meetups
                .filter(m => {
                  if (activeTab === 'network') {
                    if (networkUserIds.size === 0) return true;
                    return (
                      m.host_user_id === user?.id ||
                      (user?.id && m.attendee_ids.includes(user.id)) ||
                      networkUserIds.has(m.host_user_id)
                    );
                  }
                  return true;
                })
                .slice(0, 2)
                .map(m => (
                  <MeetupCard key={m.id} meetup={m} currentUser={user} />
                ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {filteredPosts.length > 0 ? (
          (showAllSocial ? filteredPosts : filteredPosts.slice(0, 3)).map((post) => {
            const isLiked = likedPosts.has(post.id);
            const likesCount = post.reactions_count + (isLiked ? 1 : 0);
            const isExpanded = expandedPostId === post.id;
            const commentsList = postComments[post.id] || [];
            const formattedDate = new Date(post.created_at || Date.now()).toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
              month: 'numeric',
              day: 'numeric',
              year: 'numeric'
            });

            return (
              <div key={post.id} className="rounded-3xl bg-[#131116] border border-neutral-800 overflow-hidden shadow-xl p-4 space-y-3.5">
                {/* 1. Media Section */}
                {post.image_url && post.image_url.trim() !== '' ? (
                  <div className="relative aspect-[4/3] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-neutral-950">
                    <img src={post.image_url} alt="Scene" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                    <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 bg-neutral-950/90 text-white font-bold text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full flex items-center space-x-1.5 border border-neutral-800 shadow">
                      <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-pulse" />
                      <span>COZY</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="relative aspect-[4/3] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-neutral-950/85 p-6 flex flex-col justify-center items-center text-center">
                    <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 bg-neutral-950/90 text-white font-bold text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full flex items-center space-x-1.5 border border-neutral-800 shadow">
                      <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-pulse" />
                      <span>COZY</span>
                    </div>
                    <Sparkles className="w-10 h-10 text-amber-400/60 mb-2" />
                    <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white">VibeQuest Wavelength Broadcast</p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* 2. Author Row (Clickable to open UserProfileCard) */}
                <div
                  onClick={() => handleInspectAuthor(post.user_id, post.username, post.avatar_url, post.created_at)}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 cursor-pointer group"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                    <img
                      src={post.avatar_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'}
                      alt={post.username}
                      className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover border border-amber-500/40 shadow group-hover:scale-105 transition"
                    />
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-amber-300 group-hover:underline">@{post.username}</h4>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">{formattedDate}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-950/40 border border-amber-500/40 text-amber-400 font-black text-[10px] tracking-wider shadow">
                    VERIFIED SYNC
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 3. Caption */}
                {post.caption && (
                  <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-neutral-200 leading-relaxed font-medium">
                    {post.caption}
                  </p>
                )}

                {/* 4. Action Row */}
                <div className="pt-3 border-t border-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-between text-neutral-400 text-xs">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleToggleLike(post.id)}
                    className={`flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer ${
                      isLiked ? 'text-rose-500 bg-rose-500/10' : 'hover:text-white hover:bg-neutral-800'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Heart className={`w-4 h-4 ${isLiked ? 'fill-rose-500 text-rose-500' : ''}`} />
                    <span className="font-bold">{likesCount}</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleToggleComments(post.id)}
                    className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl hover:text-white hover:bg-neutral-800 transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <MessageCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span className="font-bold">{post.comments_count}</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleShare(post)}
                    className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl hover:text-white hover:bg-neutral-800 transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>Share</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* 5. Expanded Inline Comments Section */}
                {isExpanded && (
                  <div className="pt-3 border-t border-neutral-800/80 space-y-3 animate-fadeIn">
                    <div className="space-y-2 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto">
                      {commentsList.length > 0 ? (
                        commentsList.map(comm => (
                          <div key={comm.id} className="flex space-x-2.5 items-start bg-neutral-950 p-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-800/80">
                            <img
                              src={comm.avatar_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'}
                              alt={comm.username}
                              className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full object-cover flex-shrink-0"
                            />
                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <span
                                  onClick={() => handleInspectAuthor('u-comm-' + comm.id, comm.username, comm.avatar_url, comm.created_at)}
                                  className="font-bold text-xs text-amber-300 cursor-pointer hover:underline"
                                >
                                  @{comm.username}
                                </span>
                                <span className="text-[9px] text-neutral-500">
                                  {new Date(comm.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 mt-0.5">{comm.content}</p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))

                        <div className="text-center py-3 text-xs text-neutral-500 italic">
                          No comments yet. Join the conversation!
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <form onSubmit={(e) => handleSendComment(e, post.id)} className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={commentInputs[post.id] || ''}
                        onChange={(e) => setCommentInputs({ ...commentInputs, [post.id]: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="Write a comment..."
                        className="flex-1 bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500"
                      />
                      <button
                        type="submit"
                        disabled={commentLoading[post.id]}
                        className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-teal-500 text-white hover:opacity-90 transition cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                      >
                        <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </form>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800 p-6 text-center space-y-2">
            <Sparkles className="w-7 h-7 text-amber-400 mx-auto" />
            <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-white">No posts in {activeTab.replace('_', ' ')} feed</h4>

          </div>

        {filteredPosts.length > 3 && (

            >
              {showAllSocial ? 'Show Less' : `View All (${filteredPosts.length})`}
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Sparkles, MapPin, Shield, Compass, ChevronRight, ChevronLeft, Flame, Award,
  Users, Zap, Clock, Route, GitFork, CheckCircle2, Send, X, CalendarCheck
} from 'lucide-react';
import { fetchNearbyPlaces, VibePlace, getDeviceLocation } from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit';
import { fetchCulturalTrails, fetchVibeGuardians, CulturalTrail, VibeGuardian, TrailWaypoint } from '../domains/d07_trails';
import { fetchActiveFlashEvent, fetchFlashEvents, submitVibeSuggestion, FlashEvent, SuggestionCategory } from '../domains/d11_events';
import { fetchCommentsForPost, addCommentToPost, VibeComment } from '../domains/d05_vibe';
import { fetchCityPulses, VibePulsesSummary, CityPulse } from '../domains/d04_geo_presence';
import { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';
import { TrailDetailModal } from './TrailDetailModal';
