interface HomeTabProps {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  onNavigateTab: (tab: any) => void;
  onSelectPlace: (place: VibePlace) => void;
  onInspectUser?: (profile: UserProfile) => void;
}

export const HomeTab: React.FC<HomeTabProps> = ({ user, onNavigateTab, onSelectPlace, onInspectUser }) => {
  const [guardians, setGuardians] = useState<VibeGuardian[]>([]);
  const [places, setPlaces] = useState<VibePlace[]>([]);
  const [trails, setTrails] = useState<CulturalTrail[]>([]);
  const [pulsesSummary, setPulsesSummary] = useState<VibePulsesSummary>({
    cities: [],
    totalCities: 0,
    totalLiveVibes: 0,
    source: 'calculated_baseline'
  });
  const [flashEvent, setFlashEvent] = useState<FlashEvent | null>(null);
  const [flashEvents, setFlashEvents] = useState<FlashEvent[]>([]);
  const [secondsLeft, setSecondsLeft] = useState<number>(0);
  const [selectedTrail, setSelectedTrail] = useState<CulturalTrail | null>(null);
  const [selectedGuardian, setSelectedGuardian] = useState<VibeGuardian | null>(null);
  const [selectedFlashEvent, setSelectedFlashEvent] = useState<FlashEvent | null>(null);
  const [isCreateFlashOpen, setIsCreateFlashOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isSuggestModalOpen, setIsSuggestModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [rsvpJoined, setRsvpJoined] = useState(false);
  const [rsvpLoading, setRsvpLoading] = useState(false);
  const [homeToast, setHomeToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showAllTrails, setShowAllTrails] = useState(false);
  const [showAllGuardians, setShowAllGuardians] = useState(false);

  const currentVibe = user?.interests?.[0] || null;
  const lastCheckin: string | null = null;

  // Social feed comments modal state
  const [activePostId, setActivePostId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<VibeComment[]>([]);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');

  const trailsScrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const guardiansScrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const loadFlash = async () => {
    const ev = await fetchActiveFlashEvent();
    const evs = await fetchFlashEvents();
    setFlashEvent(ev);
    if (ev) setSecondsLeft(ev.seconds_left);
    setFlashEvents(evs.length > 0 ? evs : (ev ? [ev] : []));
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchVibeGuardians().then(setGuardians);
    fetchCulturalTrails().then(setTrails);
    loadFlash();
    const flashPoll = setInterval(loadFlash, 30000);

    getDeviceLocation().then((locState) => {
      fetchNearbyPlaces(locState.coords).then(setPlaces);
      fetchCityPulses(locState.coords).then(setPulsesSummary);
    });

    return () => clearInterval(flashPoll);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (secondsLeft <= 0) return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setSecondsLeft((prev) => (prev > 0 ? prev - 1 : 0));
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [secondsLeft]);

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setHomeToast(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setHomeToast(null), 3000);
  };

  const handleRsvp = async () => {
    if (!flashEvent) return;
    setRsvpLoading(true);
    // Real D11 Events RSVP backend contract is not yet provisioned in Supabase (tables flash_events / flash_event_rsvps do not exist).
    setRsvpLoading(false);
    showToast('RSVP is unavailable: Flash Event backend is not yet provisioned in Supabase.');
  };

  const handleSuggestSubmit = async (value: { title: string; description: string; category: SuggestionCategory }) => {
    const res = await submitVibeSuggestion(value);
    if (res.success) {
      showToast('Vibe suggestion submitted to review queue.');
      setIsSuggestModalOpen(false);
    }
    return res;
  };

  const handleViewCityMap = (city?: CityPulse) => {
    if (city) {
      showToast(`Exploring map for ${city.city}...`);
    }
    onNavigateTab('explore');
  };

  const handleScrollTrails = (direction: 'left' | 'right') => {
    if (trailsScrollRef.current) {
      const scrollAmount = 300;
      trailsScrollRef.current.scrollBy({
        left: direction === 'left' ? -scrollAmount : scrollAmount,
        behavior: 'smooth'
      });
    }
  };

  const handleScrollGuardians = (direction: 'left' | 'right') => {
    if (guardiansScrollRef.current) {
      const scrollAmount = 300;
      guardiansScrollRef.current.scrollBy({
        left: direction === 'left' ? -scrollAmount : scrollAmount,
        behavior: 'smooth'
      });
    }
  };

  const handleWaypointCheckIn = (wp: TrailWaypoint, tr: CulturalTrail) => {
    showToast(`Checked in at "${wp.title}" on ${tr.title}. Reward verification is not yet available.`);
  };

  const handleOpenComments = async (postId: string) => {
    setActivePostId(postId);
    const comms = await fetchCommentsForPost(postId);
    setComments(comms);
  };

  const handleSendComment = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!activePostId || !newComment.trim() || !user) {
      showToast('Please sign in to comment.');
      return;
    }
    const added = await addCommentToPost(activePostId, newComment, {
      username: user.username,
      avatar_url: user.avatar_url
    });
    if (added) {
      setComments([...comments, added]);
      setNewComment('');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-24 text-white max-w-md mx-auto box-border overflow-x-hidden relative">
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {homeToast && (
        <div className="fixed top-16 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-teal-500 text-neutral-950 font-bold text-xs shadow-2xl flex items-center space-x-2 animate-fadeIn border border-teal-300">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>{homeToast}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Home Header: Location and Username (Clean, unboxed) */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-neutral-300">
          <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 flex-shrink-0" />
          <span className="truncate">{user?.city || user?.district || 'Location unavailable'}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white tracking-wide truncate">
          {user?.full_name || user?.username || 'Explorer'}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* VIBE CHECK-INS Section (Matching Reference 2) */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <div className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/40">
            <CalendarCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black tracking-wider uppercase text-white">VIBE CHECK-INS</h2>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {/* Current Vibe Card */}
          <div className="rounded-3xl border border-fuchsia-500/40 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1e1924] via-[#16131c] to-[#121017] p-3 sm:p-4 flex items-center space-x-2.5 sm:space-x-3.5 shadow-lg min-w-0">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-11 sm:h-11 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950/80 border border-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 shadow-inner">
              <Flame className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5 text-orange-500 animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs text-neutral-300 font-medium truncate">Current Vibe:</div>
              <div className={`text-sm sm:text-base truncate mt-0.5 ${currentVibe ? 'font-black text-orange-400' : 'text-neutral-500 italic text-[11px]'}`}>
                {currentVibe || 'No vibe set'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Last Check-in Card */}
          <div className="rounded-3xl border border-fuchsia-500/40 bg-gradient-to-br from-[#1e1924] via-[#16131c] to-[#121017] p-3 sm:p-4 flex items-center space-x-2.5 sm:space-x-3.5 shadow-lg min-w-0">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-11 sm:h-11 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950/80 border border-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 shadow-inner">
              <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5 text-amber-400" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <div className="text-[11px] sm:text-xs text-neutral-300 font-medium truncate">Last Check-in:</div>
              <div className={`text-sm sm:text-base truncate mt-0.5 ${lastCheckin ? 'font-bold text-white' : 'text-neutral-500 italic text-[11px]'}`}>
                {lastCheckin || 'No check-ins'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Canonical Home Flash & Suggestions Discovery Panel */}
      <HomeFlashDiscoveryPanel
        flashEvent={flashEvent}
        flashEvents={flashEvents}
        onSelectFlashEvent={(ev) => setSelectedFlashEvent(ev)}
        secondsLeft={secondsLeft}
        places={places}
        pulsesSummary={pulsesSummary}
        onCreateFlash={() => setIsCreateFlashOpen(true)}
        onNavigateTab={onNavigateTab}
        onSelectPlace={onSelectPlace}
        onNotify={showToast}
        onSuggestVibe={() => setIsSuggestModalOpen(true)}
        onRsvp={handleRsvp}
        rsvpEnabled={false}
        suggestionEnabled={true}
        rsvpJoined={rsvpJoined}
        rsvpLoading={rsvpLoading}
      />

      {/* Suggest Vibe Modal */}
      {isSuggestModalOpen && (
        <SuggestVibeModal
          onClose={() => setIsSuggestModalOpen(false)}
          onSubmit={handleSuggestSubmit}
          onSubmitted={() => {
            setIsSuggestModalOpen(false);
            showToast('Vibe suggestion successfully submitted for review.');
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Flash Event Detail Modal */}
      {selectedFlashEvent && (
        <FlashEventDetailModal
          event={selectedFlashEvent}
          place={places.find(p => p.id === selectedFlashEvent.place_id)}
          onClose={() => setSelectedFlashEvent(null)}
          onViewPlace={(p) => {
            setSelectedFlashEvent(null);
            onSelectPlace(p);
          }}
          onRsvp={handleRsvp}
          rsvpEnabled={false}
          rsvpJoined={rsvpJoined}
          rsvpLoading={rsvpLoading}
        />
      )}

      {/* Vibe Pulses — Exact Visual Reference & Genuine City Aggregation */}
      <VibePulsesCarousel
        summary={pulsesSummary}
        onViewMap={handleViewCityMap}
        onSelectPlace={onSelectPlace}
        onToast={showToast}
      />

      {/* Curated Cultural Trails & Vibe Tours */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold flex items-center space-x-2">
              <Award className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" />
              <span>Cultural Vibes Trails & Tours</span>
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">Curated multi-stop circuits & pro guided expeditions</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            {trails.length > 3 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowAllTrails(v => !v)}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-teal-400 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
              >
                {showAllTrails ? 'Show Less' : `View All (${trails.length})`}
              </button>
            )}
            <span className="text-xs text-neutral-400 font-semibold">{trails.length} Total</span>
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 pl-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => handleScrollTrails('left')}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 text-teal-400 hover:bg-neutral-800 cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Scroll trails left"
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleScrollTrails('right')}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 text-teal-400 hover:bg-neutral-800 cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Scroll trails right"
              >
                <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {trails.length > 0 ? (
          <div
            ref={trailsScrollRef}
            className="flex items-center space-x-3.5 overflow-x-auto pb-3 scrollbar-none px-1"
          >
            {(showAllTrails ? trails : trails.slice(0, 3)).map((t) => (
              <div
                key={t.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedTrail(t)}
                className="w-72 sm:w-80 flex-shrink-0 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 hover:border-amber-500/60 transition duration-300 cursor-pointer group flex flex-col shadow-xl"
              >
                <div className="relative h-40 w-full overflow-hidden bg-neutral-950">
                  <img
                    src={t.imageUrl || t.image_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1578632767115-351597cf2477?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80'}
                    alt={t.title}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition duration-500"
                  />
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-neutral-900 via-neutral-900/30 to-transparent" />

                  <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 right-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className={`text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border backdrop-blur-md ${
                      t.isTour
                        ? 'bg-amber-950/80 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/40'
                        : 'bg-neutral-950/80 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30'
                    }`}>
                      {t.isTour ? '⬡ VIBE TOUR' : (t.category || '🧭 VIBE TRAIL')}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-black text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/20 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/40 backdrop-blur-md">
                      +{t.vq_reward} VQ
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="absolute bottom-2.5 left-3 right-3 flex items-center space-x-2 text-[11px] text-neutral-300">
                    <span className="flex items-center space-x-1 bg-neutral-950/70 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg backdrop-blur-md">
                      <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-teal-400" />
                      <span>{t.durationHours ? `${t.durationHours}h` : `${t.duration_mins}m`}</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex items-center space-x-1 bg-neutral-950/70 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg backdrop-blur-md">
                      <Route className="w-3 h-3 text-orange-400" />
                      <span>{t.distance_km || 2.4}km</span>
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex items-center space-x-1 bg-neutral-950/70 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg backdrop-blur-md text-teal-300 font-semibold ml-auto">
                      <span>{t.stopsCount || t.waypoints_count || 3} Stops</span>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="p-4 space-y-3 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <h3 className="font-bold text-white text-base group-hover:text-amber-300 transition line-clamp-1">
                      {t.title}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                      {t.story || t.description}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-2 border-t border-neutral-800/80 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                      <img
                        src={t.authorAvatarUrl || t.guardian_avatar || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'}
                        alt={t.authorName || t.guardian_name}
                        className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full object-cover border border-orange-500/40"
                      />
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-neutral-300 font-medium truncate max-w-[120px]">
                        {t.authorName || t.guardian_name}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-teal-400 font-bold flex items-center space-x-0.5 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition">
                      <span>Explore</span>
                      <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800/80 p-5 text-center space-y-2">
            <Award className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-400/60 mx-auto" />
            <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-white">No cultural trails published yet</h4>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 max-w-xs mx-auto">
              Certified pathfinders and guardians are mapping the next historical trail.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Active Guardians & Local Legends */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold flex items-center space-x-2">
              <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-teal-400" />
              <span>Active Guardians & Local Legends</span>
            </h2>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">Verified human guides & friendly neighborhood sentinels</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            {guardians.length > 3 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowAllGuardians(v => !v)}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-teal-400 hover:underline cursor-pointer"
              >
                {showAllGuardians ? 'Show Less' : `View All (${guardians.length})`}
              </button>
            )}
            <span className="text-xs text-neutral-400 font-semibold">{guardians.length} On Duty</span>
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-1 pl-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => handleScrollGuardians('left')}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 text-teal-400 hover:bg-neutral-800 cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Scroll guardians left"
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => handleScrollGuardians('right')}
                className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 text-teal-400 hover:bg-neutral-800 cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Scroll guardians right"
              >
                <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {guardians.length > 0 ? (
          <div
            ref={guardiansScrollRef}
            className="flex items-center space-x-3.5 overflow-x-auto pb-3 scrollbar-none px-1"
          >
            {(showAllGuardians ? guardians : guardians.slice(0, 3)).map((g) => {
              const isPro = g.type === 'pro';
              return (
                <div
                  key={g.id}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedGuardian(g)}
                  className="w-72 sm:w-80 flex-shrink-0 rounded-3xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 hover:border-teal-500/60 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 transition cursor-pointer group shadow-xl"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                    <div className="relative flex-shrink-0">
                      <img
                        src={g.avatarUrl || g.avatar_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'}
                        alt={g.name}
                        className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover border border-teal-500/40 group-hover:scale-105 transition duration-300"
                      />
                      <span className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 border-2 border-neutral-900 animate-pulse" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                        <span className={`text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.2 rounded border ${
                          isPro
                            ? 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30'
                            : 'bg-teal-500/10 text-teal-300 border-teal-500/30'
                        }`}>
                          {g.tier || (isPro ? 'PRO GUIDE' : 'LOCAL LEGEND')}
                        </span>
                        {g.hourlyRate ? (
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded">
                            ${g.hourlyRate}/h
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-teal-300 bg-teal-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded">
                            Free
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white truncate group-hover:text-amber-300 transition mt-0.5">
                        {g.name}
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 truncate">{g.city || g.district}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed font-light">
                    {g.bio || 'District guardian and cultural pathfinder.'}
                  </p>

                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-neutral-800 text-xs">
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-emerald-300 font-bold">
                      Trust {g.trustScore || g.trust_score || 95}%
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-teal-400 font-bold flex items-center space-x-0.5 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition">
                      <span>Inspect</span>
                      <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800/80 p-5 text-center space-y-2">
            <Shield className="w-8 h-8 text-teal-400/60 mx-auto" />
            <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-white">No guardians registered on duty</h4>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 max-w-xs mx-auto">
              District guardian rotation active. New guardians sync when signed into Supabase.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Home Events Section */}
      <HomeEventsSection
        user={user}
        onNavigateTab={onNavigateTab}
        onToast={showToast}
      />

      {/* Home Activities Section */}
      <HomeActivitiesSection
        user={user}
        onNavigateTab={onNavigateTab}
        onToast={showToast}
      />

      {/* ========================================================
          SOCIAL FEED: MY NETWORK | LOCAL VIBES | FOR YOU
          Placed right after Activities
         ======================================================== */}
      <HomeSocialFeed user={user} onOpenComments={handleOpenComments} onToast={showToast} onInspectUser={onInspectUser} />

      {/* Comments Modal for Social Feed */}
      {activePostId && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="w-full sm:max-w-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl p-6 space-y-4 max-h-[80vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl text-white">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-800 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base">District Comments</h3>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActivePostId(null)}
                className="text-xs text-neutral-400 hover:text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Close
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-3 min-h-[160px]">
              {comments.length > 0 ? (
                comments.map((comm) => (
                  <div key={comm.id} className="flex space-x-3 items-start bg-neutral-950/60 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-800">
                    <img src={comm.avatar_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'} alt={comm.username} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full object-cover" />
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs text-white">@{comm.username}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">
                          {new Date(comm.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 mt-1">{comm.content}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                <div className="py-6 text-center text-xs text-neutral-500 italic">
                  No comments yet. Start the conversation!
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSendComment} className="flex items-center space-x-2 pt-2 border-t border-neutral-800">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={newComment}
                onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Write a comment..."
                className="flex-1 bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-teal-500 text-white hover:opacity-90 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Trail Detail Modal */}
      {selectedTrail && (
        <TrailDetailModal
          trail={selectedTrail}
          onClose={() => setSelectedTrail(null)}
          onStartNavigation={() => {
            setSelectedTrail(null);
            onNavigateTab('explore');
          }}
          onCheckInWaypoint={handleWaypointCheckIn}
          onToast={showToast}
        />
      )}

      {/* Guardian Detail Modal */}
      {selectedGuardian && (
        <GuardianDetailModal
          guardian={selectedGuardian}
          currentUser={user}
          trails={trails}
          onClose={() => setSelectedGuardian(null)}
          onSelectTrail={(t) => {
            setSelectedGuardian(null);
            setSelectedTrail(t);
          }}
          onLocateMap={() => {
            setSelectedGuardian(null);
            onNavigateTab('explore');
          }}
          onToast={showToast}
        />
      )}

      {/* Create Flash Event Modal */}
      {isCreateFlashOpen && (
        <CreateFlashModal
          user={user}
          canCreate={Boolean(user?.role === 'admin' || user?.tier === 'pro' || user?.tier === 'business' || user?.accountType === 'pro')}
          places={places}
          onClose={() => setIsCreateFlashOpen(false)}
          onCreated={loadFlash}
          onToast={showToast}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'motion/react';
import { Camera, X } from 'lucide-react';
import type { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';
import { registerGuardian } from '../domains/d07_guardians';
import type { VibeGuardian } from '../domains/d07_trails';
import { SelfieCameraStep } from './guardian/SelfieCameraStep';
import { GuardianProfileFormStep } from './guardian/GuardianProfileFormStep';

interface LiveSelfieModalProps {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onVerified: (timestamp: string) => void;
  onGuardianSaved?: (guardian: VibeGuardian) => void;
  availableTrails?: Array<{id:string;title:string}>;
  initialGuardianType?: 'local' | 'pro';
  onToast: (message: string) => void;
}
type GuardianTrailItem = { id: string; title: string; link?: string; flatPrice?: number };

export const LiveSelfieModal: React.FC<LiveSelfieModalProps> = ({
  user, onClose, onVerified, onGuardianSaved, onToast, availableTrails = [], initialGuardianType
}) => {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<'camera' | 'details'>('camera');
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const countdownTimeout = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const [cameraActive, setCameraActive] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState(false);
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [capturedPhotoUrl, setCapturedPhotoUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [capturedBlob, setCapturedBlob] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
  const [guardianType, setGuardianType] = useState<'local' | 'pro'>(initialGuardianType ?? (user?.accountType === 'pro' ? 'pro' : 'local'));
  const [name, setName] = useState(user?.full_name || '');
  const [city, setCity] = useState(user?.city || '');
  const [bio, setBio] = useState(user?.bio || '');
  const [pricingType, setPricingType] = useState<'hourly' | 'flat'>('hourly');
  const [hourlyRate, setHourlyRate] = useState(30);
  const [flatRate, setFlatRate] = useState(75);
  const [trails, setTrails] = useState<GuardianTrailItem[]>([]);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const stopCamera = () => {
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
    streamRef.current = null;
    if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = null;
    setCameraActive(false);
  };
  const startCamera = async () => {
    stopCamera();
    setCameraError(false);
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      setCameraError(true);
      setError('A compatible front camera is not available.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: 'user', width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 640 } },
        audio: false,
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
      setCameraActive(true);
    } catch (failure) {
      setCameraError(true);
      setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Camera permission was denied.');
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    if (step === 'camera') void startCamera();
    else stopCamera();
    return () => {
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
      if (countdownTimeout.current) clearTimeout(countdownTimeout.current);
    };
  }, [step]);

  const performCapture = () => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video || !streamRef.current || video.videoWidth <= 0 || video.videoHeight <= 0) {
      setCameraError(true);
      setError('The front camera is not ready. Retry capture.');
      return;
    }
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) { setError('Image capture is unavailable.'); return; }
    ctx.translate(canvas.width, 0);
    ctx.scale(-1, 1);
    ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.toBlob(blob => {
      if (!blob) { setError('Camera image capture failed.'); return; }
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85);
      setCapturedBlob(blob);
      setCapturedPhotoUrl(dataUrl);
      stopCamera();
      setStep('details');
    }, 'image/jpeg', 0.85);
  };
  const snapSelfie = () => {
    if (!cameraActive || countdown !== null) return;
    setError(null);
    const tick = (n: number) => {
      setCountdown(n);
      if (n === 0) {
        setCountdown(null);
        performCapture();
      } else {
        countdownTimeout.current = setTimeout(() => tick(n - 1), 1000);
      }
    };
    tick(3);
  };
  const retake = () => {
    setCapturedPhotoUrl(null);
    setCapturedBlob(null);
    setStep('camera');
  };
  const save = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;
    if (!user) { setError('Sign in to become a Guardian.'); return; }
    if (!capturedBlob || !capturedPhotoUrl) { setError('Capture a fresh in-app selfie first.'); return; }
    if (!name.trim() || name.trim() !== user.full_name.trim()) {
      setError('Guardian identity must match your existing public profile name.');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const guardian = await registerGuardian({
        guardianType,city:city.trim(),bio:bio.trim(),
        pricingType:guardianType === 'pro' ? pricingType : undefined,
        rate:guardianType === 'pro' ? (pricingType === 'hourly' ? hourlyRate : flatRate) : undefined,
        linkedTrailIds:trails.map(trail => trail.id),selfie:capturedBlob
      });
      onGuardianSaved?.(guardian);
      onVerified(guardian.selfieCapturedAt);
      onToast('Guardian registration saved. Fresh selfie recorded.');
      onClose();
    } catch (failure) {
      setError(failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Guardian registration failed.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto">
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 15 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 15 }}
          className="bg-[#110F15] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-lg max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto text-left shadow-2xl relative flex flex-col">
          <div className="bg-[#17141E] border-b border-white/10 p-4 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/20 border border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-purple-300">
                <Camera className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-white">
                {step === 'camera' ? 'Front-Camera Selfie' : 'Guardian Profile Details'}
              </h3>
            </div>
            <button type="button" aria-label="Close Guardian registration" onClick={onClose}
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white/5 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer">
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
          {step === 'camera' ? (
            <SelfieCameraStep videoRef={videoRef} cameraActive={cameraActive}
              cameraError={cameraError} countdown={countdown}
              onSnapSelfie={snapSelfie} onRetryCamera={() => { setError(null); void startCamera(); }} />
          ) : (
            <GuardianProfileFormStep capturedPhotoUrl={capturedPhotoUrl!}
              guardianType={guardianType} setGuardianType={setGuardianType}
              name={name} setName={setName} city={city} setCity={setCity}
              pricingType={pricingType} setPricingType={setPricingType}
              hourlyRate={hourlyRate} setHourlyRate={setHourlyRate}
              flatRate={flatRate} setFlatRate={setFlatRate}
              bio={bio} setBio={setBio} trails={trails}
              onRemoveTrail={(index) => setTrails(previous => previous.filter((_,i) => i !== index))}
              availableTrails={availableTrails}
              onAddTrail={id => {
                const found = availableTrails.find(item => item.id === id);
                if (found) setTrails(previous => previous.length < 5 && !previous.some(t => t.id === id) ? [...previous, found] : previous);
              }}
              onRetakePhoto={retake} onSubmit={save} submitting={saving} error={error}
              proEligible={user?.accountType === 'pro'} />
          )}
          {step === 'camera' && error && <p role="alert" className="text-xs text-red-400 px-5 pb-5">{error}</p>}
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';

  compact?: boolean;
}

export const MeetupCard: React.FC<MeetupCardProps> = ({
  meetup,
  currentUser,
  onRsvpChanged,
  compact = false
}) => {
  const [attending, setAttending] = useState(() => {
    if (!currentUser?.id) return false;
    const cleanId = currentUser.id.replace(/^usr_/, '');
    return meetup.attendee_ids.some(
      id => id === currentUser.id || id === cleanId || id === 'usr_' + cleanId
    );
  });
  const [attendeeCount, setAttendeeCount] = useState(meetup.attendee_ids.length);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const isHost = currentUser?.id && (
    meetup.host_user_id === currentUser.id ||
    meetup.host_user_id === currentUser.id.replace(/^usr_/, '') ||
    'usr_' + meetup.host_user_id === currentUser.id
  );

  const handleToggleRsvp = async (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!currentUser?.id || isHost || submitting) return;

    setSubmitting(true);
    const res = await toggleMeetupRsvp(meetup.id, currentUser.id);
    if (res.success) {
      setAttending(res.isAttending);
      setAttendeeCount(res.attendeesCount);
      if (onRsvpChanged) onRsvpChanged();
    }
    setSubmitting(false);
  };

  const formattedDate = meetup.is_live_checkin
    ? 'Happening Right Now'
    : new Date(meetup.scheduled_at).toLocaleDateString([], {
        weekday: 'short',
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit'
      });

  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#0e1422] border border-neutral-800 hover:border-blue-500/40 transition p-4 space-y-3 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden">
      {/* Top Banner / Badges */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
          <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
            <Users className="w-3 h-3" />
            SPOT MEETUP
          </span>
          {meetup.is_live_checkin ? (

              <Radio className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> LIVE NOW
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-300 text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
              <Calendar className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-blue-400" /> {formattedDate}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-neutral-400 bg-neutral-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg border border-neutral-800 shrink-0">
          👥 {attendeeCount} going
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Meetup Title & Description */}

        <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-white tracking-tight leading-snug">

import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Bell, X, Inbox, MessageSquare } from 'lucide-react';
import { fetchNotifications, markNotificationRead, markAllNotificationsRead, AppNotification } from '../domains/d08_notifications';

interface NotificationModalProps {
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenChat?: (targetUser: any) => void;
}

export const NotificationModal: React.FC<NotificationModalProps> = ({ onClose, onOpenChat }) => {
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<AppNotification[]>([]);
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<'all' | 'unread' | 'matches' | 'alerts' | 'dms'>('all');

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchNotifications().then(setNotifications);
  }, []);

  const handleMarkRead = async (id: string) => {
    await markNotificationRead(id);
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => n.id === id ? { ...n, read: true } : n));
  };

  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    const total = notifications.length;
    const unread = notifications.filter(n => !n.read).length;
    const matches = notifications.filter(n => n.type === 'match' || n.title.toLowerCase().includes('match')).length;
    const alerts = notifications.filter(n => n.type === 'alert' || n.type === 'system' || n.title.toLowerCase().includes('alert')).length;
    const dms = notifications.filter(n => n.type === 'dm' || n.title.toLowerCase().includes('dm')).length;
    return { total, unread, matches, alerts, dms };
  }, [notifications]);

  const filteredNotifications = useMemo(() => {
    return notifications.filter(n => {
      if (activeFilter === 'unread') return !n.read;
      if (activeFilter === 'matches') return n.type === 'match' || n.title.toLowerCase().includes('match');
      if (activeFilter === 'alerts') return n.type === 'alert' || n.type === 'system' || n.title.toLowerCase().includes('alert');
      if (activeFilter === 'dms') return n.type === 'dm' || n.title.toLowerCase().includes('dm');
      return true;
    });
  }, [notifications, activeFilter]);

  return (
    <div className="absolute top-14 left-0 right-0 z-50 px-3 animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md mx-auto bg-[#141416] border border-neutral-800 rounded-3xl p-5 space-y-4 shadow-2xl text-white backdrop-blur-2xl">
        {/* Header matching reference */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-800 pb-3">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/15 border border-amber-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-400 shadow-lg">
              <Bell className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-black text-sm tracking-wider uppercase text-white">NOTIFICATIONS</h3>
              <p className="text-[9px] text-neutral-400 font-bold tracking-widest uppercase">LIVE VIBE ALERTS & MATCHES</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="relative p-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Close Notifications"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            {counts.unread > 0 && <span className="absolute top-1 right-1 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-pulse" />}
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Filter Pills Bar */}
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none text-xs">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveFilter('all')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeFilter === 'all' ? 'bg-white text-neutral-950 font-black shadow' : 'bg-neutral-800/80 border border-neutral-700/60 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <span>All</span>
            <span className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full ${activeFilter === 'all' ? 'bg-neutral-200 text-neutral-900 font-bold' : 'bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-300'}`}>{counts.total}</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveFilter('unread')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeFilter === 'unread' ? 'bg-white text-neutral-950 font-black shadow' : 'bg-neutral-800/80 border border-neutral-700/60 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <span>Unread</span>
            {counts.unread > 0 && <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-orange-500 animate-pulse" />}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveFilter('matches')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeFilter === 'matches' ? 'bg-white text-neutral-950 font-black shadow' : 'bg-neutral-800/80 border border-neutral-700/60 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <span>Matches</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 rounded-full bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-300">{counts.matches}</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveFilter('alerts')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeFilter === 'alerts' ? 'bg-white text-neutral-950 font-black shadow' : 'bg-neutral-800/80 border border-neutral-700/60 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <span>Alerts</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 rounded-full bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-300">{counts.alerts}</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveFilter('dms')}
            className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
              activeFilter === 'dms' ? 'bg-white text-neutral-950 font-black shadow' : 'bg-neutral-800/80 border border-neutral-700/60 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <span>DMs</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 rounded-full bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-300">{counts.dms}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Notifications List matching reference */}
        <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[55vh] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
          {filteredNotifications.length > 0 ? (
            filteredNotifications.map((n) => (
              <div
                key={n.id}
                onClick={() => !n.read && handleMarkRead(n.id)}
                className={`rounded-2xl p-4 space-y-2 border transition ${
                  n.read
                    ? 'bg-[#18181b]/50 border-neutral-800/80 text-neutral-300'
                    : 'bg-[#1a1a1e] border-amber-500/40 shadow-xl text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start space-x-3">
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-purple-500/20 border border-purple-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-purple-300 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5 shadow">
                    <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-white truncate flex items-center space-x-1.5">
                        {!n.read && <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-pulse flex-shrink-0" />}
                        <span>{n.title}</span>
                      </h4>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 flex-shrink-0 ml-2">
                        {new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' })}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 mt-1 leading-relaxed">{n.message}</p>
                    {n.action_label && (
                      <div className="pt-2.5">
                        <button
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            if (onOpenChat && n.action_url) {
                              onOpenChat({ id: n.action_url, name: n.title, handle: 'voyager', avatar: '' });
                            }
                          }}
                          className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/60 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-500/20 font-extrabold text-[11px] transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer shadow"
                        >
                          <span>{n.action_label}</span>
                          <span>↗</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          ) : (
            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#18181b]/60 border border-neutral-800/80 p-8 text-center space-y-2">
              <Inbox className="w-8 h-8 text-neutral-500 mx-auto" />
              <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-white">No notifications in this filter</h4>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 max-w-xs mx-auto">
                Notifications from live vibe alerts, district matches, and direct messages will appear here.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  X, Navigation, Shield, Award, Users,
  CheckCircle2, Lock, Coffee, Utensils, Compass, Landmark,
  Moon, Star, ExternalLink, Calendar, Sparkles, Rocket, Camera
} from 'lucide-react';
import { VibePlace } from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit/types';
import { useUser } from '../contexts/UserContext';
import { computeAiVibeMatch } from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit/matchEngine';
import {
  fetchPromotionForPlace,
  getActivePlacePromotion,
  fetchPlaceCheckinsCount,
  claimCheckinReward,
  PlacePromotion
} from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit/promotions';
import {
  fetchPlaceValidations,
  PlaceValidationSummary
} from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit/validations';
import {
  fetchMeetupsByPlaceId,
  toggleMeetupRsvp,
  subscribeToMeetupUpdates
} from '../domains/d12_meetups/api';
import { PlaceMeetup } from '../domains/d12_meetups/types';
import { PromoteBusinessModal } from './PromoteBusinessModal';
import { VibeValidateModal } from './VibeValidateModal';
import { CreateMeetupModal } from './CreateMeetupModal';

export interface PlaceDetailModalProps {
  place: VibePlace;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCheckIn: (place: VibePlace) => void;
  onViewMap?: (place: VibePlace) => void;
  onRequireAuth?: () => void;
}

type ActiveTab = 'info' | 'mayor' | 'meetups';

/**
 * Returns an appropriate icon based on category
 */
function getCategoryIcon(category: string) {
  const cat = (category || '').toLowerCase();
  if (cat.includes('food') || cat.includes('restaurant')) return <Utensils className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />;
  if (cat.includes('culture') || cat.includes('history')) return <Landmark className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />;
  if (cat.includes('night') || cat.includes('owl')) return <Moon className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-400" />;
  if (cat.includes('spot') || cat.includes('café') || cat.includes('cafe')) return <Coffee className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />;
  return <Compass className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-400" />;
}

export const PlaceDetailModal: React.FC<PlaceDetailModalProps> = ({
  place,
  onClose,
  onCheckIn,
  onViewMap,
  onRequireAuth
}) => {
  const { user } = useUser();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ActiveTab>('info');
  const [isCheckedIn, setIsCheckedIn] = useState(false);

  // Sub-modals
  const [showPromoteModal, setShowPromoteModal] = useState(false);
  const [showValidateModal, setShowValidateModal] = useState(false);
  const [showCreateMeetupModal, setShowCreateMeetupModal] = useState(false);
  const pendingOpenPromoteRef = useRef(false);

  // Auto-open Promote modal if user just signed in following a promote click
  useEffect(() => {
    if (user && pendingOpenPromoteRef.current) {
      pendingOpenPromoteRef.current = false;
      setShowPromoteModal(true);
    }
  }, [user]);

  // Dynamic domain data
  const [promotion, setPromotion] = useState<PlacePromotion | null>(null);
  const [validationSummary, setValidationSummary] = useState<PlaceValidationSummary>({
    averageConfidence: null,
    count: 0,
    validations: [],
    baselineConfidence: Math.round((place.rating ?? 4.0) * 20)
  });
  const [placeMeetups, setPlaceMeetups] = useState<PlaceMeetup[]>([]);
  const [realCheckinsCount, setRealCheckinsCount] = useState<number>(place.checkins_count ?? 0);

  // Load real promotions, validations, meetups, and checkins
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;

    async function loadPlaceData() {
      try {
        const [promo, valSummary, meetups, checkins] = await Promise.all([
          fetchPromotionForPlace(place.id),
          fetchPlaceValidations(place.id, place.rating),
          fetchMeetupsByPlaceId(place.id),
          fetchPlaceCheckinsCount(place.id)
        ]);

        if (mounted) {
          setPromotion(promo);
          setValidationSummary(valSummary);
          setPlaceMeetups(meetups);
          setRealCheckinsCount(checkins);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Error loading dynamic place data:', err);
      }
    }

    loadPlaceData();

    // Subscribe to cross-feed meetup updates
    const unsubscribe = subscribeToMeetupUpdates(() => {
      fetchMeetupsByPlaceId(place.id).then(m => {
        if (mounted) setPlaceMeetups(m);
      });
    });

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [place.id, place.rating]);

  // Derived metrics
  const rating = place.rating ?? 4.6;

  // Strict Mutual Exclusivity: Only true if a user has funded a real VQ reward pool
  const activePromotion = getActivePlacePromotion(place.id) || promotion;
  const rewardPerCheckin = activePromotion?.reward_per_checkin ?? (place.is_promoted ? place.vq_reward : undefined);
  const remainingPool = activePromotion?.remaining_vq_pool ?? place.promotion_pool ?? 0;
  const isActivelyPromoted = Boolean(
    activePromotion &&
    rewardPerCheckin &&
    rewardPerCheckin > 0 &&
    remainingPool >= rewardPerCheckin
  );

  const displayCheckins = realCheckinsCount + (isCheckedIn ? 1 : 0);
  const vibeConfidence = validationSummary.averageConfidence;
  const confirmationsCount = validationSummary.count;

  // Proximity validation unlock (within 200m or checked in)
  const isWithin200m =
    (place.distance_meters !== undefined && place.distance_meters <= 200) ||
    (place.distance_km !== undefined && place.distance_km <= 0.2);
  const canValidate = isCheckedIn || isWithin200m;

  const distanceDisplay =
    place.distance_km !== undefined
      ? `${place.distance_km} km`
      : place.distance_meters !== undefined
      ? `${(place.distance_meters / 1000).toFixed(2)} km`
      : '0.38 km';

  // AI Vibe Match dynamic computation
  const matchResult = computeAiVibeMatch(place, user);
  const matchScore = place.ai_match_score ?? matchResult.score;
  const breakdown = matchResult.breakdown.length > 0
    ? matchResult.breakdown
    : [
        { label: 'Interest Alignment', delta: '+15%', points: 15 },
        { label: 'Stable Base Signal', delta: '+3%', points: 3 }
      ];

  const categoryLabel = ((place as any).categoryLabel || place.category || 'Spots').toUpperCase();

  const handlePromoteClick = () => {
    if (!user) {
      pendingOpenPromoteRef.current = true;
      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
      return;
    }
    setShowPromoteModal(true);
  };

  const handleCheckInClick = async () => {
    if (!isCheckedIn) {
      if (!user) {
        if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
        return;
      }

      setIsCheckedIn(true);
      setRealCheckinsCount(prev => prev + 1);

      // Claim reward if place is promoted
      if (user.id && rewardPerCheckin) {
        await claimCheckinReward(place.id, user.id, place.title);
        if (promotion) {
          const newPool = Math.max(0, promotion.remaining_vq_pool - rewardPerCheckin);
          setPromotion({
            ...promotion,
            remaining_vq_pool: newPool,
            status: newPool >= rewardPerCheckin ? 'active' : 'depleted'
          });
        }
      }
      onCheckIn(place);
    }
  };

  const handleVibeValidateClick = () => {
    if (!user) {
      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
      return;
    }
    setShowValidateModal(true);
  };

  const handleViewMapClick = () => {
    if (onViewMap) {
      onViewMap(place);
    } else {
      onClose();
    }
  };

  const handleRsvp = async (meetupId: string) => {
    const userId = user?.id || 'usr_anonymous';
    const res = await toggleMeetupRsvp(meetupId, userId);
    if (res.success) {
      const updated = await fetchMeetupsByPlaceId(place.id);
      setPlaceMeetups(updated);
    }
  };

  const handleValidationSuccess = (newAvg: number | null, newCount: number) => {
    setValidationSummary(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      averageConfidence: newAvg,
      count: newCount
    }));
  };

  const handleMeetupCreated = (newMeetup: PlaceMeetup) => {
    setPlaceMeetups([newMeetup, ...placeMeetups]);
    setActiveTab('meetups');
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-label={`${place.title} details`}
        className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 overflow-y-auto"
      >
        <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-[#0d111a] border border-neutral-800 border-t-4 border-t-amber-400 rounded-[28px] overflow-hidden shadow-2xl text-white my-auto max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col">
          {/* Scrollable Container */}
          <div className="overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden flex-1 overscroll-contain">
            {/* 1. Hero Image Banner */}
            <div className="relative h-56 sm:h-60 w-full shrink-0">
              <img
                src={place.image_url && place.image_url.trim() !== '' ? place.image_url : 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555396273-367ea4eb4db5?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80'}
                alt={place.title}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover"
              />
              {/* Top-right close button */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onClose}
                aria-label="Close spot details"
                className="absolute top-3.5 right-3.5 w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-black/70 hover:bg-black text-white flex items-center justify-center backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 transition cursor-pointer z-10 active:scale-90"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              {/* Bottom-left Category Pill (Emerald Green, uppercase, bold) */}
              <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-4 z-10 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="px-3.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-[#00d68f] text-neutral-950 font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-md">
                  {categoryLabel}
                </span>
                {isActivelyPromoted && (
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md bg-amber-500 text-neutral-950 font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-md flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Rocket className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>Promoted</span>
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Subtle Gradient overlay on bottom of image */}
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0d111a] via-transparent to-black/30 pointer-events-none" />
            </div>

            {/* 2. Modal Body */}
            <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
              {/* Spot Identity: Icon + Legendary Spot Badge + Title */}
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
                  <span className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-neutral-800/80 flex items-center justify-center text-sm shadow-inner">
                    {getCategoryIcon(place.category)}
                  </span>
                  <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-[#13233c] text-[#60a5fa] border border-[#2563eb]/40 font-extrabold text-[11px] tracking-wider uppercase">
                    LEGENDARY SPOT
                  </span>
                </div>
                <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight leading-tight">
                  {place.title}

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-1" role="tablist" aria-label="Spot tabs">

                  aria-selected={activeTab === 'info'}

                  className={`py-2 px-3.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition cursor-pointer ${

                    </p>

                    {/* Card Header */}

                        <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>AI VIBE MATCH SCORE</span>
                      </div>

                        className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-500 via-purple-500 to-indigo-400 rounded-full transition-all duration-700 ease-out"
                        style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, Math.max(10, matchScore))}%` }}
                      />
                    </div>

                    {/* Match Relevance Breakdown */}
                    <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-1">
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-neutral-400 tracking-wider uppercase">
                        MATCH RELEVANCE BREAKDOWN:
                      </div>
                      {breakdown.map((row, idx) => (
                        <div key={idx} className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-neutral-300">
                            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-fuchsia-400" />
                            <span>{row.label}</span>
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-neutral-300 font-bold">{row.delta}</span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>

                    {/* Italic Engine Disclaimer */}
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 italic leading-snug pt-1">
                      Based on interests, active community circles, recent check-ins, and local lifestyle sync. Offline-resilient engine active.
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* 6. Four Approved Action Buttons (Strictly Mutually Exclusive Promotion vs Check-in) */}
                  <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-2">
                    {/* Primary Button Slot: Promoted Check-in CTA OR Promote Business CTA */}
                    {isActivelyPromoted && rewardPerCheckin ? (
                      <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={handleCheckInClick}
                          disabled={isCheckedIn}
                          className={`w-full py-3.5 px-4 rounded-full font-black text-sm text-center transition cursor-pointer active:scale-98 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${
                            isCheckedIn
                              ? 'border border-emerald-500/60 bg-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-300 cursor-default'
                              : 'border border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-950/40 hover:bg-emerald-900/40 text-emerald-400'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isCheckedIn ? (
                            <>
                              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-300" />
                              <span>✅ Checked In & Vibe Validated</span>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <>
                              <Camera className="w-4 h-4" />
                              <span>📸 Check-in with LiveCheck Receipt (+500 VQ)</span>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </button>

                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2 text-[11px] text-amber-400/90 font-medium">
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Rocket className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                            <span>Sponsored Pool: <strong>{remainingPool} VQ</strong> left</span>
                          </span>
                          <span>+{rewardPerCheckin} VQ / check-in</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={handlePromoteClick}
                        className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 rounded-full font-black text-sm text-center transition cursor-pointer active:scale-98 shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 border border-amber-500/50 bg-amber-500/10 hover:bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400"
                      >
                        <Rocket className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>🚀 Promote This Business (Fund Check-in Rewards)</span>
                      </button>
                    )}

                    {/* Button 2: Check-in & Vibe Validate (Unified Status Button) */}
                    {isCheckedIn ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled
                        className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/60 bg-emerald-900/50 text-emerald-300 font-bold text-xs text-center flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-default shadow-sm"
                      >
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-300" />
                        <span>✅ Checked In & Vibe Validated</span>
                      </button>
                    ) : (place.distance_meters !== undefined && place.distance_meters <= 33) ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={handleVibeValidateClick}
                        className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-full border border-[#00e5a3]/50 bg-[#00e5a3]/10 hover:bg-[#00e5a3]/20 text-[#00e5a3] font-bold text-xs text-center transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-98 shadow-sm"
                      >
                        <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Check-in & Vibe Validate — Submit Live Status</span>
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (onRequireAuth && !user) {
                            onRequireAuth();
                          } else {
                            handleVibeValidateClick();
                          }
                        }}
                        className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-full border border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-900/50 hover:bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-400 font-semibold text-xs text-center transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-500" />
                        <span>Check-in & Vibe Validate (Locked — {place.distance_meters ?? 380}m away, must be within 33m)</span>
                      </button>
                    )}

                    {/* Button 3: View Map & Directions */}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleViewMapClick}
                      className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-full border border-blue-600/40 bg-blue-950/30 hover:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-400 font-bold text-sm text-center transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-98"
                    >
                      <Navigation className="w-4 h-4" />
                      <span>View Map & Directions</span>
                    </button>

                    {/* Button 4: Close Spot Details */}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={onClose}
                      className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-full border border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-900/60 hover:bg-neutral-800 text-white font-bold text-sm text-center transition cursor-pointer active:scale-98"
                    >
                      Close Spot Details
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Tab 2: Mayor & Badges */}
              {activeTab === 'mayor' && (
                <div className="space-y-4 pt-1">
                  <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/70 border border-neutral-800 p-4 space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500 to-orange-600 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shadow-md">
                        👑
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-400 font-bold">
                          District Sentinel / Mayor
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-base font-black text-white">
                          @{place.created_by || 'zen_stroller'}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-neutral-400">
                          Top check-in frequency ({displayCheckins > 0 ? displayCheckins : 14} visits this cycle)
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400">
                      Earnable Spot Badges
                    </h4>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                      <div className="rounded-xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800/80 p-3 flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <span className="text-xl">☕</span>
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white">Caffeine Pioneer</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">3 check-ins required</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="rounded-xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800/80 p-3 flex items-center gap-2.5">
                        <span className="text-xl">🛡️</span>
                        <div>
                          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white">Vibe Validator</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">Verify spot hours</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onClose}
                    className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-full border border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-900/60 hover:bg-neutral-800 text-white font-bold text-sm text-center transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Close Spot Details
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Tab 3: Meetups */}
              {activeTab === 'meetups' && (
                <div className="space-y-4 pt-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <h4 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400">
                      Spot Gatherings & Circles
                    </h4>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setShowCreateMeetupModal(true)}
                      className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 transition flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      + Host Meetup
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {placeMeetups.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800/80 p-6 text-center space-y-3">
                      <Users className="w-8 h-8 text-neutral-500 mx-auto" />
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">No active meetups scheduled</h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 max-w-xs mx-auto">
                        Be the first to rally the squad at {place.title}! Host an open hangout, casual study session, or coffee crawl.
                      </p>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setShowCreateMeetupModal(true)}
                        className="py-2 px-4 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-500 transition shadow-md cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        + Organize Meetup at {place.title}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2.5 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                      {placeMeetups.map((m) => {
                        const isAttending = user?.id ? m.attendee_ids.includes(user.id) : false;
                        const isHost = user?.id && m.host_user_id === user.id;

                        return (
                          <div
                            key={m.id}
                            className="p-3.5 bg-neutral-900/80 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl space-y-2"
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                              <div>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                  {m.is_live_checkin && (
                                    <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
                                      LIVE NOW
                                    </span>
                                  )}
                                  <h5 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{m.title}</h5>
                                </div>
                                <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">
                                  Hosted by <span className="text-neutral-200 font-semibold">{m.host_name}</span>
                                  {!m.is_live_checkin && ` • ${new Date(m.scheduled_at).toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}`}
                                </p>
                              </div>
                              <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-300 font-bold shrink-0">
                                {m.attendee_ids.length} going
                              </span>
                            </div>

                            {m.description && (
                              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 italic">{m.description}</p>
                            )}

                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
                              <span className="text-[11px] text-neutral-500">
                                {isHost ? 'You are host' : isAttending ? 'You are attending' : 'Open to everyone'}
                              </span>
                              {!isHost && (
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => handleRsvp(m.id)}
                                  className={`text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-lg font-bold transition cursor-pointer ${
                                    isAttending
                                      ? 'bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-300 hover:bg-neutral-700'
                                      : 'bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-500 shadow-sm'
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  {isAttending ? 'Leave' : 'RSVP / Join'}
                                </button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={onClose}
                    className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-full border border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-900/60 hover:bg-neutral-800 text-white font-bold text-sm text-center transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Close Spot Details
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sub-modals */}
      {showPromoteModal && (
        <PromoteBusinessModal
          isOpen={showPromoteModal}
          onClose={() => setShowPromoteModal(false)}
          place={place}
          user={user}
          onSuccess={(promo: any) => setPromotion(promo)}
          onRequireAuth={onRequireAuth}
        />
      )}

      {showValidateModal && (
        <VibeValidateModal
          isOpen={showValidateModal}
          onClose={() => setShowValidateModal(false)}
          place={place}
          onValidated={handleValidationSuccess}
          onRequireAuth={onRequireAuth}
        />
      )}

      {showCreateMeetupModal && (
        <CreateMeetupModal
          isOpen={showCreateMeetupModal}
          onClose={() => setShowCreateMeetupModal(false)}
          place={place}
          onCreated={handleMeetupCreated}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
};
