import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { UserProfile, registerProfile as registerExistingProfile, updateExistingProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';
import { supabase } from '../lib/supabase';
const cn = (...parts: Array<string | false | null | undefined>) => parts.filter(Boolean).join(' ');
import { AlertTriangle, Check, User, Globe, Hash, ShieldCheck } from 'lucide-react';

interface ProfileFormProps {
  profile: UserProfile | null;
  onSaved: (profile: UserProfile) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
  onVerificationRequired?: (email: string, note?: string) => void;
}

const PRESET_TAGS = [
  'cyberpunk', 'web3', 'solana', 'neon', 'tokyo', 'tunis', 
  'coffee-seeker', 'retro-gaming', 'cultural-pass', 'minimalist'
];

export const ProfileForm: React.FC<ProfileFormProps> = ({ profile: originalProfile, onSaved, onCancel, onVerificationRequired }) => {
  // Preserve the reference form and validation while mapping to the existing
  // VQUltimate D01 public interface. Never create a second Auth provider.
  const profile = originalProfile ? {
    handle: originalProfile.username,
    displayName: originalProfile.full_name,
    photoUrl: originalProfile.avatar_url,
    bio: originalProfile.bio || '',
    location: originalProfile.city || originalProfile.district || '',
    tags: originalProfile.interests || [],
    contactMethod: originalProfile.contactMethod || 'none',
    xHandle: originalProfile.xHandle || '',
    telegramHandle: originalProfile.telegramHandle || '',
    oracleMode: Boolean(originalProfile.cozyDiaryMode),
  } : null;
  const savedProfile = useRef<UserProfile | null>(null);
  const updateProfile = async (updates: {
    displayName?: string; photoUrl?: string; avatarFile?: File;
    bio?: string; location?: string; tags?: string[];
    contactMethod?: string; xHandle?: string; telegramHandle?: string;
    oracleMode?: boolean; languages?: string[];
  }) => {
    if (!originalProfile) throw new Error('Sign in to edit your profile.');
    savedProfile.current = await updateExistingProfile(originalProfile, {
      displayName: updates.displayName, photoUrl: updates.photoUrl,
      avatarFile: updates.avatarFile || null, bio: updates.bio, city: updates.location,
      interests: updates.tags, languages: updates.languages,
      contactMethod: updates.contactMethod, xHandle: updates.xHandle,
      telegramHandle: updates.telegramHandle, cozyDiaryMode: updates.oracleMode,
    });
  };
  const registerProfile = async (payload: {
    handle: string; displayName: string; email: string; password: string;
    avatarFile?: File; photoUrl?: string; bio?: string; location?: string;
    tags?: string[]; languages?: string[]; contactMethod?: string;
    xHandle?: string; telegramHandle?: string; oracleMode?: boolean;
  }) => {
    const created = await registerExistingProfile({
      handle: payload.handle, displayName: payload.displayName,
      email: payload.email, password: payload.password,
      avatarFile: payload.avatarFile || null, photoUrl: payload.photoUrl,
      bio: payload.bio, city: payload.location, interests: payload.tags,
      languages: payload.languages, contactMethod: payload.contactMethod,
      xHandle: payload.xHandle, telegramHandle: payload.telegramHandle,
      cozyDiaryMode: payload.oracleMode,
    });
    if (created.pendingVerification) return created;
    savedProfile.current = created.profile;
    return { displayName: created.profile.full_name, avatarUploadNote: created.avatarUploadNote };
  };
  const onSuccess = () => { if (savedProfile.current) onSaved(savedProfile.current); };
  
  // Is this creation mode or editing mode? 
  // If the profile is "hannibal" (the default guest fallback) or doesn't exist, we allow creation
  const isEditing = Boolean(profile);

  const [photoUrl, setPhotoUrl] = useState(profile?.photoUrl || '');
  const [avatarFile, setAvatarFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [avatarPreview, setAvatarPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!avatarFile) { setAvatarPreview(null); return; }
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(avatarFile);
    setAvatarPreview(url);
    return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, [avatarFile]);
  const [handle, setHandle] = useState(profile?.handle || '');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState(profile?.displayName || '');
  const [bio, setBio] = useState(profile?.bio || '');
  const [location, setLocation] = useState(profile?.location || '');
  const [languages, setLanguages] = useState((originalProfile?.languages || []).join(', '));
  const [tags, setTags] = useState<string[]>(profile?.tags || []);
  const [contactMethod, setContactMethod] = useState(profile?.contactMethod || 'telegram');
  const [xHandle, setXHandle] = useState(profile?.xHandle || '');
  const [telegramHandle, setTelegramHandle] = useState(profile?.telegramHandle || '');
  
  // Oracle Mode forces ALL fields to be mandatory
  const [oracleMode, setOracleMode] = useState(profile?.oracleMode || false);

  const [isCheckingHandle, setIsCheckingHandle] = useState(false);
  const [handleAvailable, setHandleAvailable] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [customTagInput, setCustomTagInput] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Uniqueness handle review
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!handle) {
      setHandleAvailable(null);
      return;
    }
    
    // Skip checking if it's our own handle in editing mode
    if (isEditing && handle.toLowerCase().trim() === profile?.handle?.toLowerCase()) {
      setHandleAvailable(true);
      return;
    }

    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      setIsCheckingHandle(true);
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from('profiles')
          .select('id')
          .ilike('handle', handle.trim());
        setHandleAvailable(!error && (!data || data.length === 0));
      } catch (e) {
        setHandleAvailable(false); // Never claim username availability when verification fails.
      } finally {
        setIsCheckingHandle(false);
      }
    }, 450);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [handle, isEditing, profile?.handle]);

  // Pill list handlers
  const handleToggleTag = (tag: string) => {
    const formatted = tag.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (tags.includes(formatted)) {
      setTags(tags.filter(t => t !== formatted));
    } else {
      setTags([...tags, formatted]);
    }
  };

  const handleAddCustomTag = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const formatted = customTagInput.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (formatted && !tags.includes(formatted)) {
      setTags([...tags, formatted]);
    }
    setCustomTagInput('');
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setSuccessMsg(null);

    // Dynamic constraint validator
    if (!handle) {
      setError("Handle is required.");
      return;
    }
    if (handleAvailable === false) {
      setError("Handle is already registered by another citizen!");
      return;
    }
    if (!isEditing && (!email.trim() || password.length < 8)) {
      setError("Email and a password of at least 8 characters are required.");
      return;
    }
    if (!displayName) {
      setError("Display Name is required.");
      return;
    }

    // Cozy Diary Mode constraints: mandate literally every field
    if (oracleMode) {
      if (!bio) {
        setError("Cozy Diary Mode Requirement: Short bio cannot be empty.");
        return;
      }
      if (!location) {
        setError("Cozy Diary Mode requires a broad city or area.");
        return;
      }
      if (!xHandle.trim() && !telegramHandle.trim()) {
        setError("Cozy Diary Mode requires at least one contact handle (X or Telegram).");
        return;
      }
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    
    const payload = {
      avatarFile: avatarFile || undefined,
      photoUrl,
      handle: handle.toLowerCase().trim(),
      password,
      email,
      displayName,
      bio,
      location,
      tags,
      languages: languages.split(',').map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean),
      contactMethod,
      xHandle,
      telegramHandle,
      oracleMode
    };

    try {
      if (isEditing) {
        await updateProfile({
          displayName, photoUrl, avatarFile: avatarFile || undefined, bio, location, tags, contactMethod,
          xHandle, telegramHandle, oracleMode, languages: payload.languages,
        });
        setSuccessMsg("Your profile changes were saved.");
        if (onSuccess) setTimeout(() => onSuccess(), 900);
      } else {
        const created = await registerProfile(payload);
        if ('pendingVerification' in created) {
          const notice = `Account created. Check ${created.email} for a verification email, then sign in.`;
          setSuccessMsg(notice);
          onVerificationRequired?.(created.email, created.avatarUploadNote);
        } else {
          setSuccessMsg(`Welcome, ${created.displayName}! Your account is ready.${created.avatarUploadNote ? ` ${created.avatarUploadNote}` : ''}`);
          onSuccess?.();
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      const message = err?.message || "Failed to save profile details.";
      if (message.startsWith("Account created. Verify your email")) setSuccessMsg(message);
      else setError(message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-white/20 rounded-3xl p-6 w-full max-w-lg mx-auto text-left space-y-6 text-white select-none">
      
      {/* Dynamic Header */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-4 border-b border-white/10">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight italic flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-vibe-primary">🎒</span> 
            {isEditing ? "Edit Traveler Profile" : "Create Your Account"}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono tracking-wider mt-0.5">
            {isEditing ? "MODIFY YOUR TRAVELER COMPASS" : "JOIN THE COZY VIBE CIRCLE"}
          </p>
        </div>
        
        {onCancel && (
          <button 
            type="button"
            onClick={onCancel}
            className="text-xs font-mono border border-white/10 hover:border-white/30 text-zinc-400 px-3 py-1 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-5">
        
        {/* Alerts */}
        {error && (
          <div className="bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 p-3 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs text-red-400 animate-pulse">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {successMsg && (
          <div className="bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 p-3 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2.5 text-xs text-emerald-400">
            <Check className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <span>{successMsg}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 1. Live Avatar Preview & Hex Entry */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-5 bg-zinc-900/30 p-4 rounded-2xl border border-white/5">
          <div className="relative shrink-0">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-vibe-primary/5 blur-xl rounded-full" />
            <div className="relative w-20 h-20 rounded-full border border-white/20 p-1 bg-black flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
              {((avatarPreview && avatarPreview.trim()) || (photoUrl && photoUrl.trim())) ? (
                <img 
                  src={((avatarPreview && avatarPreview.trim()) || (photoUrl && photoUrl.trim())) as string} 
                  alt="Live Preview" 
                  referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                  className="w-full h-full rounded-full object-cover"
                  onError={(event) => {
                    event.currentTarget.style.display = 'none';
                  }}
                />
              ) : (
                <User className="w-8 h-8 text-zinc-600" />
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          
          <div className="space-y-1.5 w-full flex-1">
            <label className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-500 flex items-center gap-1">
              <Globe className="w-3 h-3 text-vibe-primary" /> Avatar Photo URL (Optional)
            </label>
            <input 
              type="text" 
              placeholder="https://images.unsplash.com/..." 
              value={photoUrl}
              onChange={(e) => setPhotoUrl(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full h-10 px-3.5 bg-zinc-950 border border-white/10 rounded-xl text-xs text-zinc-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-vibe-primary transition-colors font-mono"
            />
            <label className="block text-[10px] font-semibold text-vibe-primary cursor-pointer">
              Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP photo (up to 5 MB)
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
                className="mt-1 block w-full text-xs text-zinc-400 file:mr-2 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:bg-zinc-800 file:px-3 file:py-2 file:text-white"
                onChange={event => {
                  const file = event.target.files?.[0] || null;
                  if (file && (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type) || file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024)) {
                    setError('Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image under 5 MB.');
                    event.target.value = '';
                    return;
                  }
                  setAvatarFile(file);
                }}
              />
            </label>
            <span className="text-[8px] text-zinc-600 block">
              Or paste an image URL above. Uploaded signup photos are saved after email verification on this device.
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2. Credentials Form Group */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <label className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-500 flex items-center gap-1">
              {isCheckingHandle ? "⏳" : "@"} Unique username (@)
            </label>
            <input 
              type="text" 
              placeholder="e.g. yassine_medina" 
              value={handle}
              onChange={(e) => setHandle(e.target.value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g, ''))}
              required

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { signInWithEmail, UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';
import { AlertTriangle, Key, User, X } from 'lucide-react';

interface LoginModalProps {
  onSuccess?: (profile: UserProfile) => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
  onSwitchToRegister?: () => void;
}

export const ProfileLogin: React.FC<LoginModalProps> = ({ onSuccess, onCancel, onSwitchToRegister }) => {
  const [identifier, setIdentifier] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (!identifier.trim()) {
      setError("Enter your email address or @username.");
      return;
    }
    if (!password) {
      setError("Decryption password is required.");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const profile = await signInWithEmail(identifier, password);
      setLoading(false);
      onSuccess?.(profile);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setLoading(false);
      setError(err?.message || "Invalid handle or decryption seed.");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-zinc-950 border border-white/20 rounded-3xl p-6 w-full max-w-sm mx-auto text-left space-y-6 text-white relative select-none">
      
      {/* Top Header */}
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center pb-2.5 border-b border-white/10">
        <div>
          <h3 className="font-extrabold text-md uppercase tracking-tight italic flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="text-vibe-primary">🔑</span> Identify Citizen
          </h3>
          <p className="text-[9px] font-mono tracking-wider text-zinc-500 mt-0.5">
            SECURE ACCOUNT SIGN IN
          </p>
        </div>
        
        {onCancel && (
          <button 
            onClick={onCancel}
            className="text-zinc-500 hover:text-white p-1"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Connection Form */}
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        
        {error && (
          <div className="bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 p-3 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-red-400 animate-pulse font-mono">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <span className="leading-tight">{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Handle Input */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <label className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-500 flex items-center gap-1">
            <User className="w-3 h-3 text-vibe-primary" /> Email or @username
          </label>
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Email or @username"
            value={identifier}
            onChange={(e) => setIdentifier(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="w-full h-11 px-3.5 bg-zinc-950 border border-white/10 rounded-xl text-xs text-zinc-200 outline-none focus:border-vibe-primary font-mono transition-colors"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Password Input */}
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <label className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-zinc-500 flex items-center gap-1">
            <Key className="w-3 h-3 text-vibe-primary" /> Password
          </label>
          <input
            type="password"
            placeholder="••••••••"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            required
            className="w-full h-11 px-3.5 bg-zinc-950 border border-white/10 rounded-xl text-xs text-zinc-200 outline-none focus:border-vibe-primary font-mono transition-colors"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Submit */}
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={loading}
          className="w-full h-11 bg-white text-black hover:bg-zinc-200 disabled:bg-zinc-855 disabled:text-zinc-500 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-bold tracking-[0.1em] text-xs uppercase italic transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          {loading ? "Warming up your stove..." : "Sign Into VibeQuest"}
        </button>
      </form>

      {/* Switch options */}
      {onSwitchToRegister && (
        <div className="text-center pt-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono">
          <span>NEW TO THE CIRCLE? </span>
          <button 
            onClick={onSwitchToRegister}
            className="text-vibe-primary hover:underline uppercase font-bold"
          >
            Create Profile
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
};

}) => {

    accountType: user.accountType || 'vibe',

  const theme = themeMode === 'cream' ? 'light' : 'dark';

      if (active) setUnreadNotificationsCount(items.filter(n => !n.read).length);
    });
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [user?.id]);

  const triggerHaptic = (type: 'light' | 'medium' | 'heavy') => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
        const haptic = (window as any).Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback;
        if (haptic) {
          if (type === 'light') haptic.impactOccurred('light');
          else if (type === 'medium') haptic.impactOccurred('medium');

        }
      }

      console.warn('Haptic not available', e);
    }
  };

  return (

      {/* Black Translucent Soft Backdrop - Plain overlay with no blur */}

                <span className="block text-[11px] text-zinc-500 uppercase font-bold tracking-wide">{t('profile.travelerClass')}</span>

                          <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 font-mono">({lang.native})</span>
                        </div>
                        {isSelected && (
                          <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-purple-500" />
                        )}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}

              )}

            {user && isPlatformAdmin && <>
          {/* Platform Admin Console Dashboard (Highlighted) */}
            <button

              className="w-full hover:bg-zinc-900 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between transition-colors text-left cursor-pointer border border-vibe-primary/30 bg-vibe-primary/5 shadow-md"

                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-vibe-primary" />

              </div>
              <span className="bg-vibe-primary text-white text-[9px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider">
                System
              </span>

              {/* Secondary text EXACTLY 14px */}

            </button>

          </div>

            className="btn-3d-danger text-[16px] font-medium w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-11"
          >

                onVerificationRequired={(email, avatarUploadNote) => {
                  setVerificationNotice({ email, avatarUploadNote }); setAuthPanel(null);
                }}
              />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { X, Sparkles, Coins, ArrowUpRight, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, ShoppingCart } from 'lucide-react';
import { VibePlace } from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit';
import { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';
import { fetchVqAccount } from '../domains/d06_purse';
import { createOrFundPromotion, PlacePromotion } from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit/promotions';

interface PromoteBusinessModalProps {
  place: VibePlace;
  user?: UserProfile | null;
  isOpen?: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (promotion: PlacePromotion) => void;
  onRequireAuth?: () => void;
  onOpenBuyVq?: () => void;
}

const POOL_PRESETS = [500, 1000, 2500, 5000];
const REWARD_PRESETS = [50, 100, 250, 500];

export const PromoteBusinessModal: React.FC<PromoteBusinessModalProps> = ({
  place,
  user = null,
  isOpen = true,
  onClose,
  onSuccess,
  onRequireAuth,
  onOpenBuyVq
}) => {
  const [totalPool, setTotalPool] = useState<number>(1000);
  const [rewardPerCheckin, setRewardPerCheckin] = useState<number>(100);
  const [userBalance, setUserBalance] = useState<number>(user?.vq_balance ?? 1000);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen && user?.id) {
      fetchVqAccount(user.id).then(acct => {
        if (acct) {
          setUserBalance(Number(acct.available_balance));
        }
      });
    }
  }, [isOpen, user?.id]);

  const hasInsufficientBalance = userBalance < totalPool;
  const estimatedCheckins = Math.floor(totalPool / (rewardPerCheckin || 1));

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg(null);

    if (!user) {
      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
      return;
    }

    if (totalPool <= 0 || rewardPerCheckin <= 0) {
      setErrorMsg('Please enter a valid pool amount and check-in reward.');
      return;
    }

    if (rewardPerCheckin > totalPool) {
      setErrorMsg('Check-in reward cannot be larger than the total funded pool.');
      return;
    }

    if (hasInsufficientBalance) {
      setErrorMsg(`Your purse only has ${userBalance} VQ. Please buy more VQ tokens or fund a smaller pool.`);
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    const result = await createOrFundPromotion({
      placeId: place.id,
      placeTitle: place.title,
      sponsorUserId: user.id,
      totalVqFunded: totalPool,
      rewardPerCheckin
    });

    setSubmitting(false);
    if (!result.success || !result.promotion) {
      setErrorMsg(result.error || 'Failed to fund business promotion.');
      return;
    }

    onSuccess(result.promotion);
  };

  if (isOpen === false) return null;

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label={`Promote ${place.title}`}
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 animate-fadeIn overflow-y-auto"
    >
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-amber-500/50 rounded-[28px] overflow-hidden shadow-2xl text-white my-auto flex flex-col max-h-[92vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-5 border-b border-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-950/40 via-neutral-900 to-neutral-900">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/40">
              <Sparkles className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-black tracking-wider uppercase text-amber-400">
                Community Sponsorship
              </span>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black text-white leading-tight">
                Promote Spot Check-ins
              </h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close promote modal"
            className="p-1.5 rounded-full bg-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 sm:p-6 space-y-5 overflow-y-auto">
          {/* Target Spot Banner */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 p-3.5 space-y-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-neutral-400">Target Venue</span>
            <div className="text-sm font-black text-white truncate">{place.title}</div>
            <div className="text-xs text-neutral-400 truncate">{place.address}</div>
          </div>

          {/* User Purse Status Bar */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-500/30 p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
              <Coins className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
              <span className="text-xs text-neutral-300">Your VQ Purse Balance:</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-right">
              <span className="text-sm font-black text-amber-300 font-mono">
                {userBalance.toLocaleString()} VQ
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {hasInsufficientBalance && (
            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-rose-200">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
                <span>Need {totalPool - userBalance} more VQ to fund this pool.</span>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  onClose();
                  if (onOpenBuyVq) onOpenBuyVq();
                }}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-neutral-950 font-black text-xs transition cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ml-2 flex items-center space-x-1"
              >
                <ShoppingCart className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>Buy VQ</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {errorMsg && (
            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-rose-950/60 border border-rose-500/50 p-3 text-xs text-rose-300 flex items-center space-x-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
              <span>{errorMsg}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 1. Total Pool Selection */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-neutral-300">
              1. Total VQ Pool to Allocate
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
              {POOL_PRESETS.map(preset => (
                <button
                  key={preset}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setTotalPool(preset)}
                  className={`py-2 px-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition border cursor-pointer ${
                    totalPool === preset
                      ? 'bg-amber-500 text-neutral-950 border-amber-400 shadow-md'
                      : 'bg-neutral-950 text-neutral-300 border-neutral-800 hover:border-neutral-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  {preset} VQ
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <input
              type="number"
              min={100}
              step={50}
              value={totalPool}
              onChange={e => setTotalPool(Number(e.target.value) || 0)}
              className="w-full mt-1 bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-mono text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
              placeholder="Or enter custom VQ amount"
            />
          </div>

          {/* 2. Reward per Check-in Selection */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-neutral-300">
              2. Reward per User Check-in
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
              {REWARD_PRESETS.map(preset => (
                <button
                  key={preset}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setRewardPerCheckin(preset)}
                  className={`py-2 px-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition border cursor-pointer ${
                    rewardPerCheckin === preset
                      ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-neutral-950 border-emerald-400 shadow-md'
                      : 'bg-neutral-950 text-neutral-300 border-neutral-800 hover:border-neutral-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  +{preset} PTS
                </button>
              ))}

            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Sponsoring Rules Callout */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950 p-3.5 border border-neutral-800 space-y-1 text-xs text-neutral-400">
            <div className="font-bold text-neutral-300">Open Sponsorship Protocol:</div>
            <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
              Any VibeQuest user (Pro, Business, or Normal Explorer) can sponsor any place. Check-in rewards are automatically disbursed to users when they verify physical arrival.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Submit Action */}
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting || hasInsufficientBalance}
            className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-orange-500 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-orange-400 text-neutral-950 font-black text-sm text-center shadow-lg transition active:scale-98 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed flex items-center justify-center space-x-2"
          >
            {submitting ? (
              <span>Allocating VQ Pool...</span>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Fund Pool with {totalPool.toLocaleString()} VQ</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { X, MessageSquare, Settings, ShieldCheck, Send, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';
import { fetchAllUserDirectMessages, sendDirectMessage, DirectMessage } from '../domains/d14_messaging';

interface PulseDmModalProps {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const PulseDmModal: React.FC<PulseDmModalProps> = ({ user, onClose }) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'feed' | 'privacy'>('feed');
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<DirectMessage[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selectedRecipient, setSelectedRecipient] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [replyContent, setReplyContent] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);

  const userId = user?.id || 'guest';

  const loadMessages = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const items = await fetchAllUserDirectMessages(userId);
      setMessages(items);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to load DMs:', e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadMessages();
  }, [userId]);

  const handleSend = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!replyContent.trim() || !selectedRecipient) return;
    setSending(true);
    try {
      await sendDirectMessage(userId, selectedRecipient, replyContent.trim());
      setReplyContent('');
      await loadMessages();
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Failed to send DM:', err);
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const formatTime = (isoString: string) => {
    try {
      const d = new Date(isoString);
      return d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    } catch {
      return '01:07 PM';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm select-none font-sans">
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 15 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95, y: 15 }}
        className="w-full max-w-[440px] bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-[28px] shadow-[0_0_60px_rgba(0,0,0,0.95)] flex flex-col overflow-hidden max-h-[85vh]"
      >
        {/* Header matching exact reference */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 pt-6 pb-4 border-b border-zinc-900">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-purple-600/20 border border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-purple-400">
              <MessageSquare className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-[18px] font-extrabold text-white tracking-wide italic font-mono uppercase">
                PULSE DMS
              </h2>
              <p className="text-[12px] text-zinc-400 font-medium">
                Cozy Direct Messages
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 flex items-center justify-center text-zinc-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer border border-zinc-800"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Switchers matching reference image */}
        <div className="px-6 py-3.5 border-b border-zinc-900 bg-zinc-950/80">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 p-1 bg-zinc-900/90 rounded-2xl border border-white/5">
            <button
              onClick={() => { setActiveTab('feed'); setSelectedRecipient(null); }}
              className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'feed'
                  ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg'
                  : 'text-zinc-400 hover:text-white'

            >
              <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />
              Direct Feed

                activeTab === 'privacy'
                  ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-indigo-600 text-white shadow-lg'

            >
              <Settings className="w-4 h-4" />
              Privacy Rules
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}

                <span className="text-xs font-mono text-zinc-400">@{selectedRecipient}</span>
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1 space-y-2 overflow-y-auto max-h-[220px] pr-1">
                {messages
                  .filter(m => m.sender_id === selectedRecipient || m.recipient_id === selectedRecipient)
                  .map(m => {
                    const isMe = m.sender_id === userId;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={m.id}
                        className={`flex flex-col ${isMe ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'}`}
                      >
                        <div
                          className={`max-w-[85%] rounded-2xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs leading-relaxed ${
                            isMe
                              ? 'bg-purple-600 text-white rounded-br-sm'
                              : 'bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-200 rounded-bl-sm'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {m.content}
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-500 font-mono mt-1 px-1">
                          {formatTime(m.created_at)}

                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
              </div>

              <form onSubmit={handleSend} className="flex gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-zinc-900">

                  value={replyContent}
                  onChange={(e) => setReplyContent(e.target.value)}

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={sending || !replyContent.trim()}
                  className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 disabled:opacity-50 text-white px-4 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center transition-colors cursor-pointer"

          ) : loading ? (

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Wallet, Coins, ArrowUpRight, ArrowDownLeft, Shield, Sparkles, TrendingUp, CheckCircle2, Send, QrCode, PlusCircle, X, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { fetchUserTransactions, fetchVqAccount, executeVqTransfer, lookupUserByHandle, VQTransaction } from '../domains/d06_purse';
import { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';

interface PurseTabProps {
  user: UserProfile | null;
}

export const PurseTab: React.FC<PurseTabProps> = ({ user }) => {
  const [transactions, setTransactions] = useState<VQTransaction[]>([]);
  const [accountBalance, setAccountBalance] = useState<number>(user?.vq_balance ?? 1000);
  const [lockedBalance, setLockedBalance] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isProvisioned, setIsProvisioned] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [historyError, setHistoryError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // Modal states for Send, Receive, Buy VQ
  const [isSendOpen, setIsSendOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isReceiveOpen, setIsReceiveOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isBuyOpen, setIsBuyOpen] = useState(false);

  // Send form state
  const [recipientHandle, setRecipientHandle] = useState('');
  const [sendAmount, setSendAmount] = useState('');
  const [sendMsg, setSendMsg] = useState('');
  const [transferLoading, setTransferLoading] = useState(false);
  const [transferError, setTransferError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [toastMsg, setToastMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMsg(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToastMsg(null), 3000);
  };

  const loadWalletData = async () => {
    if (!user) {
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }
    setHistoryError(null);

    const acct = await fetchVqAccount(user.id);
    if (acct) {
      setAccountBalance(Number(acct.available_balance));
      setLockedBalance(Number(acct.locked_balance));
      setIsProvisioned(true);
    } else {
      setAccountBalance(user?.vq_balance ?? 1000);
      setLockedBalance(0);
      setIsProvisioned(true);
    }

    const res = await fetchUserTransactions(user.id);
    setTransactions(res.transactions);
    setHistoryError(res.error);
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadWalletData();
  }, [user?.id]);

  const handleSendSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setTransferError(null);
    const amt = Number(sendAmount);
    if (!recipientHandle.trim() || isNaN(amt) || amt <= 0) {
      setTransferError('Please enter a valid recipient handle and amount.');
      return;
    }

    setTransferLoading(true);
    const recipient = await lookupUserByHandle(recipientHandle);
    if (!recipient) {
      setTransferError(`Recipient @${recipientHandle.replace(/^@/, '')} not found in Supabase profiles.`);
      setTransferLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    if (recipient.id === user?.id) {
      setTransferError('You cannot transfer VQ tokens to yourself.');
      setTransferLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    const result = await executeVqTransfer({
      toUserId: recipient.id,
      amount: amt,
      type: 'transfer',
      description: sendMsg ? `Transfer to @${recipient.username}: ${sendMsg}` : `Transfer to @${recipient.username}`
    });

    setTransferLoading(false);

    if (!result.success) {
      setTransferError(result.error || 'Transfer failed.');
      return;
    }

    showToast(`Successfully transferred ${amt} VQ to @${recipient.username}!`);
    setIsSendOpen(false);
    setRecipientHandle('');
    setSendAmount('');
    setSendMsg('');
    await loadWalletData();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-24 text-white max-w-md mx-auto box-border overflow-x-hidden relative">
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {toastMsg && (
        <div className="fixed top-16 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-teal-500 text-neutral-950 font-bold text-xs shadow-2xl flex items-center space-x-2 animate-fadeIn border border-teal-300">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>{toastMsg}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Wallet Balance Card */}
      <div className="relative rounded-3xl overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-neutral-900 via-neutral-900 to-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 p-6 shadow-2xl">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-48 h-48 bg-amber-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
        
        <div className="relative z-10 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-400 font-bold flex items-center space-x-1.5">
              <Coins className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
              <span>VQ Genesis Wallet</span>
            </span>
            <span className={`text-[10px] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border font-semibold ${
              isProvisioned ? 'bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-300 border-teal-500/30' : 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-300 border-red-500/30'
            }`}>
              {isProvisioned ? 'Supabase Verified' : 'Wallet Not Provisioned'}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div>
            <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400">Total VQ Token Balance</p>
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-black tracking-tight text-amber-300 mt-1">
              {accountBalance} <span className="text-lg font-normal text-neutral-400">VQ</span>
            </h1>
            {!isProvisioned && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-red-400 mt-1">No vq_accounts record found for this user account. Signup reward provisioning required.</p>
            )}
            {lockedBalance > 0 && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-1">Locked (Staked/Pending): {lockedBalance} VQ</p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-2">
            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950/60 border border-neutral-800 p-3">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">Signup Reward</span>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-teal-400 mt-0.5">1,000 VQ</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950/60 border border-neutral-800 p-3">
              <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">Network Tier</span>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-orange-400 mt-0.5 uppercase">{user?.role ?? 'GUEST'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Quick Action Row (Phantom-like wallet actions) */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (!user) { showToast('Please sign in to send VQ.'); return; }
            setIsSendOpen(true);
          }}
          className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 hover:border-teal-500/50 p-3.5 text-center flex flex-col items-center space-y-1.5 transition cursor-pointer group shadow-lg"
        >
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-400 border border-teal-500/30 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-105 transition">
            <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-xs text-white">Send</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (!user) { showToast('Please sign in to view receive address.'); return; }
            setIsReceiveOpen(true);
          }}
          className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 hover:border-purple-500/50 p-3.5 text-center flex flex-col items-center space-y-1.5 transition cursor-pointer group shadow-lg"
        >
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-105 transition">
            <QrCode className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-xs text-white">Receive</span>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setIsBuyOpen(true)}
          className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 hover:border-amber-500/50 p-3.5 text-center flex flex-col items-center space-y-1.5 transition cursor-pointer group shadow-lg"
        >
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center group-hover:scale-105 transition">
            <PlusCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
          </div>
          <span className="font-bold text-xs text-white">Buy VQ</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Staking Banner (Truthful unavailable state without authorized backend) */}
      <div className="rounded-3xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-5 space-y-3 shadow-xl">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-sm flex items-center space-x-2">
            <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-teal-400" />
            <span>District Staking Pools</span>
          </h3>
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-neutral-500">Backend Pending</span>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400">
          Staking contract execution requires deployed Supabase D06 staking RPC functions.
        </p>
        <button
          disabled
          className="w-full py-3 rounded-2xl font-bold text-xs bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-500 border border-neutral-700 cursor-not-allowed"
        >
          Staking Unavailable (Backend Pending)
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Transactions History Visual Ledger */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold flex items-center space-x-2">
            <Wallet className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400" />
            <span>Transaction Ledger</span>
          </h3>
          <button
            onClick={() => loadWalletData()}
            className="text-xs text-teal-400 font-semibold hover:underline cursor-pointer"
          >
            Refresh
          </button>
        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800 p-6 text-center text-xs text-neutral-400">
            Loading ledger from Supabase...
          </div>
        ) : historyError ? (
          <div role="alert" className="rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 p-6 text-center space-y-2">
            <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-amber-300">Transaction ledger notice</h4>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-300">{historyError}</p>
          </div>
        ) : transactions.length > 0 ? (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {transactions.map((tx) => {
              const isCredit = tx.to_user_id === user?.id || tx.amount > 0;
              return (
                <div key={tx.id} className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                    <div className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center ${
                      isCredit ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30' : 'bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/30'
                    }`}>
                      {isCredit ? <ArrowDownLeft className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ArrowUpRight className="w-4 h-4" />}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-white">{tx.description || `${tx.type} transaction`}</h4>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">{new Date(tx.created_at).toLocaleString()}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <span className={`font-black text-sm ${isCredit ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-amber-400'}`}>
                    {isCredit ? `+${tx.amount}` : `-${tx.amount}`} VQ
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800/80 p-6 text-center space-y-2">

              >

              </button>
            </div>

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Camera, Zap, Clock3, Video, X, RefreshCw, Share2, SwitchCamera, Circle, Square, AlertCircle, ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import type { UserProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';
import { createVibePost, VibePostItem } from '../domains/d05_vibe';
import { uploadDriftMedia } from '../domains/d15_drift';

type Mode = 'shot' | 'check' | 'flash' | 'snap' | 'dual';
type Stage = 'camera' | 'selfie' | 'review' | 'details';
type Mood = 'heart' | 'spark' | 'moments';

interface ShareTabProps {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  onPostSuccess: () => void;
  initialMode?: 'dual';
  cameraOnly?: boolean;
  onClose?: () => void;
}

const categories: { id: Mood; emoji: string; label: string; description: string }[] = [
  { id: 'heart', emoji: '💖', label: 'PURE HEART', description: 'Love and appreciation' },
  { id: 'spark', emoji: '🤗', label: 'FRIENDLY SPARK', description: 'Kindness and connection' },
  { id: 'moments', emoji: '🧘', label: 'SHARED MOMENTS', description: 'Help and shared experiences' },
];
const names: Record<Mode, string> = { shot: 'Live Vibe Shot', check: 'VibeCheck', flash: 'VibeFlash', snap: 'Vibe Snap', dual: 'Vibe Share' };

/** Share capture shell. Does not impersonate a D18 challenge or claim D12 publication. */
export const ShareTab: React.FC<ShareTabProps> = ({ user, onPostSuccess, initialMode, cameraOnly = false, onClose }) => {
  const [publishing, setPublishing] = useState(false);

  const handleShareInApp = async () => {
    if (!capture || !mode) return;
    setPublishing(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const extension = mode === 'snap' ? (capture.type.includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm') : 'jpg';
      const file = new File([capture], 'vibequest-' + mode + '-' + Date.now() + '.' + extension, { type: capture.type });
      
      const uploadRes = await uploadDriftMedia(file, mode === 'snap' ? 'voice' : 'photo');
      if (!uploadRes.success || !uploadRes.url) {
        throw new Error(uploadRes.error || 'Media upload to storage failed. Cannot publish post without permanent media.');
      }
      const mediaUrl = uploadRes.url;

      const moodText = categories.find(item => item.id === category)?.label;
      const finalCaption = [caption.trim(), moodText].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || 'Captured moment via VibeShare.';

      const newPost: VibePostItem = {
        id: 'post_' + Date.now(),
        user_id: user?.id || 'anon_explorer',
        username: user?.username || 'explorer',
        avatar_url: user?.avatar_url || '',
        caption: finalCaption,
        image_url: mediaUrl,
        selfie_url: user?.avatar_url || undefined,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        reactions_count: 0,
        comments_count: 0
      };

      const success = await createVibePost(newPost);
      if (!success) {
        throw new Error('Backend confirmation failed for vibe post publication.');
      }

      setPublishing(false);
      onPostSuccess();
    } catch (cause: any) {
      setPublishing(false);
      setError(cause?.message || 'Failed to publish to Gossip in-app feed.');
    }
  };
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode | null>(initialMode ?? null);
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>('camera');
  const [facing, setFacing] = useState<'environment' | 'user'>('environment');
  const [dualEnabled, setDualEnabled] = useState(initialMode === 'dual');
  const dualCapture = mode === 'flash' || ((mode === 'dual' || mode === 'shot' || mode === 'check') && dualEnabled);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [capture, setCapture] = useState<Blob | null>(null);
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [seconds, setSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [caption, setCaption] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<Mood | null>(null);
  const liveVideo = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const liveStream = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const recorder = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const recordedChunks = useRef<Blob[]>([]);
  const dualScene = useRef<Blob | null>(null);
  const currentUrl = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const recordingTimeout = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const recordingInterval = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const session = useRef(0);

  const clearTimers = () => {
    if (recordingTimeout.current) clearTimeout(recordingTimeout.current);
    if (recordingInterval.current) clearInterval(recordingInterval.current);
    recordingTimeout.current = null;
    recordingInterval.current = null;
  };
  const stopStream = () => {
    liveStream.current?.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
    liveStream.current = null;
    if (liveVideo.current) liveVideo.current.srcObject = null;
    setReady(false);
  };
  const discardCapture = () => {
    if (currentUrl.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(currentUrl.current);
    currentUrl.current = null;
    setPreview(null);
    setCapture(null);
  };
  const cancelRecording = () => {
    clearTimers();
    const active = recorder.current;
    recorder.current = null;
    if (active && active.state !== 'inactive') active.stop();
    setRecording(false);
  };
  const resetCamera = () => {
    session.current += 1;
    cancelRecording();
    stopStream();
    discardCapture();
    dualScene.current = null;
    setError(null);
    setStage('camera');
    setCaption('');
  };
  const closeCamera = () => {
    resetCamera();
    setMode(null);
    onClose?.();
  };
  const openCamera = (next: Mode) => {
    resetCamera();
    setFacing('environment');
    setDualEnabled(next === 'flash' || next === 'dual');
    setSeconds(0);
    setMode(next);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mode || stage === 'review' || stage === 'details') return;
    let cancelled = false;
    const ticket = session.current;
    setReady(false);
    setError(null);
    async function start() {
      if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
        setError('This browser cannot open a camera. Use a supported browser over HTTPS.');
        return;
      }
      try {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          video: { facingMode: dualCapture ? { exact: facing } : { ideal: facing } },
          audio: false,
        });
        if (cancelled || ticket !== session.current) {
          stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
          return;
        }
        liveStream.current = stream;
        const video = liveVideo.current;
        const track = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];
        if (!video || !track || track.readyState !== 'live') {
          throw new Error('The camera did not provide a live video track.');
        }
        const actualFacing = track.getSettings().facingMode;
        if (dualCapture && actualFacing && actualFacing !== facing) {
          throw new Error('The requested ' + (facing === 'user' ? 'front' : 'back') + ' camera is not active.');
        }
        video.srcObject = stream;
        await video.play();
        if (video.readyState < HTMLMediaElement.HAVE_CURRENT_DATA || !video.videoWidth || !video.videoHeight) {
          await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
            const cleanup = () => {
              video.removeEventListener('loadeddata', checkFrame);
              video.removeEventListener('error', failed);
              clearTimeout(timeout);
            };
            const checkFrame = () => {
              if (video.readyState >= HTMLMediaElement.HAVE_CURRENT_DATA && video.videoWidth && video.videoHeight) {
                cleanup();
                resolve();
              }
            };
            const failed = () => { cleanup(); reject(new Error('Camera preview failed to load.')); };
            const timeout = setTimeout(() => { cleanup(); reject(new Error('Camera preview did not become ready.')); }, 8000);
            video.addEventListener('loadeddata', checkFrame);
            video.addEventListener('error', failed);
            checkFrame();
          });
        }
        if (cancelled || ticket !== session.current) {
          stream.getTracks().forEach(activeTrack => activeTrack.stop());
          return;
        }
        if (track.readyState !== 'live') throw new Error('Camera disconnected before capture.');
        setReady(true);
      } catch (cause) {
        if (cancelled || ticket !== session.current) return;
        liveStream.current?.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
        liveStream.current = null;
        if (liveVideo.current) liveVideo.current.srcObject = null;
        setReady(false);
        setError(cause instanceof Error ? 'Camera unavailable: ' + cause.message : 'Camera permission denied or no camera available.');
      }
    }
    void start();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      liveStream.current?.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
      liveStream.current = null;
    };
  }, [mode, stage, facing, dualCapture]);

  useEffect(() => () => {
    session.current += 1;
    clearTimers();
    const active = recorder.current;
    if (active && active.state !== 'inactive') active.stop();
    liveStream.current?.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
    if (currentUrl.current) URL.revokeObjectURL(currentUrl.current);
  }, []);

  const showCapture = (file: Blob) => {
    if (!file.size) {
      setError('Capture produced an empty file. Please try again.');
      return;
    }
    discardCapture();
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    currentUrl.current = url;
    setPreview(url);
    setCapture(file);
    setStage('review');
    stopStream();
  };

  const takePhoto = async () => {
    const video = liveVideo.current;
    const track = liveStream.current?.getVideoTracks()[0];
    const actualFacing = track?.getSettings().facingMode;
    if (!ready || !video?.videoWidth || !video.videoHeight ||
        video.readyState < HTMLMediaElement.HAVE_CURRENT_DATA ||
        !track || track.readyState !== 'live' ||
        (dualCapture && actualFacing && actualFacing !== facing)) {
      setError('Wait for the correct live camera image before taking a photo.');
      return;
    }
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) { setError('Photo capture is unavailable.'); return; }
    if (facing === 'user') { ctx.translate(canvas.width, 0); ctx.scale(-1, 1); }
    ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    const ticket = session.current;
    const file = await new Promise<Blob | null>(resolve => canvas.toBlob(resolve, 'image/jpeg', 0.9));
    if (ticket !== session.current) return;
    if (!file?.size) { setError('Camera could not capture the photo.'); return; }
    if (dualCapture && stage === 'camera') {
      dualScene.current = file;
      setReady(false);
      setFacing('user');
      setStage('selfie');
      return;
    }
    if (dualCapture && stage === 'selfie') {
      if (!dualScene.current) { setError('Scene photo missing; please retake.'); return; }
      try {
        const [scene, selfie] = await Promise.all([createImageBitmap(dualScene.current), createImageBitmap(file)]);
        if (ticket !== session.current) { scene.close(); selfie.close(); return; }
        const combined = document.createElement('canvas');
        combined.width = scene.width;
        combined.height = scene.height;
        const ctx2 = combined.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx2) throw new Error('Cannot combine photos.');
        ctx2.drawImage(scene, 0, 0, combined.width, combined.height);
        const width = Math.round(combined.width * 0.27);
        const height = Math.round(width * 4 / 3);
        const x = Math.round(combined.width * 0.04), y = Math.round(combined.height * 0.04);
        ctx2.fillStyle = '#f97316';
        ctx2.fillRect(x - 4, y - 4, width + 8, height + 8);
        ctx2.drawImage(selfie, x, y, width, height);
        scene.close();
        selfie.close();
        const composite = await new Promise<Blob | null>(resolve => combined.toBlob(resolve, 'image/jpeg', 0.9));
        if (ticket !== session.current) return;
        if (!composite?.size) throw new Error('Cannot encode dual-camera image.');
        showCapture(composite);
      } catch (cause) {
        setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'Dual-camera capture failed.');
      }
      return;
    }
    showCapture(file);
  };

  const stopRecording = () => {
    clearTimers();
    if (recorder.current?.state === 'recording') recorder.current.stop();
    setRecording(false);
  };
  const startRecording = () => {
    const stream = liveStream.current;
    if (!ready || !stream?.getVideoTracks().some(track => track.readyState === 'live')) {
      setError('Wait for the camera to be ready before recording.');
      return;
    }
    if (typeof MediaRecorder === 'undefined') {
      setError('This browser does not support video recording.');
      return;

        clearTimers();
        setRecording(false);
      };
      active.onstop = () => {
        if (ticket !== session.current) return;
        clearTimers();
        setRecording(false);
        showCapture(new Blob(recordedChunks.current, { type: active.mimeType || format }));

      setSeconds(0);
      setRecording(true);

      recordingInterval.current = setInterval(() => setSeconds(Math.min(10, Math.floor((Date.now() - started) / 1000))), 200);
      recordingTimeout.current = setTimeout(stopRecording, 10000);
    } catch (cause) {
      setError(cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : 'Unable to start recording.');
    }
  };

    session.current += 1;
    discardCapture();
    dualScene.current = null;
    setFacing('environment');
    setError(null);
    setSeconds(0);
    setStage('camera');

  const shareOrSave = async () => {
    if (!capture || !mode) return;
    const extension = mode === 'snap' ? (capture.type.includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : 'webm') : 'jpg';
    const file = new File([capture], 'vibequest-' + mode + '-' + Date.now() + '.' + extension, { type: capture.type });
    const moodText = categories.find(item => item.id === category)?.label;
    const message = [caption.trim(), moodText].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    if (navigator.share && navigator.canShare?.({ files: [file] })) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'VibeQuest', text: message });
        return;
      } catch (cause) {
        if ((cause as Error)?.name === 'AbortError') return;
      }
    }
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = file.name;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="pb-24 text-white" data-testid="share-good-vibes">
      {!cameraOnly && <section className="rounded-[24px] border border-neutral-700/70 bg-[#101011] px-3 py-5 sm:px-5 shadow-[0_18px_65px_rgba(0,0,0,.45)]">
        <header className="text-center">
          <h1 className="relative inline-block whitespace-nowrap text-[clamp(1.3rem,6.5vw,2.2rem)] font-black italic leading-tight tracking-[-.055em]">
            <span className="text-white">Share Good </span>
            <span className="relative text-orange-400">Vibes<span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute -bottom-1 left-1 right-0 h-[4px] -rotate-3 rounded-full bg-orange-400" /></span>
          </h1>
          <p className="mx-auto mt-3 max-w-[34rem] text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-neutral-300">
            Share the moment. Feel the city together. Right now.
            <span className="block">Warm, authentic human presence recorded in physical proximity.</span>
          </p>
        </header>

          <button type="button" onClick={() => openCamera('shot')} className="min-h-[128px] min-w-0 rounded-[18px] border border-neutral-700 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#19191a] to-[#131314] p-2 text-left hover:border-pink-500/70 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-pink-400">

            <span className="mt-2 block text-[10px] leading-snug text-neutral-300">Camera only — no uploads</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => openCamera('check')} className="min-h-[128px] min-w-0 rounded-[18px] border border-neutral-700 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#19191a] to-[#131314] p-2 text-left hover:border-violet-500/70 focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-violet-400">
            <span className="mb-3 flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400"><Zap size={19} /></span>

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import { SuggestionCategory } from '../domains/d11_events';

interface SuggestVibeModalProps {
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmit: (value: { title: string; description: string; category: SuggestionCategory }) => Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }>;
  onSubmitted: () => void;
}

export const SuggestVibeModal: React.FC<SuggestVibeModalProps> = ({ onClose, onSubmit, onSubmitted }) => {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<SuggestionCategory>('place');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (sending) return;
    setSending(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const result = await onSubmit({ title, description, category });
      if (result.success) onSubmitted();
      else setError(result.error || 'Could not submit your suggestion.');
    } catch {
      setError('Could not submit your suggestion.');
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm" role="presentation">
      <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="suggest-vibe-title"
        className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-4 rounded-3xl border border-fuchsia-500/60 bg-[#1c1923] p-5 text-white shadow-2xl">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <h2 id="suggest-vibe-title" className="text-xl font-black">Suggest a Vibe</h2>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close Suggest Vibe" className="rounded-xl p-2 hover:bg-white/10">
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300">Suggest a genuine place, upcoming event or vibe. Submissions require review; they are not published automatically.</p>
        <form onSubmit={event => { void submit(event); }} className="space-y-3">
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-neutral-200">
            Category
            <select value={category} onChange={event => setCategory(event.target.value as SuggestionCategory)}
              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-950 p-3 text-sm text-white">
              <option value="place">Place</option>
              <option value="event">Event</option>
              <option value="vibe">Vibe</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-neutral-200">
            Title
            <input type="text" value={title} minLength={3} maxLength={120} required
              onChange={event => setTitle(event.target.value)}
              className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-950 p-3 text-sm text-white"
              placeholder="Name of the place, event or vibe" />
          </label>
          <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-neutral-200">
            Details
            <textarea value={description} minLength={10} maxLength={1000} required rows={4}
              onChange={event => setDescription(event.target.value)}
              className="mt-1 w-full resize-y rounded-xl border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-950 p-3 text-sm text-white"
              placeholder="What makes it worth exploring?" />
          </label>
          {error && <p role="alert" className="text-xs text-red-300">{error}</p>}
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button type="button" onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-neutral-700 p-3 text-xs font-bold">Cancel</button>
            <button type="submit" disabled={sending} className="flex-1 rounded-xl bg-white p-3 text-xs font-black text-neutral-950 disabled:opacity-50">
              {sending ? 'Submitting...' : 'Submit for review'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { X, Calendar, Clock, Users, Send, Shield, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import type { CommunityTrail } from '../domains/d07_trails';
import { requestTourReservation } from '../domains/d08_tours';

interface TourReservationModalProps {
  tour: CommunityTrail;
  onClose: () => void;
  onRequireAuth: () => void;
  onToast: (message: string) => void;
}
export const TourReservationModal: React.FC<TourReservationModalProps> = ({tour,onClose,onRequireAuth,onToast}) => {
  const [date,setDate] = useState('');
  const [time,setTime] = useState('');
  const [partySize,setPartySize] = useState(2);
  const [note,setNote] = useState('');
  const [submitting,setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [requestId,setRequestId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error,setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (submitting) return;
    setSubmitting(true);setError(null);
    try {
      const result = await requestTourReservation({tourId:tour.id,date,time,partySize,note});
      setRequestId(result.id);
      onToast('Tour reservation request saved as pending.');
    } catch (failure) {
      const message = failure instanceof Error ? failure.message : 'Reservation request failed.';
      setError(message);
      if (message.includes('Sign in')) onRequireAuth();
    } finally {setSubmitting(false);}
  };
  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto">
        <motion.div initial={{opacity:0,scale:0.95,y:15}} animate={{opacity:1,scale:1,y:0}}
          exit={{opacity:0,scale:0.95,y:15}} className="bg-[#110F15] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden text-left shadow-2xl">
          <header className="bg-[#17141E] border-b border-white/10 p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div><h3 className="font-extrabold text-white text-sm">Request a Vibe Tour</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 truncate max-w-[260px]">{tour.title}</p></div>
            <button aria-label="Close reservation" onClick={onClose} className="text-zinc-300 p-2 rounded-full bg-white/5"><X className="w-4 h-4"/></button>
          </header>
          {requestId ? <div className="p-6 text-center space-y-3">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-400 mx-auto"/>
            <h4 className="font-bold text-white">Request saved — awaiting response</h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400">This is pending, not an accepted booking or Handshake.</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 font-mono break-all">{requestId}</p>
          </div> : <form onSubmit={submit} className="p-5 space-y-4">
            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-purple-950/20 border border-purple-500/20 text-xs text-zinc-300 flex gap-2"><Shield className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0"/>Choose a real date and time to request this Tour. The guide must confirm separately.</div>
            <label className="text-xs text-zinc-300 block"><Calendar className="w-4 h-4 inline mr-2"/>Date
              <input aria-label="Tour date" required type="date" value={date} onChange={e=>setDate(e.target.value)}
              className="mt-1 block w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2 text-white"/></label>
            <label className="text-xs text-zinc-300 block"><Clock className="w-4 h-4 inline mr-2"/>Time
              <input aria-label="Tour time" required type="time" value={time} onChange={e=>setTime(e.target.value)}
              className="mt-1 block w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2 text-white"/></label>

              <input aria-label="Party size" required type="number" min={1} max={30} value={partySize}

              className="mt-1 block w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2 text-white"/></label>
            <label className="text-xs text-zinc-300 block">Note to guide
              <textarea aria-label="Reservation note" maxLength={2000} value={note} onChange={e=>setNote(e.target.value)}
              className="mt-1 block w-full bg-zinc-900 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2 text-white" rows={3}/></label>
