import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  X, Clock, Route, GitFork, Download, Heart, Footprints, Car, Bus, Map,
  ChevronDown, ChevronRight, CheckCircle2, Sparkles, MapPin, Compass
} from 'lucide-react';
import { CommunityTrail, TrailStop, buildTrailRoutePlan, TrailTravelMode, TrailRouteSegment } from '../domains/d07_trails';

interface TrailDetailModalProps {
  trail: CommunityTrail;
  onClose: () => void;
  onStartNavigation?: () => void;
  onCheckInWaypoint?: (waypoint: any, trail: CommunityTrail) => void;
  onToast?: (message: string) => void;
  onAdoptTrail?: (trail: CommunityTrail) => void;
  onToggleSave?: (trailId: string) => Promise<void>;
  isSaved?: boolean;
  onReserveTour?: (tour: CommunityTrail) => void;
}

export const TrailDetailModal: React.FC<TrailDetailModalProps> = ({
  trail,
  onClose,
  onCheckInWaypoint,
  onToast,
  onAdoptTrail, onToggleSave, isSaved = false, onReserveTour
}) => {
  const [completedStops, setCompletedStops] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [isCached, setIsCached] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [expandedStopId, setExpandedStopId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [routePlan, setRoutePlan] = useState<{mode: TrailTravelMode; legs: TrailRouteSegment[]} | null>(null);
  const showDirections = (mode: TrailTravelMode) => {
    const plan = buildTrailRoutePlan(trail, mode);
    if (plan.error) { onToast?.(plan.error); return; }
    if (plan.segments.length === 1) {
      setRoutePlan(null);
      window.open(plan.segments[0].url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
      return;
    }
    setRoutePlan({ mode, legs: plan.segments });
    if (mode === 'transit') {
      window.open(plan.segments[0].url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
      onToast?.('Opened the first public-transit leg. Return here to open each remaining leg in order.');
    }
  };
  const navigateToStop = (stop: TrailStop) => {
    const address = stop.address?.trim();
    const destination = address || null;
    if (!destination) {
      onToast?.('This stop needs a Google Maps address.');
      return;
    }
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ api: '1', destination });
    window.open('https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?' + params.toString(), '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer');
  };
  const [activePhoto, setActivePhoto] = useState(0);
  const gallery = trail.gallery || [];
  const rawImages = gallery.length > 0
    ? [...gallery].sort((a, b) => Number(b.isCover) - Number(a.isCover))
        .map(photo => photo.url).filter((u): u is string => Boolean(u && u.trim()))
    : [trail.imageUrl, trail.image_url].filter((u): u is string => Boolean(u && u.trim()));
  const visibleImages = Array.from(new Set(rawImages));
  if (visibleImages.length === 0) {
    visibleImages.push('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1578632767115-351597cf2477?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80');
  }

  const stops: TrailStop[] = trail.stops && trail.stops.length > 0
    ? trail.stops
    : (trail.waypoints && trail.waypoints.length > 0
        ? trail.waypoints.map((wp, idx) => ({
            id: wp.id || `stop-${idx}`,
            name: wp.title || `Stop #${idx + 1}`,
            address: wp.address?.trim() || '',
            lat: wp.lat,
            lng: wp.lng,
            vibeNote: wp.description || wp.hint || 'Cultural checkpoint on trail route.',
            timeOfDay: (idx === 0 ? 'Morning' : idx === 1 ? 'Sunset' : 'Night'),
            durationMinutes: 60,
            vq_reward: wp.vq_reward || 75
          }))
        : []);

  const handleToggleLike = async () => {
    if (!onToggleSave || isSaving) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try { await onToggleSave(trail.id); }
    finally { setIsSaving(false); }
  };
  const handleAdopt = () => onAdoptTrail?.(trail);
  const handleCacheOffline = () => {
    onToast?.('Offline Trail downloads are not yet available.');
  };

  const handleToggleStop = (id: string) => {
    setExpandedStopId((prev) => (prev === id ? null : id));
  };

  const handleCheckInStop = (stop: TrailStop) => {
    onToast?.(`Waypoint "${stop.name}" is available for navigation. Verified check-ins and rewards are not enabled yet.`);
  };

  const getTimeBadge = (timeOfDay: string) => {
    switch (timeOfDay) {
      case 'Morning':
        return { label: '🌅 Morning', bg: 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30' };
      case 'Afternoon':
        return { label: '☀️ Afternoon', bg: 'bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-300 border-orange-500/30' };
      case 'Sunset':
        return { label: '🌆 Sunset', bg: 'bg-pink-500/20 text-pink-300 border-pink-500/30' };
      case 'Night':
        return { label: '🌙 Night', bg: 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border-purple-500/30' };
      default:
        return { label: '✨ Flexible', bg: 'bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-300 border-teal-500/30' };
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="w-full sm:max-w-lg bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl text-white max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col">
        {/* Edge-to-Edge Hero Image matching reference image_86e0ae07.png */}
        <div className="relative h-64 sm:h-72 w-full bg-neutral-900 flex-shrink-0">
          <img
            src={visibleImages[activePhoto] || visibleImages[0] || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1578632767115-351597cf2477?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=80'}
            alt={trail.title}
            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
          />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-neutral-950 via-neutral-950/40 to-transparent" />

          {/* Close Button Top Right */}
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close Trail Detail"
            className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-2 rounded-full bg-neutral-950/70 hover:bg-neutral-900 text-white transition backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 cursor-pointer z-10"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>

          {/* Badges Overlay */}
          <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 flex items-center space-x-2 z-10">
            <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-neutral-950/80 text-emerald-400 font-black text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider backdrop-blur-md border border-emerald-500/40 flex items-center space-x-1">
              <span>📍 {trail.category || 'FULL DAY CIRCUIT'}</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="absolute bottom-4 right-4 z-10">
            <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-neutral-950/80 text-amber-300 font-bold text-[11px] backdrop-blur-md border border-amber-500/40 flex items-center space-x-1">
              <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
              <span>{trail.durationHours ? `${trail.durationHours}h` : `${Math.round((trail.duration_mins || 180)/60)}h`} • {stops.length} Stops</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Content Body */}
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-5 flex-1">
          {/* Title & Author Action Bar */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight leading-snug">
              {trail.title}
            </h2>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <span className="font-black text-sm text-white tracking-wide">
                  {trail.authorName || trail.guardian_name || 'MR B'}
                </span>
                <span className="text-neutral-500 text-xs">•</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                  {trail.authorHandle || trail.guardian_handle || '@curator'}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Action Buttons: Adopt, Cache, Like */}
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                {trail.isTour && onReserveTour && <button type="button" onClick={()=>onReserveTour(trail)}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold bg-purple-600/30 border-purple-500/50 text-purple-200">
                  Request Tour
                </button>}
                {!trail.isTour && <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleAdopt}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                    'bg-emerald-950/40 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/50 hover:bg-emerald-900/50'
                  }`}
                >
                  <GitFork className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Adopt</span>
                </button>}

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleCacheOffline}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                    isCached
                      ? 'bg-neutral-800 text-white border-neutral-600'
                      : 'bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-300 border-neutral-800 hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Cache</span>
                </button>

                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleToggleLike}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-xs font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer ${
                    isSaved
                      ? 'bg-pink-500/20 text-pink-400 border-pink-500/50'
                      : 'bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-400 border-neutral-800 hover:text-white'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Heart className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isSaved ? 'fill-pink-400 text-pink-400' : ''}`} />
                  <span>{trail.savesCount ?? 0}</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {visibleImages.length > 1 && (
            <section aria-label="Trail photo gallery" className="space-y-2">
              <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400">
                Gallery · {visibleImages.length} photos
              </p>
              <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
                {visibleImages.map((url, index) => (
                  <button key={`${url}-${index}`} type="button" onClick={() => setActivePhoto(index)}
                    aria-label={`View photo ${index + 1}`}
                    aria-pressed={activePhoto === index}
                    className={`w-20 flex-shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-2 ${activePhoto === index ? 'border-emerald-400' : 'border-neutral-800'}`}>
                    <img src={url} alt={`Trail photo ${index + 1}`}
                      className="aspect-video w-full object-cover" />
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
          )}

          {/* Narrative Story Snippet */}
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed font-light">
            {trail.story || trail.description}
          </p>

          {/* CURATED TRAIL ITINERARY Section */}
          <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                CURATED TRAIL ITINERARY ({stops.length} STOPS)
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 font-medium">
                Tap stop for pro-tips
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2.5">
              {stops.map((stop, index) => {
                const isChecked = completedStops.has(stop.id);
                const isExpanded = expandedStopId === stop.id;
                const timeBadge = getTimeBadge(stop.timeOfDay);

                return (
                  <div
                    key={stop.id}
                    className={`rounded-2xl border transition duration-200 overflow-hidden ${
                      isExpanded
                        ? 'bg-neutral-900/90 border-emerald-500/40'
                        : 'bg-neutral-900/50 border-neutral-800 hover:border-neutral-700'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div
                      onClick={() => handleToggleStop(stop.id)}
                      className="p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer select-none"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-3 min-w-0 flex-1 pr-2">
                        <span className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black flex-shrink-0 ${
                          isChecked
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-neutral-950 shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/30'
                            : 'bg-neutral-900 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40'
                        }`}>
                          {isChecked ? '✓' : index + 1}
                        </span>
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <h4 className="font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm text-white truncate">
                            {stop.name}
                          </h4>
                          {stop.address && stop.address !== stop.name && (
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 truncate">{stop.address}</p>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 flex-shrink-0">
                        <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border text-[10px] font-bold ${timeBadge.bg}`}>
                          {timeBadge.label}
                        </span>
                        {isExpanded ? (
                          <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 text-neutral-400" />
                        ) : (
                          <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-neutral-500" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Expanded Pro-Tips & Check-In Area */}
                    {isExpanded && (
                      <div className="px-4 pb-4 pt-1 space-y-3 border-t border-neutral-800/80 bg-neutral-950/60 animate-fadeIn">
                        <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                          <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold block mb-1">💡 Curator Pro-Tip:</span>
                          {stop.vibeNote || 'Follow the trail markers and savor the authentic cultural atmosphere.'}
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-1">
                          <span className="text-amber-300 font-bold bg-amber-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/20 text-[11px]">
                            +{stop.vq_reward || 75} VQ Check-in
                          </span>

                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleCheckInStop(stop)}
                            disabled={isChecked}
                            className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-bold transition flex items-center space-x-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                              isChecked
                                ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40'
                                : 'bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-neutral-950 shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/20'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {isChecked ? (
                              <>
                                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                <span>Checked In</span>
                              </>
                            ) : (
                              <span>Check In Here</span>
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => navigateToStop(stop)}
                          className="w-full rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-900/30 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-900/50"
                        >
                          Navigate to this stop in Google Maps
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Google Maps route modes: compact equal-width buttons, no simulated route. */}
        <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-950 p-3">
          <div aria-label="Google Maps directions" className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
            {([
              { mode: 'walking', label: 'Chill Walk', Icon: Footprints },
              { mode: 'driving', label: 'Cruise To It', Icon: Car },
              { mode: 'transit', label: 'Hop On', Icon: Bus },
              { mode: 'best', label: 'Best', Icon: Map },
            ] as const).map(({mode, label, Icon}) => (
              <button key={mode} type="button" onClick={() => showDirections(mode)}
                title={`Open ${label} directions in Google Maps`}
                className="flex min-w-0 items-center justify-center gap-0.5 rounded-xl bg-[#00e599] px-0.5 py-3 text-[8px] font-extrabold text-neutral-950 transition hover:bg-[#00c985] min-[390px]:text-[10px]">
                <Icon className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{label}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {routePlan && (
            <section aria-label="Google Maps route legs" className="space-y-2 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/30 p-3">
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-300">
                Your itinerary needs {routePlan.legs.length} Google Maps legs.
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                {routePlan.mode === 'transit'
                  ? 'Hop On opens the first public-transit leg. Return here to open the remaining legs in order. Transit directions depend on Google Maps coverage.'
                  : 'Open each leg in order to visit every stop. Maps has mobile waypoint limits.'}
              </p>
              <div className="grid gap-2">
                {routePlan.legs.map((leg, index) => (
                  <a key={`${leg.url}-${index}`} href={leg.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="rounded-lg border border-neutral-700 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-emerald-200 hover:bg-neutral-900">
                    Part {index + 1}: {leg.from} → {leg.to} ({leg.stopCount} stops)
                  </a>
                ))}
              </div>
            </section>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { X, Award, Shield, Coins, MapPin, Check, AlertCircle, Send, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import { UserProfile } from '../domains/d02_users';
import { followUser, unfollowUser, checkIsFollowing } from '../domains/d03_social_graph';
import { sendConnectionPull } from '../domains/d17_matching';
import { executeVqTransfer } from '../domains/d06_purse';
import { fetchMeetupsByUser } from '../domains/d12_meetups/api';
import { PlaceMeetup } from '../domains/d12_meetups/types';
import { MeetupCard } from './MeetupCard';

interface UserProfileCardProps {
  profile: UserProfile;
  currentUser: UserProfile | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onRequireAuth?: () => void;
  onToast?: (message: string) => void;
}

export const UserProfileCard: React.FC<UserProfileCardProps> = ({
  profile,
  currentUser,
  onClose,
  onRequireAuth,
  onToast
}) => {
  const [isFollowing, setIsFollowing] = useState(false);
  const [pullPending, setPullPending] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [feedbackError, setFeedbackError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Send VQ modal state
  const [isTransferOpen, setIsTransferOpen] = useState(false);
  const [transferAmount, setTransferAmount] = useState('50');
  const [transferMsg, setTransferMsg] = useState('');
  const [transferLoading, setTransferLoading] = useState(false);
  const [transferError, setTransferError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [userMeetups, setUserMeetups] = useState<PlaceMeetup[]>([]);

  const isSelf = currentUser?.id === profile.id || (currentUser?.username && currentUser.username === profile.username);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (currentUser?.id && profile.id && !isSelf) {
      checkIsFollowing(currentUser.id, profile.id).then(setIsFollowing);
    }
  }, [currentUser, profile.id, isSelf]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (profile.id) {
      fetchMeetupsByUser(profile.id).then(setUserMeetups);
    }
  }, [profile.id]);

  const handleEcho = async () => {
    setFeedbackError(null);
    if (!currentUser) {
      setFeedbackError('Guests must authenticate before protected social actions.');
      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
      return;
    }
    if (isSelf) {
      setFeedbackError('Users cannot ECHO themselves.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    if (isFollowing) {
      const res = await unfollowUser(currentUser.id, profile.id);
      if (res.success) {
        setIsFollowing(false);
        if (onToast) onToast(`Removed @${profile.username} from your Orbit.`);
      } else {
        setFeedbackError(res.error || 'Failed to unfollow.');
      }
    } else {
      const res = await followUser(currentUser.id, profile.id);
      if (res.success) {
        setIsFollowing(true);
        if (onToast) onToast(`ECHO active! @${profile.username} added to your Orbit (one-way follow).`);
      } else {
        setFeedbackError(res.error || 'Failed to ECHO user.');
      }
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const handlePull = async () => {
    setFeedbackError(null);
    if (!currentUser) {
      setFeedbackError('Guests must authenticate before protected social actions.');
      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
      return;
    }
    if (isSelf) {
      setFeedbackError('Users cannot PULL themselves.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    const res = await sendConnectionPull(currentUser.id, profile.id);
    if (res.success) {
      setPullPending(true);
      if (onToast) onToast(`Connection PULL sent to @${profile.username}! An accepted Vibe unlocks D14 1:1 DMs.`);
    } else {
      setFeedbackError(res.error || 'Failed to send PULL.');
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const handleSendVqSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setTransferError(null);
    if (!currentUser) {
      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
      setTransferError('Guests must authenticate before transferring VQ.');
      return;
    }
    if (isSelf) {
      setTransferError('You cannot send VQ to yourself.');
      return;
    }
    const amt = Number(transferAmount);
    if (isNaN(amt) || amt <= 0) {
      setTransferError('Please enter a valid positive VQ amount.');
      return;
    }

    setTransferLoading(true);
    const result = await executeVqTransfer({
      toUserId: profile.id,
      amount: amt,
      type: 'tip',
      description: transferMsg ? `Tip to @${profile.username}: ${transferMsg}` : `Tip to @${profile.username}`
    });
    setTransferLoading(false);

    if (!result.success) {
      setTransferError(result.error || 'Transfer failed.');
      return;
    }

    if (onToast) onToast(`Successfully sent ${amt} VQ to @${profile.username}!`);
    setIsTransferOpen(false);
    setTransferAmount('50');
    setTransferMsg('');
    onClose();
  };

  const avatar = profile.avatar_url && profile.avatar_url.trim() !== '' ? profile.avatar_url.trim() : null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl text-white relative">
        {/* Close Button */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Close Profile Card"
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 z-20 text-xs text-white/80 hover:text-white p-2 rounded-full bg-neutral-950/70 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 transition cursor-pointer"
        >
          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>

        {/* Photo-First Hero Section */}
        <div className="relative aspect-[4/4.5] w-full bg-neutral-950 overflow-hidden">
          {avatar ? (
            <img src={avatar} alt={profile.full_name} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
          ) : (
            <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-500">
              <span className="text-5xl" aria-hidden="true">👤</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-neutral-900 via-neutral-900/40 to-transparent" />

          {/* Badges Overlay */}
          <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 flex flex-col space-y-1.5 z-10">
            {profile.role === 'admin' ? (
              <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-orange-500/90 text-neutral-950 font-black text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider backdrop-blur-md flex items-center space-x-1 shadow-lg">
                <Shield className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span>SOLE ADMIN</span>
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-neutral-900/80 text-amber-300 font-bold text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider backdrop-blur-md border border-amber-500/30">
                {profile.role === 'guardian' ? 'GUARDIAN' : 'EXPLORER'}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Identity on photo */}
          <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-4 right-4 z-10 space-y-1">
            <h3 className="font-black text-xl text-white tracking-tight drop-shadow-md">
              {profile.full_name}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-teal-300 font-mono drop-shadow">@{profile.username}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Profile Details */}
        <div className="p-5 space-y-4">
          {/* VQ Balance Badge & Send VQ Button row */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 flex-wrap gap-y-1">
              <span className="text-[11px] text-amber-300 font-bold flex items-center space-x-1.5 bg-amber-500/10 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30">
                <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                <span>{profile.vq_balance} VQ</span>
              </span>

              {!isSelf && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (!currentUser) {
                      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
                      return;
                    }
                    setIsTransferOpen(true);
                  }}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-teal-500/10 hover:bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-300 border border-teal-500/50 font-bold text-xs flex items-center space-x-1.5 transition cursor-pointer shadow"
                >
                  <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Send VQ</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            {typeof profile.trust_score === 'number' && (
              <span className="text-[11px] text-teal-300 font-bold flex items-center space-x-1 bg-teal-500/10 px-3 py-1 rounded-xl border border-teal-500/30">
                <Award className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-teal-400" />
                <span>Trust {profile.trust_score}%</span>
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {profile.bio && (
            <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 italic bg-neutral-950/80 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-800 leading-relaxed">
              &ldquo;{profile.bio}&rdquo;
            </p>
          )}

          {profile.interests && profile.interests.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {profile.interests.map(tag => (
                <span key={tag} className="px-2 py-1 text-[11px] rounded-xl border border-neutral-700 bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-300">{tag}</span>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 flex items-center justify-between px-1">
            <span className="flex items-center space-x-1">
              <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-400" />
              <span>{profile.city || profile.district || 'Location not provided'}</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-neutral-500 text-[10px]">
              ECHO = Follow • PULL = Request Vibe
            </span>
          </div>

          {feedbackError && (
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 text-xs text-red-400 flex items-center space-x-1.5 animate-fadeIn">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
              <span>{feedbackError}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Active & Upcoming Spot Meetups */}
          {userMeetups.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-neutral-800/80">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider px-0.5">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-blue-400 font-black">
                  <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Spot Gatherings ({userMeetups.length})</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                {userMeetups.map((m) => (
                  <MeetupCard key={m.id} meetup={m} currentUser={currentUser} compact />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Action Buttons: Left = ECHO (D03), Right = PULL (D17) */}
          {isSelf ? (
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-center text-xs text-neutral-400 font-semibold">
              This is your public explorer profile.
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-1">
              {/* ECHO Button (Left) = D03 one-way follow */}
              <button
                onClick={handleEcho}
                disabled={loading}
                className={`flex-1 font-mono text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 ${
                  isFollowing
                    ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/60 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(168,85,247,0.2)]'

                onClick={handlePull}
                disabled={loading || pullPending}
                className={`flex-1 font-mono text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 active:scale-95 ${
                  pullPending

              >

                  <span>PULL</span>

            <Zap className="h-5 w-5 fill-fuchsia-400" />
          </span>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black leading-tight tracking-tight text-white sm:text-base">⚡ VIBE FLASH BOARD</h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-neutral-400">Live secrets, after-hours &amp; meetups starting ≤ 60m</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full border border-fuchsia-500/40 bg-fuchsia-500/15 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-fuchsia-200">
          {flashes.length} Active
        </span>
      </div>

          {/* Decorative photograph only: never represent this image as an active event. */}

/**
 * Vibe Flash Detail Modal Component
 * Displays flash event details, countdown, RSVP toggles, and <= 33m LiveCheck arrival verification.
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { X, Zap, MapPin, Clock, Users, Sparkles, CheckCircle2, Shield, Camera } from 'lucide-react';
import { VibeFlashItem } from '../domains/d13_vibe_flash/types';
import { toggleFlashInterested, toggleFlashGoing } from '../domains/d13_vibe_flash/api';
import { useUser } from '../contexts/UserContext';
import { checkPlaceProximity, processLiveCheckReceiptVerification } from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit/presenceVerifier';

interface VibeFlashDetailModalProps {
  flash: VibeFlashItem;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onRequireAuth?: () => void;
  onToast?: (msg: string) => void;
}

export const VibeFlashDetailModal: React.FC<VibeFlashDetailModalProps> = ({
  flash,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onRequireAuth,
  onToast
}) => {
  const { user } = useUser();
  const [interested, setInterested] = useState(false);
  const [going, setGoing] = useState(false);
  const [checkingGps, setCheckingGps] = useState(false);
  const [proximityStatus, setProximityStatus] = useState<{ distance: number; isWithin33m: boolean } | null>(null);
  const [gpsError, setGpsError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Camera / LiveCheck state for VQ Hunt reward
  const [showCamera, setShowCamera] = useState(false);
  const [cameraActive, setCameraActive] = useState(false);
  const videoRef = React.useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);
  const streamRef = React.useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const [capturing, setCapturing] = useState(false);
  const [successClaimed, setSuccessClaimed] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user && flash) {
      setInterested(flash.interested_ids.includes(user.id));
      setGoing(flash.going_ids.includes(user.id));
    }
  }, [user, flash]);

  // Clean up camera on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
    };
  }, []);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleToggleInterested = async () => {
    if (!user) {
      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
      return;
    }
    const res = await toggleFlashInterested(flash.id, user.id);
    if (res.success) {
      setInterested(res.isInterested);
      if (res.isInterested) setGoing(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleGoing = async () => {
    if (!user) {
      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
      return;
    }
    const res = await toggleFlashGoing(flash.id, user.id);
    if (res.success) {
      setGoing(res.isGoing);
      if (res.isGoing) setInterested(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCheckProximity = async () => {
    setCheckingGps(true);
    setGpsError(null);
    const res = await checkPlaceProximity(flash.lat, flash.lng);
    setCheckingGps(false);
    if (res.error) {
      setGpsError(res.error);
      return;
    }
    if (res.distanceMeters !== null) {
      setProximityStatus({
        distance: res.distanceMeters,
        isWithin33m: res.isWithin33m
      });
    }
  };

  const startLiveCheckCamera = async () => {
    setGpsError(null);
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      setGpsError('LiveCheck camera is not supported by your browser.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: 'environment', width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 640 } },
        audio: false
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
      setCameraActive(true);
      setShowCamera(true);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setGpsError(err?.message || 'Camera permission was denied.');
    }
  };

  const captureLiveCheckPhoto = async () => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    if (!video || !streamRef.current || video.videoWidth <= 0) {
      setGpsError('Camera preview is not ready.');
      return;
    }

    setCapturing(true);
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) {
      setCapturing(false);
      return;
    }
    ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.85);

    // Stop camera
    streamRef.current.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
    setCameraActive(false);
    setShowCamera(false);

    if (!user) {
      setCapturing(false);
      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
      return;
    }

    const prox = await checkPlaceProximity(flash.lat, flash.lng);
    if (!prox.isWithin33m || prox.distanceMeters === null) {
      setCapturing(false);
      setGpsError(`You are ${prox.distanceMeters ?? '?'}m away. Must be within 33m to claim VQ hunt reward.`);
      return;
    }

    const res = await processLiveCheckReceiptVerification({
      placeId: flash.place_id || flash.id,
      placeTitle: flash.title,
      userId: user.id,
      userCoords: prox.userCoords || { latitude: flash.lat, longitude: flash.lng },
      placeCoords: { lat: flash.lat, lng: flash.lng },
      receiptImageData: dataUrl
    });

    setCapturing(false);
    if (!res.success) {
      setGpsError(res.error || 'LiveCheck verification failed.');
      return;
    }

    setSuccessClaimed(true);
    if (onToast) onToast(`🎯 +${res.vqEarned} VQ Hunt Reward Claimed via LiveCheck!`);
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto"
    >
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-[#14101c] border border-fuchsia-500/50 rounded-[28px] overflow-hidden shadow-2xl text-white my-auto flex flex-col max-h-[92vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-5 border-b border-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-between bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-950/40 via-neutral-900 to-neutral-900">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-fuchsia-500/20 text-fuchsia-400 border border-fuchsia-500/40">
              <Zap className="w-5 h-5 fill-fuchsia-400" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black text-white tracking-tight">
                {flash.title}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 truncate max-w-[240px]">
                Hosted by <span className="text-fuchsia-300 font-semibold">@{flash.creator_name}</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close"
            className="p-2 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-neutral-800 transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div className="p-5 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto flex-1 text-xs">
          {flash.photo_url && (
            <div className="w-full h-52 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-800 shadow-lg overflow-hidden mb-2">
              <img src={flash.photo_url} alt={flash.title} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
            </div>
          )}

          {gpsError && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-red-950/60 border border-red-500/40 text-red-200 rounded-xl">
              {gpsError}
            </div>
          )}

          {successClaimed && (
            <div className="p-4 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-200 rounded-2xl text-center space-y-1">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-400 mx-auto" />
              <div className="font-black text-sm">LiveCheck Verified & Reward Claimed!</div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-emerald-300/80">+500 VQ credited to your Purse.</p>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/80 border border-neutral-800 p-4 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-neutral-300">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400" />
                <span>{flash.venue_name}</span>
              </span>
              <span className="text-neutral-400 font-mono text-[11px]">{flash.address}</span>
            </div>

            {flash.description && (
              <p className="text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed bg-neutral-950/60 p-3 rounded-xl border border-neutral-800">
                {flash.description}
              </p>
            )}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-neutral-800">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 uppercase font-bold">Entry Type</span>
                <div className="font-bold text-white text-xs">{flash.entry_type} {flash.entry_price_tnd ? `(${flash.entry_price_tnd})` : ''}</div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 uppercase font-bold">Capacity</span>
                <div className="font-bold text-fuchsia-300 text-xs">{flash.going_ids.length} / {flash.max_capacity} Going</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Mutually Exclusive Interested vs Going */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleToggleInterested}
              className={`py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border ${
                interested
                  ? 'bg-amber-500/20 border-amber-400 text-amber-300'
                  : 'bg-neutral-900 border-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <span>⭐ Interested ({flash.interested_ids.length})</span>
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleToggleGoing}
              className={`py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-black transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border ${
                going
                  ? 'bg-fuchsia-600 border-fuchsia-400 text-white shadow-lg shadow-fuchsia-600/30'
                  : 'bg-neutral-900 border-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <span>🔥 Going ({flash.going_ids.length})</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* VQ Hunt & LiveCheck Verification Section */}
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-950/40 via-neutral-900 to-neutral-900 border border-amber-500/40 p-4 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="font-black text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
                <span>VQ Hunt & Arrival (≤33m)</span>
              </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-amber-300 font-bold">+500 VQ Reward</span>
            </div>

            {!proximityStatus ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCheckProximity}
                disabled={checkingGps}
                className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-neutral-950 font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition cursor-pointer shadow-md disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {checkingGps ? 'Checking GPS Proximity...' : '📍 Verify GPS Arrival (≤33m)'}
              </button>
            ) : proximityStatus.isWithin33m ? (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300 font-bold text-center">
                  🟢 Verified Inside 33m Zone ({proximityStatus.distance}m away) — Unlocked!
                </div>
                {!successClaimed && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={startLiveCheckCamera}
                    className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-black uppercase tracking-wider transition cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                  >
                    <Camera className="w-4 h-4" />
                    <span>📸 Capture LiveCheck Receipt for +500 VQ</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 text-red-300 font-semibold text-center">
                🔴 Outside 33m Zone ({proximityStatus.distance}m away). Move within 33 meters of {flash.venue_name} to claim hunt reward.
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* LiveCheck Camera Viewfinder Modal */}
          {showCamera && (
            <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] bg-black/90 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4">
              <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-neutral-900 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border border-emerald-500/50 shadow-2xl space-y-4 p-4 text-center">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-black text-emerald-400 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">LiveCheck Camera Receipt Viewfinder</span>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
                      setShowCamera(false);
                    }}
                    className="p-1 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white"
                  >
                    <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="relative aspect-square w-full bg-black rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-neutral-800">
                  <video ref={videoRef} autoPlay playsInline muted className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                  <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3 p-2 rounded-xl bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10 text-[10px] text-emerald-300 font-mono">
                    📍 {flash.title} • Live GPS Verified (≤33m) • {new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={captureLiveCheckPhoto}
                  disabled={capturing}
                  className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-neutral-950 font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-xs transition cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/30 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {capturing ? 'Verifying Receipt...' : '📸 Snap Live Receipt & Claim +500 VQ'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Bookmark, MapPin, Compass, Sparkles, Map as MapIcon,
  Navigation, CheckCircle2, Coffee
} from 'lucide-react';
import { CityPulse, VibePulsesSummary } from '../domains/d04_geo_presence';
import { VibePlace } from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit';

interface VibePulsesCarouselProps {
  summary: VibePulsesSummary;
  onViewMap: (city?: CityPulse) => void;
  onSelectPlace?: (place: VibePlace) => void;
  onToast?: (message: string) => void;
}

/**
 * Custom SVG Glowing Pulse Wave Icon matching reference screenshot
 */
const PulseWaveIcon: React.FC<{ className?: string; size?: number }> = ({
  className = 'text-pink-400',
  size = 20
}) => (
  <svg
    width={size}
    height={size}
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    className={`inline-block shrink-0 ${className}`}
  >
    <path
      d="M3 12H7L9.5 5L14.5 19L17 12H21"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth="2.2"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
    />
  </svg>
);

export const VibePulsesCarousel: React.FC<VibePulsesCarouselProps> = ({
  summary,
  onViewMap,
  onSelectPlace,
  onToast
}) => {
  const { cities, totalCities, totalLiveVibes } = summary;

  // Active card index. Default to nearest city index 0 or Tunis if present.
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState<number>(() => {
    if (!cities || cities.length === 0) return 0;
    const tunisIdx = cities.findIndex((c) => c.city.toLowerCase() === 'tunis');
    return tunisIdx !== -1 ? tunisIdx : 0;
  });

  const [bookmarkedIds, setBookmarkedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [isInteracting, setIsInteracting] = useState(false);
  const touchStartXRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const touchCurrentXRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const autoAdvanceTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const resumeTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  // Check reduced-motion preference
  const prefersReducedMotion =
    typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
    window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

  const handleNext = useCallback(() => {
    if (cities.length <= 1) return;
    setActiveIndex((prev) => (prev + 1) % cities.length);
  }, [cities.length]);

  const handlePrev = useCallback(() => {
    if (cities.length <= 1) return;
    setActiveIndex((prev) => (prev - 1 + cities.length) % cities.length);
  }, [cities.length]);

  // Pause automatic advancement temporarily during user interaction
  const pauseAutoScroll = useCallback(() => {
    setIsInteracting(true);
    if (resumeTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(resumeTimerRef.current);
    resumeTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsInteracting(false);
    }, 4000);
  }, []);

  // Automatic scrolling loop (advances every 4.2 seconds unless paused or reduced motion)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (prefersReducedMotion || isInteracting || cities.length <= 1) {
      if (autoAdvanceTimerRef.current) clearInterval(autoAdvanceTimerRef.current);
      return;
    }

    autoAdvanceTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      handleNext();
    }, 4200);

    return () => {
      if (autoAdvanceTimerRef.current) clearInterval(autoAdvanceTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, [cities.length, handleNext, isInteracting, prefersReducedMotion]);

  // Cleanup on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (autoAdvanceTimerRef.current) clearInterval(autoAdvanceTimerRef.current);
      if (resumeTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(resumeTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Toggle bookmark
  const toggleBookmark = (e: React.MouseEvent, cityId: string, cityName: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    pauseAutoScroll();
    setBookmarkedIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(cityId)) {
        next.delete(cityId);
        onToast?.(`Removed ${cityName} from saved spots.`);
      } else {
        next.add(cityId);
        onToast?.(`Saved ${cityName} to your Vibe Pulses!`);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Card click handler: If tapping active card with placeData, open canonical Place Details modal!
  const handleCardClick = (city: CityPulse, index: number) => {
    pauseAutoScroll();
    if (index === activeIndex) {
      if (city.placeData && onSelectPlace) {
        onSelectPlace(city.placeData);
      } else {
        onViewMap(city);
      }
    } else {
      setActiveIndex(index);
    }
  };

  // Touch gesture handlers
  const handleTouchStart = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    pauseAutoScroll();
    touchStartXRef.current = e.touches[0].clientX;
    touchCurrentXRef.current = e.touches[0].clientX;
  };

  const handleTouchMove = (e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    touchCurrentXRef.current = e.touches[0].clientX;
  };

  const handleTouchEnd = () => {
    if (touchStartXRef.current !== null && touchCurrentXRef.current !== null) {
      const deltaX = touchStartXRef.current - touchCurrentXRef.current;
      const minSwipeDistance = 45;
      if (deltaX > minSwipeDistance) {
        handleNext();
      } else if (deltaX < -minSwipeDistance) {
        handlePrev();
      }
    }
    touchStartXRef.current = null;
    touchCurrentXRef.current = null;
  };

  if (!cities || cities.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-3xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800/80 p-6 text-center space-y-2">
        <Compass className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-400/60 mx-auto" />
        <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">No active pulses in this sector</h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 max-w-xs mx-auto">
          Scan the horizon in Vibe Orbit to detect newly verified city pulses.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Active city
  const activeCity = cities[activeIndex] || cities[0];

  return (
    <section
      aria-label="Vibe Pulses"
      className="relative space-y-4 pt-1 pb-2 overflow-hidden select-none font-sans"
      onMouseEnter={pauseAutoScroll}
      onTouchStart={handleTouchStart}
      onTouchMove={handleTouchMove}
      onTouchEnd={handleTouchEnd}
    >
      {/* Ambient background glow matching reference aura */}
      <div
        className="pointer-events-none absolute -top-10 -right-10 w-72 h-44 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-600/20 via-pink-500/10 to-transparent blur-3xl"
        aria-hidden="true"
      />

      {/* 1. Header Bar matching Reference Screenshot */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between relative z-10 px-0.5">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black tracking-tight text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-pink-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(244,114,182,0.8)]">
              <PulseWaveIcon size={26} />
            </span>
            <span>Vibe Pulses</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-purple-200/70 font-medium tracking-wide mt-0.5">
            Your city's social pulse
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Horizontally Arranged Carousel with Active Card Emphasis */}
      <div className="relative w-full overflow-hidden py-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 px-2">
          {cities.map((city, index) => {
            const isActive = index === activeIndex;
            const isPrev = index === (activeIndex - 1 + cities.length) % cities.length;
            const isNext = index === (activeIndex + 1) % cities.length;
            const isBookmarked = bookmarkedIds.has(city.id);

            // Hide cards beyond immediate neighbors on mobile viewport to prevent clutter
            const isVisible = isActive || isPrev || isNext;
            if (!isVisible && cities.length > 3) {
              return null;
            }

            return (
              <div
                key={city.id}
                onClick={() => handleCardClick(city, index)}
                className={`relative shrink-0 rounded-[28px] overflow-hidden transition-all duration-500 ease-out cursor-pointer ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'w-[200px] sm:w-[220px] h-[310px] sm:h-[330px] z-20 scale-100 shadow-[0_0_35px_rgba(168,85,247,0.45)] ring-2 ring-purple-400/80 border border-purple-300/40'
                    : 'w-[140px] sm:w-[155px] h-[270px] sm:h-[285px] z-10 scale-95 opacity-70 hover:opacity-90 border border-white/10'
                }`}
              >
                {/* City Photographic Background */}
                <img
                  src={city.imageUrl && city.imageUrl.trim() !== '' ? city.imageUrl : 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1548013146-72479768bada?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80'}
                  alt={city.city}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  loading="lazy"
                />

                {/* Smooth Dark Gradient Overlay for typography contrast */}
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#090611] via-[#090611]/55 to-transparent" />

                {/* Top Row: Weekend / Legendary Badge & Bookmark Button */}
                <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 right-3 flex items-center justify-between z-10">
                  {city.isWeekendHighlight ? (
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/25 border border-amber-400/50 backdrop-blur-md text-amber-200 text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm">
                      <span>{city.type === 'place' ? '⭐' : '📅'}</span>
                      <span>{city.weekendBadgeText || (city.type === 'place' ? 'Legendary Spot' : 'This Weekend')}</span>
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span />
                  )}

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => toggleBookmark(e, city.id, city.city)}
                    aria-label={`Bookmark ${city.city}`}
                    className={`w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center backdrop-blur-md border transition cursor-pointer ${
                      isBookmarked
                        ? 'bg-purple-600/80 border-purple-300 text-white shadow-md'
                        : 'bg-black/40 border-white/15 text-white/80 hover:text-white hover:bg-black/60'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Bookmark
                      className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isBookmarked ? 'fill-white' : ''}`}
                    />
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Bottom Content Area */}
                <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3 space-y-2 z-10">
                  {/* City / Place Name */}
                  <h3
                    className={`font-black text-white tracking-tight leading-tight truncate ${
                      isActive ? 'text-xl sm:text-2xl' : 'text-base sm:text-lg'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {city.city}
                  </h3>

                  {/* Pulse count with waveform */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-white/90 font-medium">
                    <span className="text-pink-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(244,114,182,0.8)]">
                      <PulseWaveIcon size={isActive ? 16 : 14} />
                    </span>
                    <span className={isActive ? 'text-white font-bold' : 'text-zinc-200 text-[11px]'}>
                      {city.activePulses} {city.metricLabel}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* View Map / Spot Details Action Button */}
                  {isActive ? (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        if (city.placeData && onSelectPlace) {
                          onSelectPlace(city.placeData);
                        } else {
                          onViewMap(city);
                        }
                      }}
                      className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-pink-400 hover:from-purple-400 hover:to-pink-300 text-white font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg shadow-purple-600/30 active:scale-95 transition cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white" />
                      <span>{city.placeData ? 'View Spot Details' : 'View Map'}</span>
                      <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        if (city.placeData && onSelectPlace) {
                          onSelectPlace(city.placeData);
                        } else {
                          onViewMap(city);
                        }
                      }}
                      className="w-full py-1.5 px-2 rounded-full bg-black/50 border border-white/10 hover:border-white/30 text-zinc-300 text-[10px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <span>View Map</span>
                      <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3 text-zinc-400" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Carousel Navigation Controls (< [dots] >) matching Reference */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-4 pt-1">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            pauseAutoScroll();
            handlePrev();
          }}
          aria-label="Previous city pulse"
          className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-zinc-900/80 hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center transition cursor-pointer active:scale-90"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>

        {/* Indicators */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5" role="tablist" aria-label="City carousel indicators">
          {cities.map((city, idx) => {
            const isSelected = idx === activeIndex;
            return (
              <button
                key={city.id}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={isSelected}
                aria-label={`Go to ${city.city}`}
                onClick={() => {
                  pauseAutoScroll();
                  setActiveIndex(idx);
                }}
                className={`transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'w-7 h-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-400 to-pink-400 rounded-full'
                    : 'w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-zinc-600 hover:bg-zinc-400 rounded-full'
                }`}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            pauseAutoScroll();
            handleNext();
          }}
          aria-label="Next city pulse"
          className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-zinc-900/80 hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-white/10 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white flex items-center justify-center transition cursor-pointer active:scale-90"
        >
          <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 4. Aggregate Summary Banner Bar matching Reference Screenshot */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#140e22]/90 border border-purple-500/20 p-3 sm:p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between shadow-xl backdrop-blur-md">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-600 via-indigo-600 to-purple-800 flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-md shadow-purple-600/30 shrink-0">
            <PulseWaveIcon size={20} className="text-pink-300" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white leading-tight">Vibe Pulses</h4>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-purple-200/70 font-medium">
              {totalCities} nearby {totalCities === 1 ? 'place' : 'places'} • {totalLiveVibes} total live vibes
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            if (activeCity?.placeData && onSelectPlace) {
              onSelectPlace(activeCity.placeData);
            } else {
              onViewMap(activeCity);
            }
          }}
          className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-zinc-800/80 hover:bg-zinc-700/80 border border-white/10 text-xs text-white font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition active:scale-95 cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
        >

import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Flame, Heart, MessageCircle, Share2, Sparkles, Send, Camera, Shield,
  User, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Check, X, Compass, Radio, Users, CheckCircle2,
  Lock, AlertCircle, Smile
} from 'lucide-react';
import { fetchVibePosts, createVibePost, VibePostItem, fetchCommentsForPost, addCommentToPost, VibeComment } from '../domains/d05_vibe';
import { fetchDemoProfiles, fetchPublicProfileByHandle, UserProfile } from '../domains/d02_users';
import { fetchOrbitProfiles, fetchEchoProfiles, unfollowUser, followUser } from '../domains/d03_social_graph';
import { fetchPendingPulls, fetchConfirmedVibes, acceptConnectionPull, passConnectionPull, ConnectionPull, ConfirmedVibe } from '../domains/d17_matching';
import { checkDmAuthorization, fetchDirectMessages, sendDirectMessage, DirectMessage } from '../domains/d14_messaging';
import {
  fetchDriftRooms,
  fetchRoomPresenceSouls,

  CANONICAL_WAVELENGTH_ROOMS
} from '../domains/d15_drift';
import { DriftIdentityModal } from './drift/DriftIdentityModal';

import { ShareTab } from './ShareTab';
import { fetchAllMeetups, subscribeToMeetupUpdates } from '../domains/d12_meetups';
import { PlaceMeetup } from '../domains/d12_meetups/types';
import { MeetupCard } from './MeetupCard';

interface VibeTabProps {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  onNavigateShare?: () => void;
}

export const VibeTab: React.FC<VibeTabProps> = ({ user, onNavigateShare }) => {
  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<'gossip' | 'drift' | 'vibes' | 'orbit' | 'echo' | 'pulls'>('gossip');
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState<VibePostItem[]>([]);
  const [demoProfiles, setDemoProfiles] = useState<UserProfile[]>([]);
  const [orbitProfiles, setOrbitProfiles] = useState<UserProfile[]>([]);
  const [echoProfiles, setEchoProfiles] = useState<UserProfile[]>([]);
  const [pendingPulls, setPendingPulls] = useState<ConnectionPull[]>([]);
  const [confirmedVibes, setConfirmedVibes] = useState<ConfirmedVibe[]>([]);
  const [spotMeetups, setSpotMeetups] = useState<PlaceMeetup[]>([]);
  
  const [activePostId, setActivePostId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<VibeComment[]>([]);
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState('');
  const [newPostCaption, setNewPostCaption] = useState('');
  const [dualCameraOpen, setDualCameraOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedProfile, setSelectedProfile] = useState<UserProfile | null>(null);
  
  // 1:1 D14 Chat State
  const [activeChatUser, setActiveChatUser] = useState<{ id: string; name: string; handle: string; avatar: string } | null>(null);
  const [chatMessages, setChatMessages] = useState<DirectMessage[]>([]);
  const [newChatMessage, setNewChatMessage] = useState('');
  const [dmAuthError, setDmAuthError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const [tunedWavelength, setTunedWavelength] = useState<string | null>('chill');
  const [likedPosts, setLikedPosts] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [notificationToast, setNotificationToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [gossipEmojiPickerOpen, setGossipEmojiPickerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [commentEmojiPickerOpen, setCommentEmojiPickerOpen] = useState(false);

  // Drift Subsystem State
  const [driftRooms, setDriftRooms] = useState<DriftRoom[]>(CANONICAL_WAVELENGTH_ROOMS);
  const [activeDriftRoom, setActiveDriftRoom] = useState<DriftRoom | null>(null);
  const [pendingIdentityRoom, setPendingIdentityRoom] = useState<DriftRoom | null>(null);
  const [currentDriftAlias, setCurrentDriftAlias] = useState<DriftAlias | null>(null);
  const [roomSoulCounts, setRoomSoulCounts] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});

  const scrollContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchVibePosts().then(setPosts);
    fetchDemoProfiles().then(setDemoProfiles);
    fetchDriftRooms().then(setDriftRooms);

    // Initial soul counts for each room
    const loadSoulCounts = async () => {
      const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
      await Promise.all(
        CANONICAL_WAVELENGTH_ROOMS.map(async (r) => {
          const souls = await fetchRoomPresenceSouls(r.id);
          counts[r.id] = souls.length;
        })
      );
      setRoomSoulCounts(counts);
    };

    loadSoulCounts();
    const interval = setInterval(loadSoulCounts, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const effectiveUserId = user?.id || 'anon_voyager_' + (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (window.localStorage.getItem('vq_anon_id') || (() => {
    const id = 'anon_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9);
    window.localStorage.setItem('vq_anon_id', id);
    return id;
  })()) : 'anon');

  const isPlatformAdmin = Boolean(
    user && (
      user.role === 'admin' ||
      user.username === 'funmarketmn' ||
      user.username === 'admin' ||
      (user as any).email === 'funmarketmn@hotmail.com' ||
      (user as any).email === 'funmarketmn@gmail.com'
    )
  );

  const handleEnterDriftRoom = async (room: DriftRoom) => {
    setTunedWavelength(room.id);
    // Check if alias exists
    const alias = await getOrCreateDriftAlias(room.id, effectiveUserId);
    if (alias) {
      setCurrentDriftAlias(alias);
      setActiveDriftRoom(room);
    } else {
      setPendingIdentityRoom(room);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmAliasAndEnter = async (handle: string, color: string) => {
    if (!pendingIdentityRoom) return;
    const room = pendingIdentityRoom;
    const alias = await getOrCreateDriftAlias(room.id, effectiveUserId, handle, color);
    setCurrentDriftAlias(alias);
    setPendingIdentityRoom(null);
    setActiveDriftRoom(room);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAllMeetups().then(setSpotMeetups);
    const unsub = subscribeToMeetupUpdates(() => {
      fetchAllMeetups().then(setSpotMeetups);
    });

    if (user?.id) {
      fetchOrbitProfiles(user.id).then(setOrbitProfiles);
      fetchEchoProfiles(user.id).then(setEchoProfiles);
      fetchPendingPulls(user.id).then(setPendingPulls);
      fetchConfirmedVibes(user.id).then(setConfirmedVibes);
    } else {
      setOrbitProfiles([]);
      setEchoProfiles([]);
      setPendingPulls([]);
      setConfirmedVibes([]);
    }

    return () => unsub();
  }, [user]);

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setNotificationToast(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setNotificationToast(null), 2500);
  };

  const handleScroll = (direction: 'left' | 'right') => {
    if (scrollContainerRef.current) {
      const scrollAmount = 220;
      scrollContainerRef.current.scrollBy({
        left: direction === 'left' ? -scrollAmount : scrollAmount,
        behavior: 'smooth'
      });
    }
  };

  const handleOpenComments = async (postId: string) => {
    setActivePostId(postId);
    const comms = await fetchCommentsForPost(postId);
    setComments(comms);
  };

  const handleSendComment = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!activePostId || !newComment.trim() || !user) return;
    const added = await addCommentToPost(activePostId, newComment, {
      username: user.username,
      avatar_url: user.avatar_url
    });
    if (added) {
      setComments([...comments, added]);
      setNewComment('');
    }
  };

  const handleToggleLike = (postId: string) => {
    setLikedPosts((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(postId)) {
        next.delete(postId);
      } else {
        next.add(postId);
      }
      return next;
    });
    setPosts((prevPosts) =>
      prevPosts.map((p) => {
        if (p.id === postId) {
          const isLiked = likedPosts.has(postId);
          return {
            ...p,
            reactions_count: Math.max(0, p.reactions_count + (isLiked ? -1 : 1))
          };
        }
        return p;
      })
    );
  };

  const handleCreatePost = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newPostCaption.trim() || !user) {
      showToast('Please sign in to publish a vibe post.');
      return;
    }
    const newPost: VibePostItem = {
      id: 'post_' + Date.now(),
      user_id: user.id,
      username: user.username,
      avatar_url: user.avatar_url,
      caption: newPostCaption,
      image_url: '',
      selfie_url: undefined,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      reactions_count: 0,
      comments_count: 0
    };
    await createVibePost(newPost);
    setPosts([newPost, ...posts]);
    setNewPostCaption('');
    showToast('Vibe broadcast published to district live feed!');

  const handleSharePost = async (post: VibePostItem) => {
    const shareText = `Check out this Vibe broadcast by @${post.username} on VibeQuest: "${post.caption}"`;
    if (navigator.share) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({
          title: 'VibeQuest Gossip',
          text: shareText,
          url: window.location.href
        });
        return;
      } catch {}
    }
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${shareText} - ${window.location.href}`);
      showToast('Post link copied to clipboard!');
    } catch {
      showToast('Share link ready!');
    }
  };

  // D14 Direct Message Flow with strict invariant: ECHO never grants DMs
  const handleOpenChat = async (targetUser: { id: string; name: string; handle: string; avatar: string }) => {
    setDmAuthError(null);
    if (!user) {
      showToast('Authentication required before starting conversations.');
      return;
    }

    const authCheck = await checkDmAuthorization(user.id, targetUser.id);
    if (!authCheck.authorized) {
      setDmAuthError(authCheck.reason || 'D14 1:1 DMs require an accepted D17 confirmed Vibe.');
      setActiveChatUser(targetUser);
      setChatMessages([]);
      return;
    }

    setActiveChatUser(targetUser);
    const msgs = await fetchDirectMessages(user.id, targetUser.id);
    setChatMessages(msgs);
  };

  const handleSendChatMessage = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!activeChatUser || !newChatMessage.trim() || !user) return;
    
    const res = await sendDirectMessage(user.id, activeChatUser.id, newChatMessage);
    if (res.success && res.message) {
      setChatMessages([...chatMessages, res.message]);
      setNewChatMessage('');
    } else {
      setDmAuthError(res.error || 'Failed to send message');
    }
  };

  const handleAcceptPull = async (pull: ConnectionPull) => {
    if (!user) return;
    const res = await acceptConnectionPull(pull.id, user.id, pull.sender_id);
    if (res.success) {
      setPendingPulls(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== pull.id));
      fetchConfirmedVibes(user.id).then(setConfirmedVibes);
      showToast(`Accepted Connection Pull! Confirmed Vibe established & D14 1:1 DMs unlocked.`);
    } else {
      showToast(res.error || 'Failed to accept pull');
    }
  };

  const handlePassPull = async (pullId: string) => {
    if (!user) return;
    const res = await passConnectionPull(pullId, user.id);
    if (res.success) {
      setPendingPulls(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== pullId));
      showToast('Passed connection pull.');
    }
  };

  const handleUnfollowOrbit = async (targetId: string, name: string) => {
    if (!user) return;
    const res = await unfollowUser(user.id, targetId);
    if (res.success) {
      setOrbitProfiles(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== targetId));
      showToast(`Removed @${name} from your Orbit.`);
    }

  const handleFollowBackEcho = async (targetId: string, name: string) => {
    if (!user) return;
    const res = await followUser(user.id, targetId);
    if (res.success) {

    { id: 'mellow', name: 'Mellow Vibes', desc: 'slow mornings, soft playlists, doing nothing but feeling everything', color: 'bg-cyan-400' },
    { id: 'echo', name: 'Echo Vibes', desc: 'instant click, same frequency, we just get each other', color: 'bg-emerald-400' },
    { id: 'zen', name: 'Zen Vibes', desc: 'breathwork, nature reset, calm your chaos together', color: 'bg-green-400' },
    { id: 'groove', name: 'Groove Vibes', desc: 'music, dance, kitchen concerts — let’s move to the same beat', color: 'bg-pink-400' },
    { id: 'pixel', name: 'Pixel Vibes', desc: 'gaming sessions, late night streams, digital world twins', color: 'bg-indigo-400' },
    { id: 'quest', name: 'Quest Vibes', desc: 'spontaneous adventures, hidden spots, real life side quests', color: 'bg-amber-500' },
    { id: 'wander', name: 'Wander', desc: 'just wander away, get lost and lose yourself in an unplanned journey with no map', color: 'bg-teal-500' },
  ];

  const subTabs = [
    { id: 'gossip', label: 'GOSSIP' },
    { id: 'drift', label: 'DRIFT' },
