                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setNewPostCaption(prev => prev ? `${prev} #MissionAccepted` : 'Completed District Heritage Mission! #MissionAccepted')}
                  className="flex items-center space-x-1 text-orange-400 font-bold hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Mission</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setNewPostCaption(prev => prev ? `${prev} ✨ #VibeCheck` : 'Electric sunset vibe across the old souk. ✨ #VibeCheck')}
                  className="flex items-center space-x-1 text-purple-400 font-bold hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <span>✨ Vibe</span>
                </button>
              </div>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-teal-500 text-white font-black text-xs shadow-lg hover:opacity-90 transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>POST</span>
                <Send className="w-3 h-3" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {gossipEmojiPickerOpen && (
              <div className="absolute top-28 left-4 z-50">
                <DriftEmojiPicker
                  onSelectEmoji={(char) => {
                    setNewPostCaption(prev => prev + char);
                    setGossipEmojiPickerOpen(false);
                  }}
                  onClose={() => setGossipEmojiPickerOpen(false)}
                />
              </div>
            )}
          </form>

          {/* Vibe Signals & Gossip Feed (D12) Header */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-neutral-400 px-1">
            <span className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-amber-400">
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>VIBE SIGNALS & GOSSIP FEED (D12)</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center space-x-1 text-emerald-400 text-[10px]">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
              <span>LIVE NETWORK</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Active Spot Meetups Cross-Feed Propagation */}
          {spotMeetups.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2.5 pb-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider px-1">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-blue-400 font-black">
                  <Users className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Spot Meetups & Circles ({spotMeetups.length})</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5">
                {spotMeetups.slice(0, 2).map((m) => (
                  <MeetupCard key={m.id} meetup={m} currentUser={user} />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Posts List or Clean Empty State */}
          {posts.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {posts.map((post) => {
                const authorUsername = post.username || 'explorer';
                const isLiked = likedPosts.has(post.id);
                return (
                  <div key={post.id} className="rounded-3xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
                    {/* Post Header */}
                    <div className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-800/80">
                      <div
                        onClick={async () => {
                          const profile = await fetchPublicProfileByHandle(authorUsername);
                          if (profile) {
                            setSelectedProfile(profile);
                          } else {
                            setSelectedProfile({
                              id: post.user_id,
                              username: authorUsername,
                              full_name: authorUsername,
                              avatar_url: post.avatar_url,
                              vq_balance: 1000,
                              reputation: 92,
                              role: 'explorer',
                              created_at: post.created_at
                            });
                          }
                        }}
                        className="flex items-center space-x-3 cursor-pointer group"
                      >
                        <img
                          src={post.avatar_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=300&q=80'}
                          alt={authorUsername}
                          className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover border border-orange-500/40 group-hover:border-teal-400 transition"
                        />
                        <div>
                          <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white group-hover:text-teal-400 transition">
                            @{authorUsername}
                          </h4>
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">Just now • 📍 Local Node</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleSharePost(post)}
                        className="text-neutral-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer"
                        aria-label="Share post"
                      >
                        <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {/* Post Image with PIP Selfie - only if image_url is provided */}
                    {post.image_url && post.image_url.trim() !== '' && (
                      <div className="relative aspect-[4/5] bg-neutral-950">
                        <img src={post.image_url} alt="Scene" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                        {post.selfie_url && (
                          <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 w-24 h-32 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-4 border-orange-500 shadow-2xl">
                            <img src={post.selfie_url} alt="Selfie" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Caption & Actions */}
                    <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
                      <p className="text-sm text-neutral-200">{post.caption}</p>

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-neutral-800 text-xs text-neutral-400">
                        <span className="flex items-center space-x-1">
                          <Heart className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isLiked ? 'text-rose-500 fill-rose-500' : 'text-rose-500 fill-rose-500/30'}`} />
                          <span className="font-bold text-white">{post.reactions_count}</span>
                          <span>{post.reactions_count === 1 ? 'like' : 'likes'}</span>
                        </span>
                        <span>{post.comments_count} comments</span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 pt-2 border-t border-neutral-800 text-xs font-semibold text-neutral-300">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleToggleLike(post.id)}
                          className={`flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 py-2 hover:bg-neutral-800/50 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer ${
                            isLiked ? 'text-rose-400 font-bold' : ''
                          }`}
                        >
                          <Heart className={`w-4 h-4 ${isLiked ? 'fill-rose-500 text-rose-500' : 'text-orange-400'}`} />
                          <span>{isLiked ? 'Liked' : 'Like'}</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleOpenComments(post.id)}
                          className="flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 py-2 hover:bg-neutral-800/50 rounded-xl transition text-teal-400 font-bold cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <MessageCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                          <span>Comment</span>
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleSharePost(post)}
                          className="flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 py-2 hover:bg-neutral-800/50 rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <Share2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          <span>Share</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="rounded-3xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-8 text-center space-y-3 shadow-xl">
              <Sparkles className="w-10 h-10 text-teal-400/70 mx-auto animate-pulse" />
              <h4 className="font-black text-base text-white">No Vibe Signals Yet</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 max-w-xs mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                Be the first explorer to drop an authentic dual-camera moment or gossip signal into your district!
              </p>
              <button
                onClick={() => setDualCameraOpen(true)}
                className="mt-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-teal-500 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-lg transition hover:opacity-90 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Launch BeReal Camera
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* DRIFT TAB CONTENT */}
      {activeSubTab === 'drift' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-4 space-y-2">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-teal-300">Shared Wavelengths</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
              Tune into a neighborhood wavelength to chat and drift along with fellow travelers sharing similar interests!
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {wavelengths.map((w) => {
              const isTuned = tunedWavelength === w.id;
              const soulCount = roomSoulCounts[w.id] ?? (isTuned ? 1 : 0);
              const matchingRoom = driftRooms.find((r) => r.id === w.id) || {
                id: w.id,
                name: w.name,
                description: w.desc,
                color: w.color
              };

              return (
                <div
                  key={w.id}
                  onClick={() => handleEnterDriftRoom(matchingRoom)}
                  className={`rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border p-4 space-y-2 transition flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer ${
                    isTuned ? 'border-teal-400/80 shadow-lg shadow-teal-500/10' : 'border-neutral-800 hover:border-teal-500/50'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white font-serif">{w.name}</h4>
                      <span className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${w.color} animate-pulse`} />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 mt-1 leading-relaxed">{w.desc}</p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      handleEnterDriftRoom(matchingRoom);
                    }}
                    className={`w-full mt-2 py-2 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-bold transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center space-x-1.5 ${
                      isTuned
                        ? 'bg-teal-500/20 border border-teal-500/50 text-teal-300'
                        : 'bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 hover:border-teal-500/50 text-neutral-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isTuned ? (
                      <span className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-emerald-300 font-bold">
                        <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                        <span>Active Souls: {soulCount}</span>
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span>Tune In Wavelength</span>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* VIBES TAB CONTENT (D17 Confirmed Vibes Squad) */}
      {activeSubTab === 'vibes' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-xs text-teal-400 uppercase tracking-wider">CONFIRMED VIBES SQUAD (D17)</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                Only confirmed mutual Vibes unlock ordinary 1:1 personal messaging (SOC-002).
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-300 border border-teal-500/30 font-bold whitespace-nowrap">
              {confirmedVibes.length} Confirmed
            </span>
          </div>

          {confirmedVibes.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {confirmedVibes.map((v) => {
                const partnerId = v.user_1_id === user?.id ? v.user_2_id : v.user_1_id;
                const partnerProfile = {
                  id: partnerId,
                  name: v.partner_profile?.full_name || 'Matched Explorer',
                  handle: v.partner_profile?.username || 'explorer',
                  avatar: (v.partner_profile?.avatar_url && v.partner_profile.avatar_url.trim() !== '') ? v.partner_profile.avatar_url : 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'
                };
                return (
                  <div key={v.id} className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div
                      onClick={async () => {
                        const profile = await fetchPublicProfileByHandle(partnerProfile.handle);
                        if (profile) setSelectedProfile(profile);
                      }}
                      className="flex items-center space-x-3 cursor-pointer group"
                    >
                      <img src={partnerProfile.avatar} alt={partnerProfile.name} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover border border-teal-500/40 group-hover:border-teal-400 transition" />
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white group-hover:text-teal-400 transition">{partnerProfile.name}</h4>
                        <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400">@{partnerProfile.handle}</p>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-300 font-medium">⚡ Cultural Explorer • Unlocked</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-end space-y-2">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-teal-400 bg-teal-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-teal-500/20">
                        ✨ {v.vibe_score || 95}% Vibe
                      </span>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleOpenChat(partnerProfile)}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-teal-500 hover:bg-teal-600 text-neutral-950 font-black text-xs shadow transition flex items-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <MessageCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Chat</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800 p-8 text-center space-y-2">
              <Users className="w-8 h-8 text-teal-400/60 mx-auto" />
              <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-white">No confirmed mutual vibes yet</h4>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 max-w-xs mx-auto">
                Send PULLs to explorers in your sector. Once they accept, your mutual vibe unlocks direct 1:1 DMs (SOC-002).
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ORBIT TAB CONTENT (D03 Outbound Follows) */}
      {activeSubTab === 'orbit' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-xs text-orange-400 uppercase tracking-wider">YOUR ORBIT (D03 OUTBOUND)</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                Accounts you actively follow via ECHO. Following is directed and distinct from confirmed Vibes (ECHO never grants DMs).
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-orange-500/20 text-orange-300 border border-orange-500/30 font-bold whitespace-nowrap">
              {orbitProfiles.length} Orbiting
            </span>
          </div>

          {orbitProfiles.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {orbitProfiles.map((g) => (
                <div key={g.id} className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div
                    onClick={() => setSelectedProfile(g)}
                    className="flex items-center space-x-3 min-w-0 cursor-pointer group"
                  >
                    <img src={g.avatar_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'} alt={g.full_name} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover border border-orange-500/40 group-hover:border-teal-400 transition" />
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white group-hover:text-teal-400 transition truncate">{g.full_name}</h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 truncate">@{g.username}</p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-300 truncate mt-0.5">{g.district}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-end space-y-2 flex-shrink-0">
                    <span className="text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 font-bold border border-amber-500/30">
                      {g.tier || g.role}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleUnfollowOrbit(g.id, g.username)}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-300 font-semibold text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Unfollow
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800 p-8 text-center space-y-2">
              <Radio className="w-8 h-8 text-orange-400/60 mx-auto" />
              <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-white">Your Orbit is clear</h4>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 max-w-xs mx-auto">
                Tap ECHO on public profile cards to follow local legends and district explorers into your Orbit.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ECHO TAB CONTENT (D03 Inbound Followers) */}
      {activeSubTab === 'echo' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-xs text-purple-400 uppercase tracking-wider">ECHO FOLLOWERS (D03 INBOUND)</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                Explorers who are tuning into your profile and presence frequency.
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30 font-bold whitespace-nowrap">
              {echoProfiles.length} Tuning In
            </span>
          </div>

          {echoProfiles.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {echoProfiles.map((echo) => (
                <div key={echo.id} className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div
                    onClick={() => setSelectedProfile(echo)}
                    className="flex items-center space-x-3 cursor-pointer group"
                  >
                    <img src={echo.avatar_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1517841905240-472988babdf9?auto=format&fit=crop&w=300&q=80'} alt={echo.full_name} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover border border-purple-500/40 group-hover:border-teal-400 transition" />
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white group-hover:text-teal-400 transition">{echo.full_name}</h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400">@{echo.username}</p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-300 mt-0.5">{echo.bio || echo.district}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleFollowBackEcho(echo.id, echo.username)}
                    className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-500 to-emerald-600 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow transition cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90"
                  >
                    ECHO Back
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800 p-8 text-center space-y-2">
              <Radio className="w-8 h-8 text-purple-400/60 mx-auto" />
              <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-white">No active Echo frequencies</h4>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 max-w-xs mx-auto">
                Broadcast your vibe or check in at high-intensity pulses to attract inbound explorers.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* PULLS TAB CONTENT (D17 Inbound Connection Pulls) */}
      {activeSubTab === 'pulls' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-xs text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-wider">CONNECTION PULLS (D17 INBOUND)</h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                Explorers inviting you into their Vibe squad. Accept establishes a confirmed Vibe and unlocks 1:1 personal DMs.
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 font-bold whitespace-nowrap">
              {pendingPulls.length} Pending
            </span>
          </div>

          {pendingPulls.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {pendingPulls.map((p) => {
                const sender = p.sender_profile || {
                  username: 'explorer',
                  full_name: 'District Voyager',
                  avatar_url: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507003211169-0a1dd7228f2d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'
                };
                const senderAvatar = (sender.avatar_url && sender.avatar_url.trim() !== '') ? sender.avatar_url : 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507003211169-0a1dd7228f2d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80';
                return (
                  <div key={p.id} className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 p-4 space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <div
                        onClick={async () => {
                          const profile = await fetchPublicProfileByHandle(sender.username);
                          if (profile) setSelectedProfile(profile);
                        }}
                        className="flex items-center space-x-3 cursor-pointer group"
                      >
                        <img src={senderAvatar} alt={sender.full_name} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover border border-amber-500/40 group-hover:border-teal-400 transition" />
                        <div>
                          <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white group-hover:text-teal-400 transition">{sender.full_name}</h4>
                          <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400">@{sender.username}</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-amber-500/30">
                        ✨ Pending Pull
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    {p.reason && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 italic bg-neutral-950/60 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-neutral-800">
                        &ldquo;{p.reason}&rdquo;
                      </p>
                    )}
                    <div className="flex space-x-2 pt-1">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handlePassPull(p.id)}
                        className="flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-300 font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Pass
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleAcceptPull(p)}
                        className="flex-2 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-teal-500 to-emerald-600 text-white font-black text-xs shadow-lg shadow-teal-500/20 transition hover:opacity-90 flex items-center justify-center space-x-1 cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
                        <span>ACCEPT</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="rounded-2xl bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800 p-8 text-center space-y-2">
              <Users className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-400/60 mx-auto" />
              <h4 className="font-bold text-xs text-white">No pending connection pulls</h4>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 max-w-xs mx-auto">
                All connection invites reviewed. Browse district profiles to send outbound Vibe pulls.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 1:1 Secure Chat Modal (SOC-002) governed by D14 authorization */}
      {activeChatUser && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="w-full sm:max-w-md bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl p-5 space-y-4 max-h-[85vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl text-white">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-800 pb-3">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                <img src={activeChatUser.avatar && activeChatUser.avatar.trim() !== '' ? activeChatUser.avatar : 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'} alt={activeChatUser.name} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover border border-teal-500/40" />
                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">{activeChatUser.name}</h4>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-teal-400">@{activeChatUser.handle} • SOC-002 Encrypted</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setActiveChatUser(null);
                  setDmAuthError(null);
                }}
                className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {dmAuthError ? (
              <div className="py-8 px-4 text-center space-y-3">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-red-400">
                  <Lock className="w-6 h-6" />
                </div>
                <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-white">D14 DM Access Denied</h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed max-w-xs mx-auto">
                  {dmAuthError}
                </p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-300/80 bg-neutral-950 p-3 rounded-xl border border-neutral-800">
                  Rule SOC-002: One-way ECHO follows do not unlock personal messages. Only mutual accepted Vibe requests (D17) unlock 1:1 DMs.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-3 min-h-[220px]">
                  {chatMessages.length > 0 ? (
                    chatMessages.map((msg) => (
                      <div
                        key={msg.id}
                        className={`flex ${msg.sender_id === user?.id ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'}`}
                      >
                        <div
                          className={`max-w-[75%] p-3 rounded-2xl text-xs space-y-1 ${
                            msg.sender_id === user?.id
                              ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-600 text-white rounded-br-sm'
                              : 'bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 text-neutral-200 rounded-bl-sm'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <p>{msg.content}</p>
                          <p className="text-[9px] text-white/60 text-right">
                            {new Date(msg.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))
                  ) : (
                    <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-neutral-500 italic">
                      Confirmed Vibe established. Start your 1:1 conversation!
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <form onSubmit={handleSendChatMessage} className="flex items-center space-x-2 pt-2 border-t border-neutral-800">
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={newChatMessage}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewChatMessage(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Send a private vibe message..."
                    className="flex-1 bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-teal-500 text-white hover:opacity-90 transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </form>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* District Comments Modal */}
      {activePostId && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-end sm:items-center justify-center p-0 sm:p-4 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="w-full sm:max-w-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-t-3xl sm:rounded-3xl p-6 space-y-4 max-h-[80vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl text-white">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-neutral-800 pb-3">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-base">District Comments</h3>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActivePostId(null)}
                className="text-xs text-neutral-400 hover:text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 cursor-pointer"
              >
                Close
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-3 min-h-[160px]">
              {comments.length > 0 ? (
                comments.map((comm) => (
                  <div key={comm.id} className="flex space-x-3 items-start bg-neutral-950/60 p-3 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-800">
                    <img src={comm.avatar_url || 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'} alt={comm.username} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full object-cover" />
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs text-white">@{comm.username}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">
                          {new Date(comm.created_at).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 mt-1">{comm.content}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              ) : (
                <div className="py-6 text-center text-xs text-neutral-500 italic">
                  No comments yet. Start the conversation!
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSendComment} className="relative flex items-center space-x-2 pt-2 border-t border-neutral-800">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={newComment}
                onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Write a comment..."
                className="flex-1 bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-teal-500"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setCommentEmojiPickerOpen(!commentEmojiPickerOpen)}
                className={`p-2 transition cursor-pointer ${commentEmojiPickerOpen ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-amber-300'}`}
                title="Telegram & Animated Emojis"
              >
                <Smile className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-teal-500 text-white hover:opacity-90 transition cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>

              {commentEmojiPickerOpen && (
                <div className="absolute bottom-14 right-0 z-50">
                  <DriftEmojiPicker
                    onSelectEmoji={(char) => {
                      setNewComment(prev => prev + char);
                      setCommentEmojiPickerOpen(false);
                    }}
                    onClose={() => setCommentEmojiPickerOpen(false)}
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {dualCameraOpen && (
        <ShareTab
          user={user}
          onPostSuccess={() => undefined}
          cameraOnly
          initialMode="dual"
          onClose={() => setDualCameraOpen(false)}
        />
      )}

      {/* User Profile Card Modal */}
      {selectedProfile && (
        <UserProfileCard
          profile={selectedProfile}
          currentUser={user}
          onClose={() => setSelectedProfile(null)}
          onToast={showToast}
        />
      )}

      {/* Full-Screen Drift Room Modal View */}
      {activeDriftRoom && currentDriftAlias && (
        <DriftRoomView
          room={activeDriftRoom}
          currentUserId={effectiveUserId}
          alias={currentDriftAlias}
          isPlatformAdmin={isPlatformAdmin}
          onLeave={() => setActiveDriftRoom(null)}
          onConfirmedVibeEstablished={() => {
            if (user?.id) fetchConfirmedVibes(user.id).then(setConfirmedVibes);
            showToast('✨ Double-match Confirmed! Unlocked in VIBES squad.');
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Drift Temporary Identity Picker Modal */}
      {pendingIdentityRoom && (
        <DriftIdentityModal
          room={pendingIdentityRoom}
          onConfirm={handleConfirmAliasAndEnter}
          onClose={() => setPendingIdentityRoom(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  X, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, Shield,
  Flame, MapPin, Sparkles, Send, Check
} from 'lucide-react';
import { VibePlace } from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit/types';
import {
  submitProximityValidation,
  fetchPlaceValidations,
  getUserValidationStreak,
  calculateValidationRewards,
  ValidationResponse
} from '../domains/d03_vibe_orbit/validations';
import { useUser } from '../contexts/UserContext';

interface VibeValidateModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  place: VibePlace;
  onValidated?: (newAverage: number | null, newCount: number) => void;
  onRequireAuth?: () => void;
}

const YES_LIVE_TAGS = [
  '🔥 High Energy',
  '😌 Chill & Cozy',
  '🪑 Seats Available',
  '🎶 Great Music',
  '💻 Fast Wi-Fi'
];

const NO_CHANGE_TAGS = [
  '🚫 Temporarily Closed',
  '⏳ Packed / Long Queue',
  '🔇 Vibe / Music Changed',
  '📍 Wrong Pin / Address',
  '💸 Price Changed'
];

export const VibeValidateModal: React.FC<VibeValidateModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  place,
  onValidated,
  onRequireAuth
}) => {
  const { user } = useUser();
  const [selectedResponse, setSelectedResponse] = useState<ValidationResponse | null>(null);
  const [selectedTags, setSelectedTags] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [comment, setComment] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [successResult, setSuccessResult] = useState<{
    message: string;
    subtext: string;
    type: 'yes' | 'no' | 'abstain';
    points: number;
    newConfidence: number | null;
  } | null>(null);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Proximity & Streak calculations
  const streak = getUserValidationStreak(user?.id);
  const { multiplier, yesReward, noReward } = calculateValidationRewards(streak);

  const isWithin200m =
    (place.distance_meters !== undefined && place.distance_meters <= 200) ||
    (place.distance_km !== undefined && place.distance_km <= 0.2);

  const distanceDisplay =
    place.distance_km !== undefined
      ? `${place.distance_km} km`
      : place.distance_meters !== undefined
      ? `${(place.distance_meters / 1000).toFixed(2)} km`
      : '0.20 km';

  const baselineConfidence = Math.round((place.rating ?? 4.0) * 20);

  // Reset state when modal opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      setSelectedResponse(null);
      setSelectedTags([]);
      setComment('');
      setSuccessResult(null);
      setErrorMessage(null);
    }
  }, [isOpen, place.id]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const toggleTag = (tag: string) => {
    if (selectedTags.includes(tag)) {
      setSelectedTags(selectedTags.filter(t => t !== tag));
    } else {
      setSelectedTags([...selectedTags, tag]);
    }
  };

  const handleSelectResponse = async (resp: ValidationResponse) => {
    if (!user && resp !== 'abstain') {
      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
      return;
    }

    setSelectedResponse(resp);
    setSelectedTags([]);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    // If 'abstain', execute immediately and close after 1.2 seconds
    if (resp === 'abstain') {
      setSuccessResult({
        type: 'abstain',
        message: 'Dismissed',
        subtext: 'Thanks for keeping Vibe Validate accurate.',
        points: 0,
        newConfidence: null
      });

      try {
        await submitProximityValidation({
          placeId: place.id,
          placeTitle: place.title,
          placeRating: place.rating,
          userId: user?.id || 'usr_anonymous',
          response: 'abstain',
          userStreak: streak
        });
      } catch {}

      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, 1200);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedResponse || selectedResponse === 'abstain' || submitting) return;

    if (!user) {
      if (onRequireAuth) onRequireAuth();
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setErrorMessage(null);

    try {
      const result = await submitProximityValidation({
        placeId: place.id,
        placeTitle: place.title,
        placeRating: place.rating,
        userId: user.id,
        response: selectedResponse,
        userStreak: streak,
        vibeTags: selectedResponse === 'yes' ? selectedTags : [],
        changeTags: selectedResponse === 'no' ? selectedTags : [],
        comment: comment.trim() || undefined
      });

      if (!result.success) {
        setErrorMessage(result.error || 'Failed to submit verification.');
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      const pointsAwarded = result.rewardPoints;
      setSuccessResult({
        type: selectedResponse,
        message: selectedResponse === 'yes' ? 'Presence Verified!' : 'Situation Report Recorded',
        subtext:
          selectedResponse === 'yes'
            ? `Confidence +15% applied • +${pointsAwarded} PTS credited to your VQ Purse.`
            : `Confidence -25% applied • +${pointsAwarded} PTS credited to your VQ Purse.`,
        points: pointsAwarded,
        newConfidence: result.newConfidence
      });

      if (onValidated) {
        onValidated(result.newConfidence, result.newConfirmationsCount);
      }

      setTimeout(() => {
        onClose();
      }, 1400);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Verification submission error.');
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md animate-fade-in"
    >
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-[#0d111a] border border-neutral-800 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden border-t-4 border-t-emerald-400">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-5 border-b border-neutral-800/80">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 rounded-2xl border border-emerald-500/30">
              <Shield className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black text-white tracking-wide">
                Vibe Validate Spot
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 truncate max-w-[280px]">
                Real-world crowd verification for <span className="text-neutral-200 font-semibold">{place.title}</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close vibe validate modal"
            className="p-2 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-neutral-800 transition cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Live Presence Status Badges */}
        <div className="px-5 py-3 bg-neutral-900/60 border-b border-neutral-800/80 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-neutral-300">
              <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-orange-400" />
              <span>{distanceDisplay} away</span>
            </span>
            <span
              className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider ${
                isWithin200m
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40'
                  : 'bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 border border-neutral-700'
              }`}
            >
              {isWithin200m ? '📍 Within 200m Verified' : '📍 Proximity Sensor Active'}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-400 font-bold text-xs">
            <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Streak {streak}x ({multiplier.toFixed(1)}x Multiplier)</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div className="p-5 space-y-5">
          {errorMessage && (
            <div className="p-3 text-xs bg-red-950/60 border border-red-500/40 text-red-200 rounded-2xl flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 shrink-0" />
              <span>{errorMessage}</span>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Success / Auto-dismiss Card */}
          {successResult ? (
            <div className="p-6 text-center space-y-3 bg-neutral-900/80 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-800 animate-fadeIn">
              <div
                className={`w-14 h-14 mx-auto rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border ${
                  successResult.type === 'yes'
                    ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/40'
                    : successResult.type === 'no'
                    ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/40'
                    : 'bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 border-neutral-700'
                }`}
              >
                {successResult.type === 'yes' ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8" />
                ) : successResult.type === 'no' ? (
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8" />
                ) : (
                  <XCircle className="w-8 h-8" />
                )}
              </div>
              <h4 className="text-lg font-black text-white">{successResult.message}</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 max-w-sm mx-auto leading-relaxed">
                {successResult.subtext}
              </p>
              {successResult.points > 0 && (
                <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 text-xs font-black border border-amber-500/30">
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>+{successResult.points} PTS Awarded</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {/* Core Prompt Box: ARE YOU HERE RIGHT NOW? */}
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <h4 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-300">
                    ARE YOU HERE RIGHT NOW?
                  </h4>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-neutral-500">
                    Baseline from rating: {baselineConfidence}%
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* 3 Response Cards */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
                  {/* Option 1: YES */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSelectResponse('yes')}
                    className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-left transition cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2 group active:scale-95 ${
                      selectedResponse === 'yes'
                        ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-950/50 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/20 ring-1 ring-emerald-500'
                        : 'border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-950/20 hover:border-emerald-500/60 hover:bg-emerald-950/30'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <CheckCircle2
                        className={`w-5 h-5 ${
                          selectedResponse === 'yes' ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-emerald-500/70'
                        }`}
                      />
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-emerald-500/20">
                        +15%
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="text-sm font-black text-white">Yes</div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-emerald-300/80 font-medium">Matches reality</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 pt-1 border-t border-emerald-500/20">
                      Earn <strong className="text-emerald-300">+{yesReward} PTS</strong>
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {/* Option 2: NO */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSelectResponse('no')}
                    className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border text-left transition cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2 group active:scale-95 ${
                      selectedResponse === 'no'
                        ? 'border-amber-500 bg-amber-950/50 shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/20 ring-1 ring-amber-500'
                        : 'border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-950/20 hover:border-amber-500/60 hover:bg-amber-950/30'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <AlertTriangle
                        className={`w-5 h-5 ${
                          selectedResponse === 'no' ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-amber-500/70'
                        }`}
                      />
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-400 bg-rose-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-rose-500/20">
                        -25%
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="text-sm font-black text-white">No</div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-300/80 font-medium">Something changed</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 pt-1 border-t border-amber-500/20">
                      Earn <strong className="text-amber-300">+{noReward} PTS</strong>
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {/* Option 3: NOT HERE / ABSTAIN */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSelectResponse('abstain')}
                    className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-900/40 hover:border-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-900/70 text-left transition cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2 group active:scale-95"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-neutral-400" />
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-neutral-500 bg-neutral-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md">
                        Abstain
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="text-sm font-black text-white">Not here</div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 font-medium">Abstain from voting</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 pt-1 border-t border-neutral-800">
                      0 PTS • Auto-dismiss
                    </div>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Detail Enrichment (Shown when Yes or No is selected) */}
              {selectedResponse === 'yes' && (
                <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-4 bg-neutral-900/60 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-800 space-y-3.5 animate-fadeIn">
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Live Situation Pills (1-Tap Selection)</span>
                    </label>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                      {YES_LIVE_TAGS.map((tag) => {
                        const isSelected = selectedTags.includes(tag);
                        return (
                          <button
                            key={tag}
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => toggleTag(tag)}
                            className={`text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl border font-semibold transition cursor-pointer ${
                              isSelected
                                ? 'bg-emerald-500/20 border-emerald-400 text-emerald-300 shadow-sm'
                                : 'bg-neutral-950/60 border-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {tag}
                          </button>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-400">
                      Live Field Note (Optional)
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={comment}
                      onChange={(e) => setComment(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="e.g. Plenty of open tables, great music playlist..."
                      maxLength={120}

                                ? 'bg-amber-500/20 border-amber-400 text-amber-300 shadow-sm'
                                : 'bg-neutral-950/60 border-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {tag}

                        );
                      })}

                    <label className="text-[11px] font-bold text-neutral-400">
                      What is the situation? (Optional)
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={comment}
                      onChange={(e) => setComment(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="e.g. Venue closed for private event today..."
                      maxLength={120}
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500"

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { UserProfile, getCurrentUserProfile, subscribeAuthProfile } from '../domains/d01_auth';

interface UserContextValue {
  user: UserProfile | null;
  loading: boolean;
  refreshUser: () => Promise<void>;
}

const UserContext = createContext<UserContextValue>({
  user: null,
  loading: true,
  refreshUser: async () => {}
});

export const UserProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<UserProfile | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const refreshUser = async () => {
    try {
      const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile();
      setUser(profile);
    } catch {
      setUser(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    refreshUser();
    const unsubscribe = subscribeAuthProfile((profile) => {
      setUser(profile);
      setLoading(false);
    });
    return () => unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  return (
    <UserContext.Provider value={{ user, loading, refreshUser }}>
      {children}
    </UserContext.Provider>
  );
};

export function useUser(): UserContextValue {
  const context = useContext(UserContext);
  // Also provide fallback if used outside UserProvider
  const [fallbackUser, setFallbackUser] = useState<UserProfile | null>(context.user);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!context.user) {
      subscribeAuthProfile(setFallbackUser);
    }
  }, [context.user]);

  if (context.user) {
    return context;
  }

  return {
    user: fallbackUser,
    loading: false,
    refreshUser: async () => {
      const p = await getCurrentUserProfile();
      setFallbackUser(p);
    }
  };
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { UserProfile, ProfileRegistration, RegistrationResult, ProfileEdits } from './types';
import { queuePendingProfileAvatar, uploadPendingProfileAvatar, uploadProfileAvatar } from '../../lib/profileAvatar';

type ProfileRow = Record<string, unknown>;

async function linkedProfile(authId: string): Promise<UserProfile | null> {
  let row: ProfileRow | null = null;
  for (const id of ['usr_' + authId, authId]) {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', id).maybeSingle();
    if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
    if (data) { row = data; break; }
  }
  if (!row) {
    const { data: link, error } = await supabase.from('s00_test_identity_links')
      .select('legacy_profile_id').eq('auth_user_id', authId).maybeSingle();
    if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
    if (link) {
      const found = await supabase.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', link.legacy_profile_id).maybeSingle();
      if (found.error) throw new Error(found.error.message);
      row = found.data;
    }
  }
  if (!row) return null;
  const { data: admin, error: adminError } = await supabase.from('vq_admin_assignments')
    .select('role').eq('auth_user_id', authId).eq('active', true).maybeSingle();
  if (adminError) throw new Error(adminError.message);
  const { data: prefs, error: preferencesError } = await supabase.from('profile_preferences')
    .select('telegram_handle,x_handle,preferred_contact_method,cozy_diary_mode')
    .eq('profile_id', String(row.id)).maybeSingle();
  if (preferencesError) throw new Error(preferencesError.message);
  let photo = String(row.photo_url || '');
  try {
    const pending = await uploadPendingProfileAvatar(authId, String(row.id));
    if (pending) photo = pending;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Pending avatar upload failed:', error);
  }
  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    username: String(row.handle || ''),
    full_name: String(row.display_name || row.handle || ''),
    avatar_url: photo,
    bio: String(row.bio || ''),
    district: String(row.city || ''),
    city: String(row.city || ''),
    interests: Array.isArray(row.interests) ? row.interests : [],
    languages: Array.isArray(row.languages) ? row.languages : [],
    xHandle: String(prefs?.x_handle || ''),
    telegramHandle: String(prefs?.telegram_handle || ''),
    contactMethod: String(prefs?.preferred_contact_method || 'none'),
    cozyDiaryMode: Boolean(prefs?.cozy_diary_mode),
    accountType: String(row.account_type || 'vibe'),
    vq_balance: Number(row.points || 0),
    streaks: Number(row.streaks ?? 0),
    reputation: 0,
    role: admin?.role === 'platform_admin' ? 'admin' : row.account_type === 'pro' ? 'guardian' : 'explorer',
    created_at: String(row.created_at || ''),
  };
}

export async function getCurrentUserProfile(): Promise<UserProfile | null> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (error || !data.user) return null;
  return linkedProfile(data.user.id);
}

/** Use VQgemini's real email or @username Supabase authentication paths. */
export async function signInWithEmail(identifier: string, password: string): Promise<UserProfile> {
  const value = identifier.trim();
  if (!value || !password) throw new Error('Email or @username and password are required.');
  if (value.includes('@') && !value.startsWith('@')) {
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email: value, password });
    if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
  } else {
    const username = value.replace(/^@/, '').toLowerCase();
    if (!/^[a-z0-9_]{3,32}$/.test(username)) throw new Error('Invalid username.');
    const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('sign-in-by-username', { body: { username, password } });
    if (error || !data?.access_token || !data?.refresh_token) {
      throw new Error('Invalid username or password, or username sign-in is unavailable.');
    }
    const { error: sessionError } = await supabase.auth.setSession({
      access_token: data.access_token, refresh_token: data.refresh_token,
    });
    if (sessionError) throw new Error(sessionError.message);
  }
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (error || !data.user) throw new Error('Authenticated session could not be verified.');
  const profile = await linkedProfile(data.user.id);
  if (!profile) {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    throw new Error('Your account exists but its profile is not linked or recognized. Contact the administrator.');
  }
  return profile;
}

/**
 * Keep the UI synchronized with real Supabase login/logout and token sessions.
 * The callback receives null for signed-out users, never a manufactured guest.
 */
export function subscribeAuthProfile(onChange: (profile: UserProfile | null) => void): () => void {
  let active = true;
  let generation = 0;
  async function refresh() {
    const currentGeneration = ++generation;
    try {
      const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile();
      if (active && currentGeneration === generation) onChange(profile);
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('Authenticated profile refresh failed:', error);
      if (active && currentGeneration === generation) onChange(null);
    }
  }
  const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
    if (!session) {
      generation++;
      if (active) onChange(null);
    } else {
      // Run outside the auth state callback to avoid nested auth-client deadlocks.
      Promise.resolve().then(() => { if (active) void refresh(); });
    }
  });
  void refresh();
  return () => {
    active = false;
    generation++;
    subscription.unsubscribe();
  };
}


/** Same profile-provisioning contract and verification handoff as VQgemini. */
export async function registerProfile(data: ProfileRegistration): Promise<RegistrationResult> {
  const handle = data.handle.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^@/, '');
  const displayName = data.displayName.trim();
  const email = data.email.trim();
  if (!/^[a-z0-9_]{3,32}$/.test(handle)) throw new Error('Choose a username of 3–32 letters, numbers or underscores.');
  if (!displayName || displayName.length > 80) throw new Error('Display name must be 1–80 characters.');
  if (!email || !data.password || data.password.length < 8) throw new Error('Email and password of at least 8 characters are required.');
  if (data.cozyDiaryMode && (!data.bio?.trim() || !data.city?.trim() ||
    !(data.telegramHandle?.trim() || data.xHandle?.trim()))) {
    throw new Error('Cozy Diary Mode requires a bio, broad city and at least one contact handle.');
  }
  const { data: existing, error: lookupError } = await supabase.from('profiles')
    .select('id').ilike('handle', handle).maybeSingle();
  if (lookupError) throw new Error('Could not verify username availability.');
  if (existing) throw new Error('Username is already taken.');
  const { data: signup, error: signupError } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
    email, password: data.password,
    options: {
      emailRedirectTo: window.location.origin + '/',
      data: {
        handle, display_name: displayName, photo_url: data.photoUrl || '',
        bio: data.bio || '', city: data.city || '', interests: data.interests || [],
        languages: data.languages || [],
        telegram_handle: data.telegramHandle || '', x_handle: data.xHandle || '',
        preferred_contact_method: data.contactMethod || 'none',
        cozy_diary_mode: Boolean(data.cozyDiaryMode),
      },
    },
  });
  if (signupError) throw new Error(signupError.message);
  if (!signup.user) throw new Error('Account creation failed.');
  if (!signup.session) {
    let avatarUploadNote: string | undefined;
    if (data.avatarFile) {
      try { await queuePendingProfileAvatar(signup.user.id, data.avatarFile); }
      catch {
        avatarUploadNote = 'Account created, but the selected photo could not be retained. Upload after verifying your email.';
      }
    }
    return { pendingVerification: true, email, avatarUploadNote };
  }
  const profile = await linkedProfile(signup.user.id);
  if (!profile) throw new Error('Account created, but profile provisioning is pending.');
  let avatarUploadNote: string | undefined;
  if (data.avatarFile) {
    try {
      profile.avatar_url = await uploadProfileAvatar(data.avatarFile, profile.id);
    } catch (error) {
      avatarUploadNote = 'Your account is ready, but photo upload failed. Try Edit Profile.';
      console.warn('Avatar upload failed:', error);
    }
  }
  return { pendingVerification: false, profile, avatarUploadNote };
}

/** Persist edits to canonical profile and private preferences, never local state only. */
export async function updateExistingProfile(profile: UserProfile, edits: ProfileEdits): Promise<UserProfile> {
  const { data: auth, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (authError || !auth.user) throw new Error('Sign in to edit your profile.');
  const current = await linkedProfile(auth.user.id);
  if (!current || current.id !== profile.id) throw new Error('This profile is not linked to your account.');
  const fields: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (edits.displayName !== undefined) {
    const name = edits.displayName.trim();
    if (!name || name.length > 80) throw new Error('Display name must be 1–80 characters.');
    fields.display_name = name;
  }
  if (edits.bio !== undefined) {
    if (edits.bio.length > 280) throw new Error('Bio must not exceed 280 characters.');
    fields.bio = edits.bio.trim();
  }
  if (edits.city !== undefined) {
    if (edits.city.length > 100) throw new Error('City must not exceed 100 characters.');
    fields.city = edits.city.trim();
  }
  if (edits.interests !== undefined) {
    if (edits.interests.length > 30 || edits.interests.some(t => !t.trim() || t.length > 60)) {
      throw new Error('Choose up to 30 valid interests.');
    }
    fields.interests = [...new Set(edits.interests.map(t => t.toLowerCase().trim()))];
  }
  if (edits.languages !== undefined) fields.languages = edits.languages;
  const telegram = edits.telegramHandle ?? current.telegramHandle ?? '';
  const xHandle = edits.xHandle ?? current.xHandle ?? '';
  const contact = edits.contactMethod ?? current.contactMethod ?? 'none';
  const cozy = edits.cozyDiaryMode ?? current.cozyDiaryMode ?? false;
  if (telegram.length > 64 || xHandle.length > 64) throw new Error('Contact handle is too long.');
  if (!['none','telegram','x','email'].includes(contact)) throw new Error('Invalid contact preference.');
  if (cozy && (!(String(fields.bio ?? current.bio ?? '')).trim() ||
    !(String(fields.city ?? current.city ?? '')).trim() || !(telegram.trim() || xHandle.trim()))) {
    throw new Error('Cozy Diary Mode requires bio, city and a contact handle.');
  }
  if (typeof edits.photoUrl === 'string') fields.photo_url = edits.photoUrl.trim();
  if (edits.avatarFile) fields.photo_url = await uploadProfileAvatar(edits.avatarFile, current.id);
  if (Object.keys(fields).length > 0) {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('profiles').update(fields).eq('id', current.id).select('id').maybeSingle();
    if (error || !data) throw new Error(error?.message || 'Profile update did not persist.');
  }
  if (['telegramHandle','xHandle','contactMethod','cozyDiaryMode'].some(
    key => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(edits, key))) {
    const { data: existing, error: lookupError } = await supabase.from('profile_preferences')
      .select('profile_id').eq('profile_id', current.id).maybeSingle();
    if (lookupError) throw new Error(lookupError.message);
    const privateFields = {
      telegram_handle: telegram.trim(), x_handle: xHandle.trim(),
      preferred_contact_method: contact, cozy_diary_mode: cozy,
    };
    const response = existing
      ? await supabase.from('profile_preferences').update(privateFields).eq('profile_id', current.id)
      : await supabase.from('profile_preferences').insert({ profile_id: current.id, ...privateFields });
    if (response.error) throw new Error(response.error.message);
  }
  const updated = await linkedProfile(auth.user.id);
  if (!updated) throw new Error('Profile saved but could not be reloaded.');
  return updated;
}

export async function signInWithGoogle(): Promise<void> {
  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
    provider: 'google', options: { redirectTo: window.location.origin },
  });
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
}

export async function signOutUser(): Promise<void> {
  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signOut();
  if (error) throw new Error(error.message);
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { Guardian, UserProfile } from './types';

/** Hydrate actual published Supabase profile records without invented values. */
function fromProfile(row: Record<string, unknown>): UserProfile {
  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    username: String(row.handle || ''),
    full_name: String(row.display_name || row.handle || ''),
    avatar_url: typeof row.photo_url === 'string' ? row.photo_url : '',
    bio: typeof row.bio === 'string' ? row.bio : '',
    city: typeof row.city === 'string' ? row.city : '',
    district: typeof row.city === 'string' ? row.city : '',
    interests: Array.isArray(row.interests) ? row.interests as string[] : [],
    vq_balance: Number(row.points ?? 0),
    reputation: 0,
    role: row.account_type === 'pro' ? 'guardian' : 'explorer',
    created_at: String(row.created_at || ''),
  };
}

export async function fetchDemoProfiles(): Promise<UserProfile[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('*')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true });
  if (error) { console.warn('Unable to read public profiles:', error.message); return []; }
  return (data || []).map(fromProfile);
}

export async function fetchPublicProfile(userId: string): Promise<UserProfile | null> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('profiles')
    .select('*').eq('id', userId).maybeSingle();
  if (error) { console.warn('Unable to read profile:', error.message); return null; }
  return data ? fromProfile(data) : null;
}

export async function fetchPublicProfileByHandle(handle: string): Promise<UserProfile | null> {
  const cleanHandle = handle.replace(/^@/, '').trim();
  if (!cleanHandle) return null;
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('profiles')
    .select('*').ilike('handle', cleanHandle).maybeSingle();
  if (error) { console.warn('Unable to read profile by handle:', error.message); return null; }
  return data ? fromProfile(data) : null;
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { UserProfile } from '../d02_users';
import { SocialFollowResult } from './types';

export async function followUser(followerId: string, targetUserId: string): Promise<SocialFollowResult> {
  if (!followerId) {
    return { success: false, following: false, error: 'Guests must authenticate before protected social actions.' };
  }
  if (followerId === targetUserId) {
    return { success: false, following: false, error: 'Users cannot ECHO themselves.' };
  }

  try {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('follows')
      .insert([{ follower_id: followerId, following_id: targetUserId, created_at: new Date().toISOString() }]);

    if (error) {
      console.warn('Supabase follow error:', error);
      return { success: false, following: false, error: error.message };
    }
    return { success: true, following: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, following: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to ECHO user' };
  }
}

export async function unfollowUser(followerId: string, targetUserId: string): Promise<SocialFollowResult> {
  if (!followerId) {
    return { success: false, following: true, error: 'Guests must authenticate before protected social actions.' };
  }

  try {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('follows')
      .delete()
      .eq('follower_id', followerId)
      .eq('following_id', targetUserId);

    if (error) {
      console.warn('Supabase unfollow error:', error);
      return { success: false, following: true, error: error.message };
    }
    return { success: true, following: false };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, following: true, error: err?.message || 'Failed to remove from Orbit' };
  }
}

export async function checkIsFollowing(followerId: string, targetUserId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!followerId || !targetUserId || followerId === targetUserId) return false;
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('follows')
      .select('id')
      .eq('follower_id', followerId)
      .eq('following_id', targetUserId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!error && data) return true;
    return false;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function fetchOrbitProfiles(userId: string): Promise<UserProfile[]> {
  if (!userId) return [];
  try {
    const { data: followRows, error } = await supabase
      .from('follows')
      .select('following_id')
      .eq('follower_id', userId);

    if (error || !followRows || followRows.length === 0) return [];
    const followingIds = followRows.map((r: any) => r.following_id);

    const { data: profiles, error: profErr } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('*')
      .in('id', followingIds);

      vq_balance: row.vq_balance || 0,
      reputation: row.reputation || 0,

      tier: row.tier || 'EXPLORER',
      trust_score: row.trust_score || 90,
      created_at: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()
    }));
