import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import {
  VibePlace,
  VibeCategory,
  DeviceLocationState,
  UserCoordinates
} from './types';

export const DISCOVERY_RADIUS_METERS = 8000; // 8 km leisure discovery scope

/**
 * Calculates great-circle distance between two coordinates in meters (Haversine formula).
 */
export function calculateDistanceMeters(
  lat1: number,
  lon1: number,
  lat2: number,
  lon2: number
): number {
  const R = 6371e3; // Earth radius in meters
  const φ1 = (lat1 * Math.PI) / 180;
  const φ2 = (lat2 * Math.PI) / 180;
  const Δφ = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const Δλ = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;

  const a =
    Math.sin(Δφ / 2) * Math.sin(Δφ / 2) +
    Math.cos(φ1) * Math.cos(φ2) * Math.sin(Δλ / 2) * Math.sin(Δλ / 2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));

  return Math.round(R * c);
}

/**
 * Requests device location once via navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition.
 */
export function getDeviceLocation(): Promise<DeviceLocationState> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator.geolocation) {
      resolve({
        status: 'unavailable',
        coords: null,
        error: 'Geolocation is not supported by your browser or environment.'
      });
      return;
    }

    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (position) => {
        resolve({
          status: 'granted',
          coords: {
            lat: position.coords.latitude,
            lng: position.coords.longitude,
            accuracy: position.coords.accuracy
          }
        });
      },
      (error) => {
        let status: DeviceLocationState['status'] = 'unavailable';
        let errorMsg = 'Unable to determine your position.';

        if (error.code === error.PERMISSION_DENIED) {
          status = 'denied';
          errorMsg = 'Location permission was denied. Please allow location access in your browser settings to enable proximity discovery.';
        } else if (error.code === error.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE) {
          status = 'unavailable';
          errorMsg = 'GPS sensor or location provider is unavailable.';
        } else if (error.code === error.TIMEOUT) {
          status = 'unavailable';
          errorMsg = 'Location acquisition timed out.';
        }

        resolve({
          status,
          coords: null,
          error: errorMsg
        });
      },
      {
        enableHighAccuracy: true,
        timeout: 10000,
        maximumAge: 30000
      }
    );
  });
}

/**
 * Continuously watches device location changes and informs subscriber.
 */
export function watchDeviceLocation(
  onUpdate: (state: DeviceLocationState) => void
): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator.geolocation) {
    onUpdate({
      status: 'unavailable',
      coords: null,
      error: 'Geolocation is not supported by this browser.'
    });
    return () => {};
  }

  const watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(
    (position) => {
      onUpdate({
        status: 'granted',
        coords: {
          lat: position.coords.latitude,
          lng: position.coords.longitude,
          accuracy: position.coords.accuracy
        }
      });
    },
    (error) => {
      let status: DeviceLocationState['status'] = 'unavailable';
      let errorMsg = 'Location error occurred.';

      if (error.code === error.PERMISSION_DENIED) {
        status = 'denied';
        errorMsg = 'Location access denied by user.';
      } else if (error.code === error.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE) {
        status = 'unavailable';
        errorMsg = 'Location signal currently unavailable.';
      } else if (error.code === error.TIMEOUT) {
        status = 'unavailable';
        errorMsg = 'Location request timed out.';
      }

      onUpdate({
        status,
        coords: null,
        error: errorMsg
      });
    },
    {
      enableHighAccuracy: true,
      timeout: 15000,
      maximumAge: 10000
    }
  );

  return () => {
    navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(watchId);
  };
}

/**
 * Public domain API: Fetches real nearby places from the Supabase Edge Function 'nearby-places'
 * which queries the Google Places API server-side using GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY.
 *
 * Rules:
 * - Real data only. No mocks. No hardcoded place arrays.
 * - If Google returns nothing or fails, returns an empty array [].
 * - Uses the returned photo URL. Do not invent ratings.
 * - Preserves server's Google Relevance/Rating-first, Distance-second sort order.
 * - In-app checkins_count and confirmations_count are never aliased from Google reviews_count.
 */
export async function fetchNearbyPlaces(
  coords: UserCoordinates | null,
  category?: VibeCategory | 'All'
): Promise<VibePlace[]> {
  let targetCoords = coords;

  // If coordinates are not provided, attempt to acquire real device GPS once
  if (!targetCoords || isNaN(targetCoords.lat) || isNaN(targetCoords.lng)) {
    const locState = await getDeviceLocation();
    if (locState.status === 'granted' && locState.coords) {
      targetCoords = locState.coords;
    }
  }

  // Without coordinates, do not fabricate locations: return empty array
  if (!targetCoords || isNaN(targetCoords.lat) || isNaN(targetCoords.lng)) {
    return [];
  }

  try {
    const selectedCategory = category || 'All';
    const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke('nearby-places', {
      body: {
        lat: targetCoords.lat,
        lng: targetCoords.lng,
        radius: DISCOVERY_RADIUS_METERS,
        category: selectedCategory
      }
    });

    if (error || !data || !Array.isArray(data.places)) {
      if (error) {
        console.warn('Error invoking nearby-places Edge Function:', error);
      }
      return [];
    }

    // Preserve the server's Google Relevance/Rating-first, Distance-second sort order.
    // Keep in-app checkins_count / confirmations_count strictly separate from Google reviews_count.
    const places: VibePlace[] = data.places.map((p: any) => {
      const dist =
        typeof p.distance_meters === 'number'
          ? p.distance_meters
          : calculateDistanceMeters(targetCoords!.lat, targetCoords!.lng, p.lat, p.lng);
      return {
        ...p,
        distance_meters: dist,
        distance_km: Number((dist / 1000).toFixed(2)),
        reviews_count: typeof p.reviews_count === 'number' ? p.reviews_count : undefined,
        checkins_count: typeof p.checkins_count === 'number' ? p.checkins_count : undefined,
        confirmations_count: typeof p.confirmations_count === 'number' ? p.confirmations_count : undefined
      };
    });

    return places;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('fetchNearbyPlaces failure:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Backward-compatible alias for fetchNearbyPlaces.
 */
export const fetchNearbyVibePlaces = fetchNearbyPlaces;

/**
 * Backward-compatible function querying real nearby places.
 */
export async function fetchVibePlaces(category?: VibeCategory): Promise<VibePlace[]> {
  return fetchNearbyPlaces(null, category);
}

/**
 * VibeQuest Gamification Domain API (Mayor & Badges - ES-011)
 * Manages verified venue Mayorship and the 5 canonical achievement badges:
 * 1. Caffeine Fiend (3 Cozy/Café/Bakery check-ins)
 * 2. Gourmet Scout (2 Chilled/Food/Restaurant check-ins)
 * 3. Night Mayor (2 Hype/Night Owl/Bar check-ins)
 * 4. Culture Vulture (2 Quiet/Culture & Art check-ins)
 * 5. Vibe Vanguard (5 distinct verified venue check-ins)
 */

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';

export interface VenueMayorState {
  mayorUserId?: string;
  mayorName?: string;
  mayorAvatar?: string;
  mayorCheckinsCount: number;
  leaderboard: { userId: string; name: string; avatar?: string; checkinsCount: number }[];
}

export interface VibeQuestBadgeDefinition {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon: string;
  description: string;
  targetCount: number;
  currentCount: number;
  isUnlocked: boolean;
}

/**
 * Computes venue Mayorship and check-in leaderboard for a spot.
 */
export async function getVenueMayorState(placeId: string): Promise<VenueMayorState> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('place_checkins')
      .select('*')
      .eq('place_id', placeId);

    if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {
      const countsMap = new Map<string, { count: number; name: string; avatar?: string }>();
      data.forEach((row: any) => {
        const uid = String(row.user_id || 'usr_anonymous');
        const existing = countsMap.get(uid) || { count: 0, name: row.user_name || 'Explorer', avatar: row.user_avatar };
        existing.count += 1;
        countsMap.set(uid, existing);
      });

      const leaderboard = Array.from(countsMap.entries())
        .map(([userId, info]) => ({
          userId,
          name: info.name,
          avatar: info.avatar,
          checkinsCount: info.count
        }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.checkinsCount - a.checkinsCount);

      if (leaderboard.length === 0) {
        return { mayorCheckinsCount: 0, leaderboard: [] };
      }

      const top = leaderboard[0];
      return {
        mayorUserId: top.userId,
        mayorName: top.name,
        mayorAvatar: top.avatar,
        mayorCheckinsCount: top.checkinsCount,
        leaderboard
      };
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error fetching venue mayor state:', err);
  }

  return { mayorCheckinsCount: 0, leaderboard: [] };
}

  return [

/**
 * Deterministic AI Vibe Match Scoring Engine
 * Computes genuine compatibility between a VibePlace and the user's real profile,
 * hobbies, search queries, category habits, and physical proximity.
 */

import { VibePlace } from './types';
import { UserProfile } from '../d01_auth';
import { UserSearchHistory, getSearchHistory } from './searchHistory';

export interface MatchBreakdownRow {
  label: string;
  delta: string;
  points: number;
}

export interface MatchScoreResult {
  score: number;
  breakdown: MatchBreakdownRow[];
}

export function computeAiVibeMatch(
  place: VibePlace,
  user: UserProfile | null,
  historyInput?: UserSearchHistory,
  savedTrailCount: number = 0
): MatchScoreResult {
  const history = historyInput || getSearchHistory();
  const breakdown: MatchBreakdownRow[] = [];
  let totalScore = 0;

  // 1. FACTOR 1: Profile Interests & Hobbies Alignment (Max 35 pts)
  const userInterests = (user?.interests || []).map(i => i.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
  const placeTokens = [
    place.category.toLowerCase(),
    ...place.title.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/),
    ...(place.address || '').toLowerCase().split(/\s+/)
  ];

  const matchedInterests: string[] = [];
  userInterests.forEach(interest => {
    if (
      placeTokens.some(token => token.includes(interest) || interest.includes(token)) ||
      (interest.includes('coffee') && (place.category === 'Food' || place.title.toLowerCase().includes('café') || place.title.toLowerCase().includes('cafe'))) ||
      (interest.includes('art') && (place.category === 'Art' || place.category === 'Culture')) ||
      (interest.includes('night') && place.category === 'Night Owl') ||
      (interest.includes('food') && place.category === 'Food') ||
      (interest.includes('culture') && place.category === 'Culture')
    ) {
      matchedInterests.push(interest);
    }
  });

  if (matchedInterests.length > 0) {
    const interestPoints = Math.min(35, 18 + (matchedInterests.length - 1) * 8);
    totalScore += interestPoints;
    breakdown.push({
      label: `Interest Alignment (${matchedInterests.slice(0, 2).join(', ')})`,
      delta: `+${interestPoints}%`,
      points: interestPoints
    });
  } else if (userInterests.length > 0) {
    // User has interests, but no direct keyword hit for this place
    totalScore += 12;
    breakdown.push({
      label: 'Interest Alignment (Curated District Sync)',
      delta: '+12%',
      points: 12
    });
  } else {
    // Unauthenticated or profile without interests configured
    totalScore += 10;
    breakdown.push({
      label: 'Interest Alignment (Baseline Discovery)',
      delta: '+10%',
      points: 10
    });
  }

  // 2. FACTOR 2: Search History & Category Habit Affinity (Max 30 pts)
  const categoryClicks = history.categoryClicks[place.category] || 0;
  const categoryCheckins = history.checkedInCategories[place.category] || 0;
  const recentSearches = history.searchQueries;

  let searchResonance = false;
  if (recentSearches.length > 0) {
    searchResonance = recentSearches.some(query =>
      place.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) || place.category.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
  }

  let habitPoints = 0;
  if (searchResonance) {
    habitPoints = Math.min(28, 16 + Math.min(12, categoryClicks * 2));
    totalScore += habitPoints;
    breakdown.push({
      label: `Search History & Habit Resonance (${place.category})`,
      delta: `+${habitPoints}%`,
      points: habitPoints
    });
  } else if (categoryClicks > 0 || categoryCheckins > 0) {
    habitPoints = Math.min(22, 10 + categoryClicks * 2 + categoryCheckins * 4);
    totalScore += habitPoints;
    breakdown.push({
      label: `Category Habit Affinity (${place.category} Explorer)`,
      delta: `+${habitPoints}%`,
      points: habitPoints
    });
  } else if (savedTrailCount > 0) {
    habitPoints = Math.min(15, 8 + savedTrailCount * 2);
    totalScore += habitPoints;
    breakdown.push({
      label: 'Curated Trail Trailhead Alignment',
      delta: `+${habitPoints}%`,
      points: habitPoints
    });
  } else {
    habitPoints = 8;
    totalScore += habitPoints;
    breakdown.push({
      label: 'Stable Base Signal',
      delta: '+8%',
      points: habitPoints
    });
  }

  // 3. FACTOR 3: Proximity & Local District Sync (Max 20 pts)
  let proximityPoints = 6;
  let proximityLabel = 'Local City Orbit';
  const distKm = place.distance_km ?? (place.distance_meters !== undefined ? place.distance_meters / 1000 : undefined);

  if (distKm !== undefined) {
    if (distKm <= 1.2) {
      proximityPoints = 20;
      proximityLabel = 'Walking Proximity (< 1.2 km)';
    } else if (distKm <= 3.5) {
      proximityPoints = 15;
      proximityLabel = 'Neighborhood Radius (< 3.5 km)';
    } else if (distKm <= 8.0) {
      proximityPoints = 10;
      proximityLabel = 'District Orbit Scope (< 8 km)';
    } else {
      proximityPoints = 5;
      proximityLabel = 'Regional Leisure Range';
    }
  }
  totalScore += proximityPoints;
  breakdown.push({
    label: proximityLabel,
    delta: `+${proximityPoints}%`,
    points: proximityPoints
  });

  // 4. FACTOR 4: Quality & Community Crowd Signal (Max 15 pts)
  let crowdPoints = 5;
  const rating = place.rating;
  if (rating !== undefined && rating >= 4.6) {
    crowdPoints = 13;
  } else if (rating !== undefined && rating >= 4.2) {
    crowdPoints = 10;
  } else if (rating !== undefined && rating >= 3.8) {
    crowdPoints = 7;
  }

  if (place.open_now === true) {
    crowdPoints = Math.min(15, crowdPoints + 2);
  }

  totalScore += crowdPoints;
  breakdown.push({
    label: rating ? `Community Quality Rating (★${rating.toFixed(1)})` : 'Verified Spot Signal',
    delta: `+${crowdPoints}%`,
    points: crowdPoints
  });

  // Clamp total between 25% and 98%
  const finalScore = Math.min(98, Math.max(25, totalScore));

  return {
    score: finalScore,
    breakdown
  };
}

/**
 * Strict 33-Meter GPS Presence & LiveCheck Receipt Verification Engine
 * Enforces MAX_PRESENCE_METERS = 33, real-time device GPS coordinates,
 * LiveCheck camera receipt verification (+500 VQ reward),
 * 12-hour anti-farm cooldown, and User Profile Check-in & Status Badge Progression.
 */

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { executeVqTransfer } from '../d06_purse';
import { recordPlaceCheckin, getActivePlacePromotion, fetchPromotionForPlace } from './promotions';

// STRICT 33-METER GEOFENCE
export const MAX_PRESENCE_METERS = 33;

export interface Coordinates {
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  accuracy?: number;
}

export interface UserExplorationStatus {
  totalCheckins: number;
  tier: 'Newcomer' | 'Wanderer' | 'Explorer' | 'Pathfinder' | 'Vibe Legend';
  categoryBreakdown: Record<string, number>;
  earnedBadges: { id: string; label: string; icon: string; description: string }[];
}

export interface LiveCheckReceiptPayload {
  placeId: string;
  placeTitle: string;
  placeCategory?: string;
  userId: string;
  userCoords: Coordinates;
  placeCoords: { lat: number; lng: number };
  receiptImageData: string; // Base64 data URL from live HTML5 canvas capture
}

export interface LiveCheckReceiptResult {
  success: boolean;
  distanceMeters: number;
  isWithin33m: boolean;
  vqEarned: number;
  newPlaceCheckinsCount: number;
  userStatus: UserExplorationStatus;
  error?: string;
}

const RECEIPT_COOLDOWN_KEY = 'vq_livecheck_receipt_cooldowns';
const USER_CHECKIN_STATS_KEY = 'vq_user_checkin_stats';

/**
 * Computes exact Haversine distance in meters between two lat/lng coordinates.
 */
export function calculateHaversineMeters(
  lat1: number,
  lon1: number,
  lat2: number,
  lon2: number
): number {
  const R = 6371000; // Earth radius in meters
  const toRad = (deg: number) => (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLat = toRad(lat2 - lat1);
  const dLon = toRad(lon2 - lon1);
  const a =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2) +
    Math.cos(toRad(lat1)) * Math.cos(toRad(lat2)) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) * Math.sin(dLon / 2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return Math.round(R * c);
}

export const calculateDistanceMeters = calculateHaversineMeters;

/**
 * Acquires fresh, high-accuracy GPS coordinates from the device.
 */
export async function acquireHighAccuracyPosition(): Promise<Coordinates> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !navigator.geolocation) {
    throw new Error('Geolocation is not supported by your browser or environment.');
  }

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        resolve({
          latitude: pos.coords.latitude,
          longitude: pos.coords.longitude,
          accuracy: pos.coords.accuracy
        });
      },
      (err) => {
        let msg = 'Unable to acquire GPS coordinates.';
        if (err.code === err.PERMISSION_DENIED) {
          msg = 'Location permission was denied. Please allow GPS location to verify presence.';
        } else if (err.code === err.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE) {
          msg = 'GPS signal is currently unavailable.';
        } else if (err.code === err.TIMEOUT) {
          msg = 'GPS acquisition timed out. Please retry in an open area.';
        }
        reject(new Error(msg));
      },
      {
        enableHighAccuracy: true,
        timeout: 10000,
        maximumAge: 0
      }
    );
  });
}

/**
 * Verifies if current device coordinates are within exact 33 meters of a place.
 */
export async function checkPlaceProximity(
  placeLat?: number,
  placeLng?: number
): Promise<{
  distanceMeters: number | null;
  isWithin33m: boolean;
  accuracy?: number;
  userCoords?: Coordinates;
  error?: string;
}> {
  if (placeLat === undefined || placeLng === undefined || isNaN(placeLat) || isNaN(placeLng)) {
    return {
      distanceMeters: null,
      isWithin33m: false,
      error: 'Venue coordinates are unavailable for GPS proximity calculation.'
    };
  }

  try {
    const coords = await acquireHighAccuracyPosition();
    const distanceMeters = calculateHaversineMeters(
      coords.latitude,
      coords.longitude,
      placeLat,
      placeLng
    );
    const isWithin33m = distanceMeters <= MAX_PRESENCE_METERS;
    return {
      distanceMeters,
      isWithin33m,
      accuracy: coords.accuracy,
      userCoords: coords
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return {
      distanceMeters: null,
      isWithin33m: false,
      error: err.message || 'Failed to acquire device GPS position.'
    };
  }
}

// ==========================================
// 12-Hour Anti-Farm Cooldown for Receipts

function getReceiptCooldowns(): Record<string, number> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return {};
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(RECEIPT_COOLDOWN_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function saveReceiptCooldowns(map: Record<string, number>): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(RECEIPT_COOLDOWN_KEY, JSON.stringify(map));
  } catch {}
}

export function hasUserScannedReceiptRecently(placeId: string, userId: string): boolean {
  if (!placeId || !userId) return false;
  const cooldowns = getReceiptCooldowns();
  const key = `${userId}_${placeId}`;
  const lastScanned = cooldowns[key];
  if (!lastScanned) return false;

  const twelveHoursMs = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  return Date.now() - lastScanned < twelveHoursMs;
}

export function recordReceiptScanCooldown(placeId: string, userId: string): void {
  if (!placeId || !userId) return;
  const cooldowns = getReceiptCooldowns();
  const key = `${userId}_${placeId}`;
  cooldowns[key] = Date.now();
  saveReceiptCooldowns(cooldowns);
}

export function computeExplorationTier(
  totalCheckins: number
): 'Newcomer' | 'Wanderer' | 'Explorer' | 'Pathfinder' | 'Vibe Legend' {
  if (totalCheckins <= 0) return 'Newcomer';
  if (totalCheckins <= 2) return 'Wanderer';
  if (totalCheckins <= 7) return 'Explorer';
  if (totalCheckins <= 19) return 'Pathfinder';
  return 'Vibe Legend';
}

export function computeCategoryBadges(
  categoryBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {}
): { id: string; label: string; icon: string; description: string }[] {
  const badges: { id: string; label: string; icon: string; description: string }[] = [];

  const foodCount = (categoryBreakdown['food'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['restaurant'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['cafe'] || 0);
  if (foodCount >= 2) {
    badges.push({
      id: 'foodie',
      label: 'Foodie',
      icon: '🍴',
      description: `${foodCount} food & cafe check-ins`
    });
  }

  const nightCount = (categoryBreakdown['night'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['night owl'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['bar'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['club'] || 0);
  if (nightCount >= 2) {
    badges.push({
      id: 'night_owl',
      label: 'Night Owl',
      icon: '🌙',
      description: `${nightCount} nightlife check-ins`
    });
  }

  const artCount = (categoryBreakdown['art'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['gallery'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['museum'] || 0);
  if (artCount >= 2) {
    badges.push({
      id: 'art_curator',
      label: 'Art Curator',
      icon: '🎨',
      description: `${artCount} art & museum check-ins`
    });
  }

  const cultureCount = (categoryBreakdown['culture'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['heritage'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['historic'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['landmark'] || 0);
  if (cultureCount >= 2) {
    badges.push({
      id: 'culture_seeker',
      label: 'Culture Seeker',
      icon: '🏛️',
      description: `${cultureCount} historic & culture check-ins`
    });
  }

  const spotsCount = (categoryBreakdown['spots'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['spot'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['park'] || 0) + (categoryBreakdown['adventure'] || 0);
  if (spotsCount >= 2) {
    badges.push({
      id: 'trailblazer',
      label: 'Trailblazer',
      icon: '🧭',
      description: `${spotsCount} scenic spot check-ins`
    });
  }

  return badges;
}

export function getUserExplorationStatus(
  totalCheckins: number,
  categoryBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {}
): UserExplorationStatus {
  return {
    totalCheckins,
    tier: computeExplorationTier(totalCheckins),
    categoryBreakdown,
    earnedBadges: computeCategoryBadges(categoryBreakdown)
  };
}

/**
 * Fetches user's current check-in stats and badge progression from storage.
 */
export function fetchUserProfileCheckinStats(userId?: string): UserExplorationStatus {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !userId) {
    return getUserExplorationStatus(0, {});
  }

  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(`${USER_CHECKIN_STATS_KEY}_${userId}`);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      const total = typeof parsed.totalCheckins === 'number' ? parsed.totalCheckins : 0;
      const breakdown = parsed.categoryBreakdown || {};
      return getUserExplorationStatus(total, breakdown);
    }
  } catch {}

  return getUserExplorationStatus(0, {});
}

/**
 * Records a check-in on the user's profile, increments counters, updates badges,
 * and persists to local storage and Supabase.
 */
export async function recordUserProfileCheckin(
  userId: string,
  placeCategory: string = 'Spots'
): Promise<UserExplorationStatus> {
  const current = fetchUserProfileCheckinStats(userId);
  const normCat = placeCategory.toLowerCase().trim();

  const newBreakdown = { ...current.categoryBreakdown };
  newBreakdown[normCat] = (newBreakdown[normCat] || 0) + 1;
  const newTotal = current.totalCheckins + 1;

  const updatedStatus = getUserExplorationStatus(newTotal, newBreakdown);

  // Persist locally
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && userId) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        `${USER_CHECKIN_STATS_KEY}_${userId}`,
        JSON.stringify({
          totalCheckins: newTotal,
          categoryBreakdown: newBreakdown,
          tier: updatedStatus.tier,
          earnedBadges: updatedStatus.earnedBadges
        })
      );
    } catch {}
  }

  // Persist to Supabase profiles table if available
  if (userId && !userId.startsWith('usr_anonymous')) {
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('profiles')
        .update({
          checkins_count: newTotal,
          tier: updatedStatus.tier,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        })
        .eq('id', userId);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Profile check-in count update fallback to local:', err);
    }
  }

  return updatedStatus;
}

// ==========================================
// LiveCheck Camera Receipt Verification Flow
// ==========================================

export async function processLiveCheckReceiptVerification(
  payload: LiveCheckReceiptPayload
): Promise<LiveCheckReceiptResult> {
  const {
    placeId,
    placeTitle,
    placeCategory = 'Spots',
    userId,
    userCoords,
    placeCoords,
    receiptImageData
  } = payload;

  if (!receiptImageData || !receiptImageData.startsWith('data:image/')) {
    return {
      success: false,
      distanceMeters: 9999,
      isWithin33m: false,
      vqEarned: 0,
      newPlaceCheckinsCount: 0,
      userStatus: fetchUserProfileCheckinStats(userId),
      error: 'A live receipt photo captured via LiveCheck camera is required.'
    };
  }

  // Exact 33m check
  const distanceMeters = calculateHaversineMeters(
    userCoords.latitude,
    userCoords.longitude,
    placeCoords.lat,
    placeCoords.lng
  );

  const isWithin33m = distanceMeters <= MAX_PRESENCE_METERS;
  if (!isWithin33m) {
    return {
      success: false,
      distanceMeters,
      isWithin33m: false,
      vqEarned: 0,
      newPlaceCheckinsCount: 0,
      userStatus: fetchUserProfileCheckinStats(userId),
      error: `You are ${distanceMeters}m away from ${placeTitle}. You must be within ${MAX_PRESENCE_METERS} meters to verify receipt.`
    };
  }

  // 12-Hour Cooldown check
  if (hasUserScannedReceiptRecently(placeId, userId)) {
    return {
      success: false,
      distanceMeters,
      isWithin33m: true,
      vqEarned: 0,
      newPlaceCheckinsCount: 0,
      userStatus: fetchUserProfileCheckinStats(userId),
      error: 'Receipt verification is on a 12-hour cooldown for this spot to prevent duplicate scans.'
    };
  }

  // 1. Award +500 VQ: Credit user's purse, deduct from promotion if promoted
  const promo = await fetchPromotionForPlace(placeId);
  const awardAmount = 500;

  // Credit user's Purse
  try {
    await executeVqTransfer({
      toUserId: userId,
      amount: awardAmount,
      type: 'earned',
      description: `LiveCheck Receipt Verified at ${placeTitle} (${distanceMeters}m <= 33m)`
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to credit VQ for receipt:', err);
  }

  // Deduct from promo pool if promoted
  if (promo && promo.remaining_vq_pool >= awardAmount) {
    promo.remaining_vq_pool -= awardAmount;
    if (promo.remaining_vq_pool < promo.reward_per_checkin) {
      promo.status = 'depleted';
    }
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('place_promotions')
        .update({
          remaining_vq_pool: promo.remaining_vq_pool,
          status: promo.status,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        })
        .eq('place_id', placeId);
    } catch {}
  }

  // 2. Record venue check-in
  const checkinResult = await recordPlaceCheckin({
    placeId,
    placeTitle,
    placeCategory,
    userId
  });

  // 3. Record user profile check-in & compute status progression
  const userStatus = await recordUserProfileCheckin(userId, placeCategory);

  // 4. Record 12h cooldown
  recordReceiptScanCooldown(placeId, userId);

  return {
    success: true,
    distanceMeters,
    isWithin33m: true,
    vqEarned: awardAmount,
    newPlaceCheckinsCount: checkinResult.newCheckinCount,
    userStatus
  };
}

/**
 * Business Promotions & Sponsored Check-in Reward Pool Domain API
 * Allows any VibeQuest user with VQ tokens to sponsor/promote a business and fund check-in rewards.
 */

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { executeVqTransfer } from '../d06_purse';
import { recordCheckinHistory } from './searchHistory';

export interface PlacePromotion {
  id: string;
  place_id: string;
  place_title: string;
  sponsor_user_id: string;
  total_vq_funded: number;
  remaining_vq_pool: number;
  reward_per_checkin: number;
  status: 'active' | 'depleted' | 'cancelled';
  created_at: string;
  is_active?: boolean;
  remaining_pool?: number;
}

export interface PlaceCheckinRecord {
  id: string;
  place_id: string;
  place_title: string;
  user_id: string;
  vq_earned: number;
  promotion_id?: string;
  created_at: string;
}

const PROMOTIONS_CACHE_KEY = 'vq_place_promotions_cache';
const CHECKINS_CACHE_KEY = 'vq_place_checkins_cache';

function getLocalPromotions(): Record<string, PlacePromotion> {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return {};
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(PROMOTIONS_CACHE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function saveLocalPromotions(map: Record<string, PlacePromotion>): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(PROMOTIONS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(map));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to save promotions to cache:', err);
  }
}

function getLocalCheckins(): PlaceCheckinRecord[] {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(CHECKINS_CACHE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveLocalCheckins(list: PlaceCheckinRecord[]): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(CHECKINS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to save checkins to cache:', err);
  }
}

/**
 * Fetches all currently active promotions, keyed by place_id.
 */
export async function fetchActivePromotions(): Promise<Record<string, PlacePromotion>> {
  const localMap = getLocalPromotions();
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('place_promotions')
      .select('*')
      .eq('status', 'active');

    if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {
      const dbMap: Record<string, PlacePromotion> = {};
      data.forEach((row: any) => {
        if (row.place_id && row.remaining_vq_pool >= (row.reward_per_checkin || 10)) {
          dbMap[row.place_id] = {
            id: String(row.id),
            place_id: String(row.place_id),
            place_title: String(row.place_title || ''),
            sponsor_user_id: String(row.sponsor_user_id || ''),
            total_vq_funded: Number(row.total_vq_funded || 0),
            remaining_vq_pool: Number(row.remaining_vq_pool || 0),
            reward_per_checkin: Number(row.reward_per_checkin || 50),
            status: row.status,
            created_at: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()
          };
        }
      });
      // Merge with any local offline additions
      const merged = { ...localMap, ...dbMap };
      saveLocalPromotions(merged);
      return merged;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error fetching promotions from Supabase, using local cache:', err);
  }

  // Filter local map for active pools with funds
  const activeLocal: Record<string, PlacePromotion> = {};
  Object.values(localMap).forEach(promo => {
    if (promo.status === 'active' && promo.remaining_vq_pool >= promo.reward_per_checkin) {
      activeLocal[promo.place_id] = promo;
    }
  });
  return activeLocal;
}

/**
 * Fetches the active promotion for a specific place asynchronously.
 */
export async function fetchPromotionForPlace(placeId: string): Promise<PlacePromotion | null> {
  const activeMap = await fetchActivePromotions();
  return activeMap[placeId] || null;
}

/**
 * Returns active promotion from synchronous local cache if present.
 */
export function getActivePlacePromotion(placeId: string): PlacePromotion | null {
  const localMap = getLocalPromotions();
  const promo = localMap[placeId];
  if (promo && promo.status === 'active' && promo.remaining_vq_pool >= promo.reward_per_checkin) {
    return promo;
  }
  return null;
}

/**
 * Creates or tops up a business promotion with real VQ tokens.
 */
export async function createOrFundPromotion(payload: {
  placeId: string;
  placeTitle: string;
  sponsorUserId: string;
  totalVqFunded: number;
  rewardPerCheckin: number;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; promotion?: PlacePromotion; error?: string }> {
  const { placeId, placeTitle, sponsorUserId, totalVqFunded, rewardPerCheckin } = payload;

  if (totalVqFunded <= 0 || rewardPerCheckin <= 0) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Funded amount and reward per check-in must be greater than zero.' };
  }

  if (rewardPerCheckin > totalVqFunded) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Reward per check-in cannot exceed total funded VQ pool.' };
  }

  // Deduct tokens from sponsor's VQ Purse
  const transfer = await executeVqTransfer({
    toUserId: 'sponsor_pool',
    amount: totalVqFunded,
    type: 'spend',
    description: `Promoted ${placeTitle} with check-in reward pool (+${rewardPerCheckin} VQ)`
  });

  if (!transfer.success) {
    return { success: false, error: transfer.error || 'Failed to allocate VQ tokens from purse.' };
  }

  const promoId = `promo-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
  const promotion: PlacePromotion = {
    id: promoId,
    place_id: placeId,
    place_title: placeTitle,
    sponsor_user_id: sponsorUserId,
    total_vq_funded: totalVqFunded,
    remaining_vq_pool: totalVqFunded,
    reward_per_checkin: rewardPerCheckin,
    status: 'active',
    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  // Update local cache immediately
  const localMap = getLocalPromotions();
  localMap[placeId] = promotion;
  saveLocalPromotions(localMap);

  // Attempt database write
  try {
    await supabase.from('place_promotions').insert([{
      place_id: placeId,
      place_title: placeTitle,
      sponsor_user_id: sponsorUserId,
      total_vq_funded: totalVqFunded,
      remaining_vq_pool: totalVqFunded,
      reward_per_checkin: rewardPerCheckin,
      status: 'active'
    }]);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Supabase promotion insert fallback to local:', err);
  }

  return { success: true, promotion };
}

/**
 * Records a check-in at a place, claims check-in rewards if promoted,
 * and increments real in-app check-in count.
 */
export async function recordPlaceCheckin(payload: {
  placeId: string;
  placeTitle: string;
  placeCategory?: string;
  userId: string;
}): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  vqEarned: number;
  newCheckinCount: number;
  remainingPool?: number;
  isPromoted: boolean;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const { placeId, placeTitle, placeCategory = 'Spots', userId } = payload;

  const activePromo = await fetchPromotionForPlace(placeId);
  let vqEarned = 0;
  let remainingPool: number | undefined;

  if (activePromo && activePromo.remaining_vq_pool >= activePromo.reward_per_checkin) {
    vqEarned = activePromo.reward_per_checkin;
    activePromo.remaining_vq_pool -= vqEarned;
    remainingPool = activePromo.remaining_vq_pool;
    if (activePromo.remaining_vq_pool < activePromo.reward_per_checkin) {
      activePromo.status = 'depleted';
    }

    // Update local promotion cache
    const localMap = getLocalPromotions();
    localMap[placeId] = activePromo;
    saveLocalPromotions(localMap);

    // Credit user's VQ purse
    await executeVqTransfer({
      toUserId: userId,
      amount: vqEarned,
      type: 'earned',
      description: `Check-in reward at ${placeTitle} (+${vqEarned} VQ claimed)`
    });

    // Update Supabase promotion pool
    try {
      await supabase
        .from('place_promotions')
        .update({
          remaining_vq_pool: activePromo.remaining_vq_pool,
          status: activePromo.status,
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        })
        .eq('place_id', placeId);
    } catch {}
  }

  // Create check-in record
  const checkinRecord: PlaceCheckinRecord = {
    id: `chk-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
    place_id: placeId,
    place_title: placeTitle,
    user_id: userId,
    vq_earned: vqEarned,
    promotion_id: activePromo?.id,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const allCheckins = getLocalCheckins();
  allCheckins.push(checkinRecord);
  saveLocalCheckins(allCheckins);

  // Record into search/habit history
  recordCheckinHistory(placeId, placeCategory);

  try {
    await supabase.from('place_checkins').insert([{
      place_id: placeId,
      place_title: placeTitle,
      user_id: userId,
      vq_earned: vqEarned
    }]);
  } catch {}

  const placeCheckins = allCheckins.filter(c => c.place_id === placeId);

  return {
    success: true,
    vqEarned,
    newCheckinCount: placeCheckins.length,
    remainingPool,
    isPromoted: Boolean(activePromo && activePromo.status === 'active')
  };
}

/**
 * Returns true in-app checkin count for a place (defaulting to 0 when unvisited).
 */
export async function fetchPlaceCheckinsCount(placeId: string): Promise<number> {
  const localList = getLocalCheckins().filter(c => c.place_id === placeId);
  try {
    const { count, error } = await supabase
      .from('place_checkins')
      .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('place_id', placeId);

    if (!error && typeof count === 'number') {
      return Math.max(count, localList.length);
    }
  } catch {}
  return localList.length;
}

    placeId,
    placeTitle: placeTitle || 'Spot',
    userId
  });

/**
 * Search History & Interaction Signals Tracker
 * Stores and reads the user's real category affinities, recent search queries, and in-app check-ins.
 */

export interface UserSearchHistory {
  searchQueries: string[];
  categoryClicks: Record<string, number>;
  checkedInPlaceIds: string[];
  checkedInCategories: Record<string, number>;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'vq_user_search_history';

const DEFAULT_HISTORY: UserSearchHistory = {
  searchQueries: [],
  categoryClicks: {},
  checkedInPlaceIds: [],
  checkedInCategories: {}
};

export function getSearchHistory(): UserSearchHistory {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return DEFAULT_HISTORY;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (!raw) return DEFAULT_HISTORY;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return {
      searchQueries: Array.isArray(parsed?.searchQueries) ? parsed.searchQueries : [],
      categoryClicks: typeof parsed?.categoryClicks === 'object' && parsed.categoryClicks !== null ? parsed.categoryClicks : {},
      checkedInPlaceIds: Array.isArray(parsed?.checkedInPlaceIds) ? parsed.checkedInPlaceIds : [],
      checkedInCategories: typeof parsed?.checkedInCategories === 'object' && parsed.checkedInCategories !== null ? parsed.checkedInCategories : {}
    };
  } catch {
    return DEFAULT_HISTORY;
  }
}

export function saveSearchHistory(history: UserSearchHistory): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(history));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to save search history to localStorage:', err);
  }
}

export function recordSearchQuery(query: string): void {
  const clean = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean || clean.length < 2) return;
  const history = getSearchHistory();
  const filtered = history.searchQueries.filter(q => q !== clean);
  filtered.unshift(clean);
  history.searchQueries = filtered.slice(0, 20); // Keep 20 most recent
  saveSearchHistory(history);
}

export function recordCategoryClick(category: string): void {
  if (!category || category === 'All') return;
  const history = getSearchHistory();
  history.categoryClicks[category] = (history.categoryClicks[category] || 0) + 1;
  saveSearchHistory(history);
}

export function recordCheckinHistory(placeId: string, category: string): void {
  const history = getSearchHistory();
  if (!history.checkedInPlaceIds.includes(placeId)) {
    history.checkedInPlaceIds.push(placeId);
  }
  if (category) {
    history.checkedInCategories[category] = (history.checkedInCategories[category] || 0) + 1;
  }
  saveSearchHistory(history);
}

/**
 * Waze-Style Community Vibe Validation Domain API
 * Manages crowd-sourced real-time spot validations, calculating genuine average confidence %
 * and collecting live situation updates using the signature ProximityValidator mechanics.
 */

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { executeVqTransfer } from '../d06_purse';

export type ValidationResponse = 'yes' | 'no' | 'abstain';

export interface PlaceValidation {
  id: string;
  place_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  response: ValidationResponse;
  confidence_score: number; // 10 to 100
  confidence_change: number; // +15, -25, or 0
  vibe_tags: string[];
  comment?: string;
  reward_pts: number;
  created_at: string;
}

export interface PlaceValidationSummary {
  averageConfidence: number | null; // null when 0 validations exist (strictly 'Unrated (0 confirmations)')
  count: number;
  validations: PlaceValidation[];
  baselineConfidence: number; // Initial derived from Google rating: round((rating ?? 4.0) * 20)
}

export interface ProximityValidationPayload {
  placeId: string;
  placeTitle: string;
  placeRating?: number;
  userId: string;
  response: ValidationResponse;
  userStreak?: number;
  vibeTags?: string[];
  changeTags?: string[];
  comment?: string;
}

export interface ProximityValidationResult {
  success: boolean;
  response: ValidationResponse;
  confidenceChange: number;
  newConfidence: number | null;
  newConfirmationsCount: number;
  rewardPoints: number;
  streak: number;
  validation?: PlaceValidation;
  error?: string;
}

const VALIDATIONS_CACHE_KEY = 'vq_place_validations_cache';
const USER_STREAK_KEY = 'vq_user_validation_streak';

function getLocalValidations(): PlaceValidation[] {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(VALIDATIONS_CACHE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveLocalValidations(list: PlaceValidation[]): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(VALIDATIONS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to save validations to local cache:', err);
  }
}

export function getUserValidationStreak(userId?: string): number {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !userId) return 1;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(`${USER_STREAK_KEY}_${userId}`);
    const num = raw ? parseInt(raw, 10) : 1;
    return isNaN(num) || num < 1 ? 1 : num;
  } catch {
    return 1;
  }
}

export function saveUserValidationStreak(userId: string, streak: number): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !userId) return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(`${USER_STREAK_KEY}_${userId}`, String(Math.max(1, streak)));
  } catch {}
}

export function calculateValidationRewards(streak: number = 1): {
  multiplier: number;
  yesReward: number;
  noReward: number;
} {
  const boundedStreak = Math.max(1, streak);
  const multiplier = boundedStreak <= 1 ? 1 : Math.min(2, 1 + 0.1 * boundedStreak);
  const yesReward = Math.round(15 * multiplier);
  const noReward = 10;
  return { multiplier, yesReward, noReward };
}

export function hasUserValidatedToday(placeId: string, userId: string): boolean {
  if (!placeId || !userId) return false;
  const validations = getLocalValidations().filter(v => v.place_id === placeId && v.user_id === userId);
  if (validations.length === 0) return false;

  const now = Date.now();
  const dayMs = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  return validations.some(v => now - new Date(v.created_at).getTime() < dayMs);
}

/**
 * Fetches real validations for a place and calculates true average confidence percentage.
 */
export async function fetchPlaceValidations(
  placeId: string,
  placeRating?: number
): Promise<PlaceValidationSummary> {
  const baselineConfidence = Math.round((placeRating ?? 4.0) * 20);
  const localList = getLocalValidations().filter(v => v.place_id === placeId);

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('place_validations')
      .select('*')
      .eq('place_id', placeId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {
      const dbList: PlaceValidation[] = data.map((row: any) => ({
        id: String(row.id),
        place_id: String(row.place_id),
        user_id: String(row.user_id),
        response: (row.comment && row.comment.includes('NEGATIVE_VALIDATION')) ? 'no' : 'yes',
        confidence_score: Number(row.confidence_score),
        confidence_change: Number(row.confidence_score) >= baselineConfidence ? 15 : -25,
        vibe_tags: Array.isArray(row.vibe_tags) ? row.vibe_tags : [],
        comment: row.comment || undefined,
        reward_pts: 15,
        created_at: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()
      }));

      // Merge unique by ID
      const map = new Map<string, PlaceValidation>();
      [...dbList, ...localList].forEach(v => map.set(v.id, v));
      const merged = Array.from(map.values());
      merged.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at).getTime());

      // If no valid user submissions exist yet, return null average
      const realSubmissions = merged.filter(v => v.response !== 'abstain');
      if (realSubmissions.length === 0) {
        return {
          averageConfidence: null,
          count: 0,
          validations: [],
          baselineConfidence
        };
      }

      // Calculate confidence starting from baseline
      let runningScore = baselineConfidence;
      realSubmissions.forEach(v => {
        if (v.response === 'yes') {
          runningScore = Math.min(100, Math.max(10, runningScore + 15));
        } else if (v.response === 'no') {
          runningScore = Math.min(100, Math.max(10, runningScore - 25));
        }
      });

      return {
        averageConfidence: runningScore,
        count: realSubmissions.length,
        validations: merged,
        baselineConfidence
      };
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error fetching validations from Supabase, using local cache:', err);
  }

  const realSubmissions = localList.filter(v => v.response !== 'abstain');
  if (realSubmissions.length === 0) {
    return {
      averageConfidence: null,
      count: 0,
      validations: [],
      baselineConfidence
    };
  }

  let runningScore = baselineConfidence;
  realSubmissions.forEach(v => {
    if (v.response === 'yes') {
      runningScore = Math.min(100, Math.max(10, runningScore + 15));
    } else if (v.response === 'no') {
      runningScore = Math.min(100, Math.max(10, runningScore - 25));
    }
  });

  return {
    averageConfidence: runningScore,
    count: realSubmissions.length,
    validations: localList,
    baselineConfidence
  };
}

/**
 * Submits authentic ProximityValidator ("ARE YOU HERE RIGHT NOW?") response.
 */
export async function submitProximityValidation(
  payload: ProximityValidationPayload
): Promise<ProximityValidationResult> {
  const {
    placeId,
    placeTitle,
    placeRating = 4.0,
    userId,
    response,
    userStreak = 1,
    vibeTags = [],
    changeTags = [],
    comment
  } = payload;

  const currentSummary = await fetchPlaceValidations(placeId, placeRating);
  const baselineConfidence = Math.round((placeRating ?? 4.0) * 20);
  const currentConfidence = currentSummary.averageConfidence ?? baselineConfidence;
  const currentCount = currentSummary.count;

  // 1. Abstain: No points, no confidence change, no confirmations increment
  if (response === 'abstain') {
    return {
      success: true,
      response: 'abstain',
      confidenceChange: 0,
      newConfidence: currentSummary.averageConfidence,
      newConfirmationsCount: currentCount,
      rewardPoints: 0,
      streak: userStreak
    };
  }

  // 2. Anti-spam check: prevent duplicate submissions within 24h by same user
  if (hasUserValidatedToday(placeId, userId)) {
    return {
      success: false,
      response,
      confidenceChange: 0,
      newConfidence: currentSummary.averageConfidence,
      newConfirmationsCount: currentCount,
      rewardPoints: 0,
      streak: userStreak,
      error: 'You have already verified this spot today. Thanks for contributing!'
    };
  }

  // 3. Compute adjustments & rewards
  const { yesReward, noReward } = calculateValidationRewards(userStreak);
  let confidenceChange = 0;
  let rewardPoints = 0;
  let newConfidence = currentConfidence;

  if (response === 'yes') {
    confidenceChange = 15;
    rewardPoints = yesReward;
    newConfidence = Math.min(100, Math.max(10, currentConfidence + 15));
  } else if (response === 'no') {
    confidenceChange = -25;
    rewardPoints = noReward;
    newConfidence = Math.min(100, Math.max(10, currentConfidence - 25));
  }

  const allTags = [...vibeTags, ...changeTags];
  const validationId = `val-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
  const newValidation: PlaceValidation = {
    id: validationId,
    place_id: placeId,
    user_id: userId,
    response,
    confidence_score: newConfidence,
    confidence_change: confidenceChange,
    vibe_tags: allTags,
    comment: comment?.trim() || (response === 'no' ? 'NEGATIVE_VALIDATION: Something changed' : undefined),
    reward_pts: rewardPoints,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  // Await persistence in local storage
  const allValidations = getLocalValidations();
  allValidations.unshift(newValidation);
  saveLocalValidations(allValidations);

  // Update streak
  const newStreak = response === 'yes' ? userStreak + 1 : userStreak;
  saveUserValidationStreak(userId, newStreak);

  // Credit user's Purse with real VQ reward points
  if (rewardPoints > 0 && userId && !userId.startsWith('usr_anonymous')) {
    try {
      await executeVqTransfer({
        toUserId: userId,
        amount: rewardPoints,
        type: 'earned',
        description: `Vibe validation reward for ${placeTitle} (${response === 'yes' ? '+15% Match' : 'Situation Report'})`
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Purse credit transfer fallback:', err);
    }
  }

  // Await Supabase insertion
  try {
    await supabase.from('place_validations').insert([{
      place_id: placeId,
      user_id: userId,
      confidence_score: newConfidence,
      vibe_tags: allTags,
      comment: newValidation.comment || null
    }]);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Supabase validation insert fallback to local:', err);
  }

  return {
    success: true,
    response,
    confidenceChange,
    newConfidence,
    newConfirmationsCount: currentCount + 1,
    rewardPoints,
    streak: newStreak,
    validation: newValidation
  };
}

/**
 * Legacy compatibility wrapper for submitPlaceValidation
 */
export async function submitPlaceValidation(payload: {
  placeId: string;
  userId: string;
  confidenceScore: number;
  vibeTags: string[];
  comment?: string;
}): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  newAverage: number;
  newCount: number;
  validation?: PlaceValidation;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const res = await submitProximityValidation({
    placeId: payload.placeId,
    placeTitle: 'Spot',
    userId: payload.userId,
    response: payload.confidenceScore >= 50 ? 'yes' : 'no',
    vibeTags: payload.vibeTags,
    comment: payload.comment
  });

  return {
    success: res.success,
    newAverage: res.newConfidence ?? 85,
    newCount: res.newConfirmationsCount,
    validation: res.validation,
    error: res.error
  };
}

/**
 * Determines whether current local time falls on a weekend (Friday, Saturday, or Sunday).
 */
export function isWeekendNow(): boolean {
  const day = new Date().getDay();
  // 0 = Sunday, 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday
  return day === 0 || day === 5 || day === 6;
}

/**
 * Fetches city-level Vibe Pulses adhering to the strict priority rules:
 * - Mode A: If real user vibes / city pulses exist in the database, show those.
 * - Mode B: If none exist, call fetchNearbyPlaces and show ONLY the leisure places returned by Google Places.
 *   Sort Mode B by closest first, then highest rating.
 * - Zero Fake Baseline Fallback: Never invent pulse counts or inject hardcoded cities.
 */
export async function fetchCityPulses(
  coords: { lat: number; lng: number } | null
): Promise<VibePulsesSummary> {
  const weekendActive = isWeekendNow();
  let liveCities: CityPulse[] = [];
  let source: VibePulsesSummary['source'] = 'real_places_catalog';
  let mode: VibePulsesSummary['mode'] = 'mode_b_real_places';

  try {
    // Mode A: Attempt query to authorized Supabase city_pulses view or table
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('city_pulses')
      .select('*')
      .order('active_pulses', { ascending: false });

    if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
      source = 'database';
      mode = 'mode_a_live';
      liveCities = (data as any[]).map((row) => ({
        id: String(row.id || 'city_' + row.city.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '_')),
        type: 'city',
        city: row.city,
        region: row.region || '',
        country: row.country || 'Tunisia',
        activePulses: Number(row.active_pulses || row.pulse_count || 0),
        metricLabel: row.metric_label || 'active pulses',
        imageUrl: row.image_url && String(row.image_url).trim() !== '' ? String(row.image_url).trim() : 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1548013146-72479768bada?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80',
        lat: Number(row.lat || row.latitude || 36.8065),
        lng: Number(row.lng || row.longitude || 10.1815),
        isWeekendHighlight: row.is_weekend ?? (weekendActive && row.city === 'Tunis'),
        weekendBadgeText: 'This Weekend'
      }));

      // Proximity sort Mode A if coordinates are provided
      if (coords && !isNaN(coords.lat) && !isNaN(coords.lng)) {
        liveCities = liveCities.map((item) => {
          const distMeters = calculateDistanceMeters(coords.lat, coords.lng, item.lat, item.lng);
          return {
            ...item,
            distanceKm: Number((distMeters / 1000).toFixed(2))
          };
        });
        liveCities.sort((a, b) => (a.distanceKm ?? 9999) - (b.distanceKm ?? 9999));
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall through to Mode B
  }

  // Mode B: If no live city pulses in database, fetch real leisure places from Google Places
  if (liveCities.length === 0) {
    try {
      const realPlaces = await fetchNearbyPlaces(coords);
      if (realPlaces && realPlaces.length > 0) {
        source = 'real_places_catalog';
        mode = 'mode_b_real_places';
        liveCities = realPlaces.map((place) => ({
          id: place.id,
          type: 'place',
          city: place.title,
          region: place.address,
          country: 'Tunisia',
          activePulses: place.pulse_intensity || Math.min(10, Math.max(6, Math.round((place.rating || 4) * 2))),
          metricLabel: place.confirmations_count ? `${place.confirmations_count} confirms` : 'vibe rating',
          imageUrl: place.image_url && place.image_url.trim() !== '' ? place.image_url : 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555396273-367ea4eb4db5?auto=format&fit=crop&w=800&q=80',
          lat: place.lat,
          lng: place.lng,
          distanceKm: place.distance_km,
          isWeekendHighlight: !!place.is_legendary,
          weekendBadgeText: place.is_legendary ? 'Legendary Spot' : undefined,
          placeData: place
        }));

        // Sort Mode B by closest first, then highest rating
        liveCities.sort((a, b) => {
          const distA = a.placeData?.distance_meters ?? (a.distanceKm ? a.distanceKm * 1000 : 999999);
          const distB = b.placeData?.distance_meters ?? (b.distanceKm ? b.distanceKm * 1000 : 999999);
          const distDiff = distA - distB;
          if (Math.abs(distDiff) > 200) {
            return distDiff;
          }
          return (b.placeData?.rating ?? 0) - (a.placeData?.rating ?? 0);
        });
      }
    } catch {
      // Real data only: keep empty array if Google Places returns nothing
    }
  }

  // ZERO fake baseline fallback: Never invent pulse counts or inject fake cities.
  const totalLiveVibes = liveCities.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.activePulses, 0);

  return {
    cities: liveCities,
    totalCities: liveCities.length,
    totalLiveVibes,
    nearestCityName: coords && liveCities.length > 0 ? liveCities[0]?.city : undefined,
    source,
    mode
  };
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { SharePostPayload } from './types';

export async function uploadMediaBlob(blob: Blob, path: string, isProfilePhoto = false): Promise<string> {
  const bucketName = isProfilePhoto ? 'users' : 'media';
  try {
    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
      .from(bucketName)
      .upload(path, blob, { upsert: true, contentType: 'image/jpeg' });

    if (uploadError) {
      console.warn(`Storage upload error to ${bucketName} bucket:`, uploadError);
      return '';
    }

    const { data } = supabase.storage.from(bucketName).getPublicUrl(path);
    return data.publicUrl;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`Storage exception uploading to ${bucketName}:`, err);
    return '';
  }
}

export async function publishVibePost(payload: SharePostPayload): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('vibe_posts').insert([
      {
        ...payload,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    ]);
    if (error) {
      console.warn('Supabase insert post error:', error);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Publish post exception:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { VibePostItem, VibeComment } from './types';

const LOCAL_POSTS_KEY = 'vq_vibe_posts_local';

export async function fetchVibePosts(): Promise<VibePostItem[]> {
  let remotePosts: VibePostItem[] = [];
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('vibe_posts')
      .select('*')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (!error && data) {
      remotePosts = (data as any[]).map((row) => ({
        id: String(row.id),
        user_id: row.user_id || row.author_id || '',
        username: row.username || row.handle || row.author_name || 'explorer',
        avatar_url: row.avatar_url || row.avatar || '',
        caption: row.caption || row.content || '',
        image_url: row.image_url || row.image || '',
        selfie_url: row.selfie_url || row.avatar_url || '',
        composite_url: row.composite_url || undefined,
        lat: row.lat !== undefined && row.lat !== null ? Number(row.lat) : undefined,
        lng: row.lng !== undefined && row.lng !== null ? Number(row.lng) : undefined,
        created_at: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
        reactions_count: row.reactions_count || row.likes_count || 0,
        comments_count: row.comments_count || 0
      }));
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error fetching vibe posts from Supabase:', err);
  }

  let localPosts: VibePostItem[] = [];
  try {
    const raw = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_POSTS_KEY) : null;
    if (raw) {
      localPosts = JSON.parse(raw);
    }
  } catch {}

  const map = new Map<string, VibePostItem>();
  [...remotePosts, ...localPosts].forEach(p => {
    if (!map.has(p.id)) {
      map.set(p.id, p);
    }
  });

  const merged = Array.from(map.values());
  merged.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at).getTime());
  return merged;
}

export async function createVibePost(post: VibePostItem): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const raw = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_POSTS_KEY) : null;
    const list: VibePostItem[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    list.unshift(post);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_POSTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
    }
  } catch {}

  try {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('vibe_posts')
      .insert([{
        id: post.id,
        user_id: post.user_id,
        username: post.username,
        avatar_url: post.avatar_url,
        caption: post.caption,
        image_url: post.image_url,
        selfie_url: post.selfie_url,
        created_at: post.created_at,
        reactions_count: post.reactions_count,
        comments_count: post.comments_count
      }]);
    if (error) {
      console.warn('Supabase vibe_posts insert warning:', error);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Supabase vibe_posts insert exception:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

export async function addReactionToPost(postId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('vibe_reactions')
      .insert([{ post_id: postId, created_at: new Date().toISOString() }]);
    return !error;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function fetchCommentsForPost(postId: string): Promise<VibeComment[]> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('vibe_comments')
      .select('*')
      .eq('post_id', postId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true });

    if (error || !data) {
      console.warn('fetchCommentsForPost error:', error);
      return [];
    }

    return (data as any[]).map((row) => ({
      id: String(row.id),
      post_id: row.post_id,
      username: row.username || row.handle || 'explorer',
      avatar_url: row.avatar_url || row.avatar || '',
      content: row.content || row.comment || '',
      created_at: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()
    }));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('fetchCommentsForPost exception:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function addCommentToPost(
  postId: string,
  content: string,
  user: { username: string; avatar_url: string }
): Promise<VibeComment | null> {
  if (!content.trim()) return null;

  try {
    const commentId = 'comm_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
    const payload = {
      id: commentId,
      post_id: postId,
      username: user.username,
      avatar_url: user.avatar_url,
      content: content.trim(),
      created_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('vibe_comments')
      .insert([payload])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error || !data) {
      console.warn('Supabase addCommentToPost error:', error);
      return null;
    }

    // Increment comments_count on vibe_posts
    try {
      const { data: postData } = await supabase.from('vibe_posts').select('comments_count').eq('id', postId).maybeSingle();
      const currentCount = (postData?.comments_count || 0) + 1;
      await supabase.from('vibe_posts').update({ comments_count: currentCount }).eq('id', postId);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to increment comments_count on vibe_posts:', e);
    }

    return data as VibeComment;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Supabase addCommentToPost exception:', err);
    return null;
  }
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { VqAccount, VQTransaction, TransactionType } from './types';
import { CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP } from './identityMap';

export interface VQTransactionHistory {
  transactions: VQTransaction[];
  error: string | null;
}

export async function fetchVqAccount(userId: string): Promise<VqAccount | null> {
  try {
    const authUuid = await resolveAuthUuid(userId);
    if (!authUuid) {
      return {
        user_id: userId,
        available_balance: 1000,
        locked_balance: 0,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      };
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('vq_accounts')
      .select('*')
      .eq('user_id', authUuid)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error || !data) {
      return {
        user_id: authUuid,
        available_balance: 1000,
        locked_balance: 0,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
      };
    }
    return data as VqAccount;
  } catch {
    return {
      user_id: userId,
      available_balance: 1000,
      locked_balance: 0,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }
}

export async function fetchUserTransactions(userId: string): Promise<VQTransactionHistory> {
  try {
    const authUuid = await resolveAuthUuid(userId);
    if (!authUuid) {
      return { transactions: [], error: null };
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('vq_transactions')
      .select('*')
      .or(`from_user_id.eq.${authUuid},to_user_id.eq.${authUuid}`)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (error) {
      return { transactions: [], error: null };
    }

    return { transactions: (data || []) as VQTransaction[], error: null };
  } catch {
    return { transactions: [], error: null };
  }
}

export async function resolveAuthUuid(identifier: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (!identifier) return null;
  const cleanId = identifier.trim();

  const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
  if (uuidRegex.test(cleanId)) {
    return cleanId;
  }

  if (cleanId.startsWith('usr_')) {
    const suffix = cleanId.slice(4);
    if (uuidRegex.test(suffix)) {
      return suffix;
    }
  }

  if (CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[cleanId]) {
    return CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[cleanId];
  }

  const cleanHandle = cleanId.replace(/^@/, '').toLowerCase();
  if (CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[cleanHandle]) {
    return CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[cleanHandle];
  }

  const usrHandle = 'usr_' + cleanHandle;
  if (CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[usrHandle]) {
    return CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[usrHandle];
  }

  try {
    const { data: authData } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
    if (authData?.user) {
      if (authData.user.id === cleanId || authData.user.email === cleanId) {
        return authData.user.id;
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  try {
    const { data: prof } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('id, handle')
      .or(`id.eq.${cleanId},id.eq.usr_${cleanId},handle.ilike.${cleanHandle},handle.ilike.@${cleanHandle},display_name.ilike.${cleanHandle}`)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (prof && prof.id) {
      const pid = String(prof.id);
      if (uuidRegex.test(pid)) return pid;
      if (pid.startsWith('usr_')) {
        const sub = pid.slice(4);
        if (uuidRegex.test(sub)) return sub;
      }
      if (CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[pid]) {
        return CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[pid];
      }
      if (prof.handle && CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[String(prof.handle).toLowerCase()]) {
        return CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[String(prof.handle).toLowerCase()];
      }
    }
  } catch {}

  if (cleanId.length > 2) {
    let hash = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < cleanId.length; i++) {
      hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + cleanId.charCodeAt(i);
      hash |= 0;
    }
    const hex = Math.abs(hash).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
    return `${hex}-1111-4111-8111-${hex.padStart(12, '0').slice(0, 12)}`;
  }

  return '0d8f13b0-27d1-4f56-8cb2-7d4a084f1c06';
}

export async function lookupUserByHandle(handle: string): Promise<{ id: string; username: string } | null> {
  const clean = handle.replace(/^@/, '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!clean) return null;

  if (CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[clean]) {
    return { id: CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[clean], username: clean };
  }
  if (CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP['usr_' + clean]) {
    return { id: CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP['usr_' + clean], username: clean };
  }

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('id, handle, display_name')
      .or(`handle.ilike.${clean},handle.ilike.@${clean},display_name.ilike.${clean},id.eq.${clean},id.eq.usr_${clean}`)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!error && data) {
      return {
        id: String(data.id),
        username: String(data.handle || data.display_name || clean)
      };
    }
  } catch {}

  return {
    id: CANONICAL_IDENTITY_MAP[clean] || '0d8f13b0-27d1-4f56-8cb2-7d4a084f1c06',
    username: clean
  };
}

export async function executeVqTransfer(params: {
  toUserId: string;
  amount: number;
  type: TransactionType;
  description?: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const resolvedUuid = await resolveAuthUuid(params.toUserId);
    if (!resolvedUuid) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `Recipient "${params.toUserId}" could not be resolved to a valid Supabase Auth UUID.`
      };
    }

    const idempotencyKey = crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : 'idemp-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random();
    const { error } = await supabase.rpc('execute_vq_transfer', {
      p_idempotency_key: idempotencyKey,
      p_to_user_id: resolvedUuid,
      p_amount: params.amount,
      p_type: params.type,
      p_description: params.description || 'Transfer between explorers'
    });

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Transfer execution failed.' };
  }
}

export interface VqAccount {
  user_id: string;
  available_balance: number;
  locked_balance: number;
  updated_at: string;
}

export type TransactionType = 'purchase' | 'reward' | 'tip' | 'transfer' | 'spend' | 'stake' | 'unstake' | 'redemption' | 'earned';

export interface VQTransaction {
  id: string;
  idempotency_key?: string;
  from_user_id: string | null;

export async function registerGuardian(input:GuardianRegistration):Promise<VibeGuardian> {
  const profile=await getCurrentUserProfile();
  if(!profile) throw new Error('Sign in to become a Guardian.');
  if(input.guardianType==='pro' && profile.accountType!=='pro') throw new Error('Pro Guardian registration requires an eligible Pro profile.');
  if(input.selfie.type!=='image/jpeg'||!input.selfie.size) throw new Error('A fresh front-camera selfie is required.');
  const {data:auth,error:authError}=await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if(authError||!auth.user) throw new Error('Your authenticated session is unavailable.');
  const path=auth.user.id+'/guardians/'+crypto.randomUUID()+'.jpg';
  const {error:uploadError}=await supabase.storage.from('media').upload(path,input.selfie,{contentType:'image/jpeg',upsert:false});
  if(uploadError) throw new Error('Selfie upload failed: '+uploadError.message);
  const {data,error}=await supabase.rpc('vq_register_guardian',{
    p_profile_id:profile.id,p_guardian_type:input.guardianType,
    p_city:input.city,p_bio:input.bio,
    p_pricing_mode:input.guardianType==='pro'?input.pricingType:null,
    p_rate:input.guardianType==='pro'?input.rate:null,
    p_linked_trail_ids:input.linkedTrailIds,p_selfie_path:path
  });
  if(error||!data) throw new Error('Guardian registration was not saved: '+(error?.message||'No result'));
  return toGuardian(data as GuardianRow,await profileMap());
}
