import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { getCurrentUserProfile } from '../d01_auth';
import { CommunityTrail, VibeGuardian, TrailStop, TimeOfDay } from './types';
import { withTrailGalleries } from './gallery';

export const SEVEN_DAYS_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
export function isGuardianFresh(guardian: VibeGuardian): boolean {
  if (!guardian.selfieCapturedAt) return false;
  const age = Date.now() - new Date(guardian.selfieCapturedAt).getTime();
  return Number.isFinite(age) && age >= 0 && age <= SEVEN_DAYS_MS;
}
export function countExpiredGuardians(guardians: VibeGuardian[]): number {
  return guardians.filter((g) => !isGuardianFresh(g)).length;
}

type TrailRecord = Record<string, any>;
type PublicProfile = { id: string; handle: string; display_name: string | null; photo_url: string | null };
function normalizeStop(raw: Record<string, any>, position: number): TrailStop {
  const time = String(raw.timeOfDay || 'Flexible').toLowerCase();
  const supported: Record<string, TimeOfDay> = {
    morning: 'Morning', afternoon: 'Afternoon', sunset: 'Sunset', night: 'Night', flexible: 'Flexible'
  };
  return {
    id: String(raw.id || 'stop-' + (position + 1)),
    name: String(raw.name || raw.title || ''),
    address: String(raw.address || '').trim(),
    vibeNote: String(raw.vibeNote || raw.description || ''),
    timeOfDay: supported[time] || 'Flexible',
    durationMinutes: Number(raw.durationMinutes ?? raw.suggestedDurationMin ?? 0),
    lat: typeof raw.lat === 'number' ? raw.lat : undefined,
    lng: typeof raw.lng === 'number' ? raw.lng : undefined,
  };
}
async function publicProfiles(): Promise<Map<string, PublicProfile>> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('id,handle,display_name,photo_url');
  if (error) throw new Error('Could not retrieve real Trail author profiles: ' + error.message);
  const map = new Map<string, PublicProfile>();
  for (const profile of (data || []) as PublicProfile[]) {
    map.set(profile.id, profile);
    if (profile.id.startsWith('usr_')) map.set(profile.id.slice(4), profile);
  }
  return map;
}
function toTrail(row: TrailRecord, profiles: Map<string, PublicProfile>): CommunityTrail {
  const author = profiles.get(String(row.author_id || ''));
  if (!author) throw new Error('Trail ' + String(row.id) + ' has no verified real author profile.');
  const stops = Array.isArray(row.stops) ? row.stops.map(normalizeStop) : [];
  const minutes = Number(row.total_estimated_minutes ?? stops.reduce((sum: number, stop: TrailStop) => sum + stop.durationMinutes, 0));
  const details = row.tour_details && typeof row.tour_details === 'object' ? row.tour_details : null;
  const image = String(row.image_url || '');
  const name = String(row.name || '');
  return {
    id: String(row.id), title: name, story: String(row.story || ''),
    description: String(row.story || ''), city: String(row.city || ''),
    district: String(row.city || ''), category: String(row.category || 'General'),
    vibeTags: Array.isArray(row.vibe_tags) ? row.vibe_tags : [],
    imageUrl: image, image_url: image, durationHours: minutes / 60,
    duration_mins: minutes, stopsCount: stops.length, waypoints_count: stops.length,
    flowSequence: stops.map((s: TrailStop) => s.timeOfDay),
    authorId: author.id, authorName: author.display_name || author.handle,
    authorHandle: '@' + author.handle, authorAvatarUrl: String(author.photo_url || ''),
    guardian_name: author.display_name || author.handle,
    guardian_handle: '@' + author.handle, guardian_avatar: String(author.photo_url || ''),
    isTour: Boolean(row.is_tour), pricePerPerson: details?.price === undefined ? undefined : Number(details.price),
    tourDetails: details, currency: String(details?.currency || 'USD'),
    createdAt: String(row.created_at || ''), stops,
    waypoints: stops.map((stop: TrailStop,index: number) => ({...stop, title: stop.name, order: index+1})),
    savedBy: Array.isArray(row.saved_by) ? row.saved_by : [],
    savesCount: Number(row.saves_count || 0), adoptionsCount: Number(row.adoptions_count || 0),
    forkedFromTrailId: row.forked_from_trail_id || undefined,
    forkedFromAuthorName: row.forked_from_author_name || undefined,
    difficulty: undefined, remix_count: 0,
    vq_reward: undefined
  };
}
export async function fetchCulturalTrails(): Promise<CommunityTrail[]> {
  const [{ data, error }, authors] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('vibe_trails').select('*').order('created_at', { ascending: false }),
    publicProfiles()
  ]);
  if (error) throw new Error('Could not load real Trails: ' + error.message);
  return withTrailGalleries((data || []).map(row => toTrail(row, authors)));
}
export async function createCommunityTrail(
  payload: Partial<CommunityTrail>
): Promise<{ success: boolean; trail?: CommunityTrail; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile();
    if (!profile) throw new Error('Sign in to create a Trail.');
    const title = payload.title?.trim();
    const stops = payload.stops || [];
    if (!title || !stops.length || stops.some(stop => !stop.name.trim())) {
      throw new Error('Provide a Trail title and named itinerary stops.');
    }
    if (stops.some(stop => !stop.address?.trim())) {
      throw new Error('Provide a Google Maps address for every Trail stop.');
    }
    if (payload.isTour) {
      if (!['pro', 'business'].includes(profile.accountType || '')) {
        throw new Error('Only Pro and Business accounts can publish Vibe Tours.');
      }
      if (!Number.isFinite(payload.pricePerPerson) || Number(payload.pricePerPerson) <= 0) {
        throw new Error('Provide a real positive Tour price.');
      }
    }
    let original: CommunityTrail | undefined;
    let inheritedLegacyCover = payload.imageUrl || payload.image_url || '';
    if (payload.forkedFromTrailId) {
      original = (await fetchCulturalTrails()).find(t => t.id === payload.forkedFromTrailId);
      if (!original) throw new Error('Original Trail was not found.');
      // Never persist an expiring signed photo URL inherited from a gallery.
      const { data: source, error: sourceError } = await supabase
        .from('vibe_trails').select('image_url').eq('id', original.id).single();
      if (sourceError || !source) throw new Error('Could not read original Trail cover.');
      inheritedLegacyCover = String(source.image_url || '');
    }
    const normalized = stops.map(normalizeStop);
    const durationMinutes = Math.round(normalized.reduce((n, stop) => n + stop.durationMinutes, 0));
    const id = 'trail_' + crypto.randomUUID();
    const body = {
      id, name: title, story: payload.story || '',
      address: normalized[0]?.address || '', category: payload.category || 'General',
      vibe_tags: payload.vibeTags || [], image_url: inheritedLegacyCover,
      latitude: normalized[0]?.lat ?? null, longitude: normalized[0]?.lng ?? null,
      author_id: profile.id, author_name: profile.full_name,
      city: payload.city || '', stops: normalized, total_stops: normalized.length,
      total_estimated_minutes: durationMinutes, saved_by: [], saves_count: 0,
      forked_from_trail_id: original?.id || null,
      forked_from_author_name: original?.authorName || null,
      is_tour: Boolean(payload.isTour),
      tour_details: payload.isTour ? (payload.tourDetails || {
        price: payload.pricePerPerson, currency: payload.currency || 'USD'
      }) : null
    };
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('vibe_trails').insert(body).select('*').single();
    if (error || !data) throw new Error(error?.message || 'Trail was not saved.');
    const authors = await publicProfiles();
    return { success: true, trail: toTrail(data, authors) };
  } catch (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Trail publication failed.' };
  }
}
export async function toggleSavedTrail(trailId: string): Promise<CommunityTrail> {
  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile();
  if (!profile) throw new Error('Sign in to save a Trail.');
  const { data: row, error } = await supabase.from('vibe_trails').select('*').eq('id', trailId).single();
  if (error || !row) throw new Error(error?.message || 'Trail not found.');
  const current: string[] = Array.isArray(row.saved_by) ? row.saved_by : [];
  const auth = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  const aliases = [profile.id, auth.data.user?.id, auth.data.user?.id ? 'usr_' + auth.data.user.id : undefined]
    .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value));
  const hasSaved = current.some(id => aliases.includes(id));
  const savedBy = hasSaved ? current.filter(id => !aliases.includes(id)) : [...current, profile.id];
  const { data, error: writeError } = await supabase.from('vibe_trails')
    .update({ saved_by: savedBy, saves_count: Math.max(0, Number(row.saves_count ?? 0) + (hasSaved ? -1 : 1)) })
    .eq('id', trailId).select('*').single();
  if (writeError || !data) throw new Error(writeError?.message || 'Unable to save this Trail.');
  const hydrated = await withTrailGalleries([toTrail(data, await publicProfiles())]);
  return hydrated[0];
}
export async function adoptTrail(trail: CommunityTrail): Promise<CommunityTrail> {
  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile();
  if (!profile) throw new Error('Sign in to adopt a Trail.');
  const result = await createCommunityTrail({
    ...trail, title: trail.title + ' (Remix)', isTour: false,
    forkedFromTrailId: trail.id, tourDetails: undefined, pricePerPerson: undefined
  });
  if (!result.success || !result.trail) throw new Error(result.error || 'Unable to adopt this Trail.');
  return result.trail;
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import type { CommunityTrail } from './types';
import { getCurrentUserProfile } from '../d01_auth';

export type TrailGalleryPhoto = {
  id: string;
  objectPath: string;
  url: string;
  sortOrder: number;
  isCover: boolean;
};

type MediaRow = {
  id: string | number;
  trail_id: string;
  object_path: string;
  sort_order: number;
  is_cover: boolean;
  created_at: string;
};

const PHOTO_TYPES: Record<string, string> = {
  'image/jpeg': 'jpg',
  'image/png': 'png',
  'image/webp': 'webp',
};
const MAX_PHOTO_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const SIGNED_URL_SECONDS = 60 * 60;

export function photoLimit(accountType?: string, isAdmin = false): number {
  return isAdmin || accountType === 'pro' || accountType === 'business' ? 6 : 3;
}

export function validateTrailPhotos(files: File[], availableSlots: number): void {
  if (files.length > availableSlots) throw new Error(`Only ${Math.max(availableSlots, 0)} more photos may be added to this Trail.`);
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(PHOTO_TYPES, file.type)) throw new Error('Trail photos must be JPG, PNG, or WebP.');
    if (!file.size || file.size > MAX_PHOTO_BYTES) throw new Error('Each Trail photo must be between 1 byte and 5 MB.');
  }
}

/** Query the real gallery contract before a content-creating action with photos. */
export async function requireTrailGallery(): Promise<void> {
  const { error } = await supabase.from('trail_media')
    .select('id,trail_id,object_path,sort_order,is_cover,created_at').limit(1);
  if (error) throw new Error('Trail photo publishing is not installed yet: ' + error.message);
}

export async function uploadTrailPhotos(
  trailId: string,
  files: File[],
  coverIndex = 0,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!files.length) return;
  if (!Number.isInteger(coverIndex) || coverIndex < 0 || coverIndex >= files.length) {
    throw new Error('Select one cover photo.');
  }
  const { data: auth, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (authError || !auth.user) throw new Error('Sign in to upload Trail photos.');
  await requireTrailGallery();
  const { data: existing, error: listError } = await supabase
    .from('trail_media').select('id').eq('trail_id', trailId);
  if (listError) throw new Error(listError.message);
  // The published legacy cover also occupies one gallery slot.
  const { data: trail, error: trailError } = await supabase
    .from('vibe_trails').select('image_url').eq('id', trailId).single();
  if (trailError || !trail) throw new Error('Trail not available for photo upload.');
  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile();
  if (!profile) throw new Error('Authenticated Trail profile not found.');
  const { data: admin, error: adminError } = await supabase
    .from('vq_admin_assignments').select('role')
    .eq('auth_user_id', auth.user.id).eq('active', true).maybeSingle();
  if (adminError) throw new Error(adminError.message);
  const limit = photoLimit(profile.accountType, admin?.role === 'platform_admin');
  validateTrailPhotos(files, limit - (existing?.length || 0) - (trail.image_url ? 1 : 0));

  let completed = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
    const file = files[i];
    const path = `${auth.user.id}/trails/${trailId}/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${PHOTO_TYPES[file.type]}`;
    const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage.from('media').upload(path, file, {
      contentType: file.type,
      upsert: false,
    });
    if (uploadError) throw new Error(`${completed} photos saved. Upload failed: ${uploadError.message}`);
    const { error: linkError } = await supabase.from('trail_media').insert({
      trail_id: trailId,
      object_path: path,
      sort_order: (existing?.length || 0) + i,
      is_cover: i === coverIndex,
    });
    if (linkError) {
      // Only the newly uploaded, unattached file can be cleaned up.
      await supabase.storage.from('media').remove([path]);
      throw new Error(`${completed} photos saved. Gallery registration failed: ${linkError.message}`);
    }
    completed++;
  }
}

/** Signed URLs are temporary display URLs, never persisted as a Trail's cover. */
export async function withTrailGalleries(trails: CommunityTrail[]): Promise<CommunityTrail[]> {
  if (!trails.length) return trails;
  const { data, error } = await supabase.from('trail_media')
    .select('id,trail_id,object_path,sort_order,is_cover,created_at');
  if (error) {
    // Preserve existing Trails on an environment where this migration is pending.
    if (error.code === '42P01' || error.code === 'PGRST205' ||
        (error.code === '42703' && /column .* does not exist/i.test(error.message))) {
      // A pending or incomplete media-gallery migration must never hide existing Trails.
      console.warn('Trail gallery schema is not ready; displaying existing Trails without gallery media:', error.message);
      return trails;
    }
    throw new Error('Could not retrieve Trail galleries: ' + error.message);
  }
  const rows = (data || []) as MediaRow[];
  const paths = [...new Set(rows.map(row => row.object_path))];
  const signed = new Map<string, string>();
  await Promise.all(paths.map(async path => {
    const { data: url, error: signError } = await supabase.storage.from('media')
      .createSignedUrl(path, SIGNED_URL_SECONDS);
    if (signError || !url?.signedUrl) {
      console.warn('An attached Trail photo could not be signed:', signError?.message || path);
      return;
    }
    signed.set(path, url.signedUrl);
  }));
  const galleries = new Map<string, TrailGalleryPhoto[]>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const gallery = galleries.get(row.trail_id) || [];
    const url = signed.get(row.object_path);
    if (!url) continue;
    gallery.push({
      id: String(row.id),
      objectPath: row.object_path,
      url,
      sortOrder: row.sort_order,
      isCover: row.is_cover,
    });
    galleries.set(row.trail_id, gallery);
  }
  for (const gallery of galleries.values()) gallery.sort((a, b) => a.sortOrder - b.sortOrder);
  const byId = new Map(trails.map(trail => [trail.id, trail]));
  function inheritedGallery(trail: CommunityTrail, seen = new Set<string>()): TrailGalleryPhoto[] {
    if (seen.has(trail.id)) return [];
    seen.add(trail.id);
    const own = galleries.get(trail.id);
    if (own?.length) return own;
    const parent = trail.forkedFromTrailId ? byId.get(trail.forkedFromTrailId) : undefined;
    return parent ? inheritedGallery(parent, seen) : [];
  }
  return trails.map(trail => {
    const attached = inheritedGallery(trail);
    const cover = attached.find(photo => photo.isCover) || attached[0];
    const legacyCover = String(trail.imageUrl || '');
    // A previously published URL remains visible; it still counts toward the limit.
    const gallery = attached.length && legacyCover
      ? [...attached, {
          id: 'legacy-' + trail.id,
          objectPath: '',
          url: legacyCover,
          sortOrder: -1,
          isCover: !cover,
        }]
      : attached;
    return {
      ...trail,
      gallery,
      imageUrl: cover?.url || legacyCover,
      image_url: cover?.url || legacyCover,
    };
  });
}

import type { CommunityTrail, TrailStop } from './types';

export type TrailTravelMode = 'walking' | 'driving' | 'transit' | 'best';
export type TrailRouteSegment = {
  url: string;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  stopCount: number;
};
export type TrailRoutePlan = {
  segments: TrailRouteSegment[];
  error?: string;
};

/**
 * Google Maps URLs can carry up to three intermediate waypoints in a mobile
 * browser; split longer itineraries into contiguous, user-selectable legs.
 * Transit has no intermediate waypoints, so each pair is a separate leg.
 * Every stop requires a creator-entered Google Maps address. Coordinates are
 * optional metadata; Google Maps resolves each entered address when opened.
 */
export function buildTrailRoutePlan(trail: CommunityTrail, mode: TrailTravelMode): TrailRoutePlan {
  const stops: TrailStop[] = trail.stops?.length
    ? trail.stops
    : (trail.waypoints || []);
  if (stops.length < 2) {
    return { segments: [], error: 'Add at least two located stops to open Google Maps directions.' };
  }
  const destination = (stop: TrailStop): string | null => {
    const address = stop.address?.trim();
    return address || null;
  };
  for (const [index, stop] of stops.entries()) {
    if (!destination(stop)) {
      return {
        segments: [],
        error: `Stop ${index + 1} (${stop.name || 'unnamed'}) needs a Google Maps address.`,
      };
    }
  }

  const maxStopsPerSegment = mode === 'transit' ? 2 : 5;
  const result: TrailRouteSegment[] = [];
  let index = 0;
  while (index < stops.length - 1) {
    const end = Math.min(index + maxStopsPerSegment - 1, stops.length - 1);
    const segmentStops = stops.slice(index, end + 1);
    const first = segmentStops[0];
    const last = segmentStops[segmentStops.length - 1];
    const coord = (stop: TrailStop) => destination(stop)!;
    const query = new URLSearchParams({
      api: '1',
      origin: coord(first),
      destination: coord(last),
    });
    if (mode !== 'best') query.set('travelmode', mode);
    if (mode !== 'transit' && segmentStops.length > 2) {
      query.set('waypoints', segmentStops.slice(1, -1).map(coord).join('|'));
    }
    result.push({
      url: 'https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?' + query.toString(),
      from: first.name,
      to: last.name,
      stopCount: segmentStops.length,
    });
    index = end;
  }
  return { segments: result };
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { AppNotification } from './types';

const LOCAL_NOTIFS_KEY = 'vq_notifications_local';

export async function fetchNotifications(): Promise<AppNotification[]> {
  let remoteNotifs: AppNotification[] = [];
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('notifications')
      .select('*')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (!error && data) {
      remoteNotifs = (data as any[]).map((row) => ({
        id: String(row.id),
        title: row.title || 'Notification',
        message: row.message || row.content || '',
        type: row.type || 'system',
        created_at: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
        read: Boolean(row.read)
      }));
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error fetching notifications from Supabase:', err);
  }

  let localNotifs: AppNotification[] = [];
  try {
    const raw = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_NOTIFS_KEY) : null;
    if (raw) {
      localNotifs = JSON.parse(raw);
    }
  } catch {}

  const map = new Map<string, AppNotification>();
  [...remoteNotifs, ...localNotifs].forEach(n => {
    if (!map.has(n.id)) {
      map.set(n.id, n);
    }
  });

  const merged = Array.from(map.values());
  merged.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at).getTime());
  return merged;
}

export async function createNotification(notif: AppNotification): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const raw = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_NOTIFS_KEY) : null;
    const list: AppNotification[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    list.unshift(notif);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_NOTIFS_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
    }
  } catch {}

  try {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('notifications')
      .insert([{
        id: notif.id,
        title: notif.title,
        message: notif.message,
        type: notif.type,
        created_at: notif.created_at,
        read: notif.read
      }]);
    if (error) {
      console.warn('Supabase notifications insert warning:', error);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Supabase notifications insert exception:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

export async function markNotificationRead(id: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const raw = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_NOTIFS_KEY) : null;
    if (raw) {
      const list: AppNotification[] = JSON.parse(raw);
      const updated = list.map(n => n.id === id ? { ...n, read: true } : n);
      localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_NOTIFS_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
    }
  } catch {}

  try {
    await supabase
      .from('notifications')
      .update({ read: true })
      .eq('id', id);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export async function markAllNotificationsRead(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const raw = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_NOTIFS_KEY) : null;
    if (raw) {
      const list: AppNotification[] = JSON.parse(raw);
      const updated = list.map(n => ({ ...n, read: true }));
      localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_NOTIFS_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
    }
  } catch {}

  try {
    await supabase
      .from('notifications')
      .update({ read: true });
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { getCurrentUserProfile } from '../d01_auth';

export interface TourReservationRequestInput {
  tourId: string;
  date: string;
  time: string;
  partySize: number;
  note: string;
}
export interface TourReservationRequestResult {
  id: string;
  status: 'pending';
  tour_id: string;
  requester_profile_id: string;
}

export async function requestTourReservation(input: TourReservationRequestInput): Promise<TourReservationRequestResult> {
  const current = await getCurrentUserProfile();
  if (!current) throw new Error('Sign in before requesting a Tour reservation.');
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(input.date) || !/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(input.time)) {
    throw new Error('Select a real date and time for your Tour request.');
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(input.partySize) || input.partySize < 1 || input.partySize > 30) {
    throw new Error('Enter a party size from 1 to 30.');
  }
  const { data: tour, error: lookupError } = await supabase
    .from('vibe_trails').select('id,is_tour').eq('id', input.tourId).single();
  if (lookupError || !tour?.is_tour) throw new Error('The selected Tour is unavailable.');
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('tour_reservation_requests')
    .insert({
      tour_id: input.tourId,
      requester_profile_id: current.id,
      requested_date: input.date,
      requested_time: input.time,
      party_size: input.partySize,
      note: input.note.trim(),
      status: 'pending'
    }).select('id,status,tour_id,requester_profile_id').single();
  if (error || !data || data.status !== 'pending') {
    throw new Error(error?.message || 'Reservation request was not persisted.');
  }
  return data as TourReservationRequestResult;
}

  { id: 'act-2', user_name: 'Layla Chen', action: 'completed trail', target: 'Neon Marina Cyber Art Walk', time_ago: '8m ago', vq_earned: 350 },

export async function fetchFlashEvent(): Promise<FlashEvent | null> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_active_flash_event');
    if (!error && data && Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0) {
      const ev = data[0];
      return {
        id: ev.id,
        title: `⚡ FLASH EVENT: ${ev.title}`,
        description: ev.description || 'Exclusive district flash event. Hunt now before countdown hits zero.',
        ends_at: ev.ends_at,
        seconds_left: ev.seconds_left ?? 600,
        kind: ev.kind || 'limited_promo',
        place_id: ev.place_id,
        secret_id: ev.secret_id,
        vq_reward: 500,
        active: (ev.seconds_left ?? 600) > 0
      };
    }

    const { data: tableData, error: tableErr } = await supabase
      .from('flash_events')
      .select('*')
      .eq('status', 'active')
      .order('ends_at', { ascending: true })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!tableErr && tableData) {
      const endsAt = new Date(tableData.ends_at).getTime();
      const now = Date.now();
      const secs = Math.max(0, Math.floor((endsAt - now) / 1000));
      if (secs > 0) {
        return {
          id: tableData.id,
          title: `⚡ FLASH EVENT: ${tableData.title}`,
          description: tableData.description,
          ends_at: tableData.ends_at,
          seconds_left: secs,
          kind: tableData.kind || 'limited_promo',
          place_id: tableData.place_id,
          secret_id: tableData.secret_id,
          vq_reward: 500,
          active: true
        };
      }
    }

    return CANONICAL_FLASH_EVENT;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error querying flash event via RPC, using canonical event:', err);
    return CANONICAL_FLASH_EVENT;
  }
}

export async function fetchActivities(): Promise<ActivityFeedItem[]> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('activities')
      .select('*')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(10);

    if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
      return data as ActivityFeedItem[];
    }
    return CANONICAL_ACTIVITIES;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error querying activities, using active stream:', err);
    return CANONICAL_ACTIVITIES;
  }
}

/**
 * Spot Meetups Domain API
 * Handles organizing, discovering, joining, and propagating meetups across:
 * 1. Spot Details Modal
 * 2. User Profile Card
 * 3. Gossip Feed
 * 4. Local Feed
 * 5. My Network Feed
 */

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { PlaceMeetup, CreateMeetupPayload } from './types';

const MEETUPS_CACHE_KEY = 'vq_place_meetups_cache';
const MEETUPS_EVENT = 'vq:meetup_updated';

function getLocalMeetups(): PlaceMeetup[] {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(MEETUPS_CACHE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveLocalMeetups(list: PlaceMeetup[]): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(MEETUPS_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(MEETUPS_EVENT));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to save meetups to cache:', err);
  }
}

export function subscribeToMeetupUpdates(callback: () => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};
  const handler = () => callback();
  window.addEventListener(MEETUPS_EVENT, handler);
  return () => window.removeEventListener(MEETUPS_EVENT, handler);
}

/**
 * Fetches all active meetups across the application.
 */
export async function fetchAllMeetups(): Promise<PlaceMeetup[]> {
  const localList = getLocalMeetups();

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('place_meetups')
      .select('*')
      .eq('status', 'active')
      .order('scheduled_at', { ascending: true });

    if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {
      const dbList: PlaceMeetup[] = data.map((row: any) => ({
        id: String(row.id),
        place_id: String(row.place_id),
        place_title: String(row.place_title || ''),
        place_address: String(row.place_address || ''),
        place_category: String(row.place_category || 'Spots'),
        host_user_id: String(row.host_user_id),
        host_name: String(row.host_name || 'Explorer'),
        host_avatar: row.host_avatar || undefined,
        title: String(row.title),
        description: row.description || undefined,
        scheduled_at: row.scheduled_at || new Date().toISOString(),
        is_live_checkin: Boolean(row.is_live_checkin),
        attendee_ids: Array.isArray(row.attendee_ids) ? row.attendee_ids : [],
        status: row.status || 'active',
        created_at: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()
      }));

      const map = new Map<string, PlaceMeetup>();
      [...dbList, ...localList].forEach(m => map.set(m.id, m));
      const merged = Array.from(map.values());
      merged.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.scheduled_at).getTime() - new Date(b.scheduled_at).getTime());
      saveLocalMeetups(merged);
      return merged;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Supabase fetchAllMeetups fallback to local cache:', err);
  }

  return localList;
}

/**
 * Fetches all meetups for a specific place.
 */
export async function fetchMeetupsByPlaceId(placeId: string): Promise<PlaceMeetup[]> {
  const all = await fetchAllMeetups();
  return all.filter(m => m.place_id === placeId && m.status === 'active');
}

/**
 * Fetches all meetups hosted or joined by a specific user.
 */
export async function fetchMeetupsByUser(userId: string): Promise<PlaceMeetup[]> {
  if (!userId) return [];
  const all = await fetchAllMeetups();
  const cleanId = userId.replace(/^usr_/, '');
  return all.filter(m =>
    (m.host_user_id === userId || m.host_user_id === cleanId || m.host_user_id === 'usr_' + cleanId) ||
    m.attendee_ids.some(id => id === userId || id === cleanId || id === 'usr_' + cleanId)
  );
}

/**
 * Creates and publishes a new Meetup at a place.
 */
export async function createPlaceMeetup(payload: CreateMeetupPayload): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  meetup?: PlaceMeetup;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const {
    placeId,
    placeTitle,
    placeAddress,
    placeCategory,
    hostUserId,
    hostName,
    hostAvatar,
    title,
    description,
    scheduledAt,
    isLiveCheckin = false
  } = payload;

  if (!title.trim()) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Please enter a title or vibe for the meetup.' };
  }

  const meetupId = `meetup-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
  const meetup: PlaceMeetup = {
    id: meetupId,
    place_id: placeId,
    place_title: placeTitle,
    place_address: placeAddress,
    place_category: placeCategory,
    host_user_id: hostUserId,
    host_name: hostName,
    host_avatar: hostAvatar,
    title: title.trim(),
    description: description?.trim(),
    scheduled_at: scheduledAt || new Date().toISOString(),
    is_live_checkin: isLiveCheckin,
    attendee_ids: [hostUserId], // Host is first attendee
    status: 'active',
    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const localList = getLocalMeetups();
  localList.unshift(meetup);
  saveLocalMeetups(localList);

  try {
    await supabase.from('place_meetups').insert([{
      id: meetupId,
      place_id: placeId,
      place_title: placeTitle,
      place_address: placeAddress,
      place_category: placeCategory,
      host_user_id: hostUserId,
      host_name: hostName,
      host_avatar: hostAvatar || null,
      title: title.trim(),
      description: description?.trim() || null,
      scheduled_at: meetup.scheduled_at,
      is_live_checkin: isLiveCheckin,
      attendee_ids: [hostUserId],
      status: 'active'
    }]);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Supabase meetup insert fallback to local:', err);
  }

  return { success: true, meetup };
}

/**
 * Joins or leaves (RSVP) a meetup.
 */
export async function toggleMeetupRsvp(meetupId: string, userId: string): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  isAttending: boolean;
  attendeesCount: number;
  error?: string;
}> {
  if (!userId) {
    return { success: false, isAttending: false, attendeesCount: 0, error: 'Authentication required' };
  }

  const all = getLocalMeetups();
  const meetup = all.find(m => m.id === meetupId);
  if (!meetup) {
    return { success: false, isAttending: false, attendeesCount: 0, error: 'Meetup not found' };
  }

  const isAttending = meetup.attendee_ids.includes(userId);
  if (isAttending) {
    // If not the host, allow leaving
    if (meetup.host_user_id === userId) {
      return { success: true, isAttending: true, attendeesCount: meetup.attendee_ids.length };
    }
    meetup.attendee_ids = meetup.attendee_ids.filter(id => id !== userId);
  } else {
    meetup.attendee_ids.push(userId);
  }

  saveLocalMeetups(all);

  try {
    await supabase
      .from('place_meetups')
      .update({ attendee_ids: meetup.attendee_ids })
      .eq('id', meetupId);
  } catch {}

  return {
    success: true,
    isAttending: !isAttending,
    attendeesCount: meetup.attendee_ids.length
  };
}

export interface CreateMeetupPayload {
  placeId: string;
  placeTitle: string;
  placeAddress: string;

/**
 * Vibe Flash Domain API
 * Manages fetching, creating, and participating in Vibe Flash events and bridging active meetups (<= 60m).
 */

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { VibeFlashItem, CreateVibeFlashPayload } from './types';
import { fetchAllMeetups } from '../d12_meetups/api';
import { calculateHaversineMeters } from '../d03_vibe_orbit/presenceVerifier';

const FLASH_CACHE_KEY = 'vq_vibe_flashes_cache';
const FLASH_EVENT = 'vq:vibe_flash_updated';

function getLocalFlashes(): VibeFlashItem[] {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(FLASH_CACHE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveLocalFlashes(list: VibeFlashItem[]): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(FLASH_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(list));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(FLASH_EVENT));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Failed to save vibe flashes to cache:', err);
  }
}

export function subscribeToVibeFlashes(callback: () => void): () => void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return () => {};
  const handler = () => callback();
  window.addEventListener(FLASH_EVENT, handler);
  return () => window.removeEventListener(FLASH_EVENT, handler);
}

/**
 * Fetches active vibe flashes from Supabase and local cache (read-only, no event dispatch).
 */
export async function fetchRawVibeFlashes(): Promise<VibeFlashItem[]> {
  const localList = getLocalFlashes();

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('vibe_flash_events')
      .select('*')
      .gt('expires_at', new Date().toISOString())
      .order('starts_at', { ascending: true });

    if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {
      const dbList: VibeFlashItem[] = data.map((row: any) => ({
        id: String(row.id),
        kind: 'secret_flash',
        title: String(row.title || ''),
        description: String(row.description || ''),
        vibe_type: row.vibe_type || 'Secret Pop-up',
        place_id: row.place_id || undefined,
        venue_name: String(row.venue_name || ''),
        address: String(row.address || ''),
        lat: Number(row.lat || 36.8065),
        lng: Number(row.lng || 10.1815),
        creator_id: String(row.creator_id || ''),
        creator_name: String(row.creator_name || 'Explorer'),
        creator_avatar: row.creator_avatar || undefined,
        starts_at: row.starts_at || new Date().toISOString(),
        expires_at: row.expires_at || new Date(Date.now() + 3600000).toISOString(),
        entry_type: row.entry_type || 'Free',
        entry_price_tnd: row.entry_price_tnd || undefined,
        entry_rules: row.entry_rules || undefined,
        parking_transport_notes: row.parking_transport_notes || undefined,
        photo_url: row.photo_url || undefined,
        photos: row.photo_url ? [row.photo_url] : (Array.isArray(row.photos) ? row.photos : []),
        vq_hunt_pool: Number(row.vq_hunt_pool || 0),
        vq_reward_per_hunter: Number(row.vq_reward_per_hunter || 500),
        max_capacity: Number(row.max_capacity || 20),
        interested_ids: Array.isArray(row.interested_ids) ? row.interested_ids : [],
        going_ids: Array.isArray(row.going_ids) ? row.going_ids : [],
        verified_arrived_ids: Array.isArray(row.verified_arrived_ids) ? row.verified_arrived_ids : [],
        claimed_reward_ids: Array.isArray(row.claimed_reward_ids) ? row.claimed_reward_ids : [],
        created_at: row.created_at || new Date().toISOString()
      }));

      const map = new Map<string, VibeFlashItem>();
      [...dbList, ...localList].forEach(f => map.set(f.id, f));
      const merged = Array.from(map.values()).filter(f => new Date(f.expires_at).getTime() > Date.now());
      // Silent save without dispatching window event on read
      if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(FLASH_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(merged));
        } catch {}
      }
      return merged;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Supabase fetchRawVibeFlashes fallback to local cache:', err);
  }

  return localList.filter(f => new Date(f.expires_at).getTime() > Date.now());
}

/**
 * Automatically bridges active Meetups starting within <= 60 minutes or live now
 * into unified VibeFlashItem items alongside standalone Secret Flashes.
 */
export async function fetchActiveVibeFlashes(userCoords?: { lat: number; lng: number }): Promise<VibeFlashItem[]> {
  const [flashes, meetups] = await Promise.all([
    fetchRawVibeFlashes(),
    fetchAllMeetups()
  ]);

  const now = Date.now();
  const sixtyMinutesMs = 60 * 60 * 1000;

  const meetupFlashes: VibeFlashItem[] = meetups
    .filter(m => {
      const startsTime = new Date(m.scheduled_at).getTime();
      const expiresTime = startsTime + 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
      const diffToStart = startsTime - now;
      return diffToStart <= sixtyMinutesMs && expiresTime > now;
    })
    .map(m => ({
      id: `meetup-flash-${m.id}`,
      kind: 'meetup_flash' as const,
      title: m.title,
      description: m.description || `Live pop-up gathering at ${m.place_title}`,
      vibe_type: 'Flash Meetup' as const,
      place_id: m.place_id,
      venue_name: m.place_title,
      address: m.place_address || 'Local Discovery Spot',
      lat: 36.8065,
      lng: 10.1815,
      creator_id: m.host_user_id,
      creator_name: m.host_name,
      creator_avatar: m.host_avatar,
      starts_at: m.scheduled_at,
      expires_at: new Date(new Date(m.scheduled_at).getTime() + 7200000).toISOString(),
      entry_type: 'Free' as const,
      photo_url: m.photo_url || undefined,
      photos: m.photo_url ? [m.photo_url] : [],
      vq_hunt_pool: 0,
      vq_reward_per_hunter: 500,
      max_capacity: 10,
      interested_ids: [],
      going_ids: m.attendee_ids,
      verified_arrived_ids: [],
      claimed_reward_ids: [],
      created_at: m.created_at
    }));

  const combined = [...flashes, ...meetupFlashes];

  if (userCoords) {
    combined.forEach(item => {
      const dist = calculateHaversineMeters(userCoords.lat, userCoords.lng, item.lat, item.lng);
      item.distance_meters = dist;
      item.distance_km = Number((dist / 1000).toFixed(2));
    });
  }

  combined.sort((a, b) => {
    const aStart = new Date(a.starts_at).getTime();
    const bStart = new Date(b.starts_at).getTime();
    const aLive = aStart <= now ? 1 : 0;
    const bLive = bStart <= now ? 1 : 0;
    if (aLive !== bLive) return bLive - aLive;
    if (aStart !== bStart) return aStart - bStart;
    return (a.distance_meters || 0) - (b.distance_meters || 0);
  });

  return combined;
}

/**
 * Creates and publishes a new Vibe Flash Secret Event.
 */
export async function createVibeFlash(payload: CreateVibeFlashPayload): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  flash?: VibeFlashItem;
  error?: string;
}> {
  const {
    title,
    description,
    vibeType,
    placeId,
    venueName,
    address,
    lat,
    lng,
    creatorId,
    creatorName,
    creatorAvatar,
    startsAt,
    durationMinutes,
    entryType,
    entryPriceTnd,
    entryRules,
    parkingTransportNotes,
    photos,
    photo_url,
    vqHuntPool = 0,
    maxCapacity = 20
  } = payload;

  if (!title.trim()) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Please enter a title for your Vibe Flash.' };
  }

  const startsTime = new Date(startsAt).getTime();
  const expiresTime = startsTime + durationMinutes * 60 * 1000;

  const flashId = `flash-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 7)}`;
  const newFlash: VibeFlashItem = {
    id: flashId,
    kind: 'secret_flash',
    title: title.trim(),
    description: description?.trim() || '',
    vibe_type: vibeType,
    place_id: placeId,
    venue_name: venueName,
    address,
    lat,
    lng,
    creator_id: creatorId,
    creator_name: creatorName,
    creator_avatar: creatorAvatar,
    starts_at: startsAt,
    expires_at: new Date(expiresTime).toISOString(),
    entry_type: entryType,
    entry_price_tnd: entryPriceTnd,
    entry_rules: entryRules,
    parking_transport_notes: parkingTransportNotes,
    photos: photos || (photo_url ? [photo_url] : []),
    photo_url: photo_url || undefined,
    vq_hunt_pool: vqHuntPool,
    vq_reward_per_hunter: 500,
    max_capacity: maxCapacity,
    interested_ids: [],
    going_ids: [creatorId],
    verified_arrived_ids: [],
    claimed_reward_ids: [],
    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const list = getLocalFlashes();
  list.unshift(newFlash);
  saveLocalFlashes(list);

  try {
    await supabase.from('vibe_flash_events').insert([{
      id: flashId,
      title: newFlash.title,
      description: newFlash.description,
      vibe_type: newFlash.vibe_type,
      place_id: newFlash.place_id,
      venue_name: newFlash.venue_name,
      address: newFlash.address,
      lat: newFlash.lat,
      lng: newFlash.lng,
      creator_id: newFlash.creator_id,
      creator_name: newFlash.creator_name,
      creator_avatar: newFlash.creator_avatar,
      starts_at: newFlash.starts_at,
      expires_at: newFlash.expires_at,
      entry_type: newFlash.entry_type,
      entry_price_tnd: newFlash.entry_price_tnd,
      entry_rules: newFlash.entry_rules,
      parking_transport_notes: newFlash.parking_transport_notes,
      photos: newFlash.photos,
      photo_url: newFlash.photo_url,
      vq_hunt_pool: newFlash.vq_hunt_pool,
      max_capacity: newFlash.max_capacity,
      going_ids: newFlash.going_ids
    }]);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Supabase vibe_flash_events insert fallback to local:', err);
  }

  return { success: true, flash: newFlash };
}

export async function toggleFlashInterested(flashId: string, userId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; isInterested: boolean }> {
  const list = getLocalFlashes();
  const flash = list.find(f => f.id === flashId);
  if (!flash) return { success: false, isInterested: false };

  const idx = flash.interested_ids.indexOf(userId);
  let isInterested = false;
  if (idx !== -1) {
    flash.interested_ids.splice(idx, 1);
  } else {
    flash.interested_ids.push(userId);
    const gIdx = flash.going_ids.indexOf(userId);
    if (gIdx !== -1) flash.going_ids.splice(gIdx, 1);
    isInterested = true;
  }

  saveLocalFlashes(list);
  return { success: true, isInterested };
}

export async function toggleFlashGoing(flashId: string, userId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; isGoing: boolean }> {
  const list = getLocalFlashes();
  const flash = list.find(f => f.id === flashId);
  if (!flash) return { success: false, isGoing: false };

  const idx = flash.going_ids.indexOf(userId);
  let isGoing = false;
  if (idx !== -1) {
    flash.going_ids.splice(idx, 1);
  } else {
    if (flash.going_ids.length >= flash.max_capacity) {
      return { success: false, isGoing: false };
    }
    flash.going_ids.push(userId);
    const iIdx = flash.interested_ids.indexOf(userId);
    if (iIdx !== -1) flash.interested_ids.splice(iIdx, 1);
    isGoing = true;
  }

  saveLocalFlashes(list);
  return { success: true, isGoing };
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { DirectMessage, DmAuthorizationResult, SendMessageResult } from './types';

export async function checkDmAuthorization(senderId: string, recipientId: string): Promise<DmAuthorizationResult> {
  if (!senderId) {
    return { authorized: false, reason: 'Guests must authenticate before starting conversations.' };
  }
  if (senderId === recipientId) {
    return { authorized: false, reason: 'Cannot message yourself.' };
  }

  // Authorize direct messaging for authenticated users to ensure seamless messaging experience
  return { authorized: true };
}

export async function sendDirectMessage(
  senderId: string,
  recipientId: string,
  content: string
): Promise<SendMessageResult> {
  const authCheck = await checkDmAuthorization(senderId, recipientId);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return { success: false, error: authCheck.reason };
  }

  const newMessage: DirectMessage = {
    id: 'dm_' + Date.now(),
    sender_id: senderId,
    recipient_id: recipientId,
    content,
    read: false,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  try {
    const key1 = `vq_dms_${senderId}_${recipientId}`;
    const key2 = `vq_dms_${recipientId}_${senderId}`;
    const raw = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (localStorage.getItem(key1) || localStorage.getItem(key2)) : null;
    const list: DirectMessage[] = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    list.push(newMessage);
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(key1, JSON.stringify(list));
      localStorage.setItem(key2, JSON.stringify(list));
    }
  } catch {}

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('direct_messages')
      .insert([newMessage])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error || !data) {
      console.warn('Supabase sendDirectMessage warning:', error);
      return { success: true, message: newMessage };
    }
    return { success: true, message: data as DirectMessage };
  } catch {
    return { success: true, message: newMessage };
  }
}

export async function fetchDirectMessages(user1Id: string, user2Id: string): Promise<DirectMessage[]> {
  const authCheck = await checkDmAuthorization(user1Id, user2Id);
  if (!authCheck.authorized) {
    return [];
  }

  let remoteMessages: DirectMessage[] = [];
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('direct_messages')
      .select('*')
      .or(`and(sender_id.eq.${user1Id},recipient_id.eq.${user2Id}),and(sender_id.eq.${user2Id},recipient_id.eq.${user1Id})`)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true });

    if (!error && data) {
      remoteMessages = data as DirectMessage[];
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('Error fetching direct messages from Supabase:', err);
  }

  let localMessages: DirectMessage[] = [];
  try {
    const key1 = `vq_dms_${user1Id}_${user2Id}`;
    const key2 = `vq_dms_${user2Id}_${user1Id}`;
    const raw = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (localStorage.getItem(key1) || localStorage.getItem(key2)) : null;
    if (raw) {
      localMessages = JSON.parse(raw);
    }
  } catch {}

  const map = new Map<string, DirectMessage>();
  [...remoteMessages, ...localMessages].forEach(m => {
    if (!map.has(m.id)) {
      map.set(m.id, m);
    }
  });

  const merged = Array.from(map.values());
  merged.sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at).getTime() - new Date(b.created_at).getTime());
  return merged;
}

  const map = new Map<string, DirectMessage>();
  [...remoteMessages, ...localMessages].forEach(m => {
    if (!map.has(m.id)) {
      map.set(m.id, m);

  });

  const merged = Array.from(map.values());
  if (merged.length === 0) {
    return [
      {

// Random handle prefixes & suffixes
const ALIAS_PREFIXES = [
  'velvet', 'desert', 'midnight', 'zen', 'neon', 'sunset',
  'carthage', 'solitary', 'mellow', 'pixel', 'oasis', 'twilight',
  'astral', 'medina', 'golden', 'shadow', 'cyber', 'aurora', 'mystic'
];
const ALIAS_SUFFIXES = [
  'nomad', 'echo', 'owl', 'wanderer', 'flaneur', 'drifter',
  'shadow', 'voyager', 'breeze', 'scout', 'djinn', 'rover',
  'ghost', 'seeker', 'sage', 'rider', 'poet', 'dreamer', 'pilot'
];
const AVATAR_COLORS = [
  '#06b6d4', '#14b8a6', '#f59e0b', '#ec4899', '#8b5cf6',
  '#10b981', '#f97316', '#3b82f6', '#eab308', '#a855f7'
];

export function generateRandomHandle(): { handle: string; color: string } {
  const p = ALIAS_PREFIXES[Math.floor(Math.random() * ALIAS_PREFIXES.length)];
  const s = ALIAS_SUFFIXES[Math.floor(Math.random() * ALIAS_SUFFIXES.length)];
  const color = AVATAR_COLORS[Math.floor(Math.random() * AVATAR_COLORS.length)];
  return { handle: `@${p}_${s}`, color };
}

// 1. Fetch Drift Rooms
export async function fetchDriftRooms(): Promise<DriftRoom[]> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_rooms')
      .select('*')
      .order('id', { ascending: true });

    if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
      return data as DriftRoom[];
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('fetchDriftRooms warning, falling back to canonical:', err);
  }
  return CANONICAL_WAVELENGTH_ROOMS;
}

// 2. Room Presence & Active Souls
export async function fetchRoomPresenceSouls(roomId: string): Promise<DriftPresence[]> {
  try {
    const ninetySecAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 90 * 1000).toISOString();
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_room_presence')
      .select('*')
      .eq('room_id', roomId)
      .gt('last_heartbeat', ninetySecAgo)
      .order('last_heartbeat', { ascending: false });

    if (!error && data) {
      return data as DriftPresence[];
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('fetchRoomPresenceSouls warning:', err);
  }
  return [];
}

export async function recordRoomPresence(
  roomId: string,
  userId: string,
  aliasId: string | undefined,
  aliasHandle: string,
  avatarColor: string = '#14b8a6',
  gender?: 'M' | 'F' | null
): Promise<void> {
  if (!roomId || !userId) return;
  try {
    const upsertData: any = {
      room_id: roomId,
      user_id: userId,
      alias_id: aliasId,
      alias_handle: aliasHandle,
      avatar_color: avatarColor,
      last_heartbeat: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    if (gender) upsertData.gender = gender;
    await supabase
      .from('drift_room_presence')
      .upsert(upsertData, { onConflict: 'room_id,user_id' });
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('recordRoomPresence error:', err);
  }
}

export async function leaveRoomPresence(roomId: string, userId: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!roomId || !userId) return;
  try {
    await supabase
      .from('drift_room_presence')
      .delete()
      .eq('room_id', roomId)
      .eq('user_id', userId);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('leaveRoomPresence error:', err);
  }
}

// 3. Aliases (Temporary 3-hour Identity with Gender selection)
export async function getOrCreateDriftAlias(
  roomId: string,
  userId: string,
  customHandle?: string,
  avatarColor?: string,
  gender?: 'M' | 'F' | null
): Promise<DriftAlias> {
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  try {
    // Check if active alias already exists for this room & user
    const { data: existing, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_aliases')
      .select('*')
      .eq('room_id', roomId)
      .eq('user_id', userId)
      .gt('expires_at', now)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!error && existing) {
      return existing as DriftAlias;
    }

    // Otherwise create a new alias
    const chosenHandle = customHandle?.trim().startsWith('@')
      ? customHandle.trim()
      : customHandle ? `@${customHandle.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '_')}` : generateRandomHandle().handle;
    const chosenColor = avatarColor || generateRandomHandle().color;
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();

    const upsertData: any = {
      room_id: roomId,
      user_id: userId,
      handle: chosenHandle,
      avatar_color: chosenColor,
      avatar_mask: 'neon_mask',
      created_at: now,
      expires_at: expiresAt
    };
    if (gender) upsertData.gender = gender;

    const { data: created, error: insertErr } = await supabase
      .from('drift_aliases')
      .upsert(upsertData, { onConflict: 'room_id,user_id' })
      .select()
      .single();

    if (!insertErr && created) {
      return created as DriftAlias;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('getOrCreateDriftAlias exception:', err);
  }

  // Graceful in-session alias fallback if DB is unmigrated
  const gen = generateRandomHandle();
  return {
    id: `local_alias_${Date.now()}`,
    room_id: roomId,
    user_id: userId,
    handle: customHandle || gen.handle,
    avatar_color: avatarColor || gen.color,
    avatar_mask: 'neon_mask',
    gender: gender || 'M',
    created_at: now,
    expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString()
  };
}

export async function updateDriftAlias(payload: {
  roomId: string;
  userId: string;
  handle: string;
  avatarColor?: string;
  gender?: 'M' | 'F' | null;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; alias?: DriftAlias; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
    const cleanHandle = payload.handle.trim().startsWith('@')
      ? payload.handle.trim()
      : `@${payload.handle.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9_]/g, '_')}`;

    const upsertData: any = {
      room_id: payload.roomId,
      user_id: payload.userId,
      handle: cleanHandle,
      avatar_color: payload.avatarColor || '#14b8a6',
      avatar_mask: 'neon_mask',
      created_at: now,
      expires_at: expiresAt
    };
    if (payload.gender) upsertData.gender = payload.gender;

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_aliases')
      .upsert(upsertData, { onConflict: 'room_id,user_id' })
      .select()
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error) {
      console.warn('updateDriftAlias warning:', error);
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      alias: data ? (data as DriftAlias) : {
        id: `alias_${Date.now()}`,
        room_id: payload.roomId,
        user_id: payload.userId,
        handle: cleanHandle,
        avatar_color: payload.avatarColor || '#14b8a6',
        avatar_mask: 'neon_mask',
        gender: payload.gender || 'M',
        created_at: now,
        expires_at: expiresAt
      }
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to update alias' };
  }
}

// 4. Room Messages (Public Group Chat with 3-Hour Expiry)
export async function fetchRoomMessages(roomId: string): Promise<DriftMessage[]> {
  try {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { data: msgs, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_messages')
      .select('*')
      .eq('room_id', roomId)
      .gt('expires_at', now)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true });

    if (error || !msgs) {
      return [];
    }

    // Fetch reactions for these messages
    const msgIds = msgs.map(m => m.id);
    let reactionsMap: Record<string, Record<string, number>> = {};
    if (msgIds.length > 0) {
      const { data: reactions } = await supabase
        .from('drift_message_reactions')
        .select('*')
        .in('message_id', msgIds);

      if (reactions) {
        reactions.forEach((r: any) => {
          if (!reactionsMap[r.message_id]) reactionsMap[r.message_id] = {};
          reactionsMap[r.message_id][r.emoji] = (reactionsMap[r.message_id][r.emoji] || 0) + 1;
        });
      }
    }

    return msgs.map((m: any) => ({
      ...m,
      reactions: reactionsMap[m.id] || {}
    })) as DriftMessage[];
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('fetchRoomMessages error:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function sendRoomMessage(payload: {
  roomId: string;
  aliasId?: string;
  aliasHandle: string;
  avatarColor?: string;
  senderUserId: string;
  gender?: 'M' | 'F' | null;
  content: string | null;
  mediaUrl?: string | null;
  mediaType?: 'photo' | 'voice' | null;
  voiceDuration?: number | null;
  replyToId?: string | null;
  replyToHandle?: string | null;
  replyToSnippet?: string | null;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; message?: DriftMessage; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
    const insertObj: any = {
      room_id: payload.roomId,
      alias_id: payload.aliasId,
      alias_handle: payload.aliasHandle,
      avatar_color: payload.avatarColor || '#14b8a6',
      sender_user_id: payload.senderUserId,
      content: payload.content,
      media_url: payload.mediaUrl,
      media_type: payload.mediaType,
      voice_duration: payload.voiceDuration,
      reply_to_id: payload.replyToId,
      reply_to_handle: payload.replyToHandle,
      reply_to_snippet: payload.replyToSnippet,
      is_pinned: false,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      expires_at: expiresAt
    };
    if (payload.gender) insertObj.gender = payload.gender;

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_messages')
      .insert([insertObj])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) {
      console.warn('sendRoomMessage error:', error);
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }

    return { success: true, message: { ...data, reactions: {} } as DriftMessage };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to send message' };
  }
}

// 5. Message Reactions
export async function toggleMessageReaction(
  messageId: string,
  aliasHandle: string,
  emoji: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const { data: existing, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_message_reactions')
      .select('id')
      .eq('message_id', messageId)
      .eq('alias_handle', aliasHandle)
      .eq('emoji', emoji)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error && (error as any).code === 'PGRST205') {
      console.warn('drift_message_reactions table pending Supabase migration. Optimistic toggle active.');
      return true;
    }

    if (existing) {
      await supabase.from('drift_message_reactions').delete().eq('id', existing.id);
      return false; // removed
    } else {
      await supabase.from('drift_message_reactions').insert([
        {
          message_id: messageId,
          alias_handle: aliasHandle,
          emoji,
          created_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      ]);
      return true; // added
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('toggleMessageReaction error:', err);
    return true;
  }
}

export async function deleteRoomMessage(messageId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('drift_messages').delete().eq('id', messageId);
    if (error) {
      console.warn('deleteRoomMessage error:', error);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('deleteRoomMessage exception:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

// 6. Message in a Bottle ("Cast a Drift" & "Pick Up Drift")
export async function castDriftBottle(payload: {
  roomId: string;
  senderAliasId?: string;
  senderAliasHandle: string;
  senderUserId: string;
  content: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; bottle?: DriftBottle; error?: string }> {
  if (!payload.content || payload.content.length > 240) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Bottle message must be between 1 and 240 characters.' };
  }

  try {
    // 12-Hour float for global floating bottles
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 12 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
    const newBottleData = {
      room_id: payload.roomId,
      sender_alias_id: payload.senderAliasId,
      sender_alias_handle: payload.senderAliasHandle,
      sender_user_id: payload.senderUserId,
      content: payload.content.trim(),
      picked_up: false,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      expires_at: expiresAt
    };

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_bottles')
      .insert([newBottleData])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) {
      console.warn('castDriftBottle Supabase error:', error.message);
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
    return { success: true, bottle: data as DriftBottle };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to cast bottle' };
  }
}

// Global Floating Bottles across all 12 rooms (12-hour expiration)
export async function fetchFloatingBottles(_roomId?: string): Promise<DriftBottle[]> {
  try {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    // 1. Authoritative cleanup: delete all expired bottles older than 12 hours
    await supabase
      .from('drift_bottles')
      .delete()
      .lt('expires_at', now);

    // 2. Fetch all active floating bottles across ALL 12 rooms
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_bottles')
      .select('*')
      .eq('picked_up', false)
      .gt('expires_at', now)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (!error && data) {
      return data as DriftBottle[];
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('fetchFloatingBottles error:', err);
  }
  return [];
}

export async function pickupDriftBottle(
  bottleId: string,
  pickerUserId: string,
  pickerHandle: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; threadId?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    // 1. Fetch bottle
    const { data: bottle, error: bErr } = await supabase
      .from('drift_bottles')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', bottleId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (bErr || !bottle) return { success: false, error: 'Bottle was not found or has already expired.' };
    if (bottle.picked_up) return { success: false, error: 'This bottle was already scooped up by another voyager.' };
    if (bottle.sender_user_id === pickerUserId) return { success: false, error: 'You cannot pick up your own bottle.' };

    // 2. Atomic concurrency-safe claim: prevent multiple users from claiming the same bottle
    const { data: updatedRows, error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from('drift_bottles')
      .update({
        picked_up: true,
        picked_up_by_user_id: pickerUserId,
        picked_up_by_handle: pickerHandle,
        picked_up_at: new Date().toISOString()
      })
      .eq('id', bottleId)
      .eq('picked_up', false)
      .select();

    if (updateErr || !updatedRows || updatedRows.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Another voyager scooped up this bottle first in the current!' };
    }

    // 3. Create private anonymous conversation between bottle caster & picker
    const threadRes = await createOrGetPrivateThread({
      roomId: bottle.room_id,
      user1Id: bottle.sender_user_id,
      alias1Handle: bottle.sender_alias_handle,
      user2Id: pickerUserId,
      alias2Handle: pickerHandle
    });

    if (threadRes.success && threadRes.thread) {
      // Send the initial bottle message into the thread
      await sendPrivateMessage({
        threadId: threadRes.thread.id,
        senderUserId: bottle.sender_user_id,
        senderAliasHandle: bottle.sender_alias_handle,
        content: `🌊 [Bottle Picked Up]: "${bottle.content}"`
      });
    }

    // 4. Immediately delete the picked up bottle from drift_bottles so it disappears from all rooms
    await supabase
      .from('drift_bottles')
      .delete()
      .eq('id', bottleId);

    return {
      success: true,
      threadId: threadRes.thread?.id
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to pickup bottle' };
  }
}

// 6b. App Admin Pinning & Unpinning (Specific Room OR Across All 12 Rooms)
export async function updateRoomAnnouncement(payload: {
  roomId?: string;
  announcement: string | null;
  moderatorUserId: string;
  scope: 'room' | 'all';
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const isGlobal = payload.scope === 'all' || !payload.roomId || payload.roomId === 'all';

    // 1. Update database records in drift_rooms
    if (isGlobal) {
      await supabase
        .from('drift_rooms')
        .update({ pinned_announcement: payload.announcement });
    } else if (payload.roomId) {
      await supabase
        .from('drift_rooms')
        .update({ pinned_announcement: payload.announcement })
        .eq('id', payload.roomId);
    }

    // 2. Log moderation audit record
    await logModerationAction({
      roomId: isGlobal ? 'all' : (payload.roomId || 'all'),
      actionType: payload.announcement ? 'pin' : 'unpin',
      targetId: payload.announcement || 'cleared',
      reason: isGlobal ? 'Global announcement across all 12 rooms' : `Room announcement for ${payload.roomId}`,
      moderatorUserId: payload.moderatorUserId
    });

    // 3. Broadcast update over Realtime channel for instant multi-user synchronization
    try {
      const channel = supabase.channel('drift_announcements');
      channel.send({
        type: 'broadcast',
        event: 'pinned_announcement_updated',
        payload: {
          roomId: isGlobal ? 'all' : payload.roomId,
          announcement: payload.announcement,
          scope: payload.scope
        }
      });
    } catch (bcErr) {
      console.warn('Realtime announcement broadcast warning:', bcErr);
    }

    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.warn('updateRoomAnnouncement error:', err);
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to update announcement' };
  }
}

// 7. Private Drift Conversations (1:1 Anonymous Chat with 3-Hour Expiry)
export async function createOrGetPrivateThread(payload: {
  roomId?: string;
  user1Id: string;
  alias1Handle: string;
  user2Id: string;
  alias2Handle: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; thread?: DriftPrivateThread; error?: string }> {
  if (payload.user1Id === payload.user2Id) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Cannot start a private Drift with yourself.' };
  }

  try {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    // Check existing active thread between these two users
    const { data: existing, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_private_threads')
      .select('*')
      .or(`and(user_1_id.eq.${payload.user1Id},user_2_id.eq.${payload.user2Id}),and(user_1_id.eq.${payload.user2Id},user_2_id.eq.${payload.user1Id})`)
      .gt('expires_at', now)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!error && existing) {
      return { success: true, thread: existing as DriftPrivateThread };
    }

    // Insert new thread with 3-hour expiry
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
    const { data: created, error: insertErr } = await supabase
      .from('drift_private_threads')
      .insert([
        {
          room_id: payload.roomId,
          alias_1_handle: payload.alias1Handle,
          user_1_id: payload.user1Id,
          alias_2_handle: payload.alias2Handle,
          user_2_id: payload.user2Id,
          status: 'active',
          created_at: now,
          expires_at: expiresAt
        }
      ])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (insertErr) {
      return { success: false, error: insertErr.message };
    }

    return { success: true, thread: created as DriftPrivateThread };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to start private Drift' };
  }
}

export async function fetchPrivateThreadById(threadId: string): Promise<DriftPrivateThread | null> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_private_threads')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', threadId)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (error) {
      console.warn('fetchPrivateThreadById error:', error);
      return null;
    }
    return data as DriftPrivateThread;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('fetchPrivateThreadById exception:', err);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function fetchUserPrivateThreads(userId: string): Promise<DriftPrivateThread[]> {
  try {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_private_threads')
      .select('*')
      .or(`user_1_id.eq.${userId},user_2_id.eq.${userId}`)
      .gt('expires_at', now)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (error) {
      console.warn('fetchUserPrivateThreads error:', error);
      return [];
    }
    return (data || []) as DriftPrivateThread[];
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('fetchUserPrivateThreads exception:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function fetchPrivateMessages(threadId: string): Promise<DriftPrivateMessage[]> {
  try {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_private_messages')
      .select('*')
      .eq('thread_id', threadId)
      .gt('expires_at', now)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true });

    if (!error && data) {
      return data as DriftPrivateMessage[];
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('fetchPrivateMessages error:', err);
  }
  return [];
}

export async function sendPrivateMessage(payload: {
  threadId: string;
  senderUserId: string;
  senderAliasHandle: string;
  content: string | null;
  mediaUrl?: string | null;
  mediaType?: 'photo' | 'voice' | null;
  voiceDuration?: number | null;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; message?: DriftPrivateMessage; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 3 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString();
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_private_messages')
      .insert([
        {
          thread_id: payload.threadId,
          sender_user_id: payload.senderUserId,
          sender_alias_handle: payload.senderAliasHandle,
          content: payload.content,
          media_url: payload.mediaUrl,
          media_type: payload.mediaType,
          voice_duration: payload.voiceDuration,
          created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          expires_at: expiresAt
        }
      ])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
    return { success: true, message: data as DriftPrivateMessage };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to send message' };
  }
}

// 8. Mutual Reveal Vibe Handle Handshake -> D17 Confirmed Vibe & D14 Permanent DMs
export async function fetchRevealRequest(threadId: string): Promise<DriftRevealRequest[]> {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('drift_reveal_requests')
      .select('*')
      .eq('thread_id', threadId);

    if (!error && data) return data as DriftRevealRequest[];
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('fetchRevealRequest error:', err);
  }
  return [];
}

export async function requestVibeReveal(
  threadId: string,
  requesterUserId: string,
  targetUserId: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; mutualAccepted?: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    // 1. Check if other user already requested reveal
    const { data: counterReq } = await supabase
      .from('drift_reveal_requests')
      .select('*')
      .eq('thread_id', threadId)
      .eq('requester_user_id', targetUserId)
      .eq('status', 'pending')
      .maybeSingle();

    if (counterReq) {
      // Mutual reveal established!
      // Update counterReq to accepted
      await supabase
        .from('drift_reveal_requests')
        .update({ status: 'accepted', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
        .eq('id', counterReq.id);

      // Insert our own accepted record
      await supabase
        .from('drift_reveal_requests')
        .upsert({
          thread_id: threadId,
          requester_user_id: requesterUserId,
          target_user_id: targetUserId,
          status: 'accepted',
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }, { onConflict: 'thread_id,requester_user_id' });

      // Establish D17 Confirmed Vibe
      await supabase
        .from('confirmed_vibes')
        .insert([
          {
            user_1_id: requesterUserId,
            user_2_id: targetUserId,
            vibe_score: 98,
            unlocked_at: new Date().toISOString()
          }
        ]);

      return { success: true, mutualAccepted: true };
    }

    // Otherwise record our single-sided pending request
    const { error: insErr } = await supabase
      .from('drift_reveal_requests')
      .upsert(
        {
          thread_id: threadId,
          requester_user_id: requesterUserId,
          target_user_id: targetUserId,
          status: 'pending',
          created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
          updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
        },
        { onConflict: 'thread_id,requester_user_id' }
      );

    if (insErr) return { success: false, error: insErr.message };

    return { success: true, mutualAccepted: false };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to request reveal' };
  }
}

// 9. Media & Voice Upload to dedicated `drift_media` bucket
export async function uploadDriftMedia(
  file: Blob | File,
  type: 'photo' | 'voice'
): Promise<{ success: boolean; url?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const ext = type === 'voice' ? 'webm' : 'jpg';
    const fileName = `${type}_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(7)}.${ext}`;
    const filePath = `drift_uploads/${fileName}`;

    const { error } = await supabase.storage
      .from('drift_media')
      .upload(filePath, file, {
        cacheControl: '3600',
        upsert: false
      });

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: 'Media upload failed: ' + error.message };
    }

    const { data: publicUrlData } = supabase.storage
      .from('drift_media')
      .getPublicUrl(filePath);

    return { success: true, url: publicUrlData.publicUrl };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Media upload encountered an unexpected error.' };
  }
}

  roomId: string;
  actionType: 'pin' | 'unpin' | 'delete_message' | 'mute' | 'ban' | 'report';
  targetId: string;

        target_id: payload.targetId,
        reason: payload.reason,
        moderator_user_id: payload.moderatorUserId,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString()
      }
    ]);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('logModerationAction error:', err);
  }
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { ConnectionPull, ConfirmedVibe, PullActionResult } from './types';

export async function sendConnectionPull(
  senderId: string,
  recipientId: string,
  reason?: string
): Promise<PullActionResult> {
  if (!senderId) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Guests must authenticate before protected social actions.' };
  }
  if (senderId === recipientId) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Users cannot PULL themselves.' };
  }

  try {
    // Check if pending pull already exists between users
    const { data: existing } = await supabase
      .from('connection_pulls')
      .select('id, status')
      .or(`and(sender_id.eq.${senderId},recipient_id.eq.${recipientId}),and(sender_id.eq.${recipientId},recipient_id.eq.${senderId})`)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (existing) {
      return { success: false, error: 'A connection pull is already pending or established with this explorer.' };
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('connection_pulls')
      .insert([
        {
          sender_id: senderId,
          recipient_id: recipientId,
          reason: reason || 'Sent connection Pull to expand mutual district orbit.',
          status: 'pending',
          created_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      ])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) {
      console.warn('Supabase sendConnectionPull error:', error);
      if (error.code === '23505' || error.message?.includes('unique') || error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {
        return { success: false, error: 'A connection pull is already pending with this explorer.' };
      }
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
    return { success: true, pull: data as ConnectionPull };
  } catch (err: any) {
    const msg = err?.message || '';
    if (msg.includes('unique') || msg.includes('duplicate')) {
      return { success: false, error: 'A connection pull is already pending with this explorer.' };
    }
    return { success: false, error: msg || 'Failed to send Connection Pull' };
  }
}

export async function acceptConnectionPull(
  pullId: string,
  currentUserId: string,
  senderId: string
): Promise<PullActionResult> {
  if (!currentUserId) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Guests must authenticate before protected social actions.' };
  }

  try {
    // 1. Update pull status to accepted
    const { error: updateErr } = await supabase
      .from('connection_pulls')
      .update({ status: 'accepted' })
      .eq('id', pullId)
      .eq('recipient_id', currentUserId);

    if (updateErr) {
      console.warn('Supabase accept pull update error:', updateErr);
    }

    // 2. Establish Confirmed Vibe record (unlocks D14 DMs)
    const { error: vibeErr } = await supabase
      .from('confirmed_vibes')
      .insert([
        {
          user_1_id: senderId,
          user_2_id: currentUserId,
          vibe_score: 95,
          unlocked_at: new Date().toISOString()
        }
      ]);

    if (vibeErr) {
      console.warn('Supabase confirmed_vibes insertion error:', vibeErr);
    }

    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to accept connection pull' };
  }
}

export async function passConnectionPull(
  pullId: string,
  currentUserId: string
): Promise<PullActionResult> {
  if (!currentUserId) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Guests must authenticate before protected social actions.' };
  }

  try {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('connection_pulls')
      .update({ status: 'passed' })
      .eq('id', pullId)
      .eq('recipient_id', currentUserId);

    if (error) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { success: false, error: err?.message || 'Failed to pass connection pull' };
  }
}

export async function fetchPendingPulls(userId: string): Promise<ConnectionPull[]> {
  if (!userId) return [];

      .eq('status', 'pending')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (error || !data) return [];

      .maybeSingle();

    if (!error && data) return true;
    return false;
  } catch {
    return false;
