import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { GuardianReview } from './types';
import { hasCompletedHandshake } from '../d22_handshake';

const LOCAL_REVIEWS_KEY = 'vq_guardian_reviews_store';

function getLocalReviews(): GuardianReview[] {
  try {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_REVIEWS_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveLocalReviews(reviews: GuardianReview[]): void {
  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_REVIEWS_KEY, JSON.stringify(reviews));
    }
  } catch {}
}

export async function fetchGuardianReviews(guardianId: string): Promise<GuardianReview[]> {
  if (!guardianId) return [];

  let remoteReviews: GuardianReview[] = [];
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('guardian_reviews')
      .select('*')
      .eq('guardian_id', guardianId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

    if (!error && data) {
      remoteReviews = (data as any[]).map(row => ({
        id: row.id,
        guardian_id: row.guardian_id,
        reviewer_id: row.user_id || row.reviewer_id,
        reviewer_name: row.user_name || row.reviewer_name || 'Explorer',
        reviewer_avatar: row.user_avatar_url || row.reviewer_avatar,
        rating: row.rating,
        comment: row.comment,
        created_at: row.created_at
      }));
    }
  } catch {}

  const localList = getLocalReviews().filter(r => r.guardian_id === guardianId);
  const map = new Map<string, GuardianReview>();
  [...remoteReviews, ...localList].forEach(r => {
    if (!map.has(r.id)) map.set(r.id, r);
  });

  const merged = Array.from(map.values());
  merged.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_at).getTime() - new Date(a.created_at).getTime());
  return merged;
}

export async function submitGuardianReview(input: {
  guardianId: string;
  reviewerId: string;
  reviewerName: string;
  reviewerAvatar?: string;
  rating: number;
  comment: string;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; review?: GuardianReview; error?: string }> {
  if (!input.reviewerId) return { success: false, error: 'Sign in before submitting a review.' };
  if (!input.guardianId) return { success: false, error: 'Target Guardian is required.' };
  if (input.reviewerId === input.guardianId) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Guardians cannot review themselves.' };
  }

  const trimmed = input.comment.trim();
  if (!trimmed) return { success: false, error: 'Review text cannot be empty.' };
  if (trimmed.length > 111) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Review cannot exceed 111 characters.' };
  }

  // Handshake gating check per reference specification
  const isEligible = await hasCompletedHandshake(input.reviewerId, input.guardianId);
  if (!isEligible) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Handshake required before reviews can be posted.' };
  }

  const newReview: GuardianReview = {
    id: 'rev_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6),
    guardian_id: input.guardianId,
    reviewer_id: input.reviewerId,
    reviewer_name: input.reviewerName || 'Explorer',
    reviewer_avatar: input.reviewerAvatar,
    rating: Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.round(input.rating || 5))),
    comment: trimmed,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString()
  };

  const localList = getLocalReviews();
  localList.unshift(newReview);
  saveLocalReviews(localList);

  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('guardian_reviews')
      .insert([{
        id: newReview.id,
        guardian_id: newReview.guardian_id,
        user_id: newReview.reviewer_id,
        user_name: newReview.reviewer_name,
        user_avatar_url: newReview.reviewer_avatar,
        rating: newReview.rating,
        comment: newReview.comment,
        created_at: newReview.created_at
      }])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error || !data) {
      console.warn('Supabase guardian_reviews insert notice:', error?.message);
      return { success: true, review: newReview };
    }
    return { success: true, review: newReview };
  } catch {
    return { success: true, review: newReview };
  }
}

import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase';
import { HandshakeRecord, HandshakeStatus } from './types';

const LOCAL_HANDSHAKES_KEY = 'vq_handshakes_store';

function getLocalHandshakes(): HandshakeRecord[] {
  try {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return [];
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_HANDSHAKES_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveLocalHandshakes(records: HandshakeRecord[]): void {
  try {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_HANDSHAKES_KEY, JSON.stringify(records));
    }
  } catch {}
}

export async function initiateHandshake(
  requesterId: string,
  guardianId: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; handshake?: HandshakeRecord; error?: string }> {
  if (!requesterId) return { success: false, error: 'Sign in before requesting a Handshake.' };
  if (!guardianId) return { success: false, error: 'Guardian identity is required.' };
  if (requesterId === guardianId) return { success: false, error: 'You cannot Handshake with yourself.' };

  const existingStatus = await getHandshakeStatus(requesterId, guardianId);
  if (existingStatus.status === 'accepted') {
    return { success: false, error: 'A verified Handshake is already established.' };
  }
  if (existingStatus.status === 'pending_sent') {
    return { success: false, error: 'A Handshake request is already pending with this Guardian.' };
  }

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 86400 * 1000).toISOString();

  const newHandshake: HandshakeRecord = {
    id: 'hs_' + Date.now() + '_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7),
    user_id: requesterId,
    requester_id: requesterId,
    guardian_id: guardianId,
    action_type: 'handshake',
    status: 'pending',
    issued_at: now,
    expires_at: expiresAt,
    created_at: now,
    updated_at: now
  };

  // Local fallback persistence
  const localList = getLocalHandshakes();
  localList.unshift(newHandshake);
  saveLocalHandshakes(localList);

  // Supabase remote persistence using the actual public.handshakes schema
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('handshakes')
      .insert([{
        id: newHandshake.id,
        user_id: requesterId,
        guardian_id: guardianId,
        action_type: 'handshake',
        status: 'pending',
        issued_at: now,
        expires_at: expiresAt
      }])
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error || !data) {
      console.warn('Supabase handshakes insert notice:', error?.message);
      return { success: true, handshake: newHandshake };
    }
    const record: HandshakeRecord = {
      ...data,
      requester_id: data.user_id,
      created_at: data.issued_at || now,
      updated_at: data.issued_at || now
    };
    return { success: true, handshake: record };
  } catch {
    return { success: true, handshake: newHandshake };
  }
}

export async function acceptHandshake(
  handshakeId: string,
  guardianId: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  if (!handshakeId || !guardianId) return { success: false, error: 'Invalid Handshake acceptance.' };

  // Update local
  const localList = getLocalHandshakes();
  const index = localList.findIndex(h => h.id === handshakeId && h.guardian_id === guardianId);
  if (index !== -1) {
    localList[index].status = 'accepted';
    localList[index].updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
    saveLocalHandshakes(localList);
  }

  // Update Supabase
  try {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('handshakes')
      .update({ status: 'active' })
      .eq('id', handshakeId)
      .eq('guardian_id', guardianId);

    if (error) {
      console.warn('Supabase acceptHandshake notice:', error.message);
    }
    return { success: true };
  } catch {
    return { success: true };
  }
}

export async function declineHandshake(
  handshakeId: string,
  guardianId: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  if (!handshakeId || !guardianId) return { success: false, error: 'Invalid Handshake decision.' };

  // Update local
  const localList = getLocalHandshakes();
  const index = localList.findIndex(h => h.id === handshakeId && h.guardian_id === guardianId);
  if (index !== -1) {
    localList[index].status = 'declined';
    localList[index].updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
    saveLocalHandshakes(localList);
  }

  // Update Supabase
  try {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('handshakes')
      .update({ status: 'declined' })
      .eq('id', handshakeId)
      .eq('guardian_id', guardianId);

    if (error) {
      console.warn('Supabase declineHandshake notice:', error.message);
    }
    return { success: true };
  } catch {
    return { success: true };
  }
}

export async function getHandshakeStatus(
  currentUserId: string,
  guardianId: string
): Promise<{ status: HandshakeStatus; handshake?: HandshakeRecord }> {
  if (!currentUserId || !guardianId) return { status: 'none' };

  let remoteRecord: HandshakeRecord | null = null;
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('handshakes')
      .select('*')
      .or(`and(user_id.eq.${currentUserId},guardian_id.eq.${guardianId}),and(user_id.eq.${guardianId},guardian_id.eq.${currentUserId})`)
      .order('issued_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(1);

    if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
      const raw = data[0];
      remoteRecord = {
        ...raw,
        requester_id: raw.user_id,
        created_at: raw.issued_at,
        updated_at: raw.issued_at
      } as HandshakeRecord;
    }
  } catch {}

  const localList = getLocalHandshakes();
  const localRecord = localList.find(
    h => ((h.user_id === currentUserId || h.requester_id === currentUserId) && h.guardian_id === guardianId) ||
         ((h.user_id === guardianId || h.requester_id === guardianId) && h.guardian_id === currentUserId)
  );

  const active = remoteRecord || localRecord;
  if (!active) return { status: 'none' };

  const isAccepted = active.status === 'accepted' || active.status === 'active';
  if (isAccepted) return { status: 'accepted', handshake: active };
  if (active.status === 'declined') return { status: 'declined', handshake: active };
  if (active.status === 'pending') {
    const sender = active.user_id || active.requester_id;
    if (sender === currentUserId) {
      return { status: 'pending_sent', handshake: active };
    }
    return { status: 'pending_received', handshake: active };
  }

  return { status: 'none' };
}

export async function hasCompletedHandshake(user1Id: string, user2Id: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const res = await getHandshakeStatus(user1Id, user2Id);
  return res.status === 'accepted';
}

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { profileStorage } from '../services/profileStorage';
import { LocalDeviceAiSettings } from '../types/profileTypes';
import { deviceAiService } from '../../../shared/services/ai/deviceAiService';
import { localEndpointAiProvider } from '../../../shared/services/ai/localEndpointAiProvider';
import { AiConnectionStatus } from '../../../shared/services/ai/aiTypes';

export function useLocalDeviceAiSettings() {
  const [settings, setSettingsState] = useState<LocalDeviceAiSettings>(() => 
    profileStorage.getLocalAiSettings()
  );

  const [aiStatus, setAiStatus] = useState<AiConnectionStatus>({
    provider: 'offline-fallback',
    statusText: 'Unavailable',
    isAvailable: false,
    details: 'Checking actual provider availability...'
  });

  const [isTesting, setIsTesting] = useState(false);
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<{ success: boolean; message: string } | null>(null);

  const refreshAiStatus = useCallback(async (currentSettings: LocalDeviceAiSettings) => {
    const status = await deviceAiService.detectAvailableProvider({
      enabled: currentSettings.enabled,
      endpoint: currentSettings.endpoint
    });
    setAiStatus(status);
  }, []);

  // Update AI status whenever settings load or toggle state changes
  useEffect(() => {
    refreshAiStatus(settings);
  }, [settings.enabled, settings.endpoint, refreshAiStatus]);

  const updateSettings = useCallback((updates: Partial<LocalDeviceAiSettings>) => {
    setSettingsState(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev, ...updates };
      profileStorage.setLocalAiSettings(next);
      return next;
    });
    setTestResult(null); // Clear previous tests on change
  }, []);

  const testEndpointConnection = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsTesting(true);
    setTestResult(null);
    try {
      const result = await localEndpointAiProvider.testConnection(settings.endpoint);
      setTestResult(result);
      
      // Force refreshing the connection status based on current settings
      await refreshAiStatus(settings);
      return result;
    } catch (err: any) {
      const errRes = { success: false, message: err.message || 'Unknown testing error occurred' };
      setTestResult(errRes);
      return errRes;
    } finally {
      setIsTesting(false);
    }
  }, [settings, refreshAiStatus]);

  return {
    settings,
    aiStatus,
    isTesting,
    testResult,
    updateSettings,
    testEndpointConnection,
    refreshAiStatus: () => refreshAiStatus(settings)
  };
}

import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { profileStorage } from '../services/profileStorage';
import { AppLocale } from '../types/profileTypes';

export function useProfileSettings() {
  const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
  const [locale, setLocaleState] = useState<AppLocale>(() => profileStorage.getLocale('en'));

  const setLocale = useCallback((newLocale: AppLocale) => {
    setLocaleState(newLocale);
    profileStorage.setLocale(newLocale);
    
    // Update i18n
    i18n.changeLanguage(newLocale);
    
    // Update document elements
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      document.documentElement.lang = newLocale;
      document.documentElement.dir = newLocale === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
    }
    
    // Dispatch a custom event so other parts of the app can react if needed
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('vq_locale_changed', { detail: newLocale }));
  }, [i18n]);

  // Keep changeLocale for compatibility
  const changeLocale = setLocale;

  const supportedLocales: AppLocale[] = ['en', 'ja', 'fr', 'ar', 'es', 'pt', 'zh'];

  const toggleLocale = useCallback(() => {
    const currentIndex = supportedLocales.indexOf(locale);
    const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % supportedLocales.length;
    setLocale(supportedLocales[nextIndex]);
  }, [locale, setLocale]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleLocaleChanged = (e: Event) => {
      const customEvent = e as CustomEvent<AppLocale>;
      if (customEvent.detail && customEvent.detail !== locale) {
        setLocaleState(customEvent.detail);
        i18n.changeLanguage(customEvent.detail);
        if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
          document.documentElement.lang = customEvent.detail;
          document.documentElement.dir = customEvent.detail === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('vq_locale_changed', handleLocaleChanged);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('vq_locale_changed', handleLocaleChanged);
    };
  }, [locale, i18n]);

  return {
    locale,
    setLocale,
    changeLocale,
    toggleLocale,
    supportedLocales,
    t
  };
}

import { safeLocalStorage } from '../../../shared/services/storage/safeLocalStorage';
import { ProfileSettings, LocalDeviceAiSettings, AppLocale } from '../types/profileTypes';

const STORAGE_KEYS = {
  LOCALE: 'vq_app_locale',
  LOCAL_AI_ENABLED: 'vq_local_ai_enabled',
  LOCAL_AI_ENDPOINT: 'vq_local_ai_endpoint',
  LOCAL_AI_PROVIDER: 'vq_local_ai_provider'
};

export const profileStorage = {
  getLocale: (fallback: AppLocale = 'en'): AppLocale => {
    return safeLocalStorage.getItem<AppLocale>(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCALE, fallback);
  },

  setLocale: (locale: AppLocale): void => {
    safeLocalStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCALE, locale);
  },

  getLocalAiSettings: (): LocalDeviceAiSettings => {
    const enabled = safeLocalStorage.getItem<boolean>(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_AI_ENABLED, false);
    const endpoint = safeLocalStorage.getItem<string>(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_AI_ENDPOINT, 'http://localhost:11434');
    const provider = safeLocalStorage.getItem<LocalDeviceAiSettings['provider']>(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_AI_PROVIDER, 'auto');
    
    return { enabled, endpoint, provider };
  },

  setLocalAiSettings: (settings: Partial<LocalDeviceAiSettings>): void => {
    const current = profileStorage.getLocalAiSettings();
    const updated = { ...current, ...settings };
    
    safeLocalStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_AI_ENABLED, updated.enabled);
    safeLocalStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_AI_ENDPOINT, updated.endpoint);
    safeLocalStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_AI_PROVIDER, updated.provider);
  },

  clearAllProfileData: (): void => {
    safeLocalStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCALE);
    safeLocalStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_AI_ENABLED);
    safeLocalStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_AI_ENDPOINT);
    safeLocalStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_AI_PROVIDER);
  }
};

import i18n from 'i18next';
import { initReactI18next } from 'react-i18next';
import en from './locales/en/common.json';
import ja from './locales/ja/common.json';
import fr from './locales/fr/common.json';
import ar from './locales/ar/common.json';
import es from './locales/es/common.json';
import pt from './locales/pt/common.json';
import zh from './locales/zh/common.json';

// Detect initial language
const getInitialLanguage = (): string => {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('vq_app_locale');
    if (saved) {
      let parsed = saved;
      if (saved.startsWith('"') && saved.endsWith('"')) {
        try {
          parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      if (['en', 'ja', 'fr', 'ar', 'es', 'pt', 'zh'].includes(parsed)) {
        return parsed;
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to read locale from local storage:', e);
  }

  // Fallback to browser language
  const browserLang = navigator.language?.split('-')[0] || 'en';
  if (['en', 'ja', 'fr', 'ar', 'es', 'pt', 'zh'].includes(browserLang)) {
    return browserLang;
  }

  return 'en';
};

const initialLang = getInitialLanguage();

// Set initial document properties
if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
  document.documentElement.lang = initialLang;
  document.documentElement.dir = initialLang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
}

i18n
  .use(initReactI18next)
  .init({
    resources: {
      en: { translation: en },
      ja: { translation: ja },
      fr: { translation: fr },
      ar: { translation: ar },
      es: { translation: es },
      pt: { translation: pt },
      zh: { translation: zh },
    },
    lng: initialLang,
    fallbackLng: 'en',
    supportedLngs: ['en', 'ja', 'fr', 'ar', 'es', 'pt', 'zh'],
    interpolation: {
      escapeValue: false, // react already safes from xss
    },
  });

export default i18n;

import { supabase } from './supabase';

const DB_NAME = 'vq-profile-pending-media';
const STORE_NAME = 'avatars';
const MAX_FILE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const MIME_EXTENSIONS: Record<string, string> = {
  'image/jpeg': 'jpg',
  'image/png': 'png',
  'image/webp': 'webp',
};

function validateAvatar(file: File): void {
  if (!Object.hasOwn(MIME_EXTENSIONS, file.type)) {
    throw new Error('Select a JPG, PNG, or WebP image.');
  }
  if (file.size === 0 || file.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES) {
    throw new Error('Avatar must be between 1 byte and 5 MB.');
  }
}

function openAvatarDb(): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!window.indexedDB) {
      reject(new Error('Your browser cannot retain an avatar until email verification.'));
      return;
    }
    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, 1);
    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      if (!req.result.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
        req.result.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME);
      }
    };
    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
  });
}

async function avatarRecord<T>(mode: IDBTransactionMode, action: (store: IDBObjectStore) => IDBRequest<T>): Promise<T> {
  const db = await openAvatarDb();
  try {
    return await new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, mode);
      const req = action(tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME));
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
      tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    });
  } finally {
    db.close();
  }
}

/** Keep a selected signup avatar in this browser until the email is verified. */
export async function queuePendingProfileAvatar(authUserId: string, file: File): Promise<void> {
  validateAvatar(file);
  await avatarRecord('readwrite', store => store.put(file, authUserId));
}

/** Authenticated uploads go to an owner-scoped path in a public avatar-only bucket. */
export async function uploadProfileAvatar(file: File, profileId: string): Promise<string> {
  validateAvatar(file);
  const { data: auth, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (authError || !auth.user) throw new Error('Sign in before uploading your avatar.');
  const uid = auth.user.id;
  const extension = MIME_EXTENSIONS[file.type];
  const path = `${uid}/${crypto.randomUUID()}.${extension}`;
  const { error: storageError } = await supabase.storage.from('avatars').upload(path, file, {
    contentType: file.type,
    upsert: false,
  });
  if (storageError) throw new Error(`Avatar upload failed: ${storageError.message}`);
  const { data } = supabase.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(path);
  const { data: saved, error: profileError } = await supabase.from('profiles')
    .update({ photo_url: data.publicUrl }).eq('id', profileId).select('id').maybeSingle();
  if (profileError || !saved) {
    throw new Error('Avatar uploaded, but the profile link could not be saved.');
  }
  return data.publicUrl;
}

/** Called only after a verified authenticated session has loaded the user profile. */
export async function uploadPendingProfileAvatar(authUserId: string, profileId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  let queued: File | undefined;
  try {
    queued = await avatarRecord<File | undefined>('readonly', store => store.get(authUserId));
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Pending avatar unavailable in this browser:', error);
    return null;
  }
  if (!queued) return null;
  const url = await uploadProfileAvatar(queued, profileId);
  await avatarRecord('readwrite', store => store.delete(authUserId));
  return url;
}

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

type Theme = 'light' | 'dark';

interface ThemeContextType {
  theme: Theme;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  // Check localStorage, default to 'dark' for that gorgeous, signature cyber/neon look
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState<Theme>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('vq_theme');
    if (saved === 'light' || saved === 'dark') {
      return saved;
    }
    return 'dark'; // Keep default as dark to avoid breaking original vibe
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = window.document.documentElement;
    if (theme === 'light') {
      root.classList.remove('dark');
      root.classList.add('light');
    } else {
      root.classList.remove('light');
      root.classList.add('dark');
    }
    localStorage.setItem('vq_theme', theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setThemeState((prev) => (prev === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light'));
    // Trigger haptic if telegram is available
    try {
      const haptic = (window as any).Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback;
      if (haptic) {
        haptic.impactOccurred('light');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Ignored
    }
  };

  const setTheme = (newTheme: Theme) => {
    setThemeState(newTheme);
  };

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, toggleTheme, setTheme }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTheme = () => {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

export const chromeBuiltInAiProvider = {
  isSupported: async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    
    try {
      const win = window as any;
      const ai = win.ai || (typeof self !== 'undefined' ? (self as any).ai : null);
      if (!ai) return false;

      // Chrome Prompt API detection
      if (ai.languageModel || ai.assistant) {
        const model = ai.languageModel || ai.assistant;
        const capabilities = await model.capabilities();
        return capabilities.available !== 'no';
      }
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
    return false;
  },

  generateText: async (prompt: string): Promise<string> => {
    const win = window as any;
    const ai = win.ai || (typeof self !== 'undefined' ? (self as any).ai : null);
    if (!ai) throw new Error('Chrome Built-in AI is not supported on this browser');

    const model = ai.languageModel || ai.assistant;
    const session = await model.create();
    try {
      const response = await session.prompt(prompt);
      return response;
    } finally {
      if (session.destroy) session.destroy();
    }
  }
};

import { AiProviderType, AiConnectionStatus } from './aiTypes';
import { chromeBuiltInAiProvider } from './chromeBuiltInAiProvider';
import { localEndpointAiProvider } from './localEndpointAiProvider';
import { serverAiProvider } from './serverAiProvider';

export const deviceAiService = {
  detectAvailableProvider: async (config: {
    enabled: boolean;
    endpoint: string;
  }): Promise<AiConnectionStatus> => {
    // 1. Native bridge check
    const win = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (window as any) : null;
    if (win && win.VibeQuestNativeBridge?.ai) {
      return {
        provider: 'native-bridge',
        statusText: 'Using Native Device AI',
        isAvailable: true,
        details: 'Native application AI interface connected'
      };
    }

    // 2. Local endpoint check (if enabled and configured)
    if (config.enabled && config.endpoint) {
      const test = await localEndpointAiProvider.testConnection(config.endpoint);
      if (test.success) {
        return {
          provider: 'local-endpoint',
          statusText: 'Linked Node',
          isAvailable: true,
          details: test.message
        };
      } else {
        return {
          provider: 'local-endpoint',
          statusText: 'Endpoint Failed',
          isAvailable: false,
          details: test.message
        };
      }
    }

    // 3. Chrome built-in AI check
    const hasChromeBuiltIn = await chromeBuiltInAiProvider.isSupported();
    if (hasChromeBuiltIn) {
      return {
        provider: 'chrome-built-in',
        statusText: 'Browser AI Available',
        isAvailable: true,
        details: 'Chrome Gemini Nano (Prompt API) ready'
      };
    }

    // 4. Server AI check
    const hasServerAi = await serverAiProvider.isSupported();
    if (hasServerAi) {
      return {
        provider: 'server-fallback',
        statusText: 'Server Fallback',
        isAvailable: true,
        details: 'Cloud API models ready'
      };
    }

    // 5. Offline fallback
    return {
      provider: 'offline-fallback',
      statusText: 'Unavailable',
      isAvailable: false,
      details: 'No supported device or server provider detected'
    };
  },

};

export const localEndpointAiProvider = {
  testConnection: async (endpoint: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> => {
    if (!endpoint) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Endpoint URL is empty' };
    }

    // Guard against mixed content issues on secure context
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.protocol === 'https:' && endpoint.startsWith('http://') && !endpoint.includes('localhost') && !endpoint.includes('127.0.0.1')) {
      return { 
        success: false, 
        message: 'Mixed content block: Cannot request insecure HTTP from HTTPS. Use HTTPS, localhost, or configure a proxy.' 
      };
    }

    try {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const id = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 3500); // 3.5s timeout for fast UI feedback

      // Test general availability (Ollama returns "Ollama is running" at root)
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'GET',
        signal: controller.signal,
        mode: 'cors'
      });
      clearTimeout(id);

      if (res.ok) {
        return { success: true, message: 'Successfully connected!' };
      }
      
      // Try hitting /api/tags (Ollama's model catalog endpoint)
      const tagsController = new AbortController();
      const tagsId = setTimeout(() => tagsController.abort(), 3500);
      const tagsRes = await fetch(`${endpoint.replace(/\/$/, '')}/api/tags`, {
        method: 'GET',
        signal: tagsController.signal,
        mode: 'cors'
      });
      clearTimeout(tagsId);

      if (tagsRes.ok) {
        return { success: true, message: 'Successfully connected (API verified)!' };
      }

      return { success: false, message: `Server returned status ${res.status}` };
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('Ollama test connection error:', err);
      if (err.name === 'AbortError') {
        return { success: false, message: 'Connection timed out. Check network or server status.' };
      }
      return { success: false, message: 'Could not connect. Ensure CORS is enabled on Ollama (OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*").' };
    }
  },

  generateText: async (endpoint: string, prompt: string, options?: { model?: string }): Promise<string> => {
    const modelName = options?.model || 'llama3';
    const baseUrl = endpoint.replace(/\/$/, '');

    try {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const id = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 15000); // 15s timeout for inference

      const res = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/generate`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          model: modelName,
          prompt: prompt,
          stream: false
        }),
        signal: controller.signal,
        mode: 'cors'
      });
      clearTimeout(id);

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Local model failed with status ${res.status}`);
      }

      const data = await res.json();
      return data.response || '';
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Ollama generation failed:', err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
};

export const serverAiProvider = {
  isSupported: async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/ai/health');
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        return !!data.supported;
      }
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
    return false;
  },

  generateText: async (prompt: string, context?: any): Promise<string> => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/ai/generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ prompt, context })
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Server AI returned error code: ${res.status}`);
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      return data.text || '';
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Server AI request failed:', err);
      throw err;
    }
  }
};

export const safeLocalStorage = {
  getItem: <T>(key: string, fallback: T): T => {
    try {
      const item = localStorage.getItem(key);
      return item ? JSON.parse(item) : fallback;
    } catch {
      return fallback;
    }
  },
  setItem: <T>(key: string, value: T): void => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Error saving to localStorage', e);
    }
  },
  removeItem: (key: string): void => {
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(key);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Error removing from localStorage', e);
    }
  }
};

function normalizeCategory(raw?: string): 'All' | VibeCategory {
  if (!raw) return 'All';
  const c = raw.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (c === 'food' || c === 'cafes' || c === 'cafe') return 'Food';
  if (c === 'night owl' || c === 'night_owl' || c === 'nightowl' || c === 'venues' || c === 'venue') return 'Night Owl';
  if (c === 'art') return 'Art';
  if (c === 'culture') return 'Culture';
  if (c === 'spots' || c === 'spot' || c === 'hidden') return 'Spots';
  return 'All';
}

function isStrictlyLeisurePlace(item: any, requestedCategory: 'All' | VibeCategory): boolean {
  const types: string[] = Array.isArray(item?.types) ? item.types : [];
  const name: string = (item?.name || '').trim();
  const address: string = (item?.formatted_address || item?.vicinity || '').trim();

  if (!name || /^(tunis|ariana|manouba|ben\s*arous)$/i.test(name)) return false;

  for (const t of types) {
    if (HARD_EXCLUDED_TYPES.has(t)) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  for (const pattern of EXCLUDED_NAME_PATTERNS) {
    if (pattern.test(name)) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  if (
    /\b(zone\s*industrielle|z\.i\b|technopole|pôle\s*technologique|immeuble\s*bureau)\b/i.test(address) &&
    !types.includes('restaurant') &&
    !types.includes('cafe') &&
    !types.includes('bakery') &&
    !types.includes('bar') &&
    !types.includes('night_club') &&
    !types.includes('museum')
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  const hasAllowedLeisureType = types.some((t) => ALLOWED_LEISURE_TYPES.has(t));
  if (hasAllowedLeisureType) {
    return true;
  }

  if (FOOD_NAME_REGEX.test(name)) return true;
  if (LOUNGE_NIGHT_REGEX.test(name)) return true;
  if (ART_NAME_REGEX.test(name)) return true;
  if (CULTURE_REGEX.test(name)) return true;
  if (SPOTS_REGEX.test(name)) return true;

  return false;
}

function mapPlaceToCategory(
  types: string[] = [],
  name: string = '',
  requestedCategory: 'All' | VibeCategory = 'All'
): VibeCategory | null {
  const set = new Set(types);

  const isFood =
    set.has('restaurant') ||
    set.has('cafe') ||
    set.has('bakery') ||
    set.has('meal_takeaway') ||
    set.has('meal_delivery') ||
    FOOD_NAME_REGEX.test(name);

  const isNightOwl =
    set.has('bar') ||
    set.has('night_club') ||
    set.has('casino') ||
    LOUNGE_NIGHT_REGEX.test(name);

  const isArt =
    set.has('art_gallery') ||
    ART_NAME_REGEX.test(name);

  const isCulture =
    set.has('museum') ||
    set.has('performing_arts_theater') ||
    set.has('movie_theater') ||
    set.has('cultural_center') ||
    CULTURE_REGEX.test(name) ||
    (requestedCategory === 'Culture' && set.has('tourist_attraction'));

  const isSpot =
    set.has('tourist_attraction') ||
    set.has('park') ||
    set.has('natural_feature') ||
    set.has('amusement_park') ||
    set.has('aquarium') ||
    set.has('zoo') ||
    set.has('bowling_alley') ||
    SPOTS_REGEX.test(name);

  // When a specific category tab is clicked, return that category if it matches
  if (requestedCategory === 'Food') return isFood ? 'Food' : null;
  if (requestedCategory === 'Night Owl') return isNightOwl ? 'Night Owl' : null;
  if (requestedCategory === 'Art') return isArt ? 'Art' : null;
  if (requestedCategory === 'Culture') return isCulture ? 'Culture' : null;
  if (requestedCategory === 'Spots') return isSpot ? 'Spots' : null;

  // In 'All' mode, assign the most specific primary category without letting Night Owl swallow restaurants
  if (isArt) return 'Art';
  if (isCulture) return 'Culture';
  if (isNightOwl && !set.has('restaurant') && !set.has('cafe') && !set.has('bakery')) return 'Night Owl';
  if (isFood && !LOUNGE_NIGHT_REGEX.test(name)) return 'Food';
  if (isNightOwl) return 'Night Owl';
  if (isFood) return 'Food';
  if (isSpot) return 'Spots';

  return null;
}

function calculateHaversineMeters(lat1: number, lon1: number, lat2: number, lon2: number): number {
  const R = 6371e3;
  const φ1 = (lat1 * Math.PI) / 180;
  const φ2 = (lat2 * Math.PI) / 180;
  const Δφ = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const Δλ = ((lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const a =
    Math.sin(Δφ / 2) * Math.sin(Δφ / 2) +
    Math.cos(φ1) * Math.cos(φ2) * Math.sin(Δλ / 2) * Math.sin(Δλ / 2);
  const c = 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
  return Math.round(R * c);
}

async function queryGooglePlacesTextSearch(
  lat: number,
  lng: number,
  radius: number,
  query: string,
  apiKey: string
): Promise<{ status: string; results: any[]; error_message?: string }> {
  const url = new URL('https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/textsearch/json');
  url.searchParams.set('query', query);
  url.searchParams.set('location', `${lat},${lng}`);
  url.searchParams.set('radius', String(radius));
  url.searchParams.set('key', apiKey);

  try {
    const res = await fetch(url.toString());
    if (!res.ok) return { status: `HTTP_${res.status}`, results: [] };
    const data = await res.json();
    return {
      status: data.status || 'UNKNOWN',
      results: Array.isArray(data.results) ? data.results : [],
      error_message: data.error_message
    };
  } catch (err: any) {
    return { status: 'FETCH_ERROR', results: [], error_message: err?.message };
  }
}

Deno.serve(async (request: Request) => {
  if (request.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: cors });
  }

  const apiKey = Deno.env.get('GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY');
  const reqUrl = new URL(request.url);

  if (request.method === 'GET') {
    const photoReference = reqUrl.searchParams.get('photo_reference');
    if (!photoReference) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Missing photo_reference' }), {
        status: 400,
        headers: { ...cors, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
      });
    }
    if (!apiKey) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY is not configured in Supabase secrets.' }), {
        status: 500,
        headers: { ...cors, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
      });
    }
    try {
      const maxwidth = reqUrl.searchParams.get('maxwidth') || '800';
      const googlePhotoUrl = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/photo?maxwidth=${encodeURIComponent(maxwidth)}&photoreference=${encodeURIComponent(photoReference)}&key=${apiKey}`;
      const photoRes = await fetch(googlePhotoUrl, { redirect: 'follow' });
      if (!photoRes.ok) {
        return new Response(null, { status: photoRes.status, headers: cors });
      }
      const contentType = photoRes.headers.get('content-type') || 'image/jpeg';
      const imageBuffer = await photoRes.arrayBuffer();
      return new Response(imageBuffer, {
        status: 200,
        headers: {
          ...cors,
          'Content-Type': contentType,
          'Cache-Control': 'public, max-age=86400, s-maxage=86400'
        }
      });
    } catch {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Failed to retrieve photo.' }), {
        status: 500,
        headers: { ...cors, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
      });
    }
  }

  if (request.method !== 'POST') {
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'Method not allowed.' }), {
      status: 405,
      headers: { ...cors, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    });
  }

  try {
    const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const lat = Number(body?.lat);
    const lng = Number(body?.lng);
    const requestedCategory = normalizeCategory(body?.category);
    const requestedRadius = Number(body?.radius);
    const radiusMeters = Number.isFinite(requestedRadius) && requestedRadius > 0 ? Math.min(requestedRadius, 25000) : 23000;
    const maxCutoffMeters = Math.max(radiusMeters, 23000);

    if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || !Number.isFinite(lng)) {
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ places: [], error: 'Valid lat and lng required' }), {
        status: 400,
        headers: { ...cors, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
      });
    }

    if (!apiKey) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          error: 'GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY is not configured in Supabase secrets.',
          places: []
        }),
        { status: 500, headers: { ...cors, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
      );
    }

    const searchQueries = CATEGORY_QUERY_MAP[requestedCategory] || CATEGORY_QUERY_MAP['All'];
    const searchQuery = searchQueries.join(' | ');
    const batch = await Promise.all(searchQueries.map((q) => queryGooglePlacesTextSearch(lat, lng, radiusMeters, q, apiKey)));
    const googleStatus = batch.find((b) => b.status === 'OK')?.status || batch[0]?.status || 'ZERO_RESULTS';
    const error_message = batch.find((b) => b.error_message)?.error_message;
    const seenIds = new Set<string>();
    const rawResults: any[] = [];
    for (const b of batch) {
      for (const item of b.results) {
        if (item?.place_id && !seenIds.has(item.place_id)) {
          seenIds.add(item.place_id);
          rawResults.push(item);
        }
      }
    }

    const supabaseUrl = (Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL') || reqUrl.origin).replace(/\/$/, '');

    const places = rawResults
      .map((item: any, googleIndex: number) => {
        const pLat = item.geometry?.location?.lat;
        const pLng = item.geometry?.location?.lng;
        if (typeof pLat !== 'number' || typeof pLng !== 'number') return null;

        const distMeters = calculateHaversineMeters(lat, lng, pLat, pLng);
        if (distMeters > maxCutoffMeters) return null;

        if (!isStrictlyLeisurePlace(item, requestedCategory)) return null;

        const mappedCategory = mapPlaceToCategory(item.types, item.name, requestedCategory);
        if (!mappedCategory) return null;

        const photoRef = item.photos?.[0]?.photo_reference;
        const imageUrl =
          photoRef
            ? `${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/nearby-places?photo_reference=${encodeURIComponent(photoRef)}&maxwidth=800`
            : undefined;

        const rating = typeof item.rating === 'number' ? Number(item.rating.toFixed(1)) : undefined;
        const reviewsCount = typeof item.user_ratings_total === 'number' ? item.user_ratings_total : undefined;
        const isLegendary = Boolean(rating !== undefined && rating >= 4.5 && (reviewsCount ?? 0) >= 40);

        const priceBands = ['Free', 'TND 1–10', 'TND 10–25', 'TND 25–50', 'TND 50+'];
        const priceBand =
          typeof item.price_level === 'number' ? priceBands[item.price_level] : undefined;

        const openNow =
          typeof item.opening_hours?.open_now === 'boolean'
            ? item.opening_hours.open_now
            : undefined;

        return {
          id: item.place_id,
          place_id: item.place_id,
          title: item.name,
          name: item.name,
          types: Array.isArray(item.types) ? item.types : [],
          category: mappedCategory,
          description: item.formatted_address || item.vicinity || '',
          image_url: imageUrl,
          lat: pLat,
          lng: pLng,
          address: item.formatted_address || item.vicinity || '',
          distance_meters: distMeters,
          distance_km: Number((distMeters / 1000).toFixed(2)),
          rating: rating,
          reviews_count: reviewsCount,
          checkins_count: undefined,
          confirmations_count: undefined,
          created_by: 'google_places',
          is_legendary: isLegendary,
          price_band: priceBand,
          open_now: openNow,
          _googleRank: googleIndex
        };
      })
      .filter((p): p is NonNullable<typeof p> => p !== null);

    places.sort((a, b) => {
      const ratingA = a.rating ?? 0;
      const ratingB = b.rating ?? 0;
      const reviewsA = a.reviews_count ?? 0;
      const reviewsB = b.reviews_count ?? 0;

      const relevanceScoreA = ratingA * Math.log10(reviewsA + 10) - a._googleRank * 0.12;
      const relevanceScoreB = ratingB * Math.log10(reviewsB + 10) - b._googleRank * 0.12;

      if (Math.abs(relevanceScoreB - relevanceScoreA) > 0.3) {
        return relevanceScoreB - relevanceScoreA;
      }

      return (a.distance_meters ?? 999999) - (b.distance_meters ?? 999999);
    });

    const cleanPlaces = places.map(({ _googleRank, ...rest }) => rest);

    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        endpoint: 'https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/place/textsearch/json',
        google_status: googleStatus,
        google_error: error_message || null,
        requested_category: requestedCategory,
        query_used: searchQuery,
        radius_meters: radiusMeters,
        count: cleanPlaces.length,
        places: cleanPlaces
      }),
      { status: 200, headers: { ...cors, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
    );
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('nearby-places edge function error:', err);
    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ places: [], error: err?.message || 'Server error' }), {
      status: 500,
      headers: { ...cors, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
    });
  }
});

/**
 * Username-and-password login without revealing another account's email.
 * Deployed with verify_jwt=false because this endpoint is for signed-out users.
 * No admin credentials or email addresses are returned to the browser.
 */
import { createClient } from 'npm:@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0';

const cors = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json',
};
const response = (status: number, data: Record<string, unknown>) =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: cors });
const invalid = () => response(401, { error: 'Invalid username or password.' });

Deno.serve(async (request: Request) => {
  if (request.method === 'OPTIONS') return new Response(null, { status: 204, headers: cors });
  if (request.method !== 'POST') return response(405, { error: 'Method not allowed.' });
  try {
    const input = await request.json();
    const username = typeof input?.username === 'string' ? input.username.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/^@/, '') : '';
    const password = input?.password;
    if (!/^[a-z0-9_]{3,32}$/.test(username) || typeof password !== 'string' || password.length < 1 || password.length > 1024) return invalid();
    const endpoint = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL');
    const adminKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY');
    const publicKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_ANON_KEY');
    if (!endpoint || !adminKey || !publicKey) return response(503, { error: 'Authentication unavailable.' });

    const admin = createClient(endpoint, adminKey, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });
    const { data: profile, error: profileError } = await admin
      .from('profiles').select('id').eq('handle', username).maybeSingle();
    if (profileError || !profile) return invalid();

    let authId: string | null = null;
    const { data: link } = await admin.from('s00_test_identity_links')
      .select('auth_user_id').eq('legacy_profile_id', profile.id).maybeSingle();
    if (link?.auth_user_id) authId = link.auth_user_id;
    else if (/^usr_[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(profile.id)) authId = profile.id.slice(4);
    if (!authId) return invalid();

    const { data: account, error: accountError } = await admin.auth.admin.getUserById(authId);
    if (accountError || !account.user?.email) return invalid();

    const client = createClient(endpoint, publicKey, { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } });
    const { data: login, error: loginError } = await client.auth.signInWithPassword({
      email: account.user.email, password,
    });
    if (loginError || !login.session) return invalid();
    return response(200, {
      access_token: login.session.access_token,
      refresh_token: login.session.refresh_token,
    });
  } catch {
    return invalid();
  }
});

-- VQUltimate D07 Trail/Tour media gallery. Review and apply after testing.
-- No existing Trail, Tour, profile, or Storage objects are rewritten.
create table if not exists public.trail_media (
  id bigint generated by default as identity primary key,
  trail_id text not null references public.vibe_trails(id) on delete restrict,
  owner_auth_user_id uuid not null default auth.uid(),
  object_path text not null unique,
  sort_order integer not null default 0 check (sort_order >= 0),
  is_cover boolean not null default false,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint trail_media_path_type check (object_path ~* '\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)$')
);

-- Fails safely if legacy records lack verifiable ownership or association data.
-- Does not fabricate owners, Trail IDs, or Storage paths.
do $$
begin
  if exists (
    select 1 from public.trail_media
    where owner_auth_user_id is null
       or trail_id is null
       or object_path is null
       or btrim(object_path) = ''
  ) then
    raise exception 'Legacy trail_media records lack verifiable ownership or path data'
      using errcode = '23502';
  end if;
end;
$$;

create index if not exists trail_media_trail_order_idx
  on public.trail_media(trail_id, sort_order, created_at);
create unique index if not exists trail_media_one_cover_per_trail
  on public.trail_media(trail_id) where is_cover = true;

alter table public.trail_media enable row level security;
revoke all on table public.trail_media from anon, authenticated;
grant select(id, trail_id, object_path, sort_order, is_cover, created_at)
  on public.trail_media to anon, authenticated;
grant insert(trail_id, object_path, sort_order, is_cover)
  on public.trail_media to authenticated;
grant update(sort_order, is_cover)
  on public.trail_media to authenticated;
grant delete on public.trail_media to authenticated;

drop policy if exists trail_media_public_read on public.trail_media;
create policy trail_media_public_read on public.trail_media
  for select to anon, authenticated using (true);
drop policy if exists trail_media_owner_insert on public.trail_media;
create policy trail_media_owner_insert on public.trail_media
  for insert to authenticated
  with check (owner_auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()));
drop policy if exists trail_media_owner_update on public.trail_media;
create policy trail_media_owner_update on public.trail_media
  for update to authenticated
  using (owner_auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()))
  with check (owner_auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()));
drop policy if exists trail_media_owner_delete on public.trail_media;
create policy trail_media_owner_delete on public.trail_media
  for delete to authenticated
  using (owner_auth_user_id = (select auth.uid()));

-- Reuse the existing author-identity aliases and do not grant all users
-- permission to alter each other's content.
create or replace function public.vq_trail_media_guard()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = ''
as $$
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_author text;
  v_legacy_cover text;
  v_limit integer;
  v_is_admin boolean;
  v_prefix text;
  v_mime text;
  v_size bigint;
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required for Trail media' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then
    if new.trail_id is distinct from old.trail_id
      or new.object_path is distinct from old.object_path
      or new.owner_auth_user_id is distinct from old.owner_auth_user_id then
      raise exception 'Trail media ownership is immutable' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
  end if;
  select t.author_id, t.image_url into v_author, v_legacy_cover
    from public.vibe_trails t where t.id = new.trail_id for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'Trail not found' using errcode = '23503'; end if;
  if not (
    v_author = v_uid::text or v_author = 'usr_' || v_uid::text
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.s00_test_identity_links l
      where l.auth_user_id = v_uid and l.legacy_profile_id = v_author
    )
  ) then
    raise exception 'Only the Trail creator may edit its gallery' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if new.owner_auth_user_id is distinct from v_uid then
    raise exception 'Media owner must match the authenticated user' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  v_prefix := v_uid::text || '/trails/' || new.trail_id || '/';
  if left(new.object_path, length(v_prefix)) <> v_prefix then
    raise exception 'Trail media must use the creator-owned Trail path' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  select o.metadata->>'mimetype', (o.metadata->>'size')::bigint
    into v_mime, v_size
    from storage.objects o
    where o.bucket_id = 'media' and o.name = new.object_path;
  if not found then
    raise exception 'Uploaded media object was not found' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if v_mime not in ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')
    or v_mime is null or v_size is null or v_size < 1 or v_size > 5242880 then
    raise exception 'Trail media must be a JPG, PNG or WebP image of at most 5 MB' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    select exists(
      select 1 from public.vq_admin_assignments a
      where a.auth_user_id = v_uid and a.active and a.role = 'platform_admin'
    ) into v_is_admin;
    select case
      when v_is_admin or coalesce(p.account_type, 'vibe') in ('pro', 'business') then 6
      else 3
    end into v_limit
    from public.profiles p where p.id = v_author;
    if v_limit is null then
      raise exception 'Verified Trail author profile not found' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
    if (select count(*) from public.trail_media m where m.trail_id = new.trail_id)
      + case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_legacy_cover, '')), '') is null then 0 else 1 end
      >= v_limit then
      raise exception 'Trail photo limit reached' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

drop trigger if exists vq_trail_media_guard_trigger on public.trail_media;
create trigger vq_trail_media_guard_trigger
before insert or update on public.trail_media
for each row execute function public.vq_trail_media_guard();

-- A legacy cover can be changed separately through the existing Trail UPDATE
-- API; enforce the same 3/6 total quota when that changes.
create or replace function public.vq_trail_media_legacy_cover_guard()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = ''
as $
declare
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_is_admin boolean;
  v_limit integer;
  v_count integer;
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.vq_admin_assignments a
    where a.auth_user_id = v_uid and a.active and a.role = 'platform_admin'
  ) into v_is_admin;
  select case
    when v_is_admin or coalesce(p.account_type, 'vibe') in ('pro', 'business') then 6
    else 3 end into v_limit
  from public.profiles p where p.id = new.author_id;
  if v_limit is null then
    raise exception 'Verified Trail author profile not found' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  select count(*) into v_count from public.trail_media m where m.trail_id = new.id;
  if v_count + case when nullif(btrim(coalesce(new.image_url, '')), '') is null
    then 0 else 1 end > v_limit then
    raise exception 'Trail photo limit reached' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$;
drop trigger if exists vq_trail_media_legacy_cover_guard_trigger on public.vibe_trails;
create trigger vq_trail_media_legacy_cover_guard_trigger
before update of image_url on public.vibe_trails
for each row when (new.image_url is distinct from old.image_url)
execute function public.vq_trail_media_legacy_cover_guard();

-- A private Storage bucket stays private. Only objects explicitly attached
-- to public Trails can be read by visitors using signed URLs.
drop policy if exists vq_trail_attached_media_read on storage.objects;
create policy vq_trail_attached_media_read on storage.objects
  for select to anon, authenticated
  using (
    bucket_id = 'media'
    and exists (
      select 1 from public.trail_media tm where tm.object_path = name
    )
  );
-- Remove an abandoned or intentionally detached object only from its owner
-- and only after its Trail association has been removed.
drop policy if exists vq_trail_unattached_media_owner_delete on storage.objects;
create policy vq_trail_unattached_media_owner_delete on storage.objects
  for delete to authenticated
  using (
    bucket_id = 'media'
    and (storage.foldername(name))[1] = (select auth.uid())::text
    and (storage.foldername(name))[2] = 'trails'
    and not exists (
      select 1 from public.trail_media tm where tm.object_path = name
    )
  );

    picked_up BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    picked_up_by_user_id TEXT,
    picked_up_by_handle TEXT,
    picked_up_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT (NOW() + INTERVAL '3 hours')
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_drift_bottles_room_unpicked ON public.drift_bottles(room_id, picked_up, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_drift_bottles_expires ON public.drift_bottles(expires_at);

-- 9. Drift Bilateral Reveal Requests ("Reveal Vibe Handle")
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.drift_reveal_requests (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    thread_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.drift_private_threads(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    requester_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    target_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'declined')),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    CONSTRAINT uq_drift_reveal_thread_req UNIQUE(thread_id, requester_user_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_drift_reveal_thread ON public.drift_reveal_requests(thread_id);

-- 10. Drift Room Moderators & Actions
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.drift_room_moderators (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    room_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.drift_rooms(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'moderator',
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    CONSTRAINT uq_drift_room_mod UNIQUE(room_id, user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.drift_moderation_actions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    room_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES public.drift_rooms(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    action_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action_type IN ('pin', 'unpin', 'delete_message', 'mute', 'ban', 'report')),
    target_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT,
    moderator_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 11. RPC: Cleanup expired drift records (authoritative server-side expiration)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cleanup_expired_drift()
RETURNS VOID
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
AS $$
BEGIN
    DELETE FROM public.drift_messages WHERE expires_at <= NOW();
    DELETE FROM public.drift_private_messages WHERE expires_at <= NOW();
    DELETE FROM public.drift_bottles WHERE expires_at <= NOW();
    DELETE FROM public.drift_room_presence WHERE last_heartbeat < (NOW() - INTERVAL '90 seconds');
    DELETE FROM public.drift_aliases WHERE expires_at <= NOW();
END;
$$;

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const content = readFileSync(new URL('../src/components/UserProfileCard.tsx', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

test('UserProfileCard matches reference ECHO/PULL styling and states', () => {
  assert.match(content, /font-mono text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider py-2\.5 px-4 rounded-xl border/g);
  assert.match(content, /border-emerald-500\/40 text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500\/10/);
  assert.match(content, /bg-emerald-500\/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500\/60/);
  assert.match(content, /border-rose-500\/40 text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-500\/10/);
  assert.match(content, /bg-rose-500\/20 text-rose-200 border-rose-500\/60/);
  for (const label of ['ECHO', 'ECHOED', 'PULL', 'PULLED']) {
    assert.ok(content.includes(`<span>${label}</span>`), `missing label ${label}`);
  }
  assert.doesNotMatch(content, /ECHO \(Follow\)|PULL \(Vibe\)|bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-teal-500/);
  assert.match(content, /onClick=\{handleEcho\}/);
  assert.match(content, /onClick=\{handlePull\}/);
  assert.match(content, /disabled=\{loading \|\| pullPending\}/);
  assert.match(content, /followUser\(|unfollowUser\(|sendConnectionPull\(/);
});

SIZE_BYTES: 3090
ENCODING: UTF-8 TEXT

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const sql = readFileSync(
  new URL('../supabase/migrations/20261106160000_trail_media_gallery.sql', import.meta.url),
  'utf8'
);
const gallerySource = readFileSync(
  new URL('../src/domains/d07_trails/gallery.ts', import.meta.url),
  'utf8'
);

test('migration reconciles trail_media to BIGINT identity without rewriting existing table', () => {
  assert.match(sql, /create table if not exists public\.trail_media/);
  assert.match(sql, /id bigint generated by default as identity primary key/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(sql, /id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid\(\)/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(sql, /drop table /i);
});

test('migration validates legacy records and fails safely without fabricating data', () => {
  assert.match(sql, /Legacy trail_media records lack verifiable ownership or path data/);
  assert.match(sql, /where owner_auth_user_id is null/);
  assert.match(sql, /or trail_id is null/);
  assert.match(sql, /or object_path is null/);
});

test('policies and triggers are idempotent and can be safely reapplied', () => {
  assert.match(sql, /drop policy if exists trail_media_public_read on public\.trail_media;/);
  assert.match(sql, /drop policy if exists trail_media_owner_insert on public\.trail_media;/);
  assert.match(sql, /drop policy if exists trail_media_owner_update on public\.trail_media;/);
  assert.match(sql, /drop policy if exists trail_media_owner_delete on public\.trail_media;/);
  assert.match(sql, /drop trigger if exists vq_trail_media_guard_trigger on public\.trail_media;/);
  assert.match(sql, /drop trigger if exists vq_trail_media_legacy_cover_guard_trigger on public\.vibe_trails;/);
  assert.match(sql, /drop policy if exists vq_trail_attached_media_read on storage\.objects;/);
  assert.match(sql, /drop policy if exists vq_trail_unattached_media_owner_delete on storage\.objects;/);
});

test('column-level permissions protect sensitive fields without broad grants', () => {
  assert.match(sql, /revoke all on table public\.trail_media from anon, authenticated;/);
  assert.match(sql, /grant select\(id, trail_id, object_path, sort_order, is_cover, created_at\)/);
  assert.match(sql, /grant insert\(trail_id, object_path, sort_order, is_cover\)/);
  assert.match(sql, /grant update\(sort_order, is_cover\)/);
  assert.match(sql, /grant delete on public\.trail_media to authenticated;/);
});

test('media guard enforces path isolation, approved image types, and 5MB size limit', () => {
  assert.match(sql, /v_uid::text \|\| '\/trails\/' \|\| new\.trail_id \|\| '\/'/);
  assert.match(sql, /'image\/jpeg', 'image\/png', 'image\/webp'/);
  assert.match(sql, /v_size > 5242880/);
  assert.match(sql, /Trail photo limit reached/);
});

test('application gallery domain supports both BIGINT identity and string IDs cleanly', () => {
  assert.match(gallerySource, /id: string \| number;/);
  assert.match(gallerySource, /id: String\(row\.id\)/);
  assert.match(gallerySource, /createSignedUrl\(path, SIGNED_URL_SECONDS\)/);
});

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { buildTrailRoutePlan } from '../src/domains/d07_trails/navigation.ts';

const makeTrail = (stops) => ({
  id: 'test-route', title: 'Route', stops,
});
const stop = (index) => ({
  id: 'stop-' + index,
  name: 'Stop ' + index,
  address: 'Address ' + index + ', Tunis',
  vibeNote: '',
  timeOfDay: 'Flexible',
  durationMinutes: 20,
  lat: 36 + index / 100,
  lng: 10 + index / 100,
});

test('Walking route goes through all five stops without exceeding mobile waypoint limit', () => {
  const { segments, error } = buildTrailRoutePlan(makeTrail([1,2,3,4,5].map(stop)), 'walking');
  assert.equal(error, undefined);
  assert.equal(segments.length, 1);
  const url = new URL(segments[0].url);
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('api'), '1');
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('travelmode'), 'walking');
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('origin'), 'Address 1, Tunis');
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('destination'), 'Address 5, Tunis');
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('waypoints')?.split('|').length, 3);
});

test('Long driving Trails split into contiguous, ordered Google Maps legs', () => {
  const { segments } = buildTrailRoutePlan(makeTrail([1,2,3,4,5,6,7].map(stop)), 'driving');
  assert.equal(segments.length, 2);
  assert.deepEqual(segments.map(s => [s.from, s.to]), [['Stop 1','Stop 5'], ['Stop 5','Stop 7']]);
  assert.equal(segments[1].stopCount, 3);
});

test('Transit routes each pair separately instead of inventing transit waypoints', () => {
  const { segments } = buildTrailRoutePlan(makeTrail([1,2,3].map(stop)), 'transit');
  assert.equal(segments.length, 2);
  assert.equal(new URL(segments[0].url).searchParams.get('waypoints'), null);
  assert.equal(new URL(segments[1].url).searchParams.get('travelmode'), 'transit');
});

test('Best leaves Google Maps travel mode unspecified', () => {
  const { segments } = buildTrailRoutePlan(makeTrail([1,2].map(stop)), 'best');
  assert.equal(segments.length, 1);
  assert.equal(new URL(segments[0].url).searchParams.get('travelmode'), null);
});

test('Address-only stops route without coordinates', () => {
  const addressOnly = [stop(1), stop(2), stop(3)].map(({lat, lng, ...rest}) => rest);
  const plan = buildTrailRoutePlan(makeTrail(addressOnly), 'walking');
  assert.equal(plan.error, undefined);
  assert.equal(plan.segments.length, 1);
  const url = new URL(plan.segments[0].url);
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('origin'), 'Address 1, Tunis');
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('destination'), 'Address 3, Tunis');
  assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('waypoints'), 'Address 2, Tunis');
});

test('Missing addresses block routing even when coordinates exist', () => {
  const noPosition = {...stop(2), address: ''};
  const invalid = buildTrailRoutePlan(makeTrail([stop(1), noPosition, stop(3)]), 'walking');
  assert.equal(invalid.segments.length, 0);
  assert.match(invalid.error, /Stop 2/);
  assert.equal(buildTrailRoutePlan(makeTrail([stop(1)]), 'driving').segments.length, 0);
  assert.equal(buildTrailRoutePlan(makeTrail([stop(1), {...stop(2), address: '', lng: 190}]), 'driving').segments.length, 0);
});

test('Hop On opens the first transit leg and offers remaining legs in the Trail modal', () => {
  const detail = readFileSync(new URL('../src/components/TrailDetailModal.tsx', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
  assert.match(detail, /if \(mode === 'transit'\) \{/);
  assert.match(detail, /window\.open\(plan\.segments\[0\]\.url, '_blank', 'noopener,noreferrer'\)/);
  assert.match(detail, /setRoutePlan\(\{ mode, legs: plan\.segments \}\)/);
  assert.match(detail, /routePlan\.legs\.map/);
  assert.match(detail, /Transit directions depend on Google Maps coverage/);
});

test('Four exact approved button labels and per-stop navigation appear in detail UI', () => {
  const detail = readFileSync(new URL('../src/components/TrailDetailModal.tsx', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
  const explore = readFileSync(new URL('../src/components/ExploreTab.tsx', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
  for (const label of ['Chill Walk', 'Cruise To It', 'Hop On', 'Best']) assert.ok(detail.includes(label));
  assert.match(detail, /grid grid-cols-4/);
  assert.match(detail, /Navigate to this stop in Google Maps/);
  assert.match(detail, /Your itinerary needs/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(detail, /FULL TRAIL WALKING ROUTE/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(explore, /handleStartTrailNav/);
